articles.title: Our extinct cousins the Denisovans had a 'distinctive' appearance, new analysis reveals
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: The enigmatic and now-extinct Denisovans of China shared traits with Neanderthals, modern humans and Homo erectus, according to a new study that looked at ancient proteins and fossils. But the Denisovans also had several unique skull traits and genetic variants that made them a distinctive ancient human group, according to the researchers — and these traits have now revealed a new face for a Denisovan man.
paras.zh: 一项对古代蛋白质和化石进行研究的新研究显示，神秘且现已灭绝的中国丹尼索瓦人与尼安德特人、现代人类和直立人有共同特征。但研究人员表示，丹尼索瓦人还拥有一些独特的头骨特征和基因变异，使他们成为一个独特的古代人类群体，而这些特征现在为丹尼索瓦人揭示了一张新面孔。

paras.en: In the study, published Oct. 21 in the journal Nature, researchers analyzed Denisovan skulls from the archaeological site of Xujiayao in northern China. The Denisovans were a group of ancient humans who lived in Asia and disappeared around 30,000 years ago. This human relative was first identified in 2010 from the DNA of a finger bone discovered in a cave in Siberia.
paras.zh: 在10月21日发表在《自然》杂志上的这项研究中，研究人员分析了来自中国北方徐家窑考古遗址的丹尼索瓦人头骨。丹尼索瓦人是一群生活在亚洲的古代人类，大约在 3 万年前就消失了。 2010 年，根据在西伯利亚一个洞穴中发现的指骨 DNA，首次鉴定出这种人类亲戚。

paras.en: The Xujiayao bones and teeth were excavated in the late 1970s, long before scientists knew about the existence of Denisovans, and were initially thought to be either Neanderthals or archaic Homo sapiens due to the shape of the fossils and their age: 138,000 to 199,000 years old.
paras.zh: 徐家窑的骨头和牙齿是在 20 世纪 70 年代末出土的，早在科学家们知道丹尼索瓦人存在之前，由于化石的形状和年龄（138,000 至 199,000 岁），最初被认为是尼安德特人或古代智人。

paras.en: But recent advances in paleoproteomics — the study of bone and tooth proteins that persist longer than DNA — have helped researchers identify Denisovan individuals due to specific genetic variants that differentiate them from other ancient human groups.
paras.zh: 但古蛋白质组学（对比 DNA 存留时间更长的骨骼和牙齿蛋白质的研究）的最新进展帮助研究人员识别了丹尼索瓦人，因为其特定的遗传变异使他们与其他古代人类群体区分开来。

paras.en: In the new study, researchers used paleoproteomic analysis on 20 remains from Xujaiyao and determined that all of them were from Denisovans. This determination then allowed the researchers to study the skull bones closely and figure out what Denisovans might have looked like.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员对徐家窑的 20 具遗骸进行了古蛋白质组学分析，确定它们全部来自丹尼索瓦人。这一决定使研究人员能够仔细研究头骨，并找出丹尼索瓦人可能的样子。

paras.en: The Xujiayao skulls had some features similar to H. erectus, the researchers wrote, including a low and wide braincase and thick cranial bones. But they also had anatomical features more similar to those of Neanderthals and modern humans, particularly in their bicuspids (the teeth between the canines and molars). The researchers also identified some unique Denisovan cranial traits. The back of the skull, for example, was more vertical and less rounded than in Neanderthals or modern humans.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道，徐家窑头骨具有一些与直立人相似的特征，包括低而宽的脑壳和厚厚的颅骨。但他们的解剖学特征也与尼安德特人和现代人类更相似，特别是他们的二尖牙（犬齿和臼齿之间的牙齿）。研究人员还发现了一些独特的丹尼索瓦人颅骨特征。例如，与尼安德特人或现代人类相比，头骨后部更加垂直，不那么圆润。

paras.en: Armed with a better understanding of Denisovan skull shape from the Xujiayao fossils, the researchers compared them with East Asian Denisovan remains that some experts have assigned to other species, such as Homo juluensis and Homo longi. But the researchers identified similarities that may preclude splitting Denisovans into different species.
paras.zh: 通过对徐家窑化石中丹尼索瓦人头骨形状的更好了解，研究人员将其与东亚丹尼索瓦人遗骸进行了比较，一些专家将这些遗骸归为其他物种，例如朱鲁人和长人。但研究人员发现了一些相似之处，这可能会阻止将丹尼索瓦人分成不同的物种。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "This unique combination of morphological traits, distinct from H. erectus, modern humans and Neanderthal-lineage hominins, supports the assignment of most members of East Asian late Middle Pleistocene archaic Homo as Denisovans," they wrote in the study. This means that Denisovans may have been one human lineage that adapted to diverse ecological zones across Asia over hundreds of thousands of years.
paras.zh: 他们在研究中写道：“这种独特的形态特征组合，不同于直立人、现代人类和尼安德特人谱系的古人类，支持将东亚中更新世晚期古人类的大多数成员归为丹尼索瓦人。”这意味着丹尼索瓦人可能是数十万年来适应亚洲不同生态区的人类谱系。

paras.en: - Enigmatic Denisovans lived by cave in what is now China for 100,000 years, rare fossils and handcrafted tools reveal
paras.zh: - 稀有化石和手工工具揭示了神秘的丹尼索瓦人在现在的中国的洞穴里生活了十万年

paras.en: - Denisovan DNA influences the immune systems of modern Oceanians — but researchers aren't sure why
paras.zh: - 丹尼索瓦人 DNA 影响现代大洋洲人的免疫系统——但研究人员不确定原因

paras.en: - 1 million-year-old skull from China holds clues to the origins of Neanderthals, Denisovans and humans
paras.zh: - 来自中国的一百万年前头骨蕴藏着尼安德特人、丹尼索瓦人和人类起源的线索

paras.en: "It is still possible that there are some other lineages that existed in East Asia during the time Denisovans are known to have existed," study co-author Qiaomei Fu, director of the Ancient DNA Laboratory at the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology, part of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、中国科学院古脊椎动物与古人类研究所古代DNA实验室主任付巧梅在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“在已知丹尼索瓦人存在的时期，东亚地区仍有可能存在其他一些谱系。”

paras.en: "We know from DNA that Denisovans were a very varied group genetically, which split early into different populations," Chris Stringer, a paleoanthropologist at the Natural History Museum in London who was not involved in the research, told Live Science in an email. "These could have developed a lot of morphological variation, which may well surprise us as the sample of fossils grows."
paras.zh: “我们从DNA中得知，丹尼索瓦人在基因上是一个非常多样化的群体，他们很早就分裂成不同的种群，”伦敦自然历史博物馆的古人类学家克里斯·斯金格（Chris Stringer）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，他没有参与这项研究。 “这些可能会产生很多形态变化，随着化石样本的增加，这很可能会让我们感到惊讶。”

paras.en: The researchers also produced a new reconstruction of what a Denisovan man might have looked like. A previous DNA study suggested that Denisovans likely had dark skin, brown hair and brown eyes. The new reconstruction shows the Denisovan looking directly at the viewer, with his low, wide braincase mostly obscured by dark hair flowing back from his massive brow ridge. There are clear similarities between the Denisovan man and Neanderthals as well as modern humans, but the Denisovan has a distinct visage all his own.
paras.zh: 研究人员还对丹尼索瓦人的外貌进行了新的重建。之前的一项 DNA 研究表明，丹尼索瓦人可能拥有深色皮肤、棕色头发和棕色眼睛。新的重建显示丹尼索瓦人直视观察者，他低矮而宽阔的脑壳大部分被从巨大眉脊向后流淌的黑发遮住。丹尼索瓦人与尼安德特人以及现代人类之间有明显的相似之处，但丹尼索瓦人有自己独特的面貌。

paras.en: Xing, S., Wu, Z., Shao, Q., Ge, J., Bennett, E. A., Rao, H., Lin, S., Zhao, Y., Liu, F., Liu, Y., Zhou, K., Feng, X., Jiangzuo, Q., & Fu, Q. (2026). The proteome of Middle Pleistocene Xujiayao and common Denisovan morphology. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11132-z
paras.zh: 兴 S.、吴 Z.、邵 Q.、葛 J.、Bennett E. A.、饶 H.、林 S.、赵 Y.、刘 F.、刘 Y.、周 K.、冯 X.、江左 Q. 和付 Q. (2026)。中更新世许家窑蛋白质组及常见丹尼索瓦人形态.自然。 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11132-z

paras.en: See how much you know about early humans with our human evolution quiz!
paras.zh: 通过我们的人类进化测验，看看您对早期人类了解多少！

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: IBD may transform neurons in the gut, triggering pain even when inflammation is under control
articles.author: Theresa Sullivan Barger

paras.en: People with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) experience gut pain that can be severe, and it doesn't always go away when their inflammation is under control and their colonoscopy looks normal. Now, in a new laboratory study, researchers found a previously unknown pain pathway that may explain this phenomenon.
paras.zh: 患有炎症性肠病 (IBD) 的人会经历严重的肠道疼痛，而且当炎症得到控制并且结肠镜检查看起来正常时，这种疼痛并不总是消失。现在，在一项新的实验室研究中，研究人员发现了一种以前未知的疼痛途径，可以解释这种现象。

paras.en: The findings, published Oct. 23 in the journal Science Immunology, also point to a potential way to block that pain.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日发表在《科学免疫学》杂志上的研究结果也指出了一种阻止这种疼痛的潜在方法。

paras.en: "Inflammation in the gut has always been thought of like a fire: the sensory nerves alarm because of the smoke and the heat, and when the fire is put out the alarm should stop," said study co-author Dr. Heng Xu, a physician at Ninth People's Hospital in Shanghai. Xu and his colleagues set out to try to isolate what could be causing the pain even when there's no visible "fire" or "smoke."
paras.zh: “人们一直认为肠道炎症就像一场火灾：感觉神经因烟雾和高温而发出警报，当火被扑灭时，警报就会停止，”该研究的合著者、上海第九人民医院的医生徐恒博士说。即使没有明显的“火”或“烟”，徐和他的同事也开始尝试找出可能引起疼痛的原因。

paras.en: "What we found is that the tissue itself changes consistency," Xu told Live Science in an email. "It becomes stiff and less elastic, a bit like a scar, and that stiffness alone keeps triggering the alarm even after the fire is out."
paras.zh: “我们发现组织本身改变了稠度，”徐在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。 “它变得僵硬且缺乏弹性，有点像疤痕，即使在火被扑灭后，仅凭僵硬就会触发警报。”

paras.en: In ulcerative colitis, the most common form of IBD, inflammation causes ulcers in the gut, as well as symptoms like bloody diarrhea and abdominal cramping. Several medications can help quell this inflammation, but that doesn't necessarily eliminate patients' pain. The researchers wondered if immune cells that live in the gut might contribute to that ongoing pain.
paras.zh: 溃疡性结肠炎是 IBD 最常见的形式，炎症会导致肠道溃疡，以及血性腹泻和腹部绞痛等症状。有几种药物可以帮助缓解这种炎症，但这并不一定能消除患者的疼痛。研究人员想知道肠道中的免疫细胞是否会导致持续的疼痛。

paras.en: They zoomed in on a protein called Piezo1; in immune cells, it's known to play a role in inflammation, and in neurons, it contributes to pain signals. The team looked at whether this protein's activity changed in the context of colitis.
paras.zh: 他们聚焦于一种名为 Piezo1 的蛋白质；在免疫细胞中，它在炎症中发挥作用，在神经元中，它会产生疼痛信号。研究小组研究了这种蛋白质的活性在结肠炎的情况下是否发生变化。

paras.en: "We started with sequencing data that reads cells one at a time, from the gut tissue of patients with ulcerative colitis and from mice with the disease," Xu said. "One cell type stood out: an immune cell that lives permanently in the gut wall, rather than arriving from the bloodstream when there's trouble." The quantity of these cells was higher in colitis than in healthy guts, and the cells carried more Piezo1 than the other cells analyzed.
paras.zh: “我们首先从溃疡性结肠炎患者和患有这种疾病的小鼠的肠道组织中一次读取一个细胞的测序数据，”徐说。 “一种细胞类型脱颖而出：一种永久存在于肠壁中的免疫细胞，而不是在出现问题时从血液中到达。”这些细胞在结肠炎中的数量高于健康肠道中的数量，并且这些细胞比其他分析的细胞携带更多的 Piezo1。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "They sit touching the nerve endings," Xu added.
paras.zh: “他们坐着触动神经末梢，”徐补充道。

paras.en: In several experiments with lab mice with colitis, the team used a probe to press on the gut tissue and measure how hard it was. This showed that, compared with healthy mice, the gut was stiffer in two models of disease: one with visible inflammation and another with almost none.
paras.zh: 在对患有结肠炎的实验室小鼠进行的几项实验中，研究小组使用探针按压肠道组织并测量其硬度。这表明，与健康小鼠相比，两种疾病模型的肠道更加僵硬：一种具有明显的炎症，另一种几乎没有炎症。

paras.en: They also measured pain levels in both sets of mice. "In mice with almost no visible gut inflammation, the pain was still there, which is why a colonoscopy can look normal while the patient hurts," Xu said.
paras.zh: 他们还测量了两组小鼠的疼痛程度。 “在几乎没有明显肠道炎症的小鼠中，疼痛仍然存在，这就是为什么在患者疼痛时结肠镜检查看起来正常，”徐说。

paras.en: They then looked at Piezo1 in both sets of mice. The protein sits in the immune-cell membrane, and when the stiffened tissue around it is pulled or squeezed, it's as if a button were pressed and a channel opens, Xu said. This sets off a chain reaction that leads to pain, Xu said.
paras.zh: 然后他们观察了两组小鼠的 Piezo1。徐说，这种蛋白质位于免疫细胞膜中，当其周围的僵硬组织被拉动或挤压时，就好像按下按钮并打开通道一样。徐说，这会引发连锁反应，导致疼痛。

paras.en: That's because calcium ions rush into the cell via the channel, and that surge sends a protein called NF-kB from the cell's interior fluid into its nucleus — the control center where DNA is stored. There, NF-kB plugs into a gene, ordering the cell to manufacture nerve growth factor (NGF) that then exits the immune cell.
paras.zh: 这是因为钙离子通过通道涌入细胞，这种涌动将一种名为 NF-kB 的蛋白质从细胞内部液体发送到细胞核——储存 DNA 的控制中心。在那里，NF-kB 插入一个基因，命令细胞制造神经生长因子 (NGF)，然后离开免疫细胞。

paras.en: This NGF, which is known to amplify pain signals in the body, interacts with nearby pain-sensing neurons. These nerve endings grow denser and become hypersensitive, which makes ordinary gut activity painful, the study suggests.
paras.zh: 这种 NGF 可以放大体内的疼痛信号，与附近的疼痛感知神经元相互作用。研究表明，这些神经末梢变得更加密集并变得过敏，这使得正常的肠道活动变得痛苦。

paras.en: The researchers used chemicals as on-off switches for Piezo1 in immune cells, opening the channel with one and closing it with another. As they did this, they tracked calcium signals and NGF production, and both rose and fell in step with the switch. This result suggests that Piezo1 activity is both necessary for this response and, on its own, enough to trigger it in these cells, Xu said.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用化学物质作为免疫细胞中 Piezo1 的开关，用一种化学物质打开通道，用另一种化学物质关闭通道。当他们这样做时，他们追踪了钙信号和 NGF 的产生，两者都随着开关的变化而上升和下降。 Xu 说，这一结果表明 Piezo1 活性对于这种反应是必要的，而且其本身足以在这些细胞中触发它。

paras.en: Blocking this chain of events abolished the pain hypersensitivity in both sets of mice. The researchers tried completely removing the Piezo1 gene from the gut immune cells and found that this eliminated the pain. Removing the gene also caused no problems in healthy mice, they noted.
paras.zh: 阻断这一系列事件可以消除两组小鼠的疼痛超敏反应。研究人员尝试从肠道免疫细胞中完全去除 Piezo1 基因，发现这可以消除疼痛。他们指出，去除该基​​因也不会给健康小鼠带来任何问题。

paras.en: The study was "well controlled," said Hongzhen Hu, the scientific director for the Mark Lebwohl Center for Neuroinflammation and Sensation at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, who was not involved in the research. Future research should address the chemical messengers that coordinate inflammation, called cytokines, and determine whether the same chain reaction occurs in human cells, he said in an email.
paras.zh: 西奈山伊坎医学院马克·莱布沃尔神经炎症和感觉中心的科学主任胡洪振（未参与这项研究）表示，这项研究“控制得很好”。他在一封电子邮件中说，未来的研究应该解决协调炎症的化学信使（称为细胞因子），并确定人类细胞中是否发生相同的连锁反应。

paras.en: The mouse experiments also may not reflect long-term, chronic disease in patients, given the mice experienced symptoms only transiently, Xu said.
paras.zh: Xu说，小鼠实验也可能无法反映患者的长期慢性疾病，因为小鼠只经历了短暂的症状。

paras.en: Xu and his colleagues are now aiming to develop a drug that can target Piezo1 to switch off gut pain locally without suppressing the entire immune system. This would be a more targeted treatment than current options, such as immunosuppressants or opioids.
paras.zh: Xu 和他的同事现在的目标是开发一种可以靶向 Piezo1 的药物，在不抑制整个免疫系统的情况下局部消除肠道疼痛。这将是比目前的选择（例如免疫抑制剂或阿片类药物）更具针对性的治疗方法。

paras.en: Other scientists have explored using anti-NGF treatments for other chronic pain conditions but not for ulcerative colitis, Xu noted. Fully blocking NGF might have downsides, he said, since NGF also helps to maintain nerves.
paras.zh: Xu 指出，其他科学家已经探索使用抗 NGF 疗法治疗其他慢性疼痛，但尚未治疗溃疡性结肠炎。他说，完全阻断 NGF 可能有缺点，因为 NGF 也有助于维持神经。

paras.en: So more work is needed to translate these findings into a treatment. But for now, the work sheds new light on how immune cells can detect a physical change — such as tissue becoming stiff — and convert it to a pain signal.
paras.zh: 因此，需要做更多的工作将这些发现转化为治疗方法。但就目前而言，这项工作为免疫细胞如何检测物理变化（例如组织变得僵硬）并将其转化为疼痛信号提供了新的线索。

paras.en: "For the pain field, that's a conceptual shift," Xu said.
paras.zh: “对于疼痛领域来说，这是一个概念上的转变，”徐说。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Wu, L., Shen, T., Wang, Z., Wang, T., Hu, X., Sun, M., Zhang, L., Cheng, Y., Hao, Y., Zhou, L., Lin, M., Bian, J., Feng, J., & Xu, H. (2026). An autonomous macrophage-nociceptor mechanosensory relay drives chronic visceral pain. Science Immunology, 11(124). https://doi.org/10.1126/sciimmunol.aeb3809
paras.zh: 吴L.、沉T.、王Z.、王T.、胡X.、孙明、张L.、程Y.、郝Y.、周L.、林明、卞J.、冯J.和徐H. (2026)。自主巨噬细胞-伤害感受器机械感觉中继驱动慢性内脏疼痛。科学免疫学，11（124）。 https://doi.org/10.1126/sciimmunol.aeb3809

paras.en: Theresa Sullivan Barger is an award-winning freelance journalist who covers health, science, and the environment. Her stories have appeared in The New York Times, The Boston Globe, Los Angeles Times, AARP, CURE, Discover, Family Circle, Health Central, Next Avenue, IEEE Spectrum, Connecticut Magazine, CT Health Investigative Team, and more. Based in central Connecticut, she is an advanced master gardener who is passionate about gardening for wildlife, especially pollinators and songbirds.
paras.zh: Theresa Sullivan Barger 是一位屡获殊荣的自由记者，报道健康、科学和环境问题。她的故事曾发表在《纽约时报》、《波士顿环球报》、《洛杉矶时报》、AARP、CURE、Discover、Family Circle、Health Central、Next Avenue、IEEE Spectrum、康涅狄格杂志、CT Health 调查团队等杂志上。她居住在康涅狄格州中部，是一位高级园艺大师，热衷于野生动物园艺，尤其是传粉媒介和鸣禽。

articles.title: Some Monkeys Seem to Become Germophobic After Living Through a Disease Outbreak, Just Like Humans

paras.en: In early 2020, while humans were sanitizing their groceries and obsessively washing their hands to avoid Covid-19, some Japanese macaques in Texas were dealing with their own outbreak in similar ways. After experiencing the spread of a deadly disease at their sanctuary, the monkeys seemed to become germophobic.
paras.zh: 2020 年初，当人类对食品杂货进行消毒并勤洗手以避免感染 Covid-19 时，德克萨斯州的一些日本猕猴也在以类似的方式应对自己的疫情爆发。在经历了一种致命疾病在保护区的传播后，这些猴子似乎变得有细菌恐惧症。

paras.en: In a study published in the journal Royal Society Open Science on October 21, scientists found that macaques that had experienced the outbreak became more wary of food that appeared contaminated. The findings could help researchers pinpoint the evolutionary origins of disgust, which is at the center of what researchers call the behavioral immune system—a collection of strategies that animals use to evade pathogens.
paras.zh: 10月21日发表在《皇家学会开放科学》杂志上的一项研究中，科学家发现，经历过疫情爆发的猕猴对似乎受到污染的食物变得更加警惕。这些发现可以帮助研究人员查明厌恶的进化起源，这是研究人员所说的行为免疫系统的核心——动物用来逃避病原体的一系列策略。

paras.en: “We can show now, in non-human primates, that this is the same for them,” says study co-author Federico Rossano, a cognitive scientist at the University of California, San Diego, in a statement. “Even with no knowledge of how disease is transmitted, being exposed to others getting sick and dying changes the likelihood of engaging in behaviors that potentially could lead to some form of sickness.”
paras.zh: “我们现在可以证明，在非人类灵长类动物中，这对它们来说是一样的，”研究合著者、加州大学圣地亚哥分校的认知科学家费德里科·罗萨诺在一份声明中说。 “即使不知道疾病是如何传播的，接触其他人生病和死亡也会改变从事可能导致某种形式疾病的行为的可能性。”

paras.en: The study began with an outbreak of simian retrovirus (SRV) among Japanese macaques at the Born Free USA Primate Sanctuary in southern Texas. SRV causes an AIDS-like immunodeficiency and spreads through scratches and bites. Once a monkey is infected via contaminated bodily fluids, the disease “can take a rapid progression, where about three to four weeks after you initially get infected, you might die,” says study co-author Stephan Kaufhold, a cognitive and behavioral scientist at UC San Diego, to Jonathan Lambert at NPR.
paras.zh: 这项研究始于得克萨斯州南部生而自由美国灵长类动物保护区的日本猕猴中爆发了猿猴逆转录病毒（SRV）。 SRV 会导致类似艾滋病的免疫缺陷，并通过抓伤和咬伤传播。研究合著者、加州大学圣地亚哥分校的认知和行为科学家斯蒂芬·考夫霍尔德 (Stephan Kaufhold) 向美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的乔纳森·兰伯特 (Jonathan Lambert) 表示，一旦猴子通过受污染的体液感染，这种疾病“就会迅速发展，在最初感染后大约三到四周，你可能会死亡”。

paras.en: The sanctuary responded to the outbreak by separating, testing and quarantining groups of monkeys. That created four groups: three that experienced the outbreak either by getting sick or witnessing others become ill, and one that hadn’t.
paras.zh: 该保护区通过隔离、测试和隔离猴子群来应对疫情的爆发。这就产生了四组：三组是因为生病或目睹其他人生病而经历了疫情爆发，另一组则没有。

paras.en: To see how those experiences affected the animals, the researchers set up an experiment where the macaques received two plates of grapes, a rare treat. On one plate, a red grape sat on a clean surface, while on the other, a grape sat atop epoxy-coated macaque poop. (Previous research suggests these animals will still eat a high-value snack if it’s presented with poop.)
paras.zh: 为了了解这些经历如何影响这些动物，研究人员进行了一项实验，给猕猴喂了两盘葡萄，这是一种罕见的享受。在一个盘子上，一颗红葡萄放在干净的表面上，而在另一个盘子上，一颗葡萄放在涂有环氧树脂的猕猴粪便上。 （之前的研究表明，如果高价值的零食与粪便一起出现，这些动物仍然会吃它。）

paras.en: They repeated this experiment across nearly 200 successful trials among 55 sanctuary-born monkeys. Animals that experienced the outbreak ate the contaminated grape in 47 percent of trials, whereas those that didn’t experience the outbreak consumed it in 79 percent of trials.
paras.zh: 他们在 55 只保护区出生的猴子中进行了近 200 次成功的试验，重复了这一实验。在 47% 的试验中，经历过疫情爆发的动物食用了受污染的葡萄，而未经历疫情爆发的动物在 79% 的试验中食用了受污染的葡萄。

paras.en: The macaques that lived through the outbreak avoided the contaminated grape more often than those that didn’t witness the illness’ effects, even though they didn’t know how the disease spread. And in the case of SRV, feces has nothing to do with transmission.
paras.zh: 经历过疫情爆发的猕猴比那些没有目睹疾病影响的猕猴更频繁地避开受污染的葡萄，尽管它们不知道这种疾病是如何传播的。就SRV而言，粪便与传播无关。

paras.en: “The monkeys see disease and sick individuals and increase their overall sensitivity, even for a transmission route that is completely unrelated to how the disease actually spreads,” Kaufhold tells Ryan Green at the New York Times. What’s more, monkeys from the exposed groups behaved similarly regardless of whether they had been infected; seeing another individual go through the disease was enough.
paras.zh: 考夫霍尔德告诉《纽约时报》的瑞安·格林：“猴子看到疾病和生病的个体后，它们的整体敏感性就会提高，即使对于与疾病实际传播方式完全无关的传播途径也是如此。”更重要的是，无论是否被感染，暴露组的猴子都会表现出相似的行为。看到另一个人经历这种疾病就足够了。

paras.en: In a different experiment, the researchers tested 54 macaques of multiple species from various backgrounds—sanctuary-born, zoo-born, laboratory-reared animals and former pets—to see how upbringing might influence their behavior. Analyses revealed that former pets were much more likely to eat the contaminated food than sanctuary-born macaques raised by their moms.
paras.zh: 在另一项实验中，研究人员测试了 54 只来自不同背景的多个物种的猕猴——保护区出生的、动物园出生的、实验室饲养的动物和曾经的宠物——以了解成长过程如何影响它们的行为。分析显示，以前的宠物比在保护区出生、由妈妈饲养的猕猴更有可能食用受污染的食物。

paras.en: “One possibility is that these monkeys didn’t have the opportunity to learn typical avoidance behaviors from their mothers and other macaques early in life,” Kaufhold explains in the statement. “Even after living with other monkeys for several years, that early experience may still shape how they respond to potential sources of disease.”
paras.zh: 考夫霍尔德在声明中解释说：“一种可能性是，这些猴子在生命早期没有机会从它们的母亲和其他猕猴那里学习典型的回避行为。” “即使与其他猴子一起生活了几年，早期的经历可能仍然会影响它们对潜在疾病源的反应。”

paras.en: While the study didn’t directly look at disgust, the researchers suspect the animals’ post-outbreak avoidance could have something to do with the emotion. “The possibility that things like disgust are influencing the behavior of other species, and especially species like primates, it’s definitely a possibility worth considering,” says Andrew MacIntosh, a biologist at the Canada-based conservation charity Wilder Institute who wasn’t involved in the study, to NPR.
paras.zh: 虽然这项研究没有直接观察厌恶情绪，但研究人员怀疑动物在疫情爆发后的回避可能与这种情绪有关。加拿大保护慈善机构怀尔德研究所的生物学家安德鲁·麦金托什（Andrew MacIntosh）对美国国家公共广播电台表示：“厌恶等因素可能会影响其他物种，尤其是灵长类动物等物种的行为，这绝对是一种值得考虑的可能性。”他没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: “It seems plausible that past exposure to outbreaks could make individuals more cautious or risk-averse,” he adds, though he would like to see more research to confirm that. Still, one thing is clear: Many of us want to avoid eating a poop-contaminated grape.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“过去接触过疫情可能会让个人更加谨慎或规避风险，这似乎是合理的，”尽管他希望看到更多研究来证实这一点。尽管如此，有一件事是明确的：我们中的许多人都想避免吃被粪便污染的葡萄。

articles.title: Did Women and Children Collaborate With Male Artisans to Create China's Terra-Cotta Army? Fingerprints Left on the 2,000-Year-Old Clay Warriors May Hold the Answer

paras.en: When China’s first emperor, Qin Shi Huang, died in 210 B.C.E., he was buried in style, with an army of some 8,000 terra-cotta warriors assigned to protect him in the afterlife. Forgotten for more than 2,000 years, the towering clay figures were only rediscovered in 1974, when farmers in northwest China stumbled onto them while digging a well. The sculptures are eerily life-like: The artisans who created them carefully carved the soldiers’ hair, eyes, ears, mouths, muscles and attire, ensuring that no individual is identical to another.
paras.zh: 中国第一位皇帝秦始皇于公元前 210 年去世，他的下葬十分隆重，并有一支由约 8000 名兵马俑组成的军队在他的来世保护他。这些高耸的泥人被遗忘了 2000 多年，直到 1974 年才被重新发现，当时中国西北的农民在打井时偶然发现了它们。这些雕塑栩栩如生：制作它们的工匠仔细雕刻了士兵的头发、眼睛、耳朵、嘴巴、肌肉和服装，确保没有一个人是完全相同的。

paras.en: Experts generally agree that the clay soldiers’ torsos were modeled by hand, while their heads and hands were cast from molds. As art historian Wu Hung wrote in the 2003 book Chinese Sculpture, the process began with a rudimentary form crafted from coarse clay, which was then covered with layers of finer clay. Craftspeople carved details into this fine clay, adding touches that lent the figures their unique personalities. To finish the job, workers fired the sculptures, painted them in vivid colors and outfitted them with real weapons. “The distinctive appearance of each statue resulted from assembling a different set of components and from hand-finishing at the final stage,” Wu explained.
paras.zh: 专家普遍认为，泥兵的躯干是手工制作的，而他们的头和手是用模具铸造的。正如艺术史学家巫鸿在 2003 年出版的《中国雕塑》一书中所写的那样，这个过程从用粗粘土制作的基本形式开始，然后覆盖上一层更细的粘土。工匠们在这种精致的粘土上雕刻出细节，并添加一些细节，赋予人物独特的个性。为了完成这项工作，工人们对雕塑进行了烧制，将它们涂上鲜艳的色彩，并为它们配备了真正的武器。 “每座雕像独特的外观都是由一组不同的组件组装而成，并在最后阶段进行手工完成，”吴解释道。

paras.en: Researchers led by Xiaoxi Li, an archaeologist at the Emperor Qin Shi Huang’s Mausoleum Site Museum, have published a new analysis that may call into doubt the long-held assumption that the terra-cotta soldiers were created exclusively by adult men. As the authors write in the Journal of Cultural Heritage, “Our results provide the first biological evidence for a diverse workforce including adult females and juveniles.”
paras.zh: 秦始皇陵博物院考古学家李小西领导的研究人员发表了一项新的分析，可能会对长期以来兵马俑完全由成年男子创造的假设提出质疑。正如作者在《文化遗产杂志》上所写的那样，“我们的研究结果为包括成年女性和青少年在内的多元化劳动力提供了第一个生物学证据。”

paras.en: - Archaeologists have excavated sections of the emperor’s mausoleum, including the outer pits where the Terra-cotta Army was found, but Qin Shi Huang’s tomb remains unopened.
paras.zh: - 考古学家已经挖掘了皇帝陵墓的部分区域，包括发现兵马俑的外坑，但秦始皇陵墓仍未被打开。

paras.en: - Chinese officials have cited concerns about higher-than-anticipated mercury levels at the site, as well as the challenges associated with properly preserving the tomb once it has been exposed to the elements.
paras.zh: - 中国官员表示担心该遗址的汞含量高于预期，以及陵墓暴露在这些元素后如何妥善保存所面临的挑战。

paras.en: To gain a clearer sense of the workforce’s makeup, the team identified 79 well-preserved fingerprints found on 36 warriors. Of these prints, 45 percent appeared to come from adult women, with another 33 percent left by adult men. Juveniles accounted for the final 22 percent. (The paper defines juveniles as those under the age of 15, based on Qin dynasty records that suggest this was “the minimum age of criminal responsibility, as well as the threshold age for forced labor and military service.”)
paras.zh: 为了更清楚地了解劳动力的构成，该团队在 36 名战士身上发现了 79 个保存完好的指纹。在这些指纹中，45% 似乎来自成年女性，另外 33% 是成年男性留下的。青少年占最后的22%。 （该论文将未成年人定义为15岁以下的人，根据秦朝的记录，这表明这是“承担刑事责任的最低年龄，以及强迫劳动和服兵役的门槛年龄。”）

paras.en: Although scientists have long relied on fingerprint analysis to estimate an individual’s age or sex, the study argues that the traditional methods used have clear limitations. These assessments are often based on measurements of mean ridge breadth, or the average distance between raised lines in a fingerprint, and ridge density, which measures the average number of ridges in a set area of the print.
paras.zh: 尽管科学家长期以来一直依靠指纹分析来估计个人的年龄或性别，但该研究认为，使用的传统方法有明显的局限性。这些评估通常基于平均脊宽度（或指纹中凸起线之间的平均距离）和脊密度（测量指纹设定区域中脊的平均数量）的测量。

paras.en: Adult men tend to have more space between fingerprint ridges than their female counterparts, resulting in a lower ridge density—but this pattern doesn’t hold true for adult women and teenage boys, whose prints can be virtually identical. The paper’s authors also point out that conventional methods fail to account for “interpopulation variation and post-firing ceramic shrinkage.”
paras.zh: 成年男性的指纹脊线之间往往比女性指纹脊线之间有更大的空间，导致指纹脊线密度较低，但这种模式不适用于成年女性和十几岁的男孩，他们的指纹几乎是相同的。该论文的作者还指出，传统方法无法解释“群体间差异和烧制后陶瓷收缩”。

paras.en: The team addressed these limitations by using a Bayesian mixture model laid out by a separate group of researchers in a 2023 journal article. “Instead of classifying every print, the method looks at the whole batch,” Guillermo Carvajal writes for La Brújula Verde. “It works a bit like an opinion poll, which cannot know how each person voted but can estimate the result for the group. … It tests many possible mixes of ages and sexes against the measurements, keeps the ones that fit best, and returns ranges of probability instead of certainties.”
paras.zh: 该团队通过使用另一组研究人员在 2023 年期刊文章中提出的贝叶斯混合模型来解决这些局限性。 “该方法不是对每张印刷品进行分类，而是查看整批印刷品，”吉列尔莫·卡瓦哈尔 (Guillermo Carvajal) 为《La Brújula Verde》写道。 “它的工作原理有点像民意调查，它无法知道每个人如何投票，但可以估计该群体的结果……它根据测量值测试许多可能的年龄和性别组合，保留最适合的组合，并返回概率范围而不是确定性。”

paras.en: Although the researchers describe their findings as “compelling, biologically grounded evidence” of their theory, they caution against drawing sweeping conclusions based on the data.
paras.zh: 尽管研究人员将他们的发现描述为他们的理论的“令人信服的、有生物学基础的证据”，但他们警告不要根据数据得出笼统的结论。

paras.en: While 44 percent of the fingerprints were attributed to women, this doesn’t necessarily imply that women made up the same percentage of overall craftspeople. The study’s sample size was relatively small, drawing from just one of three army pits. It’s also possible that a single individual left fingerprints on multiple sculptures. Finally, the authors note that inexperienced workers—probably including women and children—were more likely to leave behind fingerprints than trained artisans, who might have erased such traces after finishing their work.
paras.zh: 虽然 44% 的指纹属于女性，但这并不一定意味着女性在工匠总数中所占的比例相同。该研究的样本量相对较小，仅来自三个军营之一。一个人也有可能在多个雕塑上留下指纹。最后，作者指出，缺乏经验的工人（可能包括妇女和儿童）比受过训练的工匠更有可能留下指纹，后者可能在完成工作后擦除了这些痕迹。

paras.en: Despite these caveats, the researchers note that their analysis lines up with written evidence from Qin dynasty lacquerware found in Hubei Province. Inscriptions on these artifacts include Chinese phrases that translate to “adult woman,” “young woman” and “young boy,” “indicating that women and children participated in lacquer production under state supervision,” the authors write in the study.
paras.zh: 尽管有这些警告，研究人员指出，他们的分析与湖北省发现的秦代漆器的书面证据相符。作者在研究中写道，这些文物上的铭文包括翻译为“成年女性”、“年轻女性”和“年轻男孩”的中文短语，“表明妇女和儿童在国家监督下参与漆器生产”。

paras.en: The sculpted warriors weren’t realistic portraits of real people, but they didn’t conform to standardized types, either. Instead, the figures formed part of a terra-cotta retinue intended to serve Qin Shi Huang after his death. “The goal of the army’s sculptors was to recreate reality by replicating its aspects with as much verisimilitude as possible, given the limits of medium, technique and representational capabilities,” art historian Ladislav Kesner wrote for the Art Bulletin in 1995. “The experience of the authentic world, which a tomb master could ‘believe in,’ can only be sustained if the style is sufficiently transparent.”
paras.zh: 雕刻的武士不是真人的写实肖像，但也不符合标准化类型。相反，这些人物是兵马俑的一部分，旨在在秦始皇死后为他服务。艺术史学家拉迪斯拉夫·凯斯纳 (Ladislav Kesner) 1995 年在《艺术公报》中写道：“考虑到媒介、技术和表现能力的限制，军队雕塑家的目标是通过尽可能真实地复制现实的各个方面来重新创造现实。只有当风格足够透明时，墓主才能‘相信’的真实世界的体验才能得以维持。”

paras.en: In addition to the clay warriors, archaeologists excavating the emperor’s mausoleum have unearthed sculptures of acrobats, civil servants and even waterfowl serenaded by musicians. “We find the underground pits are an imitation of the real organization in the Qin dynasty,” Duan Qingbo, then-head of the mausoleum excavation team, told Smithsonian magazine’s Arthur Lubow in 2009. “People thought when the emperor died, he took just a lot of pottery army soldiers with him. Now they realize he took a whole political system with him.”
paras.zh: 除了泥塑武士之外，考古学家在皇帝陵墓的挖掘中还出土了杂技演员、公务员甚至音乐家演奏的水鸟雕塑。 2009 年，时任秦陵发掘团队负责人的段庆波对《史密森尼》杂志的 Arthur Lubow 表示：“我们发现这些地下墓穴是对秦朝真实组织的模仿。人们认为秦始皇去世时，他只带走了很多陶军士兵。现在他们意识到，他带走了整个政治体系。”

articles.title: 'Lie Down and Look Up' at England's Most Ornate Ceilings, From Sparkling Gold-Leaf Stars to Intricate Plaster Designs at Queen Victoria's Seaside Retreat

paras.en: Historic buildings across England are encouraging visitors to spend some time considering what often goes over their heads: the oft-forgotten art of ceilings.
paras.zh: 英格兰各地的历史建筑鼓励游客花一些时间思考经常被忽视的问题：经常被遗忘的天花板艺术。

paras.en: The conservation charity English Heritage's “Lie Down and Look Up” campaign, which runs through November 1, highlights five distinctive ceilings across the country. In each room, space has been created and cushions provided to help visitors get as comfortable as possible while looking up—supine if they like—and experience details and craftsmanship they otherwise may have neglected.
paras.zh: 保护慈善机构英国遗产基金会的“躺下抬头看”活动将于 11 月 1 日持续，重点介绍了全国各地的五个独特的天花板。每个房间都创造了空间并提供了垫子，以帮助游客在仰视时尽可能舒适（如果他们愿意的话可以仰卧），并体验他们可能忽视的细节和工艺。

paras.en: “Ceilings are often the crowning glory of a historic building. Designed to inspire awe, they can be wonderfully distinctive—with decoration that survives remarkably well,” Jeremy Ashbee, head curator of properties at English Heritage, says in a statement.
paras.zh: “天花板往往是历史建筑的至高无上的荣耀。它们的设计旨在激发敬畏，它们可以非常独特，并且装饰能够​​保存得很好，”英国遗产博物馆的首席策展人杰里米·阿什比（Jeremy Ashbee）在一份声明中说道。

paras.en: “But when visiting a historic place, there’s not always the opportunity to enjoy a splendid ceiling to the fullest,” he adds. “We’re inviting visitors to put formality to one side, make themselves at home, linger, even lie down and enjoy the view up above.”
paras.zh: “但是，当参观历史悠久的地方时，并不总是有机会充分享受华丽的天花板，”他补充道。 “我们邀请游客抛开拘谨，像在家里一样，流连忘返，甚至躺下来欣赏上面的景色。”

paras.en: One brilliant room, the Star Chamber inside Bolsover Castle in Derbyshire, may give visitors the feeling that they’re actually gazing up at the night sky. The room’s name derives from the 254 sparkling gold-leaf stars adoring its teal ceiling, which was originally painted dark blue. Painted wall panels and tapestries depict biblical stories playing out beneath the ceiling’s constellations.
paras.zh: 德比郡博尔索弗城堡内的星室（Star Chamber）是一个明亮的房间，可能会给游客带来一种实际上正在仰望夜空的感觉。该房间的名字源自青色天花板上装饰着 254 颗闪闪发光的金叶星星，天花板最初被漆成深蓝色。彩绘墙板和挂毯描绘了天花板星座下上演的圣经故事。

paras.en: The castle’s creator, William Cavendish, clearly had an eye for decadent ceilings. Painted in 1619, the ceiling of a letter-writing room affectionately called the Heaven Closet shows a swirling scene of Christ’s ascension into heaven surrounded by dozens of cherubs.
paras.zh: 这座城堡的创造者威廉·卡文迪什显然对颓废的天花板有着独到的见解。一间被亲切地称为“天堂壁橱”的写信室的天花板画于 1619 年，描绘了基督升天的旋转场景，周围有数十个小天使。

paras.en: The star-gazing effect is also evident at Northumberland’s Belsay Hall, both a medieval castle and Greek Revival mansion, which was inspired by designer Sir Charles Monck’s time in Greece.
paras.zh: 诺森伯兰郡的贝尔赛大厅 (Belsay Hall) 的观星效果也很明显，它既是一座中世纪城堡，又是一座希腊复兴风格的宅邸，其灵感来自设计师查尔斯·蒙克爵士 (Sir Charles Monck) 在希腊的时光。

paras.en: Built in the early 19th century, Belsay’s New Hall evokes Greek marble temples and offers a connection to the outdoors via a rectangular glass roof.
paras.zh: 贝尔赛的新大厅建于 19 世纪初，让人想起希腊大理石神庙，并通过矩形玻璃屋顶与户外相连。

paras.en: “Obviously our weather isn’t as kind as that of the Mediterranean so [Monck] decided to build a covered courtyard,” Charlotte Woolley, Belsay Hall’s cluster manager, tells the BBC’s Dan Hall.
paras.zh: “显然我们的天气不像地中海那样好，所以蒙克决定建造一个有顶棚的庭院，”贝尔赛霍尔的集群经理夏洛特·伍利 (Charlotte Woolley) 告诉 BBC 的丹·霍尔 (Dan Hall)。

paras.en: Compared to the four other sites featured by English Heritage, which have “quite ornate ceilings,” Woolley says, Belsay is unique for its “stark” design.
paras.zh: 伍利说，与英国遗产中其他四个拥有“相当华丽的天花板”的遗址相比，贝尔赛因其“鲜明”的设计而独一无二。

paras.en: “Rather than looking at the plasterwork or the paintings, you’re really looking at the architecture,” she explains.
paras.zh: “你看到的不是石膏作品或绘画，而是真正的建筑，”她解释道。

paras.en: How have visitors found lying down and looking up at Belsay? “It was a bit of a struggle for me,” David Turner, a 66-year-old visitor to Belsay, tells the BBC. “But once I got down it was just like stargazing.”
paras.zh: 游客们对躺下并仰视贝尔赛有什么感受？ “这对我来说有点困难，”贝尔赛 (Belsay) 的 66 岁游客大卫·特纳 (David Turner) 告诉 BBC。 “但一旦我下来，就像在观星一样。”

paras.en: Plasterwork is the central feature of the Durbar Room at Osborne, the luxurious seaside retreat of Queen Victoria and Prince Albert on the Isle of Wight. The room was originally designed by Rudyard Kipling’s father, Lockwood Kipling, as a banquet hall to honor Victoria’s status as Empress of India.
paras.zh: 石膏制品是奥斯本杜巴厅 (Durbar Room) 的核心特色，奥斯本是维多利亚女王和阿尔伯特亲王在怀特岛的豪华海滨度假胜地。该房间最初是由拉迪亚德·吉卜林 (Rudyard Kipling) 的父亲洛克伍德·吉卜林 (Lockwood Kipling) 设计的，作为宴会厅，以纪念维多利亚作为印度皇后的地位。

paras.en: The room’s walls and ceiling feature ornate plaster designs, overseen by Bhai Ram Singh, a master craftsman at India’s Mayo School of Art. The massive peacock mantlepiece alone took 26 craftsmen some 500 hours of labor to create. The bright white room is framed by dark teak wood accents and features ornate objects gifted to Victoria.
paras.zh: 房间的墙壁和天花板采用华丽的石膏设计，由印度梅奥艺术学院的工匠大师 Bhai Ram Singh 监督。仅这个巨大的孔雀壁炉架就需要 26 名工匠花费约 500 小时的劳动才能制作完成。明亮的白色房间以深色柚木装饰，并配有送给维多利亚的华丽物品。

paras.en: Closer to London, ceiling gazers can view two other distinct artistic styles and epochs. Built in the 1830s, Bedfordshire’s Wrest Park is a French chateau-inspired mansion that was used to film scenes in the Netflix period drama “Bridgerton.” Its drawing room is home to an elaborate ceiling painting of Venus and Cupid flying through the sky.
paras.zh: 距离伦敦较近，天花板上的凝视者可以看到另外两种截然不同的艺术风格和时代。贝德福德郡的莱斯特公园 (Wrest Park) 建于 1830 年代，是一座法国城堡风格的宅邸，曾用于拍摄 Netflix 古装剧《布里奇顿》中的场景。它的客厅里有一幅精美的天花板画，画着维纳斯和丘比特飞过天空。

paras.en: And in southeast London, there is Eltham Palace, a manor with medieval roots that was converted into an “art deco party palace” in the 1930s, according to English Heritage. Eltham was a residence of Edward IV, who oversaw the construction of the site’s Great Hall in the 1470s. There, visitors can lay back and take in its upward-channeling oak hammerbeam roof, which was restored in the early 20th century. During different stages of its history, the wooden space was an indoor tennis court, banquet room and music hall.
paras.zh: 据英国遗产协会称，在伦敦东南部，有埃尔特姆宫 (Eltham Palace)，这是一座具有中世纪根源的庄园，在 20 世纪 30 年代被改造成“装饰艺术派对宫殿”。埃尔特姆是爱德华四世的住所，他在 1470 年代监督了该地点大厅的建设。在那里，游客可以躺下来欣赏其向上延伸的橡木锤梁屋顶，该屋顶于 20 世纪初修复。在其历史的不同阶段，木质空间曾是室内网球场、宴会厅和音乐厅。

paras.en: As the Telegraph’s Nick Trend points out, there are far more than just five spectacular ceilings in Britain “in need of a few cushions or bean bags.” Until then, however, visitors will have to crane their necks to enjoy the nave ceiling of Peterborough Cathedral or the iron and glass roof that spans St. Pancras Station.
paras.zh: 正如《每日电讯报》的 Nick Trend 指出的那样，英国“需要一些垫子或豆袋椅”的远不止五个壮观的天花板。然而，在那之前，游客将不得不伸长脖子欣赏彼得伯勒大教堂的中殿天花板或横跨圣潘克拉斯车站的铁和玻璃屋顶。

paras.en: “Ceilings in historic places are a vital part of the story of the people who lived there and of the buildings themselves,” per the statement. “They might demonstrate the architecture fashions of the period, the wealth and power of the owner or the finest craftsmanship. They are a crucial puzzle piece in the story of the past.”
paras.zh: 声明称：“历史名胜的天花板是居住在那里的人们和建筑物本身故事的重要组成部分。” “它们可能展示了那个时期的建筑时尚、主人的财富和权力或最精湛的工艺。它们是过去故事中至关重要的拼图。”

articles.title: Sony Wants You to Forget About Discs With Its Gorgeous Transparent Controllers
articles.author: Boone Ashworth

paras.en: Sony has a collection of colorful, translucent cosmetics for its PlayStation consoles and controllers. Announced Wednesday, the Prism collection brings three new, gorgeous color options that conjure a nostalgic, transparent tech feel.
paras.zh: 索尼为其 PlayStation 游戏机和控制器提供了一系列色彩缤纷、半透明的化妆品。周三发布的 Prism 系列带来了三种全新的绚丽色彩选择，营造出怀旧、透明的科技感。

paras.en: They come in Flare Orange, Emerald Green, and Graphite Gray. (Based on the pictures, the gray looks more like a blue to me.) You can get Sony’s DualSense PlayStation 5 controllers in the Prism design or opt for PS5 console covers. On the controllers, translucent plastic wraps around almost the entire device’s frame, letting you view the components inside. On the console cover version, the transparency is more limited—you can see only the fan and a few other components.
paras.zh: 它们有耀斑橙色、翠绿色和石墨灰色。 （根据图片，对我来说，灰色看起来更像蓝色。）您可以购买采用 Prism 设计的索尼 DualSense PlayStation 5 控制器，或选择 PS5 主机盖。在控制器上，半透明塑料几乎包裹着整个设备的框架，让您可以看到内部的组件。在控制台盖版本上，透明度更加有限——您只能看到风扇和一些其他组件。

paras.en: The Prism Collection DualSense wireless controllers cost $85, while the console covers cost $75. Preorders start on November 10, but the collection won’t ship until February 4. Those are roughly the same prices as existing controllers and covers, though on the higher end. Basic color controllers start at $74 on the PlayStation website. Covers start around $59. The more colorful options on both products go up from there.
paras.zh: Prism Collection DualSense 无线控制器售价 85 美元，而控制台外壳售价 75 美元。预购于 11 月 10 日开始，但该系列要到 2 月 4 日才会发货。这些价格与现有控制器和外壳大致相同，但价格较高。基本颜色控制器在 PlayStation 网站上的起价为 74 美元。封面起价约为 59 美元。两种产品的更多色彩选项都从那里开始。

paras.en: Apple’s original iMac largely popularized translucent, colorful tech that lets you see inside the machine. The look was en vogue for a while in seminal devices like the PlayStation 2 and Nintendo’s Game Boy Color.
paras.zh: Apple 最初的 iMac 广泛采用了半透明、彩色技术，让您可以看到机器内部。这种外观在 PlayStation 2 和任天堂的 Game Boy Color 等开创性设备中流行了一段时间。

paras.en: That see-through aesthetic was a signature in the early 2000s. (My first CD player had a translucent top, and you could see the disc spinning around the whole time.) Twenty-some years later, it’s being revived as nostalgia bait in a transparent tech renaissance. You can find the transparent look in everything from gaming handhelds to a Theragun. Sony also has a transparent pair of earbuds.
paras.zh: 这种透视美学是 2000 年代初期的标志。 （我的第一台 CD 播放器有一个半透明的顶部，你可以看到光盘一直在旋转。） 二十多年后，它在透明的科技复兴中作为怀旧诱饵而复活。从游戏手持设备到 Theragun，您可以在各种产品中找到透明外观。索尼还有一对透明耳塞。

paras.en: Still, the Prism collection sure looks pretty.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，棱镜系列看起来确实很漂亮。

articles.title: The Inside Story of Why Apple Finally Brought a Touch Display to the Mac
articles.author: Steven Levy

paras.en: It’s a bright day in Cupertino. Apple’s new CEO strolls to an outdoor seating area within the company’s otherworldly ring-shaped headquarters and pulls up a chair. An employee notes the angle and asks if he minds the sun. John Ternus doesn’t mind at all.
paras.zh: 这是库比蒂诺美好的一天。苹果公司的新任首席执行官漫步到公司超凡脱俗的环形总部内的户外座位区，拉了一把椅子。一名员工记下角度并询问他是否介意阳光。约翰·特纳斯一点也不介意。

paras.en: Nearly two months into his tenure, he’s been busy. While the tech world buzzes about AI agents and the upcoming IPO of a company reporting spectacular losses, Ternus’ leadership of a ridiculously profitable firm has so far been defined by a sequence of significant launches—the long-awaited foldable iPhone, a household device that can control digital appliances, new Mac Minis, and AirPods. Intentionally or not, all that activity sends a message that, even as AI dominates the public imagination, hardware products still rule.
paras.zh: 上任近两个月，他一直很忙碌。尽管科技界热议人工智能代理和一家报告巨额亏损的公司即将进行 IPO，但迄今为止，Ternus 对一家盈利惊人的公司的领导地位是由一系列重大发布所决定的——期待已久的可折叠 iPhone、可以控制数字电器的家用设备、新款 Mac Mini 和 AirPods。无论有意还是无意，所有这些活动都传达了一个信息：即使人工智能主导了公众的想象力，硬件产品仍然占据主导地位。

paras.en: Ternus doesn’t endorse that take, but he doesn’t object when I suggest it. “We’ve been working on these products for quite some time,” he says. “It feels like everyone here is just kind of riding high right now, enjoying it.”
paras.zh: 特努斯并不赞同这种做法，但当我提出这个建议时他并没有反对。 “我们开发这些产品已经有一段时间了，”他说。 “感觉这里的每个人现在都在享受它。”

paras.en: I ask if Apple is about to break a long-imposed taboo and introduce a Macintosh with a touch screen.
paras.zh: 我问苹果公司是否会打破长期以来的禁忌，推出带有触摸屏的麦金塔电脑。

paras.en: We are referring to the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display that Apple is releasing today at an event in Los Angeles. It’s got a mighty M5 Pro or M5 Max chip and a show-stopping tandem OLED screen. (A tandem screen has multiple light-emitting layers, producing more dramatic contrasts.) But its most conspicuous feature is one that’s been deeply woven into iPhones, iPads, and even Apple Watches for years but not Apple’s laptops: a touch display. After years of resistance, a Mac screen has finally gone digital. As in fingers.
paras.zh: 我们指的是 Apple 今天在洛杉矶的一次活动中发布的配备 PROLED XDR 显示屏的新款 MacBook Pro。它配备了强大的 M5 Pro 或 M5 Max 芯片和令人惊叹的串联 OLED 屏幕。 （串联屏幕具有多个发光层，产生更引人注目的对比度。）但其最显着的功能是触摸显示屏，多年来一直深深地融入 iPhone、iPad 甚至 Apple Watch 中，但苹果笔记本电脑却没有。经过多年的抵制，Mac 屏幕终于实现了数字化。就像手指一样。

paras.en: This turnaround is a big deal to Apple fans. Ternus shrugs off the drama. “The Mac is first and foremost an indirect input device, built around the trackpad and keyboard. But I think there’s times when it’s comfortable and handy to have touch.”
paras.zh: 对于苹果粉丝来说，这一转变意义重大。特努斯对这出戏不屑一顾。 “Mac 首先是一种间接输入设备，围绕触控板和键盘构建。但我认为有时触摸会舒适且方便。”

paras.en: Ternus and Apple want to make sure that the Mac faithful don’t panic that the 42-year-old franchise is losing its identity to Apple’s gangbusters mobile products. “We needed to get to a point where adding touch didn’t make the product lesser in any way. It didn’t make it heavier. It didn’t make it thicker. That came together with the OLED screen, the best display we’ve ever put into a Mac,” Ternus told me. “All of these things, and, oh yeah, it has touch as well.”
paras.zh: Ternus 和苹果公司希望确保 Mac 忠实用户不会因为这个拥有 42 年历史的特许经营商正在因苹果公司风靡一时的移动产品而失去其身份而感到恐慌。 “我们需要达到这样的程度：添加触摸功能不会以任何方式让产品变得更小。它不会让它变得更重。它不会让它变得更厚。这与 OLED 屏幕结合在一起，这是我们在 Mac 上安装的最好的显示屏，”Ternus 告诉我。 “所有这些东西，而且，哦，是的，它也有触摸。”

paras.en: Apple has a long history of refusing to implement certain desirable features, only to pivot when it feels the time is right. Steve Jobs once proclaimed iPods would never do video, until they did. He also once said “no one’s going to buy” a jumbo-size phone—and then Apple released a supersized iPhone 6. Then there was that time Jobs declared styluses inappropriate for tablets. Now the Apple Pencil works with iPads and the brand-new Duo.
paras.zh: 苹果长期以来一直拒绝实现某些理想的功能，只有在认为时机成熟时才进行调整。史蒂夫·乔布斯曾经宣称 iPod 永远不会播放视频，直到它们做到了。他还曾经说过“没有人会买”大尺寸手机，然后苹果发布了超大尺寸的 iPhone 6。然后，乔布斯曾一度宣称手写笔不适合平板电脑。现在，Apple Pencil 可与 iPad 和全新 Duo 配合使用。

paras.en: The 2026 MacBook Pro instantly qualifies as the canonical example of this switcheroo. Apple executives had been on record regarding touch on PCs as a misbegotten idea. Never mind that just about every PC maker not headquartered in Cupertino has implemented touch on their laptops. And customers of Microsoft, Dell, Acer, Lenovo, and HP have snapped them up. Clearly, people wanted touch on their laptop displays. Even toddlers knew it—put some rugrats in front of a computer and their little arms shoot straight to the screen in futile attempts to swipe and scroll as they do on their iPads. People were baffled why Apple—the pioneer in touch displays since the iPhone—was so steadfast in its rejection.
paras.zh: 2026 款 MacBook Pro 立即成为这种切换的典型例子。苹果高管曾公开表示，个人电脑上的触摸是一个错误的想法。没关系，几乎所有总部不在库比蒂诺的个人电脑制造商都在他们的笔记本电脑上实现了触摸功能。微软、戴尔、宏碁、联想和惠普的客户纷纷抢购它们。显然，人们希望触摸他们的笔记本电脑显示屏。即使是幼儿也知道这一点——把一些小矮人放在电脑前，它们的小手臂会直接伸向屏幕，徒劳地尝试像在 iPad 上那样滑动和滚动。人们感到困惑的是，为什么苹果——自iPhone以来触摸屏领域的先驱——如此坚决地拒绝它。

paras.en: In 2015, while doing a story about a new iMac, I pressed Phil Schiller, then the senior vice president of worldwide product marketing, on this very question. Usually, top Apple executives field such queries with cryptic remarks. In this case, Schiller began a filibuster. “I’m going to get a little bit philosophical,” he said, and launched into what I later described as the Grand Unified Theory of Apple Hardware.
paras.zh: 2015 年，在撰写有关新款 iMac 的报道时，我向时任全球产品营销高级副总裁 Phil Schiller 询问了这个问题。通常，苹果高层管理人员会用含糊其辞的言论来回答此类问题。在这种情况下，席勒开始进行阻挠。 “我要讲一点哲学，”他说，然后开始介绍我后来所说的苹果硬件大统一理论。

paras.en: He explained that every Apple hardware product—the Watch, iPad, iMac, MacBook—is basically a computer and a piece of glass. Each one has a specific function. And each one has an interface appropriate to the hardware. Multitouch is fine for products like the iPhone, he said—but not the Macintosh. He provided two reasons: ergonomics and the software interface.
paras.zh: 他解释说，每一款苹果硬件产品——Watch、iPad、iMac、MacBook——基本上都是一台电脑和一块玻璃。每一项都有特定的功能。每一种都有适合硬件的接口。他说，多点触控适用于 iPhone 等产品，但不适用于 Macintosh。他提供了两个原因：人体工程学和软件界面。

paras.en: “From the ergonomic standpoint, we have studied this pretty extensively, and we believe that on a desktop scenario, where you have a fixed keyboard, having to reach up to do touch interfaces is uncomfortable,” he told me.
paras.zh: “从人体工程学的角度来看，我们对此进行了相当广泛的研究，我们相信在桌面场景中，你有一个固定的键盘，必须伸手去操作触摸界面是不舒服的，”他告诉我。

paras.en: As for the interface, Schiller argued that Apple’s two main operating systems were built on different design principles. The iPhone and iPad’s iOS was multitouch from the get-go, and didn’t use macOS conventions that require precision, such as cursors and tiny boxes to close windows. “These two worlds are different on purpose, and that’s a good thing—we can optimize around the best experience for each of those and not try to mesh them together into a least-common-denominator experience,” he told me.
paras.zh: 至于界面，席勒认为苹果的两个主要操作系统是基于不同的设计原则构建的。 iPhone 和 iPad 的 iOS 从一开始就是多点触控，并且没有使用需要精确度的 macOS 约定，例如光标和用于关闭窗口的小框。 “这两个世界是有意不同的，这是一件好事——我们可以围绕每个世界的最佳体验进行优化，而不是试图将它们融合在一起形成最小公分母的体验，”他告诉我。

paras.en: A year later, when Apple introduced a MacBook Pro with the ill-fated “touch bar”—a dynamic strip of virtual function keys above the keyboard’s top row—Schiller doubled down on the view that touch should never find its way into a Mac display. He said that such a move would mean totally redesigning the menu bar for fingers, and that would clash with the experience of pointer devices like a touchpad or mouse. “You can’t optimize for both,” he said.
paras.zh: 一年后，当苹果推出配备了不幸的“触摸栏”（键盘顶行上方的动态虚拟功能键条）的 MacBook Pro 时，席勒更加坚定地认为触摸永远不应该进入 Mac 显示屏。他表示，此举将意味着完全重新设计手指菜单栏，这将与触摸板或鼠标等指针设备的体验发生冲突。 “你无法同时优化两者，”他说。

paras.en: To double-check this assumption, Apple conducted user tests with touchscreens on Mac. “What the heck, we could be wrong,” Schiller told me then. “We’ve absolutely come away with the belief that it isn’t the right thing to do. Our instincts were correct.”
paras.zh: 为了再次验证这一假设，Apple 在 Mac 上使用触摸屏进行了用户测试。 “管他呢，我们可能是错的，”席勒当时告诉我。 “我们绝对相信这不是正确的做法。我们的直觉是正确的。”

paras.en: When I met with Apple executives Johny Srouji and Greg Joswiak this week to discuss the touchscreen MacBook Pro, you bet I invoked Schiller’s list of concerns. (Apple’s reps chose not to make Schiller, who now holds the title of “Apple Fellow,” available for an interview. In fact, they laughed when I asked.) It wasn’t only Schiller drawing a red line. In 2021, Ternus told journalist Joanna Stern, “The Mac is totally optimized for indirect input. We haven’t really felt a reason to change that.”
paras.zh: 本周，当我与苹果高管 Johny Srouji 和 Greg Joswiak 会面讨论触摸屏 MacBook Pro 时，我肯定引用了席勒的担忧清单。 （苹果公司的代表选择不让现在拥有“苹果院士”头衔的席勒接受采访。事实上，当我提出要求时，他们笑了。）不仅仅是席勒画了一条红线。 2021 年，Ternus 告诉记者 Joanna Stern，“Mac 完全针对间接输入进行了优化。我们还没有真正感觉到有理由改变这一点。”

paras.en: “Ten years is a very, very long time,” says Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer. “Many things have changed, whether it's the display technology, the custom silicon, et cetera.” Eventually, he told me, the confluence of chips, display tech, and software architecture “met our bar.” “I like my engineers to be gated by physics, not imagination or timelines,” he says.
paras.zh: “十年是一段非常非常长的时间，”苹果首席硬件官斯鲁吉说。 “很多事情都发生了变化，无论是显示技术、定制芯片等等。”他告诉我，芯片、显示技术和软件架构的融合最终“达到了我们的标准”。 “我希望我的工程师受到物理的限制，而不是想象力或时间线，”他说。

paras.en: Joswiak, who holds Schiller’s old title of SVP of worldwide marketing, concedes that touch was overdue, at least for users with sophisticated needs. Its pro customers—engineers, scientists, software developers, and media creators—were impatient with Apple for its failure to let them interact directly with the screen. “Most pros own an iPad, and almost every pro owns an iPhone,” Joswiak says. “So this is something that they’re natural with. There’s a generation of young creators and young people using our MacBook Pros that expect to touch.”
paras.zh: 乔斯维亚克（Joswiak）曾担任席勒的全球营销高级副总裁，他承认触摸已经姗姗来迟，至少对于有复杂需求的用户来说是这样。它的专业客户——工程师、科学家、软件开发人员和媒体创作者——对苹果未能让他们直接与屏幕交互感到不耐烦。 “大多数专业人士都拥有 iPad，几乎每个专业人士都拥有 iPhone，”Joswiak 说。 “所以这是他们很自然的事情。有一代年轻的创作者和年轻人使用我们的 MacBook Pro 期望触摸。”

paras.en: Between the lines, Srouji and Joswiak seem to consider their competitors’ touchscreen implementations shabby and lazy. The Apple ethos, as every one of its executives will happily explain to anyone who asks, is an expectation of quality that’s sky-high. “If you’re working on something easy, you’re wasting your time,” says Srouji, who has been at Apple since 2008 and has pretty much driven its innovation by spearheading the company’s charge to custom-build silicon.
paras.zh: 言外之意，Srouji 和 Joswiak 似乎认为竞争对手的触摸屏实现简陋且懒惰。苹果公司的精神，正如苹果公司的每一位高管都会很乐意向任何询问的人解释的那样，是对质量的极高期望。 “如果你正在做一些简单的事情，那么你就是在浪费时间，”Srouji 说，他自 2008 年以来一直在苹果工作，并通过带头负责定制芯片来推动公司的创新。

paras.en: “The easy things, I want to outsource,” he continues. “So the custom silicon is hard. The touch is hard. The display is hard. Everything we build is hard.” This swaggering philosophy dates from the Steve Jobs days and, in 2026, stands in contrast to the endgame of the ascendant AI industry, which hopes to turn over the toughest parts of industrial production to superintelligent entities.
paras.zh: “我想把简单的事情外包，”他继续说道。 “所以定制硅很硬。触感很硬。显示器很硬。我们制造的一切都很硬。”这种趾高气扬的理念可以追溯到史蒂夫·乔布斯时代，到 2026 年，它与方兴未艾的人工智能行业的结局形成鲜明对比，人工智能行业希望将工业生产中最困难的部分移交给超级智能实体。

paras.en: Srouji presents Mac touch as a suite of innovations, starting with that screen that Ternus described as the Mac’s best ever. It also involves custom silicon and a rearchitected thermal system to prevent the display from feeling hot when people pinch, stretch, and swipe on it. Srouji contends that current touchscreen laptops suffer from “wobble” when fingers make contact with the display; to minimize this effect, Apple has redesigned the hinge on the MacBook Pro screen to stabilize it.
paras.zh: Srouji 将 Mac 触控作为一套创新展示，首先是 Ternus 形容为 Mac 有史以来最好的屏幕。它还涉及定制硅和重新架构的散热系统，以防止人们在显示屏上捏、拉伸和滑动时感觉很热。 Srouji 认为，当手指与显示屏接触时，当前的触摸屏笔记本电脑会出现“晃动”现象。为了最大限度地减少这种影响，Apple 重新设计了 MacBook Pro 屏幕上的铰链以使其稳定。

paras.en: When I get a demo of the 16-inch version (as with previous Pros, it’s also available in a 14-inch version), I see what they mean about the display. It’s noticeably dense and bright, and the obsidian blacks are the deepest I’ve seen on a computer screen. In part because the OLED screen doesn’t require backlighting, this MacBook weighs less than its predecessor.
paras.zh: 当我得到 16 英寸版本的演示时（与之前的 Pros 一样，它也有 14 英寸版本），我明白了他们对显示屏的含义。它明显浓密而明亮，黑曜石黑色是我在电脑屏幕上见过的最深的。部分原因是 OLED 屏幕不需要背光，因此这款 MacBook 的重量比其前身更轻。

paras.en: As a pair of Apple managers take the MacBook through its paces, I see how Apple has addressed some of Schiller’s decade-old concerns, like having to redesign the menu bar for fingers. While it looks the same, when you move a finger over a menu item, it expands to allow you to select your choice with precision. Some of the objects on the screen, like the traffic-light buttons that close or hide windows, also get bigger when you touch them.
paras.zh: 当两位苹果经理对 MacBook 进行测试时，我看到苹果是如何解决席勒十年来一直担心的一些问题的，比如必须为手指重新设计菜单栏。虽然看起来相同，但当您将手指移到菜单项上时，它会展开以允许您精确地选择您的选择。屏幕上的一些对象（例如关闭或隐藏窗口的交通灯按钮）在您触摸时也会变大。

paras.en: They show me how the touch tech can handle precision tasks, like color grading in the video editing software DaVinci Resolve, or tweaking a soundtrack on Logic Pro, Apple’s high-end audio workstation. One innovation, not just for pros, is a new gesture to pull down the “Dynamic Island,” that black oval hosting ongoing tasks that has made its way to Mac from iPhone. An expanded version floats on the screen like a widget, enabling easy access to Siri responses and Spotlight search.
paras.zh: 他们向我展示了触摸技术如何处理精确的任务，例如视频编辑软件 DaVinci Resolve 中的颜色分级，或调整 Apple 高端音频工作站 Logic Pro 上的配乐。不仅仅是针对专业人士的一项创新，是一种拉下“动态岛”的新手势，即黑色椭圆形托管正在进行的任务，这些任务已从 iPhone 转移到了 Mac。扩展版本像小部件一样漂浮在屏幕上，可以轻松访问 Siri 响应和 Spotlight 搜索。

paras.en: But what about greasy fingers messing up the screen? I was told that the new display has an anti-reflective outer coating that will require no more cleaning than your normal non-interactive screen.
paras.zh: 但是油腻的手指弄乱了屏幕怎么办？有人告诉我，新显示器具有防反射外涂层，与普通的非交互式屏幕相比，不需要更多的清洁。

paras.en: Apple clearly hopes that the MacBook Pro launch puts an exclamation point on the burst of product announcements that Apple customers are still absorbing. For the foldable Duo, some customers are impatiently waiting for delivery dates that stretch into January. (Lines were long at Apple stores last Friday, when the device went on sale, and Joswiak personally greeted those who queued up at Apple’s Fifth Avenue store in New York City.)
paras.zh: 苹果显然希望 MacBook Pro 的发布能给苹果客户仍在关注的大量产品发布带来一个感叹号。对于可折叠 Duo，一些客户正在不耐烦地等待延至一月的交货日期。 （上周五，当该设备上市时，苹果专卖店里排起了长队，乔斯维亚克亲自向那些在纽约市第五大道苹果专卖店排队的人打招呼。）

paras.en: I ask Srouji whether Apple is making a statement with its armada of new products, maybe as a way to say that in a year dominated by AI obsession, Apple is still here. He responds much as his new boss did, contending that Apple is simply sticking to its game plan. “We’re here to build the most amazing products in the world, and we want to ship them when we believe it’s ready and complete,” says Srouji. “That’s the statement we’re making. I think everyone knows we’re here.”
paras.zh: 我问斯鲁吉，苹果是否正在通过其新产品阵容发表声明，也许是为了表明，在人工智能痴迷主导的一年里，苹果仍然存在。他的反应与他的新老板很相似，认为苹果只是坚持其游戏计划。 “我们来这里是为了制造世界上最令人惊叹的产品，我们希望在我们相信产品已经准备好并完成时发货，”Srouji 说。 “这就是我们要发表的声明。我想每个人都知道我们在这里。”

paras.en: While longtime users will be happy to hear that a Macintosh now has a touchscreen, those with limited budgets will be disappointed. Apple’s current stance—that touch-on-a-Mac display is most appropriate to the “pro” crowd—rationalizes an astronomical price tag: The new MacBook Pro starts at $2,899 for the 14-inch version and $3,399 for the 16-inch model. Financial analyst Neil Cybart, who got an early MacBook Pro briefing, thinks that serious professionals will pay up. “People are in search of value, and that means going for products that leverage technology to improve what they’re doing,” he says.
paras.zh: 虽然长期用户会很高兴听到 Macintosh 现在有触摸屏，但那些预算有限的用户会感到失望。苹果目前的立场——Mac 上的触摸显示屏最适合“专业”人群——合理化了天文数字的价格标签：新款 MacBook Pro 14 英寸版本的起价为 2,899 美元，16 英寸型号的起价为 3,399 美元。金融分析师尼尔·赛巴特（Neil Cybart）在早期听取了 MacBook Pro 简报后认为，认真的专业人士会付出代价。 “人们正在寻找价值，这意味着寻求利用技术来改进他们正在做的事情的产品，”他说。

paras.en: When I ask Ternus about the timeline, or even the possibility, of seeing touch displays on less exorbitantly priced MacBook Airs and iMacs, he shakes his head. “You’ve been doing this a long time,” he says. “You know I will never tell you anything about our future.”
paras.zh: 当我向 Ternus 询问在价格不太昂贵的 MacBook Air 和 iMac 上看到触摸显示屏的时间表，甚至可能性时，他摇了摇头。 “你已经这样做很长时间了，”他说。 “你知道我永远不会告诉你任何关于我们未来的事情。”

paras.en: I don’t know why I bothered to ask. If Ternus said that touch would never happen on a MacBook Air, who would believe him? I’d be back at The Ring a year later, hearing that Apple had finally figured out a way to do it right.
paras.zh: I don’t know why I bothered to ask.如果 Ternus 说 MacBook Air 上永远不会实现触摸，谁会相信他呢？一年后，我回到 The Ring，听说苹果终于找到了正确的方法。

paras.en: Let us know what you think about this article. Submit a letter to the editor at [email protected].
paras.zh: 让我们知道您对这篇文章的看法。通过 [email protected] 向编辑提交一封信。

articles.title: I Put a Bunch of AI Agents in Charge of a Fantasy Soccer Team. They’re Not Better Than Humans—Yet
articles.author: Will Knight

paras.en: I have consulted my AI-powered crystal ball, and it’s telling me that frontier models are going to get a lot better at making predictions in the near future. Just ask my Premier League fantasy team.
paras.zh: 我查阅了我的人工智能水晶球，它告诉我，在不久的将来，前沿模型的预测能力将会大大提高。问问我的英超梦幻球队就知道了。

paras.en: A few weeks ago, I deployed a small horde of AI agents to craft and manage an experimental roster. Given the proliferation of AI agents into pretty much every aspect of our lives, I wanted to know if a swarm of bots could put together a winning team.
paras.zh: 几周前，我部署了一小群人工智能代理来制作和管理实验名册。鉴于人工智能代理已渗透到我们生活的几乎各个方面，我想知道一群机器人是否可以组建一支获胜的团队。

paras.en: I first looked at the potential for AI here a few years ago, playing around with a tool from the UK’s Turing Institute that selected teams after modeling previous fantasy league data. Its suggestions were remarkably bonkers—it didn’t incorporate real-world information, like a player’s injury or a team’s change in management.
paras.zh: 几年前，我第一次看到了人工智能的潜力，使用了英国图灵研究所的一个工具，该工具在对之前的梦幻联赛数据进行建模后选择了球队。它的建议非常疯狂——它没有结合现实世界的信息，比如球员的伤病或球队的管理层变动。

paras.en: This time, while on a flight to visit family, I asked Codex for help. First, I fed the model a couple of relevant research papers. Then, I asked it to build a harness—instructions and code that guides different agents through various steps—that would check recent news and run a model to make predictions.
paras.zh: 这次，在探望家人的航班上，我向 Codex 寻求帮助。首先，我向模型提供了几篇相关的研究论文。然后，我要求它构建一个工具（指导不同代理完成各个步骤的指令和代码），用于检查最近的新闻并运行模型来进行预测。

paras.en: It quickly came up with a setup that seemed to collate and analyze way more information than I ever would have. And yet I was surprised by how dumb the initial team suggestions were. Leaving Erling Haaland on the bench? Really, Codex?
paras.zh: 它很快就想出了一个设置，似乎可以整理和分析比我以前拥有的更多的信息。然而，令我惊讶的是最初的团队建议是多么愚蠢。把埃尔林·哈兰德留在替补席上？真的吗，法典？

paras.en: I then asked Codex to create a team of agents that did different things: several that read news and blog posts; others that analyzed recent results; more that ran models; and a bunch that critiqued suggestions. This seemed to significantly improve the suggestions. I tried increasing the number of agents to more than 100, hoping this would make the system smarter still, but it didn’t change much besides running up my API bill.
paras.zh: 然后，我要求 Codex 创建一个代理团队，负责做不同的事情：几个负责阅读新闻和博客文章；几个负责阅读新闻和博客文章；几个负责执行任务。其他分析最近结果的人；更多运行模型；以及一堆批评建议的人。这似乎显着改善了建议。我尝试将代理数量增加到 100 个以上，希望这能让系统变得更加智能，但除了增加我的 API 账单外，并没有太大变化。

paras.en: Still, the improvement from a few years ago was striking. According to Haifeng Xu, a computer scientist at the University of Chicago who studies the uses of AI in market situations, newer models may be even better at making predictions because they’re able to consume and analyze huge amounts of real-world information, and they’re able to orchestrate more complex systems for their guesses.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，与几年前相比，进步还是惊人的。芝加哥大学计算机科学家徐海峰研究人工智能在市场情况下的应用，他表示，更新的模型可能更擅长做出预测，因为它们能够消费和分析大量的现实世界信息，并且能够为猜测编排更复杂的系统。

paras.en: “AI is just getting smarter in understanding the world—I feel like that's the fundamental reason they’re improving,” Xu tells me.
paras.zh: “人工智能在理解世界方面变得越来越聪明——我觉得这是它们进步的根本原因，”徐告诉我。

paras.en: Late last year, Xu was marveling at the growing popularity of prediction markets like Kalshi and Polymarket. He wondered how the best commercial models might fare on those markets, so alongside several colleagues, he began testing their forecasting skills.
paras.zh: 去年年底，徐对 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 等预测市场的日益普及感到惊讶。他想知道最好的商业模型在这些市场上的表现如何，因此他与几位同事一起开始测试他们的预测技能。

paras.en: They had models guess, for example, who would win the NBA Championship and who President Trump would meet with.
paras.zh: 例如，他们让模型猜测谁将赢得 NBA 总冠军以及特朗普总统将与谁会面。

paras.en: “Very quickly we started to realize that models did really well,” Xu tells me. The models were sometimes able to do better than the average person without any special instructions or guidance, he says. In their testing, GPT-5 was the best at making predictions, followed by Grok 4, Claude Sonnet, Gemini, and Llama.
paras.zh: “很快我们开始意识到模型效果非常好，”徐告诉我。他说，在没有任何特殊指示或指导的情况下，这些模型有时能够比普通人做得更好。在他们的测试中，GPT-5 的预测能力最强，其次是 Grok 4、Claude Sonnet、Gemini 和 Llama。

paras.en: The team went on to develop Prophet Arena, a benchmark that measures a model’s ability to make predictions. It’s one of a number of benchmarks designed to test AI’s future-gazing capabilities; another, Prediction Arena, from researchers at Harvard University and a company called Arcada Labs, recently gave frontier models $10,000 to wager on prediction markets over 57 days. The models consistently lost money in their experiment, but the researchers saw evidence of them improving consistently over time.
paras.zh: 该团队继续开发 Prophet Arena，这是衡量模型预测能力的基准。这是旨在测试人工智能未来展望能力的众多基准之一；哈佛大学的研究人员和一家名为 Arcada Labs 的公司开发的 Prediction Arena 最近向前沿模型提供了 10,000 美元，让其在 57 天内对预测市场进行下注。这些模型在实验中持续亏损，但研究人员发现，有证据表明它们随着时间的推移不断改善。

paras.en: Xu tells me that AI can most effectively make predictions using a custom harness, and notes that having agents with unique tasks—reading the news, collecting other data, and analyzing the whole system, for instance—seems to be the most effective approach.
paras.zh: Xu 告诉我，人工智能可以使用定制工具最有效地进行预测，并指出让代理执行独特的任务（例如阅读新闻、收集其他数据和分析整个系统）似乎是最有效的方法。

paras.en: Interestingly, AI still often lags behind very skilled experts known as superforecasters. Xu explains that, although humans cannot consume as much information, their understanding of the real world—that is, of the dynamics behind a news story—is deeper.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，人工智能仍然常常落后于被称为超级预测者的非常熟练的专家。徐解释说，尽管人类无法消耗那么多信息，但他们对现实世界（即新闻故事背后的动态）的理解更加深刻。

paras.en: That said, there’s growing evidence that the human superforecaster’s edge is eroding. A contest called the Metaculus Cup recently showed that AI can sometimes beat even the best human predictors. And a benchmark called ForecastBench could provide further evidence that AI can match human skills when the results of an ongoing contest conclude soon. In fact, I think we can expect the big labs to turn their attention to future-gazing as a powerful new way to measure progress in machine intelligence.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，越来越多的证据表明人类超级预测者的优势正在减弱。最近一场名为“Metaculus Cup”的竞赛表明，人工智能有时甚至可以击败最好的人类预测者。当正在进行的比赛结果很快结束时，名为 ForecastBench 的基准可以提供进一步的证据，证明人工智能可以与人类技能相媲美。事实上，我认为我们可以期待大型实验室将注意力转向未来展望，以此作为衡量机器智能进展的强大新方法。

paras.en: All of these predictive experiments seem to suggest that, like math, coding, and law, industries predicated on trading may soon be upended by AI. Perhaps the best human traders will take on a new kind of role: supervising and orchestrating AI agents capable of divining the future far better than they can.
paras.zh: 所有这些预测实验似乎都表明，像数学、编码和法律一样，以交易为基础的行业可能很快就会被人工智能颠覆。也许最优秀的人类交易员将扮演一种新的角色：监督和协调能够比他们更好地预测未来的人工智能代理。

paras.en: For the time being, my AI’s suggestions still don’t seem all that impressive. Its team hasn’t outscored the average over the past weeks. I certainly won’t be using any of its suggestions in my own selections.
paras.zh: 就目前而言，我的人工智能的建议似乎还没有那么令人印象深刻。过去几周，其团队的得分并未超过平均水平。我当然不会在自己的选择中使用它的任何建议。

paras.en: But AI will no doubt get better, perhaps making it all too easy to dominate fantasy league pretty soon. I’m kind of hoping it won’t, though, as it would spoil the fun of trying to earn bragging rights by winning all by yourself.
paras.zh: 但人工智能无疑会变得更好，也许很快就会很容易主宰幻想联盟。不过，我有点希望它不会，因为这会破坏通过自己赢得一切来赢得吹牛权利的乐趣。

articles.title: Mexican forces kill cartel leader wanted by U.S. for $5 million

paras.en: Oct. 28 (UPI) -- Mexican naval forces killed cartel operator Jesús González Peñuelas, known as "El Chuy," during an air and ground operation that began Monday in Guasave, Sinaloa, authorities said Wednesday.
paras.zh: 10 月 28 日（合众社）——当局周三称，墨西哥海军于周一在锡那罗亚州瓜萨维开始的空中和地面行动中击毙了贩毒集团主犯赫苏斯·冈萨雷斯·佩努拉斯（Jesús González Peñuelas），绰号“El Chuy”。

paras.en: The suspected drug trafficker was a high-priority target for the U.S. government, which had offered a reward of up to $5 million for his capture.
paras.zh: 这名毒贩嫌疑人是美国政府的高度优先目标，美国政府悬赏高达 500 万美元抓捕他。

paras.en: Mexican Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch confirmed the death in a post on X, saying the confrontation began near the Alfredo V. Bonfil neighborhood in Guasave when naval personnel came under fire from members of a criminal organization and returned fire.
paras.zh: 墨西哥安全部长奥马尔·加西亚·哈富奇 (Omar García Harfuch) 在 X 上的一篇帖子中证实了这起死亡事件，称冲突始于瓜萨韦 (Guasave) 的阿尔弗雷多·邦菲尔 (Alfredo V. Bonfil) 社区附近，当时海军人员遭到犯罪组织成员的射击并进行还击。

paras.en: "During the confrontation, two people were killed, including, according to available information, Jesús González Peñuelas, alias 'Chuy Peñuelas,' one of the operators of the Guasave Cartel," García Harfuch said.
paras.zh: 加西亚·哈富奇说：“在对峙过程中，有两人被杀，其中包括根据现有信息，赫苏斯·冈萨雷斯·佩努埃拉斯（Jesús González Peñuelas），别名‘Chuy Peñuelas’，瓜萨维卡特尔的操纵者之一。”

paras.en: The Guasave Cartel is a criminal organization linked to major factions of the Sinaloa Cartel, one of Mexico's most powerful drug trafficking organizations. González Peñuelas was identified as the group's second-in-command.
paras.zh: 瓜萨维卡特尔是一个犯罪组织，与墨西哥最强大的贩毒组织之一锡那罗亚卡特尔的主要派别有联系。冈萨雷斯·佩努拉斯被确定为该组织的二号人物。

paras.en: García Harfuch said naval personnel seized four stolen vehicles, three long guns, magazines and ammunition during the operation.
paras.zh: 加西亚·哈富奇说，海军人员在行动中缴获了四辆被盗车辆、三把长枪、弹匣和弹药。

paras.en: Authorities turned over the evidence to Mexico's Attorney General's Office for further investigation.
paras.zh: 当局将证据移交给墨西哥总检察长办公室进行进一步调查。

paras.en: The confrontation lasted several hours and extended along rural roads near the communities of Estación Bamoa, Estación Capomas and Siete Ejidos.
paras.zh: 对抗持续了几个小时，并沿着 Estación Bamoa、Estación Capomas 和 Siete Ejidos 社区附近的乡村道路延伸。

paras.en: Facing armed resistance, Mexican naval forces deployed additional ground units and armed helicopters to contain the suspects and confront González Peñuelas' security detail, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局表示，面对武装抵抗，墨西哥海军部署了更多地面部队和武装直升机来遏制嫌疑人并对抗冈萨雷斯·佩努拉斯的安保人员。

paras.en: Another suspected member of the criminal organization, identified as Cesáreo Peñuelas Ruiz, also was killed during the operation.
paras.zh: 该犯罪组织的另一名疑似成员塞萨雷奥·佩努拉斯·鲁伊斯也在行动中被击毙。

paras.en: González Peñuelas, 56, had a long history of alleged involvement in organized crime. He initially worked with the Beltrán Leyva organization before operating independently and developing ties to Los Chapitos and Los Mayos, rival factions associated with the Sinaloa Cartel.
paras.zh: 56 岁的冈萨雷斯·佩努拉斯 (González Peñuelas) 长期被指控参与有组织犯罪。他最初与贝尔特兰·莱瓦组织合作，后来独立运作，并与与锡那罗亚贩毒集团有关联的敌对派系洛斯查皮托斯和洛斯梅约斯建立了联系。

paras.en: His organization allegedly controlled the production of heroin, methamphetamine and counterfeit M-30 fentanyl pills destined for U.S. markets, including California, Texas and Colorado, Excelsior reported.
paras.zh: 据 Excelsior 报道，该组织据称控制了运往美国市场（包括加利福尼亚州、德克萨斯州和科罗拉多州）的海洛因、甲基苯丙胺和假冒 M-30 芬太尼药丸的生产。

paras.en: The U.S. Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control had sanctioned González Peñuelas under the Foreign Narcotics Kingpin Designation Act since 2021.
paras.zh: 自 2021 年以来，美国财政部外国资产控制办公室根据《外国毒枭认定法》对冈萨雷斯·佩努拉斯进行了制裁。

paras.en: U.S. federal authorities had also sought his arrest to face charges related to international opioid trafficking.
paras.zh: 美国联邦当局还寻求逮捕他，以面临与国际阿片类药物贩运有关的指控。

paras.en: García Harfuch said the operation reflected ongoing coordination and intelligence-sharing among Mexico's security agencies as authorities seek to restore security in Sinaloa.
paras.zh: 加西亚·哈富奇表示，此次行动反映了墨西哥安全机构之间在当局寻求恢复锡那罗亚州安全之际正在进行的协调和情报共享。

articles.title: Federal Reserve keeps interest rates unchanged

paras.en: Oct. 28 (UPI) -- As expected, the Federal Open Market Committee kept interest rates unchanged Wednesday in its last meeting before the U.S. midterm elections.
paras.zh: 10月28日（UPI）——正如预期的那样，联邦公开市场委员会周三在美国中期选举前的最后一次会议上维持利率不变。

paras.en: The consumer price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of inflation, increased in September to an annual rate of 3.7%, a four-month high and well above its 2% target. Last month the central bank hiked interest rates by 25 basis points to the 3.75% to 4% target range.
paras.zh: 消费者物价指数（美联储首选的通胀指标）9 月份年率上升至 3.7%，创四个月新高，远高于 2% 的目标。上个月央行将利率加息25个基点至3.75%至4%的目标区间。

paras.en: That was the first rate hike in three years. The decision Wednesday maintains that target range.
paras.zh: 这是三年来的首次加息。周三的决定维持了这一目标范围。

paras.en: Two committee members -- Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack -- dissented from the decision. Both were in favor of increasing rates by a quarter percentage point.
paras.zh: 两名委员会成员——州长丽莎·库克和克利夫兰联储主席贝丝·哈马克——反对这一决定。两人都赞成将利率提高四分之一个百分点。

paras.en: Despite the continued economic pressures on consumers, including elevated gas prices due to the Iran war's strain on the global fuel supply, investors had given a less than 10% chance that the Federal Reserve would increase interest rates Wednesday.
paras.zh: 尽管消费者面临持续的经济压力，包括伊朗战争给全球燃料供应带来压力导致天然气价格上涨，但投资者认为美联储周三加息的可能性不到 10%。

paras.en: "Inflation is still the No. 1 problem in the U.S. economy, and there are a lot of signs it is getting more broad-based," said Heather Long, chief economist at Navy Federal Credit Union. "For consumers, it means really high borrowing costs for the foreseeable future."
paras.zh: 海军联邦信用合作社首席经济学家希瑟·朗表示：“通货膨胀仍然是美国经济的头号问题，而且有很多迹象表明通货膨胀正在变得更加广泛。” “对于消费者来说，这意味着在可预见的未来，借贷成本非常高。”

paras.en: Next week's midterm elections also factor into the central bank's decision, Long said, decreasing the likelihood of a rate hike.
paras.zh: 朗表示，下周的中期选举也会影响央行的决定，从而降低加息的可能性。

paras.en: September's inflation reading was not the only sign that the U.S. economy is struggling. New job hires slowed to 29,000 for the month, down from 162,000 in August.
paras.zh: 九月份的通胀数据并不是美国经济陷入困境的唯一迹象。本月新增就业人数从 8 月份的 162,000 人放缓至 29,000 人。

paras.en: President Donald Trump has long called for the Federal Reserve to lower interest rates, sparring with former Fed chair Jerome Powell with threats of removing him for months.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统长期以来一直呼吁美联储降低利率，数月以来一直与美联储前主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔争吵，威胁要罢免他。

paras.en: The president has continued to call for the Federal Reserve to lower interest rates under current chairman Kevin Warsh, who was appointed by the president in the spring. When the Federal reserve increased interest rates last month, Trump took to social media reiterating his wish for lower rates.
paras.zh: 总统继续呼吁美联储在春季任命的现任主席凯文·沃什的领导下降低利率。当美联储上个月加息时，特朗普在社交媒体上重申了他降低利率的愿望。

paras.en: "LOWER THE INTEREST RATES FOR THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, AND FAST!" Trump said.
paras.zh: “降低美国的利率，而且要快！”特朗普说道。

articles.title: Judge Alvin Hellerstein, who presided over Nicolas Maduro case, dies

paras.en: Oct. 28 (UPI) -- U.S. District Judge Alvin Hellerstein, who was overseeing the case against deposed Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro, has died at 92.
paras.zh: 10 月 28 日（UPI）——负责监督委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗案件的美国地区法官阿尔文·海勒斯坦去世，享年 92 岁。

paras.en: A court spokesperson announced his death Wednesday morning. The Maduro case, and all others Hellerstein was presiding over, will be randomly assigned to other judges.
paras.zh: 周三上午，法庭发言人宣布了他的死亡消息。马杜罗案以及海勒斯坦主持的所有其他案件将被随机分配给其他法官。

paras.en: Hellerstein was appointed to the federal bench in 1998 by President Bill Clinton.
paras.zh: 海勒斯坦于 1998 年被比尔·克林顿总统任命为联邦法官。

paras.en: In recent years, Hellerstein presided over a lawsuit against the Trump administration's efforts to deport immigrants under the Alien Enemies Act with little to no due process.
paras.zh: 近年来，海勒斯坦主持了一场诉讼，反对特朗普政府根据《外国敌人法案》在几乎没有正当程序的情况下驱逐移民。

paras.en: He issued a stern ruling against the administration, stating that the president's use of the law contradicts it, which dictates that those deported be given due process.
paras.zh: 他对政府做出了严厉的裁决，指出总统对法律的使用与法律相矛盾，法律规定那些被驱逐出境的人应受到正当程序。

paras.en: "Conveniently, Respondents fail to mention another section of the AEA that imposes a 'duty' on the federal courts to give a 'full examination and hearing' to the Executive's 'complaint' against the alien, and to order the alien's removal only upon 'sufficient cause appearing,'" he said.
paras.zh: “方便的是，被告没有提及 AEA 的另一部分，该部分规定联邦法院有‘义务’对行政部门针对外国人的‘投诉’进行‘全面审查和听证’，并且只有在‘出现充分理由’时才下令驱逐外国人，”他说。

paras.en: He also blocked Trump's attempts to move his criminal case for hush-money payments to Stormy Daniels to federal court. Hellerstein rejected three of Trump's attempts to do so.
paras.zh: 他还阻止了特朗普试图将向斯托米·丹尼尔斯支付封口费的刑事案件移交联邦法院。海勒斯坦拒绝了特朗普的三项尝试。

paras.en: Hellerstein was a deeply religious Orthodox Jew and was known to hold sentencings on Fridays so he could reflect on his decisions over the Sabbath, The New York Times reported.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，海勒斯坦是一位虔诚的东正教犹太人，众所周知，他会在周五宣判，这样他就可以在安息日反思自己的决定。

paras.en: The judge also oversaw the lawsuit from 9/11 victims against American Airlines and a lawsuit against former movie producer Harvey Weinstein.
paras.zh: 该法官还负责监督 9/11 受害者针对美国航空公司的诉讼以及针对前电影制片人哈维·韦恩斯坦的诉讼。

articles.title: Here’s the latest.
articles.author: Isabel Kershner, Johnatan Reiss, Aaron Boxerman, Qasim Nauman and Leo Sands

paras.en: Israel’s political leaders were poised for weeks of negotiations over the shape of the next government, as initial results on Wednesday showed no clear winner in a tightly fought election that many have described as a make-or-break moment for the country.
paras.zh: 以色列政治领导人准备就下届政府的组建进行数周的谈判，周三的初步结果显示，这场激烈的选举没有明显的赢家，许多人称这场选举是该国的成败时刻。

paras.en: If neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s hard-line alliance nor an opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot win enough seats to form a government, both would need to find support from outside their blocs for backing as prime minister.
paras.zh: 如果本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理的强硬联盟和加迪·艾森科特领导的反对派集团都无法赢得足够的席位来组建政府，那么双方都需要寻求集团之外的支持来担任总理。

paras.en: By Wednesday evening, election officials had counted about 80 percent of ballots. Those votes, alongside exit polls, indicate that neither bloc would reach the 61 seats needed to secure a straightforward majority in the Knesset, Israel’s Parliament.
paras.zh: 截至周三晚上，选举官员已清点了约 80% 的选票。这些投票以及出口民意调查表明，两个阵营都无法获得在以色列议会中获得绝对多数所需的 61 个席位。

paras.en: Some of Mr. Netanyahu’s allies are floating the idea that he could join Mr. Eisenkot and other centrists to form a broad unity government to stay in power. For Mr. Netanyahu, the long-serving prime minister who remains as a caretaker until a government is formed, that would be a comfortable scenario, as long as he remained on top.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的一些盟友提出了这样的想法，即他可以与艾森科特和其他中间派一起组建一个广泛的联合政府以继续掌权。对于长期担任总理、在政府组建之前仍担任看守总理的内塔尼亚胡来说，只要他继续掌权，这将是一个舒适的局面。

paras.en: His primary rival, Mr. Eisenkot, faces a dilemma of his own: He has denounced Mr. Netanyahu as unfit to lead Israel, but he has also objected to partnering with Arab parties in a potential coalition. The two Arab parties are projected to win as many as 17 seats — a remarkable show of strength that could make them Mr. Eisenkot’s only path to toppling Mr. Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 他的主要竞争对手艾森科特也面临着自己的困境：他谴责内塔尼亚胡不适合领导以色列，但他也反对与阿拉伯政党合作组建潜在的联盟。预计这两个阿拉伯政党将赢得多达 17 个席位——这是一次非凡的实力展示，可能使它们成为艾森科特推翻内塔尼亚胡的唯一途径。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Mr. Eisenkot did not explicitly mention the Arab parties and instead pledged to build “a stable Zionist government.”
paras.zh: 周三，艾森科特没有明确提及阿拉伯政党，而是承诺建立“一个稳定的犹太复国主义政府”。

paras.en: Most of the votes were expected to be counted by Wednesday, though the final tally could take days. Lengthy negotiations could follow as political parties try to assemble a governing majority. If those talks fail, the country could head to a second round of elections — a scenario that has played out before. For Mr. Netanyahu, running down the clock in the hope of securing a stronger showing in a fresh election could be his strongest shot at retaining his role as prime minister.
paras.zh: 预计大部分选票将在周三清点完毕，但最终统计可能需要几天时间。随着各政党试图聚集执政多数，接下来可能会进行漫长的谈判。如果这些谈判失败，该国可能会进入第二轮选举——这种情况以前已经上演过。对内塔尼亚胡来说，抓紧时间希望在新的选举中获得更好的表现可能是他保住总理职位的最强机会。

paras.en: The uncertainty did not stop the leading candidates from making triumphant late-night speeches to their supporters.
paras.zh: 这种不确定性并没有阻止主要候选人向他们的支持者发表胜利的深夜演讲。

paras.en: Mr. Eisenkot, a former Israeli military chief of staff, struck a defiant tone toward Mr. Netanyahu, saying: “Tonight we got the answer: The public opted for change.”
paras.zh: 以色列前军事参谋长艾森科特对内塔尼亚胡采取了挑衅的语气，他说：“今晚我们得到了答案：公众选择了变革。”

paras.en: A few hours later, Mr. Netanyahu told supporters that his party, Likud, had emerged as the largest in Israel. “We must form a strong right-wing government,” he said.
