paras.en: “Just because an insurer disagrees doesn’t necessarily mean that it’s not something that’s required or necessary to fix the car right, and then how to support your customer in that situation,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“仅仅因为保险公司不同意，并不一定意味着不需要或不需要正确修理汽车，以及在这种情况下如何为客户提供支持。”

paras.en: Lewis also plans to touch on the right to appraisal and minimum standards for insurer claims handling that took effect earlier this week in Washington. After six years of advocating by the Washington Independent Collision Repair Association (WICRA) for mandatory right to appraisal, Gov. Bob Ferguson signed it into law last year.
paras.zh: 刘易斯还计划讨论本周早些时候在华盛顿生效的评估权和保险公司索赔处理的最低标准。华盛顿独立碰撞修复协会 (WICRA) 六年来一直倡导强制评估权，州长鲍勃·弗格森 (Bob Ferguson) 去年将其签署为法律。

paras.en: While Lewis’s session name mentions the technical side of customer authorization, he said he plans to keep it simple.
paras.zh: 虽然刘易斯的会议名称提到了客户授权的技术方面，但他表示他计划保持简单。

paras.en: “My intention is to make people think, ‘Oh, I’m matching insurance sheets. I shouldn’t be doing that,'” he said. “One of my big things in there is this industry made a change. It went from what’s required to fix the car to what the insurance is willing to pay, and that’s not the right way to address repair requirements. That’s going to be the whole premise: getting the mindset changed from will they pay for it to what’s required and what’s my liability if I don’t do it. What does the OEM say I have to do versus what does the insurance want to indemnify? And then how do I get my customer to authorize what needs to be done, and how do I support that?”
paras.zh: “我的目​​的是让人们思考，‘哦，我正在匹配保险单。我不应该这样做，’”他说。 “我在这个行业所做的一件大事就是这个行业发生了变化。它从修车的要求变成了保险公司愿意支付的费用，这不是解决维修要求的正确方式。这将是整个前提：将心态从他们是否愿意付费转变为需要什么以及如果我不这样做我的责任是什么。OEM 要求我必须做什么，而保险公司想要赔偿什么？然后我如何让我的客户授权需要做什么，我如何支持？”

paras.en: Isaac Aronson’s “Repair Planning That Pays: Protecting Revenue Through Research” session will cover the inconsistencies of collision repair planning from the perspective of front-end research behaviors. Aronson, OEConnection’s product manager, will discuss how those behaviors translate into measurable financial outcomes.
paras.zh: Isaac Aronson 的“付费维修计划：通过研究保护收入”会议将从前端研究行为的角度探讨碰撞维修计划的不一致问题。 OEConnection 的产品经理 Aronson 将讨论这些行为如何转化为可衡量的财务成果。

paras.en: “Modern vehicles require extensive OEM research, conditional procedure evaluation, and calibration consideration before repairs even begin,” the session description states. “Yet inconsistent workflows create supplements, delays, and lost revenue opportunities for performed work.”
paras.zh: “现代车辆在维修开始之前需要进行广泛的 OEM 研究、条件程序评估和校准考虑，”会议描述指出。 “然而，不一致的工作流程会造成工作的补充、延误和收入机会的损失。”

paras.en: Based on patterns across thousands of repair plans, Aronson will identify where breakdowns most commonly occur and how early research decisions influence final profitability, such as including calibration evaluation into a structured workflow.
paras.zh: 根据数千个维修计划的模式，阿伦森将确定最常发生故障的位置以及早期研究决策如何影响最终盈利能力，例如将校准评估纳入结构化工作流程。

paras.en: A panel discussion centered on mechanical repairs will include Steve Dawson, Hunter Engineering regional manager; Todd Hesford, owner of Mission Viejo Auto Collision; Dan Stander, president of Fix Auto Highlands Ranch; Chris Dacus, owner of Dacus Auto Body and Collision Repair; and Gerry McNee, owner of Ultimate Collision Repair.
paras.zh: 以机械维修为中心的小组讨论将包括 Hunter Engineering 区域经理 Steve Dawson；托德·赫斯福德 (Todd Hesford)，Mission Viejo 汽车碰撞公司的所有者；丹·斯坦德 (Dan Stander)，Fix Auto Highlands Ranch 总裁； Chris Dacus，Dacus Auto Body and Collision Repair 所有者；和 Gerry McNee，Ultimate Collision Repair 的所有者。

paras.en: Titled “Bringing Mechanical Repairs In-house,” the session will candidly cover what transitioning to in-house availability entails, according to the session description.
paras.zh: 根据会议描述，该会议的标题为“将机械维修引入内部”，将坦诚地讨论向内部可用性过渡所需的内容。

paras.en: “More collision repair businesses are evaluating whether bringing mechanical work in-house can create new revenue opportunities, improve cycle time, and strengthen control over the repair process,” the description states. “But what does that transition really look like in practice?”
paras.zh: 描述称：“越来越多的碰撞修复企业正在评估将机械工作引入内部是否可以创造新的收入机会、缩短周期时间并加强对修复过程的控制。” “但这种转变在实践中到底是什么样的呢？”

paras.en: SCRS notes that the panelists are from high-performing shops, and they’ll share why they decided to expand into mechanical repairs, how they implemented the change, and what impact it has had on their operations and profitability.
paras.zh: SCRS 指出，小组成员来自高绩效商店，他们将分享为什么决定扩展到机械维修领域、他们如何实施变革，以及变革对他们的运营和盈利能力产生了哪些影响。

paras.en: The sessions above are only part of SCRS’s 2026 SEMA Show education opportunities. SCRS will hold its annual OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, IDEAS Collide Showcase, and more. Learn more about RDE here.
paras.zh: 上述会议只是 SCRS 2026 年 SEMA 展会教育机会的一部分。 SCRS 将举办年度 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会、IDEAS 碰撞展示会等。在此处了解有关 RDE 的更多信息。

paras.en: An SCRS RDE Full Series Pass provides access to Tuesday and Wednesday RDE sessions, IDEAS Collide, the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, and the SCRS Afterparty. To register for the full series pass, click here. Individual sessions are $125 each.
paras.zh: SCRS RDE 全系列通行证可让您参加周二和周三的 RDE 会议、IDEAS Collide、OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会和 SCRS 余兴派对。要注册完整系列通行证，请单击此处。个人会议每次 125 美元。

articles.title: Toyota plans hydrogen-powered commercial trucks launch for 2027
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Toyota Motor North America says its commercial hydrogen-powered trucks will hit the road next year.
paras.zh: 丰田汽车北美公司表示，其商用氢动力卡车将于明年上路。

paras.en: Its Hydrogen Headquarters (H2HQ) division is steadily improving fueling for heavy-duty fuel cell trucks as it works to bring advancements to the OEM’s commercial U.S. fleets, according to a company press release.
paras.zh: 据公司新闻稿称，其氢能总部 (H2HQ) 部门正在稳步改进重型燃料电池卡车的燃料供应，努力为 OEM 的美国商业车队带来进步。

paras.en: Toyota recently installed two mobile hydrogen fueling devices at North American Parts Center California (NAPCC), its largest U.S. parts distribution facility.
paras.zh: 丰田最近在其美国最大的零部件分销设施加州北美零部件中心 (NAPCC) 安装了两台移动加氢设备。

paras.en: With the tanks and fuel in place, Toyota’s commercial logistics fleets plan to use the mobile fuelers to support operations by fueling heavy-duty fuel cell trucks hauling freight from the Port of Los Angeles to Ontario and throughout the region. Toyota plans to build a permanent station on site.
paras.zh: 油箱和燃料到位后，丰田的商业物流车队计划使用移动加油机为从洛杉矶港运输货物到安大略省以及整个地区的重型燃料电池卡车提供燃料，以支持运营。丰田计划在现场建立一个永久车站。

paras.en: The station will initially fuel heavy-duty trucks commissioned through Hyroad Energy and will later integrate heavy-duty trucks with Toyota’s own certified fuel cell powertrain.
paras.zh: 该加油站最初将为 Hyroad Energy 委托的重型卡车提供燃料，随后将重型卡车与丰田自己认证的燃料电池动力系统集成。

paras.en: In a public-private partnership, Toyota is collaborating with the U.S. Department of Energy’s National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) in Golden, Colorado, to research several initiatives, including 70 MPa high-flow hydrogen fueling for heavy-duty trucks.
paras.zh: 通过公私合作，丰田正在与美国能源部位于科罗拉多州戈尔登的落基山脉国家实验室 (NLR) 合作研究多项举措，包括为重型卡车提供 70 MPa 高流量氢燃料。

paras.en: High-flow fueling means trucks can accept hydrogen fuel at speeds about five times faster than conventional light-duty fueling technology, up to 300 grams per second, and allows energy to be brought into heavy-duty trucks equivalent to the speed of a 20 MW fast charger.
paras.zh: 高流量加氢意味着卡车可以以比传统轻型加氢技术快约五倍的速度接受氢燃料，最高可达每秒 300 克，并允许将能量引入重型卡车，其速度相当于 20 兆瓦快速充电器的速度。

paras.en: Refueling times are comparable to modern diesel-powered, heavy-duty trucks. Unlike a diesel powertrain, however, fuel cells emit only water.
paras.zh: 加油时间与现代柴油动力重型卡车相当。然而，与柴油动力系统不同的是，燃料电池仅排放水。

paras.en: Toyota and NLR engineers and researchers have conducted multiple rounds of testing under SAE J2601-5 standards, demonstrating that the OEM’s heavy-duty trucks can be refueled in about 8 minutes for a range of up to 450 miles, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，丰田和 NLR 的工程师和研究人员根据 SAE J2601-5 标准进行了多轮测试，证明该 OEM 的重型卡车可以在大约 8 分钟内加油，行驶里程可达 450 英里。

paras.en: Over the next several months, Toyota says it aims to upgrade its private fueling infrastructure at its H2HQ to the same high-flow standard for testing heavy-duty vehicles. It also plans to install new equipment for light passenger fuel cell electric vehicles in order to evaluate station hardware and share insights intended to improve operations and reliability.
paras.zh: 丰田表示，在接下来的几个月里，其目标是将其总部的私人加油基础设施升级到与测试重型车辆​​相同的高流量标准。它还计划为轻型客运燃料电池电动汽车安装新设备，以评估车站硬件并分享旨在改善运营和可靠性的见解。

paras.en: When the publicly available permanent station at NAPCC goes online, Toyota plans to provide conventional and high-flow hydrogen fueling for heavy-duty trucks, along with a separate area for fueling light-duty vehicles.
paras.zh: 当 NAPCC 的公共永久站上线时，丰田计划为重型卡车提供传统和高流量的氢燃料加注，并为轻型车辆提供单独的燃料加注区域。

paras.en: Toyota continues to develop and refine fuel cell technologies for heavy-duty vehicles, commercial applications, stationary power generation, and light-duty passenger vehicles, including supporting past, current, and future vehicle development.
paras.zh: 丰田继续开发和完善用于重型车辆、商业应用、固定发电和轻型乘用车的燃料电池技术，包括支持过去、当前和未来的车辆开发。

paras.en: General Motors and Stellantis discontinued hydrogen fuel development last year.
paras.zh: 通用汽车和 Stellantis 去年停止了氢燃料开发。

paras.en: In July, Stellantis announced it will discontinue its hydrogen fuel cell technology development program “due to limited availability of hydrogen refueling infrastructure, high capital requirements, and the need for stronger consumer purchasing incentives.” The company said it didn’t anticipate hydrogen-powered light commercial vehicle adoption before the end of the decade.
paras.zh: 7月，Stellantis宣布将停止其氢燃料电池技术开发计划，“由于加氢基础设施有限、资本要求高以及需要更强有力的消费者购买激励措施”。该公司表示，预计在本世纪末之前不会采用氢动力轻型商用车。

paras.en: In October, GM announced it would cease next-generation hydrogen fuel cell development through its Hydrotec brand to focus its research and development and capital resources on batteries, charging technology, and electric vehicles.
paras.zh: 10月，通用汽车宣布将停止通过其Hydrotec品牌进行下一代氢燃料电池开发，将其研发和资本资源集中在电池、充电技术和电动汽车上。

paras.en: In September, Toyota filed a patent application for a hybrid electric vehicle with a hydrogen engine.
paras.zh: 9月，丰田提交了带有氢发动机的混合动力电动汽车的专利申请。

paras.en: The diagram above shows Toyota’s proposed patented arrangement of hydrogen tanks and battery as viewed from below the vehicle.
paras.zh: 上图显示了丰田提出的专利氢罐和电池布置（从车辆下方观察）。

paras.en: According to the patent application, the vehicle would include a center tunnel, hydrogen engine, generator, battery, and hydrogen tank. The generator would provide electric power after receiving it from the hydrogen engine.
paras.zh: 根据专利申请，该车辆将包括中心通道、氢发动机、发电机、电池和氢罐。发电机从氢发动机接收电力后提供电力。

paras.en: Diagram provided in U.S. Patent and Trademark Office patent application 20260274062
paras.zh: 美国专利商标局专利申请 20260274062 中提供的图表

articles.title: Alignment Specs: 2021–Current Ford Mustang Mach-E
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E uses Ford’s Global Electrified 1 (GE1) platform, a heavily reworked version of the automaker’s C2 architecture. The C2 platform also underpins the fourth-generation Ford Focus and third-generation Kuga, as well as the fourth-generation Escape. While the Mach-E shares its platform lineage with these vehicles, GE1 was adapted for an all-electric SUV. That platform connection provides useful context for technicians approaching its suspension and alignment service, while vehicle-specific procedures and specifications remain essential across model years and configurations.
paras.zh: Mustang Mach-E 使用福特的 Global Electrified 1 (GE1) 平台，这是该汽车制造商 C2 架构的经过大量修改的版本。 C2 平台还支持第四代福特福克斯、第三代 Kuga 以及第四代 Escape。虽然 Mach-E 与这些车辆共享其平台血统，但 GE1 适合于全电动 SUV。该平台连接为技术人员提供悬架和定位服务提供了有用的背景，而车辆特定的程序和规范在不同型号年份和配置中仍然至关重要。

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E has adjustable camber and toe at both ends, but an alignment service with this car also calls for attention to the vehicle loading, ride height and driver-assistance systems. The procedures provided in this article are for a 2023 AWD Mach-E, so confirm the specifications and service procedure for the vehicle’s exact model year and configuration before making adjustments. The supplied information does not include numerical alignment specifications or acceptable ride-height ranges.
paras.zh: 野马 Mach-E 两端的外倾角和前束均可调节，但该车的对准服务还需要注意车辆负载、行驶高度和驾驶员辅助系统。本文提供的程序适用于 2023 年 AWD Mach-E，因此在进行调整之前请确认车辆的确切型号年份和配置的规格和维修程序。提供的信息不包括数字对准规范或可接受的行驶高度范围。

paras.en: Before measuring toe, Ford’s procedure calls for a level surface, correct tire pressure, and an inspection for tire wear, damage and suspension wear or damage. The steering wheel must be held straight ahead with a suitable holding device during the toe checks.
paras.zh: 在测量前束之前，福特的程序要求地面平整、轮胎压力正确，并检查轮胎磨损、损坏和悬架磨损或损坏。在检查前束时，必须使用合适的固定装置将方向盘保持在正前方。

paras.en: Ride-height measurement has additional preparation requirements. Position the vehicle on a flat, level surface with tires inflated to the correct pressure. The procedure specifies a full tank of fuel, proper fluid levels and no cargo in the cabin or bed. Inspect for aftermarket equipment and changes to steering, suspension, wheels or tires, then jounce the front and rear suspension vigorously to let the vehicle settle.
paras.zh: 行驶高度测量有额外的准备要求。将车辆放置在平坦的水平表面上，轮胎充气至正确的压力。该程序规定燃油箱已满、液位适当且客舱或床上不得有货物。检查售后设备以及转向、悬架、车轮或轮胎的变化，然后用力摇晃前后悬架，让车辆稳定下来。

paras.en: Remember: Alignment readings are only useful when the vehicle is in the specified condition. If ride height is incorrect, look for changes or problems in the suspension and review the vehicle’s service information before treating alignment adjustments as the solution.
paras.zh: 请记住：对准读数仅在车辆处于指定条件时才有用。如果行驶高度不正确，请查找悬架的变化或问题，并查看车辆的维修信息，然后再将定位调整作为解决方案。

paras.en: If you find that you can’t get the vehicle to roll to carry out the rolling compensation measurements, this is because it has Rollaway Protection Mode that activates when the car is turned off and the driver exits. To enable the car to roll, you will have to leave it on and in neutral during the alignment. In some cases, you might want to attach the driver seatbelt and roll the door latch to prevent it from going into park.
paras.zh: 如果您发现无法让车辆滚动以进行滚动补偿测量，这是因为它具有滚动保护模式，该模式会在汽车关闭且驾驶员退出时激活。为了使汽车能够滚动，您必须在对准过程中将其保持在空档位置。在某些情况下，您可能需要系上驾驶员安全带并滚动门锁以防止其进入停车位。

paras.en: Front camber is adjusted at the strut-to-knuckle connection. First, measure camber with alignment equipment, then remove the wheels and tires. The brake flexible hose is unbolted and moved aside, and the wheel knuckle is supported with mechanic’s wire.
paras.zh: 前外倾角在支柱到转向节的连接处进行调整。首先，用定位设备测量外倾角，然后拆下车轮和轮胎。松开制动软管并移到一边，车轮转向节用机械钢丝支撑。

paras.en: The original strut-to-knuckle bolts and nuts are removed and discarded. Ford specifies new service bolts and nuts for reassembly. The service fasteners are smooth and smaller in diameter than the splined original equipment bolts. With the new fasteners installed and snug, move the knuckle inboard or outboard to bring camber into specification. The procedure states that moving from the maximum inboard to maximum outboard position provides 0.5 degree of adjustment.
paras.zh: 原来的支柱到转向节的螺栓和螺母被拆除并丢弃。福特指定了用于重新组装的新维修螺栓和螺母。维修紧固件光滑且直径小于带花键的原始设备螺栓。安装新的紧固件并使其紧贴后，将转向节向内或向外移动，使外倾角符合规格。该程序规定，从最大内侧位置移动到最大外侧位置可提供 0.5 度的调整。

paras.en: Do not fully tighten the strut-to-knuckle fasteners until camber is corrected. After adjustment, torque the bolts and nuts to 173 lb.-ft. (235 Nm). Reinstall the brake hose and torque its bolt to 97 lb.-in. (11 Nm). Reinstall the wheels and tires, recheck alignment and adjust front toe if needed. Because changing camber can affect toe, finish by verifying the toe readings.
paras.zh: 在外倾角得到纠正之前，请勿完全拧紧支柱至转向节的紧固件。调整后，将螺栓和螺母拧紧至 173 磅英尺。 （235 牛米）。重新安装制动软管并将其螺栓拧紧至 97 磅英寸。 （11 纳米）。重新安装车轮和轮胎，重新检查对准情况并根据需要调整前束。由于改变外倾角会影响前束，因此最后要验证前束读数。

paras.en: Front toe is adjusted at the inner tie rods. With the steering wheel held straight, check toe on both sides. Hold each outer tie-rod end stationary while loosening its jam nut; Ford cautions that allowing the tie-rod end to turn can damage the boot. Move the steering gear boot clamp aside, then rotate the inner tie rod to adjust toe. Do not let the steering gear bellows twist as the inner tie rod turns. Recheck toe after adjustment and road test the vehicle.
paras.zh: 前束通过内横拉杆进行调节。保持方向盘伸直，检查两侧前束。松开锁紧螺母时，保持每个外横拉杆端部固定；福特警告说，让横拉杆末端转动可能会损坏行李箱。将舵机靴夹移到一边，然后旋转内横拉杆调整前束。请勿让转向器波纹管随着内拉杆的转动而扭转。调整后重新检查前束并对车辆进行路试。

paras.en: Rear camber is adjusted by moving the upper control arm at its inboard mounting point. Measure camber, loosen the inboard nut approximately two turns, then slide the control arm inboard or outboard to change the reading. Recheck the alignment to verify the change and adjust rear toe if needed. The supplied procedure lists a torque of 76 lb.-ft. (103 Nm) for the upper control arm inboard nut.
paras.zh: 通过移动内侧安装点的上控制臂来调整后外倾角。测量外倾角，松开内侧螺母大约两圈，然后向内或向外滑动控制臂以更改读数。重新检查对齐情况以验证更改并根据需要调整后束。提供的程序列出了 76 磅-英尺的扭矩。 (103 Nm) 用于上控制臂内侧螺母。

paras.en: Rear toe is adjusted at the toe link. With the steering wheel held straight ahead, measure toe on both sides. Before turning the toe-link bolt, clean the area around the joint using mild liquids. Ford notes that the cam nut and cam bolt area must be free of foreign material for proper clamping. Loosen the toe-link nut approximately one turn, rotate the toe-link bolt to obtain the specified reading, and tighten without disturbing the setting. The procedure lists 66 lb.-ft. (90 Nm) for the toe-link nut.
paras.zh: 后束角在束角处进行调节。将方向盘保持笔直向前，测量两侧的前束角。转动趾连杆螺栓之前，请使用温和的液体清洁接头周围的区域。福特指出，凸轮螺母和凸轮螺栓区域必须没有异物才能正确夹紧。松开趾连杆螺母大约一圈，旋转趾连杆螺栓以获得指定读数，然后在不干扰设置的情况下拧紧。该程序列出了 66 磅英尺。 (90 Nm) 用于趾连杆螺母。

paras.en: If the Mach-E is equipped with Lane Departure Warning, Ford requires an IPMA camera alignment after rear toe adjustment. Connect a scan tool and follow its directions for the camera alignment procedure. Road test after the adjustment and required camera service.
paras.zh: 如果 Mach-E 配备车道偏离警告，福特需要在后束调整后进行 IPMA 摄像头对准。连接扫描工具并按照其说明进行相机对准过程。调整后的路试和所需的相机服务。

paras.en: The supplied ride-height procedure uses a surface gauge to measure from a flat, level surface to suspension reference points. At the front, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm forward bolt and to the center of the ball-joint pinch bolt. Subtract the lower-arm forward-bolt measurement from the ball-joint pinch-bolt measurement to calculate front ride height.
paras.zh: 提供的行驶高度程序使用表面测量仪来测量从平坦的水平表面到悬架参考点的距离。在前面，从表面到下臂前部螺栓的中心以及球形接头压紧螺栓的中心进行测量。从球窝接头压紧螺栓测量值中减去下臂前向螺栓测量值，即可计算前部行驶高度。

paras.en: At the rear, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm-to-subframe bolt and to the center of the lower arm-to-wheel-knuckle bolt. For the rear, subtract the wheel-knuckle-bolt measurement from the subframe-bolt measurement.
paras.zh: 在后部，从表面到下臂到副车架螺栓的中心以及下臂到车轮转向节螺栓的中心进行测量。对于后部，从副车架螺栓测量值中减去车轮转向节螺栓测量值。

paras.en: The service information provided describes how to take these measurements but does not give target ride-height values. Use the correct model-year service information for the vehicle to determine whether the recorded measurements are within specification. Avoid substituting a visual estimate or a generic ride-height value.
paras.zh: 提供的服务信息描述了如何进行这些测量，但没有给出目标行驶高度值。使用车辆的正确型号年份服务信息来确定记录的测量值是否符合规格。避免用视觉估计或通用行驶高度值代替。

paras.en: The vehicle’s service information shows a headlamp level sensor at both the front and rear suspension. The front sensor is mounted at the left front suspension, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. The rear sensor is also mounted at the left side, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. Each has an electrical connector.
paras.zh: 车辆的维修信息显示前悬架和后悬架上都有前照灯水平传感器。前传感器安装在左前悬架上，其臂支架连接到下臂。后传感器也安装在左侧，其臂支架连接到下臂。每个都有一个电连接器。

paras.en: During a suspension or alignment inspection, check that the sensors, brackets, arms and wiring are present and undamaged. The supplied procedure covers sensor removal and installation, but it does not specify an adjustment or calibration following a wheel alignment. If a sensor or its linkage has been disturbed or damaged, consult the correct service information for the required repair steps.
paras.zh: 在悬挂或对准检查期间，检查传感器、支架、臂和接线是否存在且未损坏。提供的程序涵盖了传感器的拆卸和安装，但没有指定车轮定位后的调整或校准。如果传感器或其连杆受到干扰或损坏，请查阅正确的服务信息以了解所需的维修步骤。

articles.title: PRI 2026 Education Program Promises Expert Insights
articles.author: Greg Jones

paras.en: Performance Racing Industry (PRI) will offer a range of educational opportunities at the 2026 PRI Show, Dec. 10-12, at the Indiana Convention Center and Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. The program will cover business strategies, motorsports engineering and career development, with sessions designed for professionals at different stages of their careers.
paras.zh: Performance Racing Industry (PRI) 将于 12 月 10 日至 12 日在印第安纳州会议中心和印第安纳波利斯卢卡斯石油体育场举行的 2026 PRI 展上提供一系列教育机会。该项目将涵盖商业战略、赛车运动工程和职业发展，并为处于职业生涯不同阶段的专业人士设计课程。

paras.en: Friday, Dec. 11, will feature PRI Education sessions addressing key business and technical challenges facing motorsports, including:
paras.zh: 12 月 11 日星期五，将举办 PRI 教育会议，解决赛车运动面临的关键业务和技术挑战，包括：

paras.en: - Using Tribology to Find Extra Horsepower (9 a.m.): Peter Lee of Southwest Research Institute and Lake Speed Jr. of SPEEDiagnostix will explain how reducing friction can improve engine and drivetrain performance.
paras.zh: - 利用摩擦学寻找额外马力（上午 9 点）：西南研究所的 Peter Lee 和 SPEEDiagnostix 的 Lake Speed Jr. 将解释减少摩擦如何提高发动机和传动系统的性能。

paras.en: - State of the Racing Market (11 a.m.): PRI Director of Market Research Gavin Knapp will discuss new research on industry performance, market conditions and business expectations.
paras.zh: - 赛马市场状况（上午 11 点）：PRI 市场研究总监 Gavin Knapp 将讨论有关行业绩效、市场状况和业务预期的新研究。

paras.en: - How a Culture Can Cure Your Crew Needs (1 p.m.): Tom Shay of Profits Plus Solutions will share strategies for attracting employees, improving retention and building a stronger workplace culture.
paras.zh: - 文化如何满足您的员工需求（下午 1 点）：Profits Plus Solutions 的 Tom Shay 将分享吸引员工、提高保留率和建立更强大的工作场所文化的策略。

paras.en: - Using AI for Sponsorships (3 p.m.): Alex Striler of SponsorshipTactics.com will explore how racers can use artificial intelligence to strengthen their sponsorship programs.
paras.zh: - 使用人工智能进行赞助（下午 3 点）：SponsorshipTactics.com 的 Alex Striler 将探讨赛车手如何使用人工智能来加强他们的赞助计划。

paras.en: The inaugural PRI Motorsports Engineering Symposium will expand the PRI Show’s educational offerings Thursday, Dec. 10, with technical discussions on simulation, powertrain development, materials, manufacturing and workforce development. The program will feature experts from IndyCar, Purdue University and Motor State Distributing and is open to all registered PRI Show attendees at no additional cost.
paras.zh: 首届 PRI 赛车运动工程研讨会将于 12 月 10 日星期四扩大 PRI Show 的教育内容，包括有关模拟、动力总成开发、材料、制造和劳动力发展的技术讨论。该计划将邀请来自 IndyCar、普渡大学和 Motor State Distributing 的专家参加，并向所有注册 PRI Show 与会者开放，无需支付额外费用。

paras.en: New for 2026, NextGen Connect presented by Carlyle Tools will help students and young adults explore motorsports careers through educational sessions, networking, resume reviews and career guidance. The program will also feature daily Lunch & Learn sessions covering professional branding, apprenticeships and internships, and career paths in motorsports. The NextGen Connect Breakfast on Saturday, Dec. 12, will feature a keynote address from Hendrick Motorsports Director of Technical Partnerships Alba Colon.
paras.zh: Carlyle Tools 推出的 2026 年新产品 NextGen Connect 将通过教育课程、网络、简历审查和职业指导帮助学生和年轻人探索赛车运动职业。该计划还将提供每日午餐和学习课程，内容涵盖专业品牌、学徒和实习以及赛车运动的职业道路。 12 月 12 日星期六，NextGen Connect 早餐会由 Hendrick Motorsports 技术合作总监 Alba Colon 发表主题演讲。

paras.en: To register and learn more, visit PRI2026.com/Attend. PRI membership is no longer required to attend. For more information, visit PerformanceRacing.com.
paras.zh: 要注册并了解更多信息，请访问 PRI2026.com/Atend。 PRI 会员不再需要参加。欲了解更多信息，请访问 PerformanceRacing.com。

articles.title: Automotive Parts Headquarters Raises $513K for WACOSA
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Automotive Parts Headquarters Inc. (APH), together with its supplier partners and the Bartlett family, raised $513,000 through its annual fundraiser benefiting WACOSA, a central Minnesota nonprofit serving adults with disabilities. The 2026 event brings the fundraiser’s 14-year total to $3.7 million.
paras.zh: Automotive Parts Headhead Inc. (APH) 与其供应商合作伙伴和 Bartlett 家族一起，通过其年度筹款活动筹集了 513,000 美元，惠及 WACOSA，这是一家为残疾人服务的明尼苏达州中部非营利组织。 2026 年的活动使该活动 14 年来的筹款总额达到 370 万美元。

paras.en: Proceeds support WACOSA programs that provide meaningful employment, day services and opportunities for more than 650 adults with disabilities across central Minnesota.
paras.zh: 收益将用于支持 WACOSA 项目，为明尼苏达州中部地区 650 多名残疾成年人提供有意义的就业、日间服务和机会。

paras.en: The event began with a walleye shore lunch and guided tours of WACOSA before attendees gathered at APH’s newest facility (a bulk storage warehouse) in St. Cloud for a pie and ice cream social celebrating its grand opening and APH’s “Building Our Future Together” initiative.
paras.zh: 活动以白眼鱼岸边午餐和 WCOSA 导游带领开始，然后与会者聚集在 APH 位于圣克劳德的最新设施（散装仓储仓库），参加馅饼和冰淇淋社交活动，庆祝其盛大开业和 APH 的“共创未来”倡议。

paras.en: Attendees also participated in a hands-on art experience led by WACOSA artist-in-residence Dan Mondloch. The individual pieces created during the event will be incorporated into a collaborative collage inspired by the northern lights above a Minnesota lake.
paras.zh: 与会者还参加了由 WACOSA 驻场艺术家 Dan Mondloch 主持的艺术实践体验。活动期间创作的个人作品将被纳入灵感来自明尼苏达州湖上北极光的合作拼贴画中。

paras.en: “The day captured so much of what makes this event special,” said Jason Vogel, president of APH Stores Inc. “Bringing our supplier partners, employees and friends together to experience WACOSA’s mission firsthand, celebrate a new chapter for APH and create something together was incredibly rewarding.”
paras.zh: APH Stores Inc. 总裁杰森·沃格尔 (Jason Vogel) 表示：“这一天体现了本次活动的特别之处。将我们的供应商合作伙伴、员工和朋友聚集在一起，亲身体验 WACOSA 的使命、庆祝 APH 翻开新篇章并共同创造一些东西，这是令人难以置信的回报。”

paras.en: The day concluded with a cocktail reception, lobster-themed dinner and awards ceremony hosted by John and Nancy Bartlett at their home. A highlight of the evening was the presentation of a $513,000 check to Nancy Betts, executive director of WACOSA.
paras.zh: 约翰·巴特利特 (John Bartlett) 和南希·巴特利特 (Nancy Bartlett) 在他们家中举办了鸡尾酒会、龙虾主题晚宴和颁奖典礼，结束了这一天。当晚的一大亮点是向WACOSA 执行董事Nancy Betts 赠送了一张513,000 美元的支票。

paras.en: “Fourteen years of support from APH, its supplier partners and the Bartlett family has created a remarkable legacy for the people we serve,” Betts said. “This generosity creates opportunities for people to discover their strengths, contribute to their communities and pursue greater independence. We are deeply grateful for the lasting difference this partnership makes.”
paras.zh: “APH、其供应商合作伙伴和 Bartlett 家族十四年的支持为我们服务的人们创造了非凡的遗产，”贝茨说。 “这种慷慨为人们创造了发现自己的优势、为社区做出贡献并追求更大独立的机会。我们对这种伙伴关系所带来的持久影响深表感谢。”

paras.en: Corey Bartlett, CEO and owner of APH, said the event reflects the generosity and commitment of the automotive aftermarket community.
paras.zh: APH 首席执行官兼所有者科里·巴特利特 (Corey Bartlett) 表示，此次活动体现了汽车售后市场社区的慷慨和承诺。

paras.en: “Every year, this event reminds us of the extraordinary generosity within the automotive aftermarket,” Bartlett said. “What began as a fundraiser has grown into a lasting partnership between APH, our supplier community and WACOSA. Seeing everyone come together to support the people and mission at the heart of WACOSA is what makes this event so meaningful.”
paras.zh: “每年，这一活动都会提醒我们汽车售后市场的非凡慷慨，”巴特利特说。 “最初的筹款活动现已发展成为 APH、我们的供应商社区和 WACOSA 之间的持久合作伙伴关系。看到每个人齐心协力支持 WACOSA 的人民和使命，这使得这次活动如此有意义。”

paras.en: To view highlights from this year’s event, including the celebration, collaborative art project and messages from industry leaders, visit https://vimeo.com/autopartshq/wacosa26.
paras.zh: 要查看今年活动的亮点，包括庆祝活动、合作艺术项目和行业领袖的信息，请访问 https://vimeo.com/autopartshq/wacosa26。

articles.title: Audi Matrix LED Headlights
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: LED headlights are changing the role of forward illumination. Before LEDs, forward lighting was just a bulb that cast its light in a pattern defined by the housing. Most of the innovation came with incandescent, halogen and Xenon bulbs. But light-emitting diodes (LEDs) are really a game changer for designers, engineers and technicians.
paras.zh: LED 车头灯正在改变前方照明的作用。在 LED 出现之前，前向照明只是一个灯泡，它按照外壳定义的模式投射光线。大多数创新来自白炽灯、卤素灯和氙气灯泡。但发光二极管 (LED) 确实改变了设计师、工程师和技术人员的游戏规则。

paras.en: LED lights offer increased functionality by being able to control the brightness and pattern almost instantaneously. This is the case with Audi’s Matrix LED headlights found on the A8 and some E-Tron models. With these headlights, just the high-beam unit itself is made up of 25 individual segments. The small light-emitting diodes, which work in conjunction with lenses and reflectors connected in series, are activated and deactivated or dimmed individually according to the situation. This enables the system to react precisely to other cars, which it recognizes using a camera, and always illuminates the road brightly. Additional features of the new headlights are the intelligent cornering light, new-look daytime running lights and dynamic turn signals. The Audi Matrix LED headlights get the information they need from a camera, the navigation system and other sensors.
paras.zh: LED 灯几乎可以即时控制亮度和图案，从而提供了更多功能。 A8 和一些 E-Tron 车型上的奥迪矩阵 LED 车头灯就是这种情况。对于这些车头灯，仅远光灯单元本身就由 25 个单独的部分组成。小型发光二极管与串联的透镜和反射器一起工作，根据情况单独激活、关闭或变暗。这使得系统能够对使用摄像头识别的其他车辆做出精确反应，并始终明亮地照亮道路。新型车头灯的附加功能包括智能转弯灯、新外观日间行车灯和动态转向灯。奥迪矩阵 LED 车头灯从摄像头、导航系统和其他传感器获取所需的信息。

paras.en: Composed of 1.3 million micromirrors per headlight, the units operate like movie projectors, emitting tiny unique particles or adaptable light. This is done with electrostatically controlled micromirrors that can adjust light beam pixels up to 5,000 times per second.
paras.zh: 每个车头灯由 130 万个微镜组成，这些装置的运行方式类似于电影放映机，发射微小的独特粒子或适应性强的光。这是通过静电控制的微镜完成的，该微镜每秒可以调整光束像素高达 5,000 次。

paras.en: This lighting technology offers a selection of five different welcome/leaving animations when the vehicle is parked, each with unique motion graphics and text selected through the vehicle’s touchscreen display.
paras.zh: 当车辆停放时，该照明技术提供五种不同的欢迎/离开动画选择，每种动画都具有通过车辆触摸屏显示屏选择的独特动态图形和文本。

paras.en: Audi’s lighting technology provides drivers with a 50-meter “light carpet” that is designed to keep light within the driver’s lane and extends the carpet left or right when changing lanes, and helps to avoid a “blinding” effect for oncoming traffic. Low-beam curved lighting bends below oncoming traffic, helping to illuminate people or objects on the side of the road that are otherwise difficult to detect. And on-ground light arrows help place the vehicle’s tires within its lane.
paras.zh: 奥迪的照明技术为驾驶员提供了50米长的“光地毯”，旨在将光线保持在驾驶员车道内，并在变道时向左或向右延伸光地毯，有助于避免对迎面驶来的车辆产生“致盲”效果。近光弧形照明在迎面驶来的车辆下方弯曲，有助于照亮路边难以察觉的人或物体。地面光箭头有助于将车辆的轮胎放置在车道内。

paras.en: Early versions from 2020 in the U.S. lacked functions of the light carpet due to antiquated headlight laws that forbid adaptive lighting. Previously, the system could only show logos during startup and shutdown. On recent models, most of the European functionality has been enabled due to changes in headlight laws and adaptive lighting.
paras.zh: 由于过时的前灯法律禁止自适应照明，美国 2020 年的早期版本缺乏灯毯功能。此前，系统只能在启动和关闭时显示徽标。在最近的车型上，由于前灯法规和自适应照明的变化，大部分欧洲功能已启用。

paras.en: The good news is that the LED segments and lighting elements are expected to last the lifetime of the vehicle. But the units are sealed, and individual components inside can’t be serviced. The complete headlight assembly may cost in excess of $6,000 to replace.
paras.zh: 好消息是 LED 段和照明元件预计可持续车辆的使用寿命。但这些装置是密封的，内部的单个组件无法维修。更换整个车头灯组件的成本可能超过 6,000 美元。

paras.en: The units are deeply integrated with the ADAS systems of the vehicle, including the Pre-Sense systems for automatic emergency braking. Having a scan tool that can talk to the ADAS system’s modules is critical. The ability to program replacement is also vital. Audi has issued several updates over the air and in new calibrations from the service information website.
paras.zh: 这些单元与车辆的 ADAS 系统深度集成，包括用于自动紧急制动的 Pre-Sense 系统。拥有一个可以与 ADAS 系统模块对话的扫描工具至关重要。编程替换的能力也至关重要。奥迪通过无线方式发布了多项更新，并通过服务信息网站进行了新的校准。

paras.en: The headlights are aimed and calibrated using a dynamic self-learning procedure that uses the forward-facing camera. If the camera is out of calibration, the headlights might not be aimed properly.
paras.zh: 前灯通过使用前向摄像头的动态自学习程序进行瞄准和校准。如果摄像头未校准，前灯可能无法正确瞄准。

articles.title: Timing BMW VANOS N53 And N54
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The BMW N53 (naturally aspirated) and N54 (turbocharged) engines were among the first BMW engines to come with variable valve timing on the intake and exhaust camshafts. The N53 and N54 straight-six have unfairly earned a bad reputation for reliability with technicians due to timing chain and variable valve timing problems. The reputation comes from owners not keeping up with oil changes and it is difficult to check engine timing.
paras.zh: BMW N53（自然吸气）和 N54（涡轮增压）发动机是首批在进气和排气凸轮轴上配备可变气门正时的 BMW 发动机。由于正时链条和可变气门正时问题，N53 和 N54 直列六缸发动机在可靠性方面赢得了技术人员的坏名声。这种声誉来自于车主不及时更换机油，并且很难检查发动机正时。

paras.en: The latest versions continuously adjust the position of the intake and exhaust camshafts for better power, efficiency and idle performance. The keyword to remember for a late-model VANOS system is that it works “continuously,” and not just under specific RPM ranges.
paras.zh: 最新版本不断调整进气和排气凸轮轴的位置，以获得更好的动力、效率和怠速性能。对于最新型号的 VANOS 系统，要记住的关键词是它“连续”工作，而不仅仅是在特定的转速范围内工作。

paras.en: To service them, you will need the appropriate toolset to lock the crank and camshaft. You will also need a scan tool and scope to observe the crankshaft and camshaft signals to accomplish more advanced diagnostics.
paras.zh: 要维修它们，您将需要适当的工具组来锁定曲柄和凸轮轴。您还需要扫描工具和示波器来观察曲轴和凸轮轴信号，以完成更高级的诊断。

paras.en: Some newer systems can change the camshaft timing by as much as ±72 degrees. Dual-VANOS systems operate at all engine speeds. At lower engine speeds, the VANOS system opens the valves later during the intake stroke, increasing the vacuum and scavenging effect generated by the piston traveling downward in the cylinder. This improves idle quality and smooth power tip-in from a stop. As the engine rpm increases, the valves are opened earlier, enhancing torque as rpm increases. At higher engine speeds, the valves open later for full power delivery so the scavenging effect of the exhaust leaving the cylinder can pull more air into the cylinder. Hot rodders call this “valve overlap.”
paras.zh: 一些较新的系统可以将凸轮轴正时改变多达 ±72 度。双 VANOS 系统可在所有发动机转速下运行。在发动机转速较低时，VANOS 系统会在进气冲程期间稍后打开气门，从而增加活塞在气缸中向下运动所产生的真空和扫气效果。这提高了怠速质量并在停车时平稳地提供动力。随着发动机转速的增加，阀门会提前打开，从而随着转速的增加而增强扭矩。在发动机转速较高时，气门稍后打开以提供全部动力，因此离开气缸的废气的扫气作用可以将更多空气吸入气缸。热棒爱好者称之为“气门重叠”。

paras.en: The system can augment and even eliminate the EGR valve by allowing some of the exhaust gas to remain in the combustion chamber to control combustion temperatures and NOX emissions.
paras.zh: 该系统可以通过允许部分废气保留在燃烧室中来控制燃烧温度和氮氧化物排放，从而增强甚至消除 EGR 阀。

paras.en: Also, the camshaft position is changed to reduce engine warm-up times by allowing some unburned fuel to reach the catalytic converters. When the VANOS system on the N53 and N54 is not working, the most common symptoms are poor idle quality, reduced power and poor fuel economy. These symptoms are common to any other variable valve timing system, as well.
paras.zh: 此外，凸轮轴位置发生变化，通过允许一些未燃烧的燃料到达催化转化器来减少发动机预热时间。当N53和N54上的VANOS系统不工作时，最常见的症状是怠速质量差、动力下降和燃油经济性差。这些症状对于任何其他可变气门正时系统也很常见。

paras.en: Like many variable valve timing systems, VANOS uses oil pressure-powered actuators to move the camshafts. The actuators need a consistent supply of oil for the correct viscosity, pressure and volume.
paras.zh: 与许多可变气门正时系统一样，VANOS 使用油压驱动的执行器来移动凸轮轴。执行器需要持续供应油，以获得正确的粘度、压力和体积。

paras.en: The N53 and N54 use a conventional cam phaser with internal chambers that hold pressurized oil that changes the position of the camshaft.
paras.zh: N53 和 N54 使用传统的凸轮相位器，其内腔可容纳可改变凸轮轴位置的加压油。

paras.en: BMW N53 and N54 use an oil control valve like a lot of other variable valve timing engines. The solenoid is actuated by a pulse-width modulated signal.
paras.zh: 与许多其他可变气门正时发动机一样，BMW N53 和 N54 使用油控制阀。螺线管由脉宽调制信号驱动。

paras.en: If the oil is contaminated or is the wrong viscosity, the system can become sluggish. If the oil pressure can’t move the camshafts to the target positions in a specified time, the camshaft position sensors will sense it and set a code.
paras.zh: 如果油被污染或粘度错误，系统可能会变得缓慢。如果油压无法在指定时间内将凸轮轴移动到目标位置，凸轮轴位置传感器将感应到并设置一个代码。

paras.en: When oil pressure is not present, the camshafts go to a fully retarded position and are locked in place by a pin. A code will be set if the actuator and camshaft do not return to the correct position, because they are hydraulically jammed due to oil pressure leaking past a seal.
paras.zh: 当不存在油压时，凸轮轴进入完全延迟位置并通过销锁定到位。如果执行器和凸轮轴由于油压通过密封件泄漏而被液压卡住，因此无法返回到正确位置，则会设置一个代码。

paras.en: Disconnect the oil control valve if you are trying to scope a crankshaft and camshaft waveform. If this is not done, the waveform might look like the timing is out of sync because the engine will be adjusting the camshafts.
paras.zh: 如果您尝试观察曲轴和凸轮轴波形，请断开油控制阀。如果不这样做，波形可能看起来像是正时不同步，因为发动机将调整凸轮轴。

paras.en: What Goes Wrong With N53 And N54 VANOS Systems?
paras.zh: N53 和 N54 VANOS 系统出了什么问题？

paras.en: The two most common failures for a VANOS system are related to the quality of the oil. The most common failure is when the O-ring seal on the piston wears out and allows oil pressure to move between the two chambers. This causes the actuator to be stuck or hydraulically jammed in either the full advance or retard positions.
paras.zh: VANOS 系统最常见的两个故障与油的质量有关。最常见的故障是活塞上的 O 形密封圈磨损并导致油压在两个腔室之间移动。这会导致执行器卡在或液压卡在完全提前或延迟位置。

paras.en: When this happens, the actuator can’t fight the pressure exerted on the camshaft by the valve springs. This can cause a rattling noise at startup and idle.
paras.zh: 发生这种情况时，执行器无法抵抗气门弹簧施加在凸轮轴上的压力。这可能会导致启动和闲置时发出嘎嘎声。

paras.en: If the oil is the wrong viscosity, it can cause the corrections to either retard or advance – in other words, to lag or happen too quickly. These changes take place in milliseconds. Depending on your scan tool and whether you can pull BMW DME or OBDII codes, the description may include the words jammed, stiff or lagging.
paras.zh: 如果油的粘度不正确，可能会导致修正延迟或提前——换句话说，滞后或发生得太快。这些变化发生在几毫秒内。根据您的扫描工具以及是否可以提取 BMW DME 或 OBDII 代码，描述可能包括“卡住”、“僵硬”或“滞后”等字样。

paras.en: The engine will factor in the oil and coolant temperature into the time allowed for the actuation. If you have any codes related to these sensors, you might want to resolve these issues before troubleshooting the VANOS system.
paras.zh: 发动机会将机油和冷却液温度考虑到允许的致动时间中。如果您有与这些传感器相关的任何代码，您可能需要在对 VANOS 系统进行故障排除之前解决这些问题。

paras.en: Remind your customers that the quality of the oil in both engines matters to the life of their timing chains. BMW recommends a high-quality 5W-30 or 5W-40 that is fully synthetic and meets the BMW Longlife-01 FE specifications. These oils are formulated around the extended oil change interval. When a low-quality oil is used, it can break down before the oil change interval and accelerate wear on the links and pins of the timing chain.
paras.zh: 提醒您的客户，两台发动机中的机油质量对其正时链的使用寿命至关重要。 BMW 推荐使用高品质的全合成 5W-30 或 5W-40，且符合 BMW Longlife-01 FE 规格。这些油是围绕延长换油间隔而配制的。当使用劣质机油时，它可能会在换油间隔之前发生故障，并加速正时链条的链节和销的磨损。

articles.title: Read ShopOwner’s October Digital Edition Now
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: The interactive and easy-to-use digital edition of ShopOwner’s October issue is available now.
paras.zh: ShopOwner 十月号的交互式且易于使用的数字版现已推出。

paras.en: What happens when some of North America’s best automotive technicians gather in Detroit to compete for the title of 2026 Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper Technician of the Year? There are challenging diagnostic exercises, timed competitions and plenty of pressure, but something even more interesting emerges: camaraderie, mutual respect and a shared passion for solving problems. From military veterans and former electronics technicians to third-generation automotive professionals, this year’s finalists demonstrate that there’s no single road to success in the automotive service industry. Ultimately, Matt Wagg of Accelerated Diagnostic & Automotive in Bennington, NE, earned the U.S. championship, while Jake McKie and Roberto Chávez Chairez claimed the Canadian and Latin American honors.
paras.zh: 当北美一些最优秀的汽车技术人员齐聚底特律，争夺 2026 年汽车价值和年度最佳技术人员称号时，会发生什么？这里有具有挑战性的诊断练习、定时竞赛和巨大的压力，但更有趣的东西出现了：友情、相互尊重和解决问题的共同热情。从退伍军人、前电子技术人员到第三代汽车专业人士，今年的决赛入围者证明，汽车服务行业没有单一的成功之路。最终，内布拉斯加州本宁顿 Accelerated Diagnostic & Automotive 公司的 Matt Wagg 赢得了美国冠军，而 Jake McKie 和 Roberto Chávez Chairez 则获得了加拿大和拉丁美洲的荣誉。

paras.en: But the real story goes well beyond the winners. Through candid conversations with the finalists, a powerful message emerges about mentorship, ongoing training, professional pride and the importance of recognizing technicians for the work they do every day. Their experiences offer valuable lessons for shop owners looking to develop and retain great employees while building stronger businesses. Read the complete article to meet these outstanding professionals, discover the people and experiences that shaped their careers, and learn why the greatest reward of this competition may have nothing to do with taking home a trophy.
paras.zh: 但真实的故事远远超出了获胜者的范围。通过与决赛入围者的坦诚对话，关于指导、持续培训、职业自豪感以及认可技术人员日常工作的重要性的强有力的信息浮现出来。他们的经验为希望培养和留住优秀员工、同时打造更强大企业的店主提供了宝贵的经验教训。阅读完整的文章来认识这些杰出的专业人士，了解塑造他们职业生涯的人物和经历，并了解为什么本次比赛的最大奖励可能与带回家奖杯无关。

paras.en: PLUS, you’ll find Tech Tips, new products, editorial commentary and technical content from ImportCar Brake & Front End, Underhood Service, TechShop and Tire Review, all ShopOwner channels.
paras.zh: 另外，您还可以找到来自 ImportCar Brake & Front End、Underhood Service、TechShop 和 Tire Review 以及所有 ShopOwner 频道的技术提示、新产品、编辑评论和技术内容。

articles.title: Recalling The Brake Rotor Wars of the Early 2000s
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Last year, Chinese and Turkish brake drum manufacturers were hit with antidumping duties for selling some trailer brake drums in the United States at less than fair market value. The news gave me flashbacks to the light-vehicle rotor market 25 years ago, when I first started working on Brake & Front End magazine.
paras.zh: 去年，中国和土耳其制动鼓制造商因以低于公平市场价格的价格在美国销售部分拖车制动鼓而受到反倾销税打击。这个消息让我回想起 25 年前的轻型车辆转子市场，当时我第一次开始为《Brake & Front End》杂志工作。

paras.en: In the early 2000s, shops faced brake pedal pulsation comebacks for several reasons. Some people might call it a perfect storm.
paras.zh: 2000 年代初，由于多种原因，商店面临制动踏板脉动卷土重来的问题。有些人可能称之为完美风暴。

paras.en: Facing new fuel-efficiency standards, OEMs began removing mass from brake rotors. Vehicles such as the Jeep Cherokee and Chevrolet Malibu used “composite” rotor designs with stamped-steel hats cast into iron friction rings. These rotors would develop lateral runout if the lug nuts were tightened even slightly unevenly.
paras.zh: 面对新的燃油效率标准，原始设备制造商开始减轻制动盘的重量。吉普切诺基和雪佛兰马里布等车辆采用“复合”转子设计，将冲压钢帽铸入铁摩擦环中。如果凸耳螺母拧紧得稍微不均匀，这些转子就会产生横向跳动。

paras.en: Some rotor manufacturers introduced one-piece replacements for these composite applications, but wheel-stud length was always a concern. Because the cast hats were thicker, the studs sometimes did not extend far enough beyond the rotor flange to properly secure the wheel. Some aftermarket brake companies even offered longer wheel-stud kits.
paras.zh: 一些转子制造商为这些复合材料应用推出了一体式替代品，但轮螺柱长度始终是一个问题。由于铸帽较厚，螺柱有时无法延伸到转子法兰之外足够远以正确固定车轮。一些售后制动公司甚至提供更长的车轮螺柱套件。

paras.en: This period also marked the infancy of ceramic brake pad formulations. Most OE friction materials at the start of the transition process were semi-metallic or aggressive non-asbestos organic (NAO) compounds that could contribute to disc thickness variation when even a small amounts of runout were present. Ceramic formulations were being rolled out that on new OE platforms and as aftermarket alternatives. They can be credited, at least in part, with extending rotor life and reducing incidents of brake pedal pulsation.
paras.zh: 这一时期也标志着陶瓷刹车片配方的起步阶段。大多数原厂摩擦材料在过渡过程开始时都是半金属或侵蚀性非石棉有机 (NAO) 化合物，即使存在少量跳动，也会导致摩擦盘厚度变化。陶瓷配方正在新的原厂平台上推出，并作为售后市场的替代品。它们至少可以部分归功于延长转子寿命和减少制动踏板脉动事件。

paras.en: What I remember most was the debate surrounding replacement brake rotors. In the late 1990s, “offshore manufacturers” were selling brake rotors at prices well below fair market value. By 2006, the federal government had begun investigating the situation and imposed antidumping duties on certain imports.
paras.zh: 我印象最深刻的是围绕更换制动盘的争论。 20 世纪 90 年代末，“离岸制造商”以远低于公平市场价值的价格销售制动盘。 2006年，联邦政府开始调查这一情况并对某些进口产品征收反倾销税。

paras.en: Within the aftermarket, some brake brands alleged that these inexpensive rotors were unsafe. Their main argument was that manufacturers were reducing rotor weight by making the friction plates thinner and failing to match the original fin design. I remember several press events that highlighted these design differences. I also remember phone calls from other rotor manufacturers arguing that the practice was acceptable because OE rotors were designed with an “eight-times” safety margin.
paras.zh: 在售后市场，一些刹车品牌声称这些廉价的转子不安全。他们的主要论点是，制造商通过使摩擦片更薄来减轻转子重量，并且未能匹配原始的翅片设计。我记得有几次新闻发布会强调了这些设计差异。我还记得其他转子制造商打来的电话，他们认为这种做法是可以接受的，因为原厂转子的设计具有“八倍”的安全裕度。

paras.en: The lasting effect of these events were on technicians and repair shops. Replacement brake rotors became so inexpensive that installing new ones often cost less than the labor required to machine the originals. The economics allowed shops to recommend new rotors with increasing frequency, based on the rationale that replacement produced a more reliable, comeback-free brake job.
paras.zh: 这些事件对技术人员和维修店产生了持久影响。更换制动盘变得如此便宜，以至于安装新制动盘的成本通常低于加工原始制动盘所需的劳动力。从经济角度考虑，商店可以越来越频繁地推荐新的转子，其理由是更换可以带来更可靠、无复发的制动效果。

paras.en: This replacement mindset even prompted California’s Bureau of Automotive Repair to conduct a sting investigation in 2010 targeting shops that recommended new rotors without first measuring the thickness of the existing ones.
paras.zh: 这种更换心态甚至促使加州汽车维修局在 2010 年针对那些在没有先测量现有转子厚度的情况下推荐新转子的商店进行了一项诱捕调查。

paras.en: Like it or not, we have been spoiled by inexpensive brake rotors over the past 20 years. Their availability permanently changed how some technicians and shops service brake systems. Today, it is not uncommon for technicians to recommend new rotors regardless of whether the existing rotors remain within specification, based on the economics.
paras.zh: 不管你喜欢与否，在过去的 20 年里，我们已经被廉价的制动盘宠坏了。它们的可用性永久地改变了一些技术人员和商店维修制动系统的方式。如今，技术人员根据经济性推荐新转子，无论现有转子是否符合规格，这种情况并不罕见。

paras.en: The market, however, is always changing. Vehicle brake systems have improved, and modern friction formulations have extended rotor life through better ceramic transfer-layer developments. OEMs have also increased the size and mass of many brake rotors to improve braking performance, manage heat and control noise.
paras.zh: 然而，市场总是在变化。车辆制动系统得到了改进，现代摩擦配方通过更好的陶瓷转移层开发延长了转子寿命。原始设备制造商还增加了许多制动盘的尺寸和质量，以提高制动性能、管理热量和控制噪音。

paras.en: On the parts side, replacement rotor prices have increased because of higher transportation costs, inflation, tariffs and other market pressures. Rotors have also become more sophisticated, incorporating improved hat and heat-dam designs. Coatings and treatments such as ferritic nitrocarburizing have further increased the price of replacement rotors.
paras.zh: 在零部件方面，由于运输成本上升、通货膨胀、关税和其他市场压力，更换转子的价格有所上涨。转子也变得更加复杂，采用了改进的帽子和热坝设计。铁素体氮碳共渗等涂层和处理进一步提高了更换转子的价格。

paras.en: In my opinion, we are approaching another perfect storm. As replacement rotor prices rise and original brake rotors become more durable, the economics of replacement versus machining are beginning to converge on some brake jobs—especially when shops compare labor and parts costs while accounting for the rotor’s discard dimension.
paras.zh: 在我看来，我们正在接近另一场完美风暴。随着更换转子价格的上涨和原装制动转子变得更加耐用，更换与加工的经济性开始集中在一些制动作业上，特别是当商店在考虑转子报废尺寸的同时比较劳动力和零件成本时。

paras.en: As an industry veteran who survived the rotor wars, I see this as a win-win for repair shops. On the labor side, machining rotors can be a profitable again. On the parts side, selling a higher-value replacement rotor can generate more gross-profit dollars.
paras.zh: 作为一名在转子战争中幸存下来的行业资深人士，我认为这对于维修店来说是双赢的。在劳动力方面，加工转子可以再次盈利。在零件方面，销售更高价值的替换转子可以产生更多的毛利润。

paras.en: It may be time to dust off your micrometers and tune up your brake lathes.
paras.zh: 也许是时候掸去千分尺上的灰尘并调整刹车车床了。

articles.title: Alignment Specs: 2021–Current Ford Mustang Mach-E
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E uses Ford’s Global Electrified 1 (GE1) platform, a heavily reworked version of the automaker’s C2 architecture. The C2 platform also underpins the fourth-generation Ford Focus and third-generation Kuga, as well as the fourth-generation Escape. While the Mach-E shares its platform lineage with these vehicles, GE1 was adapted for an all-electric SUV. That platform connection provides useful context for technicians approaching its suspension and alignment service, while vehicle-specific procedures and specifications remain essential across model years and configurations.
paras.zh: Mustang Mach-E 使用福特的 Global Electrified 1 (GE1) 平台，这是该汽车制造商 C2 架构的经过大量修改的版本。 C2 平台还支持第四代福特福克斯、第三代 Kuga 以及第四代 Escape。虽然 Mach-E 与这些车辆共享其平台血统，但 GE1 适合于全电动 SUV。该平台连接为技术人员提供悬架和定位服务提供了有用的背景，而车辆特定的程序和规范在不同型号年份和配置中仍然至关重要。

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E has adjustable camber and toe at both ends, but an alignment service with this car also calls for attention to the vehicle loading, ride height and driver-assistance systems. The procedures provided in this article are for a 2023 AWD Mach-E, so confirm the specifications and service procedure for the vehicle’s exact model year and configuration before making adjustments. The supplied information does not include numerical alignment specifications or acceptable ride-height ranges.
paras.zh: 野马 Mach-E 两端的外倾角和前束均可调节，但该车的对准服务还需要注意车辆负载、行驶高度和驾驶员辅助系统。本文提供的程序适用于 2023 年 AWD Mach-E，因此在进行调整之前请确认车辆的确切型号年份和配置的规格和维修程序。提供的信息不包括数字对准规范或可接受的行驶高度范围。

paras.en: Before measuring toe, Ford’s procedure calls for a level surface, correct tire pressure, and an inspection for tire wear, damage and suspension wear or damage. The steering wheel must be held straight ahead with a suitable holding device during the toe checks.
paras.zh: 在测量前束之前，福特的程序要求地面平整、轮胎压力正确，并检查轮胎磨损、损坏和悬架磨损或损坏。在检查前束时，必须使用合适的固定装置将方向盘保持在正前方。

paras.en: Ride-height measurement has additional preparation requirements. Position the vehicle on a flat, level surface with tires inflated to the correct pressure. The procedure specifies a full tank of fuel, proper fluid levels and no cargo in the cabin or bed. Inspect for aftermarket equipment and changes to steering, suspension, wheels or tires, then jounce the front and rear suspension vigorously to let the vehicle settle.
paras.zh: 行驶高度测量有额外的准备要求。将车辆放置在平坦的水平表面上，轮胎充气至正确的压力。该程序规定燃油箱已满、液位适当且客舱或床上不得有货物。检查售后设备以及转向、悬架、车轮或轮胎的变化，然后用力摇晃前后悬架，让车辆稳定下来。

paras.en: Remember: Alignment readings are only useful when the vehicle is in the specified condition. If ride height is incorrect, look for changes or problems in the suspension and review the vehicle’s service information before treating alignment adjustments as the solution.
paras.zh: 请记住：对准读数仅在车辆处于指定条件时才有用。如果行驶高度不正确，请查找悬架的变化或问题，并查看车辆的维修信息，然后再将定位调整作为解决方案。

paras.en: If you find that you can’t get the vehicle to roll to carry out the rolling compensation measurements, this is because it has Rollaway Protection Mode that activates when the car is turned off and the driver exits. To enable the car to roll, you will have to leave it on and in neutral during the alignment. In some cases, you might want to attach the driver seatbelt and roll the door latch to prevent it from going into park.
paras.zh: 如果您发现无法让车辆滚动以进行滚动补偿测量，这是因为它具有滚动保护模式，该模式会在汽车关闭且驾驶员退出时激活。为了使汽车能够滚动，您必须在对准过程中将其保持在空档位置。在某些情况下，您可能需要系上驾驶员安全带并滚动门锁以防止其进入停车位。

paras.en: Front camber is adjusted at the strut-to-knuckle connection. First, measure camber with alignment equipment, then remove the wheels and tires. The brake flexible hose is unbolted and moved aside, and the wheel knuckle is supported with mechanic’s wire.
paras.zh: 前外倾角在支柱到转向节的连接处进行调整。首先，用定位设备测量外倾角，然后拆下车轮和轮胎。松开制动软管并移到一边，车轮转向节用机械钢丝支撑。

paras.en: The original strut-to-knuckle bolts and nuts are removed and discarded. Ford specifies new service bolts and nuts for reassembly. The service fasteners are smooth and smaller in diameter than the splined original equipment bolts. With the new fasteners installed and snug, move the knuckle inboard or outboard to bring camber into specification. The procedure states that moving from the maximum inboard to maximum outboard position provides 0.5 degree of adjustment.
paras.zh: 原来的支柱到转向节的螺栓和螺母被拆除并丢弃。福特指定了用于重新组装的新维修螺栓和螺母。维修紧固件光滑且直径小于带花键的原始设备螺栓。安装新的紧固件并使其紧贴后，将转向节向内或向外移动，使外倾角符合规格。该程序规定，从最大内侧位置移动到最大外侧位置可提供 0.5 度的调整。

paras.en: Do not fully tighten the strut-to-knuckle fasteners until camber is corrected. After adjustment, torque the bolts and nuts to 173 lb.-ft. (235 Nm). Reinstall the brake hose and torque its bolt to 97 lb.-in. (11 Nm). Reinstall the wheels and tires, recheck alignment and adjust front toe if needed. Because changing camber can affect toe, finish by verifying the toe readings.
paras.zh: 在外倾角得到纠正之前，请勿完全拧紧支柱至转向节的紧固件。调整后，将螺栓和螺母拧紧至 173 磅英尺。 （235 牛米）。重新安装制动软管并将其螺栓拧紧至 97 磅英寸。 （11 纳米）。重新安装车轮和轮胎，重新检查对准情况并根据需要调整前束。由于改变外倾角会影响前束，因此最后要验证前束读数。

paras.en: Front toe is adjusted at the inner tie rods. With the steering wheel held straight, check toe on both sides. Hold each outer tie-rod end stationary while loosening its jam nut; Ford cautions that allowing the tie-rod end to turn can damage the boot. Move the steering gear boot clamp aside, then rotate the inner tie rod to adjust toe. Do not let the steering gear bellows twist as the inner tie rod turns. Recheck toe after adjustment and road test the vehicle.
paras.zh: 前束通过内横拉杆进行调节。保持方向盘伸直，检查两侧前束。松开锁紧螺母时，保持每个外横拉杆端部固定；福特警告说，让横拉杆末端转动可能会损坏行李箱。将舵机靴夹移到一边，然后旋转内横拉杆调整前束。请勿让转向器波纹管随着内拉杆的转动而扭转。调整后重新检查前束并对车辆进行路试。

paras.en: Rear camber is adjusted by moving the upper control arm at its inboard mounting point. Measure camber, loosen the inboard nut approximately two turns, then slide the control arm inboard or outboard to change the reading. Recheck the alignment to verify the change and adjust rear toe if needed. The OEM procedure lists a torque of 76 lb.-ft. (103 Nm) for the upper control arm inboard nut.
paras.zh: 通过移动内侧安装点的上控制臂来调整后外倾角。测量外倾角，松开内侧螺母大约两圈，然后向内或向外滑动控制臂以更改读数。重新检查对齐情况以验证更改并根据需要调整后束。 OEM 程序列出的扭矩为 76 磅-英尺。 (103 Nm) 用于上控制臂内侧螺母。

paras.en: Rear toe is adjusted at the toe link. With the steering wheel held straight ahead, measure toe on both sides. Before turning the toe-link bolt, clean the area around the joint using mild liquids. Ford notes that the cam nut and cam bolt area must be free of foreign material for proper clamping. Loosen the toe-link nut approximately one turn, rotate the toe-link bolt to obtain the specified reading, and tighten without disturbing the setting. The procedure lists 66 lb.-ft. (90 Nm) for the toe-link nut.
paras.zh: 后束角在束角处进行调节。将方向盘保持笔直向前，测量两侧的前束角。转动趾连杆螺栓之前，请使用温和的液体清洁接头周围的区域。福特指出，凸轮螺母和凸轮螺栓区域必须没有异物才能正确夹紧。松开趾连杆螺母大约一圈，旋转趾连杆螺栓以获得指定读数，然后在不干扰设置的情况下拧紧。该程序列出了 66 磅英尺。 (90 Nm) 用于趾连杆螺母。

paras.en: If the Mach-E is equipped with Lane Departure Warning, Ford requires an IPMA camera alignment after rear toe adjustment. Connect a scan tool and follow its directions for the camera alignment procedure. Road test after the adjustment and required camera service.
paras.zh: 如果 Mach-E 配备车道偏离警告，福特需要在后束调整后进行 IPMA 摄像头对准。连接扫描工具并按照其说明进行相机对准过程。调整后的路试和所需的相机服务。

paras.en: The ride-height procedure uses a surface gauge to measure from a flat, level surface to suspension reference points. At the front, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm forward bolt and to the center of the ball-joint pinch bolt. Subtract the lower-arm forward-bolt measurement from the ball-joint pinch-bolt measurement to calculate front ride height.
paras.zh: 行驶高度程序使用表面测量仪来测量从平坦的水平表面到悬架参考点的距离。在前面，从表面到下臂前部螺栓的中心以及球形接头压紧螺栓的中心进行测量。从球窝接头压紧螺栓测量值中减去下臂前向螺栓测量值，即可计算前部行驶高度。

paras.en: At the rear, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm-to-subframe bolt and to the center of the lower arm-to-wheel-knuckle bolt. For the rear, subtract the wheel-knuckle-bolt measurement from the subframe-bolt measurement.
paras.zh: 在后部，从表面到下臂到副车架螺栓的中心以及下臂到车轮转向节螺栓的中心进行测量。对于后部，从副车架螺栓测量值中减去车轮转向节螺栓测量值。

paras.en: The service information provided describes how to take these measurements but does not give target ride-height values. Use the correct model-year service information for the vehicle to determine whether the recorded measurements are within specification. Avoid substituting a visual estimate or a generic ride-height value.
paras.zh: 提供的服务信息描述了如何进行这些测量，但没有给出目标行驶高度值。使用车辆的正确型号年份服务信息来确定记录的测量值是否符合规格。避免用视觉估计或通用行驶高度值代替。

paras.en: The vehicle’s service information shows a headlamp level sensor at both the front and rear suspension. The front sensor is mounted at the left front suspension, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. The rear sensor is also mounted at the left side, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. Each has an electrical connector.
paras.zh: 车辆的维修信息显示前悬架和后悬架上都有前照灯水平传感器。前传感器安装在左前悬架上，其臂支架连接到下臂。后传感器也安装在左侧，其臂支架连接到下臂。每个都有一个电连接器。

paras.en: During a suspension or alignment inspection, check that the sensors, brackets, arms and wiring are present and undamaged. The service procedure covers sensor removal and installation, but it does not specify an adjustment or calibration following a wheel alignment. If a sensor or its linkage has been disturbed or damaged, consult the correct service information for the required repair steps.
paras.zh: 在悬挂或对准检查期间，检查传感器、支架、臂和接线是否存在且未损坏。维修程序涵盖传感器的拆卸和安装，但没有指定车轮定位后的调整或校准。如果传感器或其连杆受到干扰或损坏，请查阅正确的服务信息以了解所需的维修步骤。

articles.title: Read ShopOwner’s October Digital Edition Now
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: The interactive and easy-to-use digital edition of ShopOwner’s October issue is available now.
paras.zh: ShopOwner 十月号的交互式且易于使用的数字版现已推出。

paras.en: What happens when some of North America’s best automotive technicians gather in Detroit to compete for the title of 2026 Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper Technician of the Year? There are challenging diagnostic exercises, timed competitions and plenty of pressure, but something even more interesting emerges: camaraderie, mutual respect and a shared passion for solving problems. From military veterans and former electronics technicians to third-generation automotive professionals, this year’s finalists demonstrate that there’s no single road to success in the automotive service industry. Ultimately, Matt Wagg of Accelerated Diagnostic & Automotive in Bennington, NE, earned the U.S. championship, while Jake McKie and Roberto Chávez Chairez claimed the Canadian and Latin American honors.
paras.zh: 当北美一些最优秀的汽车技术人员齐聚底特律，争夺 2026 年汽车价值和年度最佳技术人员称号时，会发生什么？这里有具有挑战性的诊断练习、定时竞赛和巨大的压力，但更有趣的东西出现了：友情、相互尊重和解决问题的共同热情。从退伍军人、前电子技术人员到第三代汽车专业人士，今年的决赛入围者证明，汽车服务行业没有单一的成功之路。最终，内布拉斯加州本宁顿 Accelerated Diagnostic & Automotive 公司的 Matt Wagg 赢得了美国冠军，而 Jake McKie 和 Roberto Chávez Chairez 则获得了加拿大和拉丁美洲的荣誉。

paras.en: But the real story goes well beyond the winners. Through candid conversations with the finalists, a powerful message emerges about mentorship, ongoing training, professional pride and the importance of recognizing technicians for the work they do every day. Their experiences offer valuable lessons for shop owners looking to develop and retain great employees while building stronger businesses. Read the complete article to meet these outstanding professionals, discover the people and experiences that shaped their careers, and learn why the greatest reward of this competition may have nothing to do with taking home a trophy.
paras.zh: 但真实的故事远远超出了获胜者的范围。通过与决赛入围者的坦诚对话，关于指导、持续培训、职业自豪感以及认可技术人员日常工作的重要性的强有力的信息浮现出来。他们的经验为希望培养和留住优秀员工、同时打造更强大企业的店主提供了宝贵的经验教训。阅读完整的文章来认识这些杰出的专业人士，了解塑造他们职业生涯的人物和经历，并了解为什么本次比赛的最大奖励可能与带回家奖杯无关。

paras.en: PLUS, you’ll find Tech Tips, new products, editorial commentary and technical content from ImportCar, Brake & Front End, Underhood Service, TechShop and Tire Review, all ShopOwner channels.
paras.zh: 另外，您还可以找到来自 ImportCar、Brake & Front End、Underhood Service、TechShop 和 Tire Review 以及所有 ShopOwner 频道的技术提示、新产品、编辑评论和技术内容。

articles.title: Automotive Transmission Market to Reach $94.8 Billion by 2033
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: According to a report from MarketsandMarkets, the global automotive transmission market will grow from $66.1 billion in 2026 to $94.8 billion by 2033. The market will expand at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 5.3%.
paras.zh: 根据MarketsandMarkets的报告，全球汽车变速器市场将从2026年的661亿美元增长到2033年的948亿美元。该市场将以5.3%的复合年增长率（CAGR）扩大。

paras.en: The shift toward eight- to 10-speed automatic transmissions, advanced dual-clutch transmissions (DCTs) and continuously variable transmissions (CVTs) supports greater efficiency. Low-friction gearsets and predictive shift-control software also help automakers optimize engine performance, reduce power losses and improve drivability.
paras.zh: 转向 8 至 10 速自动变速箱、先进的双离合变速箱 (DCT) 和无级变速箱 (CVT) 可提高效率。低摩擦齿轮组和预测换档控制软件还可以帮助汽车制造商优化发动机性能、减少功率损失并提高驾驶性能。

paras.en: Meanwhile, dedicated hybrid transmissions (DHTs), electronic CVTs (e-CVTs) and integrated motor-transmission systems are gaining importance. Automakers use these technologies to blend internal combustion engines (ICEs) with electric motors, improve regenerative braking and optimize packaging.
paras.zh: 与此同时，专用混合动力变速器 (DHT)、电子无级变速器 (e-CVT) 和集成电机变速器系统变得越来越重要。汽车制造商利用这些技术将内燃机 (ICE) 与电动机融合在一起，改进再生制动并优化包装。

paras.en: Manufacturers are also developing multispeed EV transmissions for applications requiring greater high-speed efficiency, towing capability or performance.
paras.zh: 制造商还在开发多速电动汽车变速箱，用于需要更高高速效率、牵引能力或性能的应用。

paras.en: However, transmission suppliers face significant challenges as they develop conventional, hybrid and EV-specific architectures simultaneously. These include high research and development costs, extensive validation requirements, increasing software complexity and pricing pressures. Battery-electric vehicles (BEVs) also reduce demand for conventional multispeed gearboxes.
paras.zh: 然而，变速箱供应商在同时开发传统、混合动力和电动汽车专用架构时面临着重大挑战。其中包括高昂的研发成本、广泛的验证要求、不断增加的软件复杂性和定价压力。电池电动汽车 (BEV) 也减少了对传统多速变速箱的需求。

paras.en: Single-Speed Systems Lead Automotive Transmission Market
paras.zh: 单速系统引领汽车变速箱市场

paras.en: Single-speed reducers dominate the BEV market because electric motors offer broad operating speed ranges with lower costs, weight and complexity.
paras.zh: 单速减速器在纯电动汽车市场占据主导地位，因为电动机可提供较宽的运行速度范围，并且成本、重量和复杂性较低。

paras.en: Manufacturers are optimizing reduction ratios, improving high-speed gear durability, enhancing lubrication efficiency and reducing gear-mesh noise.
paras.zh: 制造商正在优化减速比，提高高速齿轮的耐用性，提高润滑效率并降低齿轮啮合噪音。

paras.en: Electric motors deliver high torque at low speeds and maintain a broad usable speed range. These characteristics eliminate the need for multiple gear ratios in most passenger EVs.
paras.zh: 电动机在低速下提供高扭矩，并保持广泛的可用速度范围。这些特性消除了大多数乘用电动汽车对多个齿轮比的需求。

paras.en: Fixed-ratio reduction gears simplify drivetrains and reduce mechanical losses, weight, packaging complexity and maintenance requirements. They also enable precise torque delivery and seamless acceleration.
paras.zh: 固定比减速齿轮简化了传动系统并降低了机械损失、重量、包装复杂性和维护要求。它们还能够实现精确的扭矩传递和无缝加速。

paras.en: Advances in high-speed motors, optimized helical gears, low-friction bearings and integrated e-axle designs further improve efficiency and power density.
paras.zh: 高速电机、优化斜齿轮、低摩擦轴承和集成电轴设计的进步进一步提高了效率和功率密度。

paras.en: Multispeed Transmissions Address EV Performance Needs
paras.zh: 多速变速箱满足电动汽车性能需求

paras.en: However, single-speed systems face trade-offs when balancing launch torque with high-speed efficiency. These challenges particularly affect heavy-duty EVs and performance applications.
paras.zh: 然而，单速系统在平衡启动扭矩和高速效率时面临着权衡。这些挑战尤其影响重型电动汽车和高性能应用。

paras.en: Looking ahead, multispeed transmissions will likely remain the preferred solution for high-performance and commercial EVs. Meanwhile, single-speed architectures will maintain an advantage in mainstream passenger EVs because of their simplicity, cost and efficiency.
paras.zh: 展望未来，多速变速箱可能仍然是高性能和商用电动汽车的首选解决方案。与此同时，单速架构因其简单性、成本和效率而将在主流乘用电动汽车中保持优势。

articles.title: TERREPOWER to Showcase New Products at AAPEX
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: TERREPOWER, formerly BBB Industries, will showcase two new products at AAPEX 2026. The company specializes in sustainable aftermarket manufacturing. The products include the Remy Belt Alternator Starter (BAS) for 48-volt mild hybrid vehicles and the mobile S.T.A.R.T. diagnostic application. S.T.A.R.T. stands for Smart Troubleshooting and Resolution Tool.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER（原 BBB Industries）将在 AAPEX 2026 上展示两款新产品。该公司专注于可持续售后市场制造。产品包括用于 48 伏轻度混合动力汽车的 Remy 皮带交流发电机启动器 (BAS) 和移动式 S.T.A.R.T.诊断应用。开始。代表智能故障排除和解决工具。

paras.en: TERREPOWER will also highlight an expansion of its steering and braking portfolio. The expansion includes 92 new electric power steering part numbers. The company also plans to expand its NuGeon new brake caliper line to more than 1,800 SKUs in 2027.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 还将重点介绍其转向和制动产品组合的扩展。此次扩展包括 92 个新的电动助力转向部件号。该公司还计划在 2027 年将其 NuGeon 新型制动卡钳系列扩展到 1,800 多个 SKU。

paras.en: “Today’s aftermarket is changing quickly as new vehicle technologies enter the repair cycle and technicians face increasingly complex diagnostic challenges,” said Duncan Gillis, CEO of TERREPOWER. “Innovation for TERREPOWER means bringing new parts to market as well as technologies to help our customers solve the entire repair. The Remy BAS and S.T.A.R.T. app demonstrate how we are complementing scalable sustainable manufacturing of automotive components with user-friendly tools to help our customers keep vehicles on the road longer.”
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 首席执行官邓肯·吉利斯 (Duncan Gillis) 表示：“随着新技术进入维修周期，当今的售后市场正在迅速变化，技术人员面临着日益复杂的诊断挑战。” “TERREPOWER 的创新意味着将新零件推向市场以及帮助我​​们的客户解决整个维修问题的技术。Remy BAS 和 S.T.A.R.T. 应用程序展示了我们如何通过用户友好的工具补充汽车零部件的可扩展可持续制造，以帮助我们的客户让车辆在路上行驶更长时间。”

paras.en: TERREPOWER Introduces Remy BAS for Mild Hybrids
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 推出适用于轻度混合动力车的 Remy BAS

paras.en: The Remy BAS combines starter and generator functionality in a belt-driven motor-generator for 48-volt mild hybrids. TERREPOWER will feature the product in the AAPEX New Product Showcase.
paras.zh: Remy BAS 将启动器和发电机功能结合在皮带驱动电动发电机中，适用于 48 伏轻度混合动力车。 TERREPOWER 将在 AAPEX 新产品展示会上展示该产品。

paras.en: TERREPOWER is the first company to introduce a remanufactured BAS solution for North American aftermarket distribution. Applications include the Ram 1500 eTorque and Audi 48-volt mild hybrid vehicles.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 是第一家为北美售后市场分销引入再制造 BAS 解决方案的公司。应用包括 Ram 1500 eTorque 和奥迪 48 伏轻度混合动力汽车。

paras.en: As mild hybrid vehicles move beyond their original warranties, the Remy BAS offers an alternative to limited OE supply. TERREPOWER uses the original OE design and remanufactures the unit with qualified components, manufacturing controls and validation testing. The process restores the unit to its original OE performance level.
paras.zh: 随着轻度混合动力汽车超出其原始保修期，Remy BAS 提供了有限原厂供应的替代方案。 TERREPOWER 使用原始 OE 设计，并使用合格的组件、制造控制和验证测试重新制造该装置。该过程将设备恢复到其原始 OE 性能水平。

paras.en: The Remy BAS supports stop-start operation, captures energy during braking and deceleration, and provides torque assistance.
paras.zh: Remy BAS支持启停操作，在制动和减速过程中捕获能量，并提供扭矩辅助。

paras.en: Initial coverage includes H80002 for 2019-2024 Ram 1500 5.7-liter V8 eTorque applications. Part Number H80001 covers 2020-2025 Audi 48-volt mild hybrid applications.
paras.zh: 初始覆盖范围包括适用于 2019-2024 年 Ram 1500 5.7 升 V8 eTorque 应用的 H80002。零件号 H80001 涵盖 2020-2025 年奥迪 48 伏轻度混合动力应用。

paras.en: Remanufacturing Process and Product Support
paras.zh: 再制造流程和产品支持

paras.en: The core-exchange remanufacturing process begins with a returned unit. Technicians disassemble and inspect the unit, replace or renew components, and rebuild it to its original OE design.
paras.zh: 核心交换再制造过程从返回的单元开始。技术人员拆卸并检查设备，更换或更新组件，并将其重建为原始原厂设计。

paras.en: The process keeps serviceable metal and electronic components in circulation. Compared with manufacturing an equivalent new unit, it reduces raw material extraction, energy consumption and landfill waste.
paras.zh: 该过程使可用的金属和电子元件保持流通。与制造同等的新装置相比，它减少了原材料开采、能源消耗和垃圾填埋废物。

paras.en: TERREPOWER will support the introduction with sales materials, electronic catalog support, product videos and training modules with quizzes. These resources will help partners prepare counter staff and technicians for emerging hybrid repair opportunities.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 将通过销售材料、电子目录支持、产品视频和带有测验的培训模块来支持介绍。这些资源将帮助合作伙伴为柜台工作人员和技术人员做好准备，以应对新兴的混合动力维修机会。

paras.en: Expanding Brake Caliper and Steering Coverage
paras.zh: 扩大制动钳和转向覆盖范围

paras.en: TERREPOWER will also preview an expansion of its NuGeon new brake caliper line. The company plans to release more than 1,800 caliper SKUs in 2027. The new calipers aim to simplify stocking and installation.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 还将预览其 NuGeon 新制动卡钳系列的扩展。该公司计划在 2027 年发布超过 1,800 个卡钳 SKU。新卡钳旨在简化库存和安装。

paras.en: Additionally, TERREPOWER is expanding its electric power steering (EPS) program with 92 new part numbers. The expansion covers more than 20.2 million vehicles in operation in the U.S. and more than 226,000 in Canada.
paras.zh: 此外，TERREPOWER 正在通过 92 个新零件号扩展其电动助力转向 (EPS) 计划。此次扩张涵盖了美国超过 2,020 万辆运营车辆和加拿大超过 226,000 辆运营车辆。

paras.en: S.T.A.R.T. Mobile App Supports Diagnostics
paras.zh: 开始。移动应用程序支持诊断

paras.en: TERREPOWER designed its S.T.A.R.T. app to guide technicians through a structured diagnostic process. The app helps identify the root cause of a failure before technicians install a replacement component. This approach aims to reduce repeat repairs and returns.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 设计了 ​​S.T.A.R.T.应用程序指导技术人员完成结构化诊断过程。该应用程序可帮助技术人员在安装更换组件之前确定故障的根本原因。这种方法旨在减少重复维修和退货。

paras.en: The mobile version launches with turbocharger troubleshooting. TERREPOWER plans to add alternator and starter capabilities before the end of 2026.
paras.zh: 移动版本推出时带有涡轮增压器故障排除功能。 TERREPOWER 计划在 2026 年底前增加交流发电机和起动机功能。

paras.en: - Symptom-based troubleshooting by product type.
paras.zh: - 按产品类型进行基于症状的故障排除。

paras.en: - Diagnostic trouble code lookup, including codes such as P0299 turbo underboost.
paras.zh: - 诊断故障代码查找，包括 P0299 涡轮增压不足等代码。

paras.en: - Direct access to TechEyeQ remote assistance by phone or email.
paras.zh: - 通过电话或电子邮件直接访问 TechEyeQ 远程协助。

paras.en: “S.T.A.R.T. is another example of how we’re thinking beyond the replacement part,” Gillis said. “Giving technicians better diagnostic support can help them identify the underlying problem before installing a new component. That means greater confidence in the repair for technicians, distributors and ultimately the vehicle owner.”
paras.zh: “S.T.A.R.T. 是我们超越替换部件思考的另一个例子，”吉利斯说。 “为技术人员提供更好的诊断支持可以帮助他们在安装新部件之前识别根本问题。这意味着技术人员、经销商以及最终车主对维修更有信心。”

paras.en: The S.T.A.R.T. app is available on Apple’s App Store for iPhone, iPad and Mac and on Google Play for Android devices.
paras.zh: S.T.A.R.T.该应用程序可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 的 Apple App Store 以及 Android 设备的 Google Play 上下载。

paras.en: TERREPOWER also offers alternator and starter troubleshooting through its expanded desktop application at www.partinstall.com/start.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 还通过 www.partinstall.com/start 上的扩展桌面应用程序提供交流发电机和起动机故障排除服务。

paras.en: Additional Aftermarket Products at AAPEX
paras.zh: AAPEX 上的其他售后产品

paras.en: The Remy BAS, S.T.A.R.T. app and expanded parts portfolio reflect TERREPOWER’s focus on products and repair support. The company combines remanufactured components with diagnostic technology, training and resources for aftermarket customers.
paras.zh: 雷米 BAS、S.T.A.R.T.应用程序和扩展的零件组合反映了 TERREPOWER 对产品和维修支持的关注。该公司将再制造部件与售后市场客户的诊断技术、培训和资源相结合。

paras.en: TERREPOWER will also highlight products and services across rotating electrical, turbochargers, braking, steering and electric vehicle battery lifecycle services.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 还将重点介绍旋转电气、涡轮增压器、制动、转向和电动汽车电池生命周期服务等领域的产品和服务。

paras.en: AAPEX 2026 takes place Nov. 3-5 in Las Vegas. TERREPOWER will exhibit at booth V8405 in the Remanufacturing/Sustainable Manufacturing area.
paras.zh: AAPEX 2026 将于 11 月 3 日至 5 日在拉斯维加斯举行。 TERREPOWER 将在再制造/可持续制造领域的 V8405 展位展出。

paras.en: Visitors can view the Remy BAS and watch demonstrations of the S.T.A.R.T. app. TERREPOWER technical experts will also discuss product applications, diagnostic technology and sustainable manufacturing.
paras.zh: 参观者可以参观 Remy BAS 并观看 S.T.A.R.T. 的演示。应用程序。 TERREPOWER技术专家还将讨论产品应用、诊断技术和可持续制造。

articles.title: AISIN Launches Expanded Product Lineup
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: AISIN Corporation, a Top 10 global Tier One supplier of automotive components and systems and one of the industry’s largest manufacturers of aftermarket parts, will introduce a new product line at the Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo (AAPEX) in Las Vegas, Nov. 3-5, 2026. Built on its reputation for delivering OE-quality products to the professional aftermarket, the expansion marks a new chapter for AISIN, the company said.
paras.zh: 爱信公司是全球十大汽车零部件和系统一级供应商，也是业内最大的售后零件制造商之一，将于 2026 年 11 月 3 日至 5 日在拉斯维加斯举行的汽车售后产品博览会 (AAPEX) 上推出新产品线。该公司表示，凭借向专业售后市场提供原厂品质产品的声誉，此次扩张标志着爱信翻开了新篇章。

paras.en: Pilot Program Expands Access and Categories
paras.zh: 试点计划扩大了准入范围和类别

paras.en: To support the rollout, AISIN vetted and established a pilot program with a China-based global supply chain partner. The pilot enabled AISIN to maintain its OE-quality standards while expanding into new, high-volume maintenance-related categories, the company said.
paras.zh: 为了支持该计划的推出，爱信与一家位于中国的全球供应链合作伙伴审查并建立了试点计划。该公司表示，该试点使爱信能够维持其原厂质量标准，同时扩展到新的、大批量维护相关的类别。

paras.en: Parts available through this program include products in cooling systems, drivetrain, steering, suspension, chemicals and fluids. AISIN will bring a selection of the approximately 10,000 SKUs of replacement parts to AAPEX.
paras.zh: 通过该计划提供的零件包括冷却系统、传动系统、转向装置、悬架、化学品和液体等产品。爱信将在 AAPEX 上精选约 10,000 个 SKU 替换零件。

paras.en: Online-First Launch and Joint Venture Plans
paras.zh: 在线首发和合资计划

paras.en: “With a broader, more accessible product offering, AISIN is opening the door for a wider range of customers to experience the quality, performance and reliability that define the AISIN name,” said Dwayne Bates, president of AISIN Aftermarket and Service of America. “Part of our growth strategy announced in 2024 is to create an online auto parts mall where customers can access affordable, AISIN-quality replacement parts. This aligns perfectly with that strategy, allowing us to maintain the quality standards our customers know and trust, while expanding into new product categories that meet the needs of today’s evolving automotive market.”
paras.zh: 爱信美国售后市场和服务总裁德韦恩·贝茨 (Dwayne Bates) 表示：“通过提供更广泛、更容易获得的产品，爱信正在为更广泛的客户打开大门，让他们体验定义爱信品牌的质量、性能和可靠性。” “我们在 2024 年宣布的增长战略的一部分是创建一个在线汽车零部件商城，客户可以在这里获得价格实惠、爱信品质的替换零部件。这与该战略完美契合，使我们能够保持客户了解和信任的质量标准，同时扩展到新的产品类别，以满足当今不断发展的汽车市场的需求。”

paras.en: The new AISIN product range has begun rolling out through online sellers first, including Amazon, and will expand into offline channels by the end of the year. Following the pilot, the company has a pending joint venture in the works, with additional details to be announced at completion.
paras.zh: 新的爱信产品系列已开始首先通过包括亚马逊在内的在线卖家推出，并将在今年年底扩展到线下渠道。试点结束后，该公司正在筹建一家合资企业，更多细节将在完成后公布。

paras.en: AAPEX Display to Feature New Product Range
paras.zh: AAPEX 展示将展示新产品系列

paras.en: AAPEX 2026 will be the first time the new product line is shown at an industry event. The display will include catalytic converters, turbochargers, AC compressors, fuel pumps, hub bearings, shock absorbers, mass airflow sensors, lift strut supports, alternators and expansion tanks.
paras.zh: AAPEX 2026 将是新产品线首次在行业活动中展示。该展示将包括催化转换器、涡轮增压器、交流压缩机、燃油泵、轮毂轴承、减震器、质量气流传感器、提升支柱支架、交流发电机和膨胀水箱。

paras.en: The new line of products will be on display at booth V3261 in The Venetian Expo at AAPEX, Nov. 3-5, 2026.
paras.zh: 新系列产品将于 2026 年 11 月 3 日至 5 日在 AAPEX 威尼斯人博览会 V3261 展位展出。

articles.title: Bumper Removal & ADAS Recalibration
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Removing a front bumper cover for repairs or modifications can affect advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). Cameras, radar and other sensors require precise alignment to function properly.
paras.zh: 拆卸前保险杠盖进行维修或改装可能会影响高级驾驶员辅助系统 (ADAS)。摄像头、雷达和其他传感器需要精确对准才能正常工作。

paras.en: Remind customers that bumper removal or replacement may require ADAS recalibration, even during routine radiator, condenser or headlight repairs. Always consult manufacturer procedures to ensure proper operation and safety.
paras.zh: 提醒客户，即使在常规散热器、冷凝器或前灯维修期间，拆卸或更换保险杠也可能需要 ADAS 重新校准。请务必查阅制造商程序以确保正确操作和安全。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: Simple Steps for Successful Wiper Blade Installation
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Installing wiper blades is a valuable customer service, but proper installation requires care. Never place blades on a vehicle’s paint or leave an exposed wiper arm upright, where it could damage the windshield.
paras.zh: 安装雨刷片是一项有价值的客户服务，但正确安装需要小心。切勿将刀片放在车辆的油漆上或将暴露的雨刷臂直立放置，否则可能会损坏挡风玻璃。

paras.en: Use a pocket screwdriver to help remove stubborn blades, select the correct adapter and ensure it snaps securely into place before lowering the arm.
paras.zh: 使用袖珍螺丝刀帮助移除顽固的刀片，选择正确的适配器并确保其在放下臂之前牢固地卡入到位。
