paras.en: They call it the Rocky Mountain Thunder. The stadium-shuddering racket reverberated by Denver Broncos fans stomping their feet on the metal decks of their old Mile High Stadium.
paras.zh: 他们称之为落基山雷霆。丹佛野马队球迷在旧英里高体育场的金属甲板上跺脚，回响着令人颤抖的球拍声。

paras.en: It would become a storied intimidation tactic that has since translated across to their current home Empower Field, but perhaps too an unwritten cheat code to thousands 'getting their steps in', given all I would come to learn of this fitness-enthused Mountain West metropolis.
paras.zh: 这将成为一种传奇的恐吓策略，后来被应用到了他们现在的家乡 Empower Field，但考虑到我对这座热衷于健身的西部山区大都市的了解，也许对成千上万的人来说，这也是一种不成文的作弊代码。

paras.en: Here was your proverbial protein shake of Colorado goodness, unbridled escapism and blood-pumping self-care flexing in the clouds some 5,280ft above sea level, as if detached from the rest of the nation. They breathe a little differently here, operate a little differently, attack sport a little differently.
paras.zh: 这是众所周知的科罗拉多州的蛋白质奶昔，无拘无束的逃避现实和令人血脉喷张的自我保健，在海拔约 5,280 英尺的云层中弯曲，仿佛与这个国家的其他地方分离。他们在这里的呼吸方式略有不同，运作方式也略有不同，进攻运动也略有不同。

paras.en: The city is serene and soothing in accordance with its neighbouring nature, and yet its sporting disciples deafening. From its mountainous backdrop to its rich variety of wildlife, Denver is a laptop screensaver picture of tranquillity. From its sunrise joggers to its rock-scaling climbers, it is a breeding ground for adrenaline and activity. And between its seven major league sports teams, it is a cauldron of intense, ever-expanding fandom.
paras.zh: 这座城市与周围的自然环境相得益彰，宁静而舒缓，但其运动爱好者却震耳欲聋。从多山的背景到丰富多样的野生动物，丹佛就像笔记本电脑屏幕上一幅宁静的画卷。从日出慢跑者到攀岩攀岩者，这里是肾上腺素和活动的滋生地。在其七支大联盟运动队之间，它是一个充满激烈且不断扩大的球迷群体的大熔炉。

paras.en: Welcome to Mile High, where an early awakening at the Limelight hotel (fuelled by some jet-lag) would kickstart my stay with a stunning sunrise view over Union Station, around which bustled coffee-grabbers, job-goers and worm-catching early birds.
paras.zh: 欢迎来到 Mile High，在 Limelight 酒店（由于时差的影响）我早早起床，欣赏联合车站令人惊叹的日出景色，周围是熙熙攘攘的喝咖啡的人、上班族和早起的鸟儿。

paras.en: - For further information, head to visitdenver.com
paras.zh: - 欲了解更多信息，请访问visitdenver.com

paras.en: - Jay-Z picks himself to headline Super Bowl half-time show
paras.zh: - Jay-Z 选择自己担任超级碗中场秀的主角

paras.en: - Latest NFL fixtures, results and UK kick-off times
paras.zh: - 最新 NFL 赛程、赛果和英国开球时间

paras.en: I had flown in directly from London Heathrow for a dose of Denver life, another West Brom-come-Broncos fan I met that weekend had made the trip from Birmingham, and each week Sean Payton's side receive support from neighbouring states in New Mexico, Montana, Utah and Wyoming. Such is their isolated geographical position in the metaphorical 'Gods' of America, the Broncos reign supreme as a prized NFL attraction.
paras.zh: 我直接从伦敦希思罗机场飞来体验丹佛的生活，那个周末我遇到的另一位西布朗野马队球迷从伯明翰飞来，每周肖恩·佩顿的球队都会得到新墨西哥州、蒙大拿州、犹他州和怀俄明州等邻近州的支持。野马队在美国“众神”的隐喻中处于孤立的地理位置，在 NFL 中占据着至高无上的地位。

paras.en: Saturday. My choice of cargo trousers in bronzeable heat had already come back to haunt me in a land where shorts and t-shirt tend to top the attire. Denver's 300-days of sunshine each year lend themselves to a city driven by life outside and an accompanying will to explore. This Brit stuck out, a reality only amplified by the perplexed look upon learning bars and clubs close earlier here in order to avoid squandering mornings better dedicated to fitness and training; party early, workout early. And for what it is worth, the motivation and zest to stay on the move becomes infectious.
paras.zh: 周六。在一个短裤和 T 恤往往搭配着装的国家里，我在古铜色高温下选择的工装裤已经再次困扰着我。丹佛每年 300 天的阳光明媚，造就了一座充满户外生活和探索欲望的城市。这位英国人脱颖而出，这一现实只会因为这里的学习酒吧和俱乐部早些时候关闭的困惑表情而放大，以避免浪费早上更好地致力于健身和训练；早点聚会，早点锻炼。无论如何，继续前进的动力和热情会变得具有感染力。

paras.en: By night, Red Rocks Amphitheatre is known as Denver's unique home of world-class music acts, where Lily Allen had been headlining on her album tour at the time of my visit. By morning, it appears to adopt the appearance of an outdoor gym, with its multiple tiers of theatre steps occupying yoga classes and workouts for families and friends of all ages.
paras.zh: 到了晚上，红岩露天剧场被称为丹佛独特的世界级音乐表演之家，在我访问期间，莉莉·艾伦 (Lily Allen) 一直是她专辑巡演的主角。到了早上，它似乎呈现出室外健身房的外观，其多层剧院台阶为各个年龄段的家人和朋友提供瑜伽课程和锻炼。

paras.en: One man is shadow boxing back-and-forth in a mask reminiscent of Batman villain Bane, a father and his four children are tackling the steep incline in unison from bottom to top and one elderly gentleman is performing kettle bell swings at the awe of younger workout partners. It is enough to guilt-trip this sluggish journalist after an evening of down-time watching the Colorado Rockies baseball team and exploring Denver's world class breweries; Ratio Beerworks, for curious travellers, and Whiskey Bar, where I witnessed the most competitive round robin of snooker games - they take sport and winning seriously here, no matter the game or level.
paras.zh: 一名男子戴着让人想起蝙蝠侠恶棍贝恩的面具来回打太极拳，一位父亲和他的四个孩子从下到上齐心协力应对陡峭的斜坡，一位年长的绅士正在挥舞壶铃，令年轻的健身伙伴惊叹不已。在观看了科罗拉多洛矶队棒球队的比赛并参观了丹佛的世界级啤酒厂之后，这位迟钝的记者一晚上的休息时间就足以让他感到内疚了。 Ratio Beerworks 适合好奇的旅行者，而 Whiskey Bar 则让我目睹了最具竞争力的斯诺克比赛循环赛 - 他们在这里认真对待比赛并赢得胜利，无论比赛或级别如何。

paras.en: The Rockies these days are a little less associated with success in comparison to tavern snooker and their Broncos brothers, having reached the playoffs just five times since 1993. Still, they retain a devoted fanbase that preserve baseball's unique pass-time entertainment. On this occasion families were invited to a fireworks show, dare I say to compensate for the lack of Rockies fireworks on the field. And yet their supporters keep coming back.
paras.zh: 与酒馆斯诺克和他们的兄弟野马队相比，如今的落基山脉队与成功的联系要小一些，自 1993 年以来仅五次进入季后赛。尽管如此，他们仍保留着忠实的粉丝群，保留了棒球独特的消遣娱乐。这次，家人被邀请观看烟花表演，我敢说这是为了弥补落基山脉烟花表演的不足。然而他们的支持者不断回来。

paras.en: The Broncos, as mentioned before, top the sporting charts in Denver as three-time Super Bowl champions and one of the most successful franchises in NFL history. The team boasts the longest active sell-out streak for an NFL franchise that has remained in one city, dating back to 1970, contributing to a 20-year wait-list for season tickets.
paras.zh: 如前所述，野马队作为三届超级碗冠军和 NFL 历史上最成功的球队之一，在丹佛体育排行榜上名列前茅。该球队自 1970 年以来一直是 NFL 球队中在一个城市保持最长的活跃门票售空记录的球队，导致季票等待名单长达 20 年。

paras.en: Denver initially played their football in Mile High Stadium from 1960 to 2000, before moving into Empower Field at Mile High in 2001. The organisation is now targeting the 2031 NFL season as a completion date for their new retractable roof stadium, which would account for the Colorado elements as well as offering year-round use of the facility for events beyond football. Recent history points towards an increased chance of hosting the Super Bowl for stadiums that have a roof or can be covered.
paras.zh: 丹佛队最初从 1960 年到 2000 年在 Mile High 体育场踢球，然后于 2001 年迁入 Mile High 的 Empower Field。该组织现在的目标是 2031 年 NFL 赛季作为其新的可伸缩屋顶体育场的竣工日期，该体育场将考虑到科罗拉多州的元素，并为橄榄球以外的活动提供全年使用该设施的机会。最近的历史表明，有屋顶或可覆盖的体育场举办超级碗的机会增加。

paras.en: The Broncos are the only team in the NFL to announce the number of 'no-shows' on the big screen during each home game, prompting boos from fans in attendance towards those who didn't make the journey.
paras.zh: 野马队是 NFL 中唯一一支在每场主场比赛中都会在大屏幕上公布“缺席”人数的球队，这引发了现场球迷对那些没有到场的球迷的嘘声。

paras.en: Right on cue, the jeers arrived late in their Week Two victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars, where I was among 76,472 fans basking in Colorado sunshine to soak up a day that began with the Broncos' traditional pre-game skydiving Thunderstorm show and ended in a first win of the season for Bo Nix's side.
paras.zh: 就在此时，嘲笑声在他们第二周战胜杰克逊维尔美洲虎队的比赛中到来，我和 76,472 名球迷一起沐浴在科罗拉多州的阳光下，享受着野马队传统赛前跳伞雷暴表演的一天，并以博尼克斯球队本赛季的第一场胜利结束。

paras.en: It is raucous, rattling noise from start to finish, underlining one of the most renowned fan bases in football. Oh, and boy do they hate the Kansas City Chiefs, whose travelling fans shall be alerted to that fact - if not already aware - when they head to Mile High this weekend, live on Sky Sports NFL.
paras.zh: 从头到尾都是刺耳的、嘎嘎作响的噪音，凸显了足球界最著名的球迷基础之一。哦，天哪，他们讨厌堪萨斯城酋长队，当堪萨斯城酋长队本周末前往 Mile High 进行天空体育 NFL 直播时，他们的客场球迷应该会意识到这一事实——如果还没有意识到的话。

paras.en: They cut the figure of overlords, empowered by their respiratory nuances high in the sky, reminding teams of where they are with an unmissable sign reading: "ELEV 5280′ Altitude Sickness is Real" as opposition players walk into the stadium.
paras.zh: 他们塑造了霸主的形象，在高空呼吸的细微差别赋予了力量，当对手球员走进体育场时，他们用一个不容错过的标牌提醒球队他们在哪里：“ELEV 5280'高原反应是真实的”。

paras.en: It creates an 'us versus them' unity among Broncos fans, and yet it remains a city warm and welcoming to its visitors; I met one Cowboy hat-wearing local fascinated by a British accent, so too a stadium worker who had a friend living in Clapham - because OF COURSE. It's always Clapham.
paras.zh: 它在野马队球迷中创造了一种“我们与他们”的团结，但它仍然是一座热情欢迎游客的城市；我遇到了一位戴着牛仔帽的当地人，对英国口音着迷，还有一位体育场工作人员，他有一个朋友住在克拉珀姆 - 当然是因为。总是克拉彭。

paras.en: Empower Field has also served as host for events ranging from Barack Obama's Democratic presidential nomination acceptance in 2008 to Taylor Swift concerts. In March 2026 it also made history by setting a new National Women's Soccer League attendance record when 63,004 fans watched the Denver Summit expansion team play the Washington Spirit, surpassing the previous benchmark of 40,091 set by Bay FC at Oracle Park.
paras.zh: Empower Field 还主办过各种活动，从巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 2008 年接受民主党总统提名到泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 音乐会等。 2026 年 3 月，它还创造了新的全国女子足球联盟观众人数纪录，当时有 63,004 名球迷观看了丹佛峰会扩张队对阵华盛顿精神队的比赛，超过了海湾足球俱乐部之前在甲骨文公园创下的 40,091 人的纪录。

paras.en: Denver natives do not mess around when it comes to sport. If there is a team, a game, an individual for whom to root - they are there. There are enough of them; just three years ago the Nuggets won the NBA Finals, and four years ago the Colorado Avalanche won NHL's Stanley Cup.
paras.zh: 丹佛人在运动方面从不乱搞。如果有一支球队、一场比赛、一个个人值得支持——他们就在那里。它们已经够多了；就在三年前，掘金队赢得了 NBA 总决赛，四年前，科罗拉多雪崩队赢得了 NHL 的斯坦利杯。

paras.en: The Summit are something of Denver's newest, thriving hope having been accepted as an NWSL expansion team in January 2025, with legendary Broncos quarterback Peyton Manning part of their ownership group. Six Summit players were recently called up to represent the US Women's National Team during the October international break. That included midfielder Lindsey Heaps, who has won a World Cup, two Olympic medals and captained her side at the 2023 World Cup across more than 170 caps for the national team.
paras.zh: Summit 是丹佛最新的、蓬勃发展的希望，已于 2025 年 1 月被接纳为 NWSL 扩充球队，传奇野马队四分卫佩顿·曼宁 (Peyton Manning) 是其所有权集团的一部分。最近，六名峰会球员被征召代表美国女子国家队参加 10 月份的国际比赛日。其中包括中场球员林赛·希普斯 (Lindsey Heaps)，她曾赢得过一次世界杯、两枚奥运会奖牌，并作为队长参加了 2023 年世界杯，代表国家队出场 170 多次。

paras.en: I attended Summit's 2-1 win over Seattle Reign, where a sold-out crowd of 12,272 watched on despite an hour-long rain delay. Chants of 'you can't do that' at the sight of a foul was a unique Americanism contrary to the more profane tirades customary to European football, but it proved yet another crowd reflective of Denver's deep-rooted sporting devotion.
paras.zh: 我观看了 Summit 2-1 战胜西雅图君临队的比赛，尽管由于下雨推迟了一个小时，仍有 12,272 名观众观看了比赛。看到犯规时高喊“你不能这么做”是一种独特的美国风格，与欧洲足球惯用的更亵渎的长篇大论相反，但这又证明了丹佛球迷对体育根深蒂固的热爱。

paras.en: Beyond its sport it is a city embodied by its gateway to the natural world.
paras.zh: 除了体育之外，它还是一座通向自然世界的城市。

paras.en: Dedicated Broncos fans might know 'Frank the Tank' as being the childhood nickname for offensive tackle Frank Crum, while others may know it to be the legendary moose bull of Rocky Mountain National Park. Sadly (or perhaps fortunately), a day trip into the mountains did not lead me to Frank.
paras.zh: 忠实的野马队球迷可能知道“坦克弗兰克”是进攻截锋弗兰克·克拉姆的童年昵称，而其他人可能知道它是落基山国家公园的传奇驼鹿公牛。可悲的是（或许幸运的是），一日山游并没有把我带到弗兰克那里。

paras.en: What it did lead me to was the otherworldly sights of Mount Blue Sky, where never-ending greenery, the whisper-inciting Echo Lake, Idaho Springs and scenic road loops along which Walter Mitty might skateboard delivered lifelong images for the mental archives. So too a buoyant tour guide who would inform us of his potential Big Foot encounter while camping in the surrounding forest area; I saw his photos, and the foot-prints are almost believable enough to sway the most stubborn of naysayer.
paras.zh: 它确实把我带到了蓝天山的超凡脱俗的景色，那里永无休止的绿色植物、令人耳语的回音湖、爱达荷斯普林斯和沃尔特·米蒂可能沿着风景优美的环路滑板，为我的精神档案留下了终生的图像。一位热情的导游也会告诉我们他在周围森林地区露营时可能遇到的大脚怪；我看过他的照片，脚印几乎可信，足以动摇最顽固的反对者。

paras.en: Anyway, it is a perfect calming complement to the city's Broncos mania, where ziplining and whitewater rafting still preserves Denver's commitment to sporting adrenaline. The views are truly something else.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，它是对这座城市野马队狂热的完美补充，高空滑索和激流漂流仍然保留着丹佛对运动肾上腺素的承诺。这些观点确实是另一回事。

paras.en: It is as versatile a sporting city as you might find in the United States, my deepest regret being my inability to ski such is the access to some of the world's greatest slopes.
paras.zh: 它是美国一座多才多艺的体育城市，我最遗憾的是我无法滑雪，无法进入世界上一些最大的滑雪场。

paras.en: Denver's RiNo district plays host to trendy shops, phenomenal street murals and the multiple cuisines of Denver Central Market. It is a community that offers a reminder to Denver's diversity, with Hispanic and Latino residents making up roughly 34 per cent of the city's population - and no doubt contributing to my faultless gameday chilaquiles at The Bindery.
paras.zh: 丹佛的 RiNo 区拥有时尚商店、精美的街头壁画和丹佛中央市场的多种美食。这个社区提醒人们注意丹佛的多样性，西班牙裔和拉丁裔居民约占该市人口的 34%，这无疑为我在 The Bindery 的比赛日完美的 Chilaquiles 做出了贡献。

paras.en: Shopping in Cherry Creek, the Denver Art Museum, the city's eight Michelin-starred restaurants and easy access to the Rocky Mountains occupy some days, while sport on tap awaits on every other.
paras.zh: 樱桃溪 (Cherry Creek) 购物、丹佛艺术博物馆 (Denver Art Museum)、市内八家米其林星级餐厅以及轻松前往落基山脉 (Rocky Mountains) 的交通会让您花上几天的时间，而每隔几天就可以参加体育运动。

paras.en: Bring your shorts, and a Broncos jersey.
paras.zh: 带上你的短裤和野马队球衣。

paras.en: For more information, visit visitdenver.com.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问visitdenver.com。

articles.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed Ukraine Starlink ‘loophole,’ while Kyiv denies breaching terms
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: Elon Musk has said his company imposed limits on the use of its Starlink satellite system in Ukraine last week, after curbs led to disruption to Ukrainian military operations.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，在限制措施导致乌克兰军事行动中断后，他的公司上周对其在乌克兰的星链卫星系统的使用实施了限制。

paras.en: Ukraine said Saturday that both Starlink, run by Musk’s SpaceX, and its military variant Starshield were now fully functional after the long outage, two days after President Donald Trump indicated Musk had been asked to “put it back.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰周六表示，由马斯克旗下 SpaceX 运营的 Starlink 及其军用变体 Starshield 在经历了长时间断电后现已完全正常运行，而两天前，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示马斯克已被要求“将其恢复”。

paras.en: “That loophole was closed last week,” the billionaire wrote.
paras.zh: “这个漏洞上周已被堵住，”这位亿万富翁写道。

paras.en: “Using Starlink, a civilian commercial service, for offensive drone strikes to kill people has never been allowed, nor should it be,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“利用民用商业服务星链进行进攻性无人机袭击来杀人是从来不被允许的，也不应该被允许。”

paras.en: SpaceX did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: SpaceX 没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Neither Musk nor the United States government had initially taken responsibility for imposing the curbs last week, with Musk saying previously with respect to Starshield that “any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS.”
paras.zh: 马斯克和美国政府最初都没有对上周实施限制承担责任，马斯克此前就“星盾”表示，“对速度或使用的任何限制均由美国军方决定，最终由美国总统决定。”

paras.en: Trump says he 'wasn't involved' in limiting Ukraine's Starlink access
paras.zh: 特朗普称他“没有参与”限制乌克兰星链接入

paras.en: Starlink technology is critical to front-line communications as well as Ukraine’s drone operations and its ability to intercept jet-powered drones launched by Russia.
paras.zh: 星链技术对于前线通信以及乌克兰的无人机行动及其拦截俄罗斯发射的喷气式无人机的能力至关重要。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials said the restrictions were imposed without warning and capped Starshield operations at speeds of 100 mph, hampering the military’s ability to intercept drones and forcing the cancellation of some operations.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员表示，这些限制是在没有警告的情况下实施的，并将“星盾”行动的速度限制在 100 英里/小时，这阻碍了军方拦截无人机的能力，并迫使部分行动取消。

paras.en: “Starlink remains critical to the defense of Ukraine, as it is the only system that cannot be jammed or blown up, at least for now,” Musk said. “Were Starlink to be turned off, the Ukrainian front line would collapse immediately. This is NOT a threat, it is simply a statement of fact.”
paras.zh: 马斯克表示：“星链对于乌克兰的防御仍然至关重要，因为它是唯一不会被干扰或炸毁的系统，至少目前如此。” “如果星链被关闭，乌克兰前线将立即崩溃。这不是威胁，这只是事实的陈述。”

paras.en: In a series of posts and replies, he called his critics “bloodthirsty warmongers” who “want the war to continue until every last man in Ukraine has died in a ditch.”
paras.zh: 在一系列帖子和回复中，他称批评者是“嗜血的战争贩子”，“希望战争继续下去，直到乌克兰的每一个人都死在沟里”。

paras.en: Hours later, responding to an X user comment that said “Zelensky needs to go,” Musk responded: “Yes.”
paras.zh: 几个小时后，在回复 X 用户评论“泽伦斯基需要下台”时，马斯克回答说：“是的。”

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Starlink speeds started returning to normal on Saturday night. Ukraine’s defense ministry said Saturday that the connection remained stable at over 250 mph. The Ukrainian military does not disclose the systems’ maximum operating speeds.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，星链速度已于周六晚上开始恢复正常。乌克兰国防部周六表示，连接速度稳定在 250 英里/小时以上。乌克兰军方没有透露该系统的最大运行速度。

paras.en: Russia has barraged Ukraine over the past week, Zelenskyy said on Sunday, though he did not draw any direct link to the limitations.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周日表示，俄罗斯在过去一周对乌克兰进行了猛烈攻击，但他没有将其与这些限制联系起来。

paras.en: “This past week alone, Russia has launched around 1,600 guided aerial bombs, 48 missiles of various types, including ballistic missiles, and nearly 2,300 attack drones against Ukraine. Unfortunately, almost every day, these brutal strikes leave people killed and injured,” he said in a post on X.
paras.zh: “仅过去一周，俄罗斯就向乌克兰发射了约 1,600 枚制导炸弹、48 枚各种类型的导弹，包括弹道导弹，以及近 2,300 架攻击无人机。不幸的是，这些残酷的袭击几乎每天都会造成人员伤亡，”他在 X 上发帖称。

paras.en: The restrictions on Starlink services last week came amid a souring of relations between the White House and Ukraine, after President Donald Trump agreed to a diesel deal with Russia, waived sweeping sanctions and called for Ukraine to get a new president.
paras.zh: 上周对星链服务的限制是在唐纳德·特朗普总统同意与俄罗斯达成柴油协议、放弃全面制裁并呼吁乌克兰选出新总统之后，白宫和乌克兰之间的关系恶化。

paras.en: The disruption to the service also coincided with what Ukrainian officials described as a temporary interruption to U.S. intelligence warnings about incoming Russian attacks.
paras.zh: 服务中断也恰逢乌克兰官员称美国情报部门对俄罗斯即将发动的袭击的警告暂时中断。

paras.en: In a response to Musk on Sunday, Ukrainian presidential adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov said: “It’s very strange that Elon Musk doesn’t know about the restrictions on Starlink in Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统顾问谢尔盖·别斯克雷斯诺夫 (Serhiy Beskrestnov) 周日在回应马斯克时表示：“埃隆·马斯克不知道乌克兰对星链的限制，这很奇怪。”

paras.en: “Starlink does not work over Russian territory,” he said in a post on Telegram. “So we PHYSICALLY CANNOT USE COMMERCIAL STARLINK for deep strikes and mid-range strikes.”
paras.zh: “星链在俄罗斯领土上不起作用，”他在 Telegram 上发帖称。 “因此，我们实际上无法使用商业星链进行纵深打击和中程打击。”

paras.en: Serhii Sternenko, a former drone adviser to Ukraine’s defense ministry, said that using a civilian Starlink service for drone missions like Musk had described was “technically impossible.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰国防部前无人机顾问谢尔希·斯特年科(Serhii Sternenko)表示，像马斯克所描述的那样，使用民用星链服务执行无人机任务“在技术上是不可能的”。

paras.en: “For any satellite terminal to work while on the move, it had to be added to a special list and connected to the military Starshield system,” he posted on X. “All drone missions that required satellite communication could only be carried out using Starshield.”
paras.zh: 他在 X 上发帖称：“任何卫星终端要想在移动中工作，就必须将其添加到特殊列表中并连接到军用 Starshield 系统。所有需要卫星通信的无人机任务都只能使用 Starshield 来执行。”

paras.en: “We are very grateful to the United States and SpaceX for access to critically important satellite communications. Ukraine did not violate the terms of use,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们非常感谢美国和 SpaceX 获得至关重要的卫星通信。乌克兰没有违反使用条款，”他补充道。

paras.en: Ukrainian drone strikes deep within Russia have continued over the past week despite the Starlink issues.
paras.zh: 尽管存在Starlink问题，但过去一周乌克兰无人机在俄罗斯境内的袭击仍在继续。

paras.en: Asked whether he thought Trump or Musk had directly made the decision to limit Starlink, Zelenskyy told NBC News’ “Meet the Press” last week he did not know but thought “both” were involved. He said that if Trump decided tomorrow to lift the restriction, “it will immediately work as it was before.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否认为特朗普或马斯克直接做出了限制星链的决定时，泽连斯基上周在 NBC 新闻节目“会见媒体”节目中表示，他不知道，但认为“两人”都参与其中。他表示，如果特朗普明天决定取消限制，“它将立即像以前一样发挥作用。”

paras.en: Asked whether he spoke to Musk on Thursday, Trump said: “I don’t want to comment on it, whether I called or whether somebody else called, doesn’t make any difference, I guess. The bottom line — he put it back.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他周四是否与马斯克通话时，特朗普表示：“我不想对此发表评论，我想无论是我打电话还是其他人打电话，都没有任何区别。最重要的是，他把电话放了回去。”

paras.en: Amid the dispute, there have been signs that Ukraine is keen for more control over its communications.
paras.zh: 在这场争端中，有迹象表明乌克兰渴望对其通讯加强控制。

paras.en: Last week, the country’s defense ministry announced a partnership with Nokia and Finnish satellite imagery firm ICEYE to develop a “sovereign satellite communications” system, with the two firms already working on building a Starlink-style satellite internet system “built on trusted European technology.”
paras.zh: 上周，该国国防部宣布与诺基亚和芬兰卫星图像公司 ICEYE 合作开发“主权卫星通信”系统，两家公司已经致力于构建“基于可信欧洲技术”的星链式卫星互联网系统。

paras.en: “Modern warfare has proven that reliable communications are a matter of national security,” Zelenskyy said of the deal at the time. “We must all rely on capabilities that we can control.”
paras.zh: “现代战争已经证明，可靠的通信关系到国家安全，”泽伦斯基当时谈到这笔交易时说道。 “我们都必须依赖我们可以控制的能力。”

paras.en: Musk’s ability to limit Starlink gives him “enormous leverage,” said Moritz Brake, a senior fellow at the Center for Advanced Security, a Washington-based think tank.
paras.zh: 华盛顿智库高级安全中心高级研究员莫里茨·布雷克表示，马斯克限制星链的能力给了他“巨大的影响力”。

paras.en: “This is indeed one of the reasons why the European Union is pursuing independent space infrastructure capabilities, military capabilities, communication capabilities,” he told NBC News.
paras.zh: “这确实是欧盟追求独立太空基础设施能力、军事能力、通信能力的原因之一，”他告诉美国全国广播公司新闻。

paras.en: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius announced plans in 2025 to spend $39 billion on Germany’s defense space capabilities, but Brake said Europe still had plenty of ground to cover to match “the need for space assets in peace and war.”
paras.zh: 德国国防部长鲍里斯·皮斯托利斯宣布计划在 2025 年斥资 390 亿美元增强德国的国防太空能力，但布雷克表示，欧洲仍有足够的空间来满足“和平与战争时期对太空资产的需求”。

paras.en: “This is something Ukraine is now experiencing on the sharp end,” Brake added.
paras.zh: “这就是乌克兰现在正在经历的最尖锐的事情，”布雷克补充道。

paras.en: There have been concerns about potential interference with Ukraine’s Starlink connection before, with a September 2022 interruption occurring during a pivotal push by Ukraine to retake territory from Russia.
paras.zh: 此前，人们一直担心乌克兰的星链连接可能受到干扰，2022 年 9 月，乌克兰在从俄罗斯手中夺回领土的关键行动中发生了一次中断。

paras.en: A Reuters report in 2025 cited three sources who alleged that Musk gave an order that disrupted the counteroffensive, triggering a communication blackout and leaving long-range artillery units reliant on Starlink struggling to hit their targets.
paras.zh: 路透社 2025 年的一篇报道援引三位消息人士的话称，马斯克下达的命令扰乱了反攻，引发了通讯中断，导致依赖星链的远程炮兵部队难以击中目标。

paras.en: A SpaceX spokesperson called the news agency’s reporting “inaccurate.”
paras.zh: SpaceX 发言人称该通讯社的报道“不准确”。

articles.title: NFL fans in Paris for Saints vs. Steelers game were undeterred by protests
articles.author: Doha Madani

paras.en: PARIS — American football fans brought high energy, chants and smiles to Stade de France on Sunday to watch the Pittsburgh Steelers face the New Orleans Saints. Some said the mass protests in the city were not an issue during their weekend trip.
paras.zh: 巴黎——周日，美国球迷带着高昂的歌声和微笑来到法兰西体育场观看匹兹堡钢人队对阵新奥尔良圣徒队的比赛。一些人表示，在周末旅行期间，该市的大规模抗议活动并不是问题。

paras.en: The NFL’s first regular-season game in France came a day after more than 400,000 people around the country took to the streets to protest educational funding and the high cost of living. At least 110,000 of those protesters were concentrated in Paris, according to the French Interior Ministry.
paras.zh: NFL 在法国举行首场常规赛的一天前，全国超过 40 万人走上街头抗议教育经费和高昂的生活成本。据法国内政部称，其中至少 11 万名抗议者集中在巴黎。

paras.en: Although the demonstrations were largely peaceful, some clashes broke out, prompting French security forces to use tear gas and water cannons in several cities. Paris prosecutors said there were 64 arrests in the nation’s capital on Saturday, mostly for suspected weapons offenses or participation in a group preparing violence or property damage.
paras.zh: 尽管示威活动基本上是和平的，但还是爆发了一些冲突，促使法国安全部队在几个城市使用催泪瓦斯和水枪。巴黎检察官表示，周六，巴黎有 64 人被捕，大部分因涉嫌武器犯罪或参与准备暴力或破坏财产的团体而被捕。

paras.en: But American visitors in town to cheer on their teams told NBC News that everyone they’ve encountered had been welcoming.
paras.zh: 但镇上为球队加油的美国游客告诉 NBC 新闻，他们遇到的每个人都很热情。

paras.en: Lifelong friends and Saints fans Sindhu Pandit, Shruti Menon and Pramod Menon said they never felt the game would be canceled. Pandit said the key to their own movements around the city was to stay informed.
paras.zh: 辛德胡·潘迪特 (Sindhu Pandit)、施鲁蒂·梅农 (Shruti Menon) 和普拉莫德·梅农 (Pramod Menon) 是圣徒队的终生好友和球迷，他们表示，他们从未认为比赛会被取消。潘伟迪表示，他们在城市中行动的关键是随时了解情况。

paras.en: Pramod Menon added that locals were “incredibly hospitable” and considerate of the fact that they were visitors. The friends said they came to support both the country and their team, a sentiment his wife shared.
paras.zh: 普拉莫德·梅农 (Pramod Menon) 补充说，当地人“非常热情好客”，并且考虑到他们是游客。朋友们表示，他们来这里是为了支持国家和球队，他的妻子也有同样的感受。

paras.en: “We’re so excited to be here in Paris, and what a perfect place for New Orleans, the home of the French,” Shruti Menon said. “And so it’s wonderful to be here.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴来到巴黎，对于法国人的故乡新奥尔良来说，这是一个多么完美的地方，”施鲁蒂·梅农说。 “所以很高兴来到这里。”

paras.en: Sean Warner, a Steelers fan since 1974, may not share the Menons’ taste in teams, but he also told NBC News that he and his wife, Saroja, were having a “wonderful” time in Paris.
paras.zh: 自 1974 年以来一直是钢人队球迷的肖恩·华纳 (Sean Warner) 可能不认同梅农队对球队的品味，但他也告诉 NBC 新闻，他和妻子萨罗贾 (Saroja) 在巴黎度过了“美妙”的时光。

paras.en: “We were concerned about the riots and everything that we had heard about and read about, but quite honestly, it’s been amazing,” he said. “The experience has been fantastic. ... Paris has really tried to work hard to, you know, make people feel safe and comfortable, and then enjoy the experience.”
paras.zh: “我们对骚乱以及我们所听到和读到的一切感到担忧，但说实话，这真是太棒了，”他说。 “这种体验太棒了。……巴黎真的很努力，让人们感到安全和舒适，然后享受这种体验。”

paras.en: The Washington, D.C.-based couple, who have visited Paris several times, spent Saturday walking around the city. Saroja Warner said it was a bit sad to see some businesses with boarded-up windows, but any clashes seemed “localized.”
paras.zh: 这对住在华盛顿特区的夫妇曾多次访问巴黎，周六在这座城市里散步。萨罗贾·华纳 (Saroja Warner) 表示，看到一些企业的窗户用木板封起来有点令人难过，但任何冲突似乎都是“局部的”。

paras.en: “We walked around Paris all day till about 6 o’clock at night ... and we didn’t see any unrest, any crazy stuff,” she said. “It just felt like a lot of folks trying to have a nice time on a rainy day in Paris.”
paras.zh: “我们整天在巴黎闲逛，直到晚上 6 点左右……我们没有看到任何骚乱，任何疯狂的事情，”她说。 “感觉就像很多人都想在巴黎的雨天度过愉快的时光。”

paras.en: The Steelers beat the Saints 16-10 at France’s national stadium, just outside the heart of Paris. The game is the latest in a series of international games the NFL has scheduled in recent seasons to grow the sport outside of its domestic audience.
paras.zh: 钢人队在巴黎市中心郊外的法国国家体育场以 16-10 击败圣徒队。这场比赛是 NFL 近几个赛季为了在国内观众之外发展这项运动而安排的一系列国际比赛中的最新一场。

paras.en: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell told reporters Wednesday that he was not concerned about the Paris protests ahead of the game and was comfortable with the security preparations the league had made in coordination with French authorities.
paras.zh: 美国国家橄榄球联盟(NFL)专员罗杰·古德尔(Roger Goodell)周三对记者表示，他并不担心赛前巴黎的抗议活动，并且对联盟与法国当局协调所做的安全准备工作感到满意。

paras.en: “Protests are not unusual in France, as you know, and that’s something that we will be aware of and make sure that the appropriate arrangements are made,” Goodell said.
paras.zh: 古德尔说：“正如你所知，抗议活动在法国并不罕见，我们会意识到这一点，并确保做出适当的安排。”

paras.en: Figures from the Interior Ministry indicate Saturday’s demonstrations produced significantly fewer problems than those the week before. There were about 1,300 arrests nationwide, roughly half the previous week’s total. Only 53 members of the security forces reported injuries, compared with 1,144 the week before, according to the ministry.
paras.zh: 内政部的数据显示，周六的示威活动产生的问题比前一周明显减少。全国约有 1,300 人被捕，大约是前一周总数的一半。据该部称，只有 53 名安全部队成员报告受伤，而前一周有 1,144 人受伤。

paras.en: The unrest began weeks ago, when students at a high school in Créteil, a suburb of Paris, began protesting a lack of resources and poor conditions at their school. Students at other schools in the poorer suburbs surrounding Paris soon joined, and the protests grew into a movement of students across France.
paras.zh: 骚乱始于几周前，当时巴黎郊区克雷泰伊一所高中的学生开始抗议学校资源匮乏和条件恶劣。巴黎周边较贫困郊区其他学校的学生很快也加入进来，抗议活动发展成为法国各地的学生运动。

paras.en: The teenagers blocked entrances to their schools and demanded that the French government invest in their educations by increasing staffing, repairing aging buildings and providing more resources to the public education system. Their protests caught the attention of many across the country who were struggling with the high cost of living.
paras.zh: 这些青少年封锁了学校的入口，并要求法国政府通过增加人员配备、修复老化建筑以及为公共教育系统提供更多资源来投资他们的教育。他们的抗议引起了全国许多正在与高生活成本作斗争的人的注意。

paras.en: Protest organizers agreed to the plans coordinated with the French government on Saturday, the Interior Ministry said Sunday. But the ministry warned that high-risk groups, largely made up “of radical far-left and ultraleft activists,” had infiltrated demonstrations in medium- and large-sized cities. It blamed those groups for “fomenting attacks” against law enforcement, businesses and other people.
paras.zh: 内政部周日表示，抗议组织者周六同意了与法国政府协调的计划。但该部警告说，主要由“激进极左和极左活动人士”组成的高风险团体已经渗透到大中城市的示威活动中。报告指责这些组织“煽动攻击”执法部门、企业和其他人。

paras.en: “While the level of violence from these radical elements was the same as last week, their attempted actions — which triggered systematic intervention by law enforcement in line with the clear instructions of the Minister of the Interior — were generally thwarted,” the ministry said.
paras.zh: 内政部表示：“虽然这些激进分子的暴力程度与上周相同，但他们试图采取的行动——引发执法部门根据内政部长的明确指示进行系统性干预——总体上遭到挫败。”

paras.en: Richard Engel and Marc Smith reported from Paris and Doha Madani from New York City.
paras.zh: 理查德·恩格尔和马克·史密斯从巴黎报道，多哈·马达尼从纽约报道。

articles.title: FA expecting Socceroos friendlies in Middle East to go ahead

paras.en: Football Australia says Socceroos will play friendlies in Qatar, Jordan before Asian Cup
paras.zh: 澳大利亚足球协会表示，澳大利亚足球队将在亚洲杯之前在卡塔尔和约旦进行友谊赛

paras.en: Football Australia says it is monitoring the security situation in the Middle East ahead of two upcoming Socceroos friendlies.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚足球协会表示，在即将举行的两场澳大利亚国家队友谊赛之前，他们正在监控中东的安全局势。

paras.en: The Australian team is scheduled to play Qatar in Doha and Jordan in Amman next month as the last outings ahead of January's Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队计划下个月在多哈对阵卡塔尔，在安曼对阵约旦，作为一月份在沙特阿拉伯举行的亚洲杯之前的最后一场比赛。

paras.en: Recent violence in the region has heightened concerns, but FA says it expects the games to go ahead..
paras.zh: 该地区最近发生的暴力事件加剧了人们的担忧，但英足总表示预计比赛将如期举行。

articles.title: Former teacher Tayla Lee Brailey jailed for sex acts with students
articles.author: Charles Rushforth

paras.en: A woman who taught at a Sydney high school has been given a 15-month prison sentence for sexual offences involving two male students.
paras.zh: 一名在悉尼一所高中任教的女性因涉及两名男学生的性犯罪而被判处 15 个月监禁。

paras.en: Tayla Lee Brailey appeared in Parramatta District Court today after pleading guilty to four charges relating to sex acts committed against two teenage students in 2024, including using a carriage service to transmit and access child abuse material.
paras.zh: 泰拉·李·布雷利 (Tayla Lee Brailey) 今天在帕拉马塔地方法院出庭，承认了四项与 2024 年对两名青少年学生实施性行为有关的指控，其中包括使用运输服务传输和获取虐待儿童材料。

paras.en: Judge Elizabeth Ryan said the manner in which Brailey had broken the trust between teacher and student warranted a custodial sentence.
paras.zh: 法官伊丽莎白·瑞安表示，布莱利破坏了师生之间的信任，因此应被判处监禁。

paras.en: "Offences like this cause immense harm to the trust that must exist between families and the education system," Judge Ryan said.
paras.zh: 瑞安法官说：“此类犯罪行为对家庭和教育系统之间必须存在的信任造成了巨大损害。”

paras.en: "For these reasons … no penalty other than imprisonment is appropriate."
paras.zh: “出于这些原因……除了监禁之外，没有其他处罚是适当的。”

paras.en: Brailey was first arrested by detectives at a Sydney school in August 2024, when she was charged with offences relating to sexual touching and sexual intercourse with a person under special care.
paras.zh: Brailey于2024年8月在悉尼一所学校首次被侦探逮捕，当时她被指控犯有与性接触和与特别照顾的人发生性关系的罪行。

paras.en: After being released on bail, she was arrested again less than two weeks later and charged with multiple sex offences relating to a second teenage student.
paras.zh: 在被保释后，她在不到两周后再次被捕，并被指控犯有与第二名青少年学生有关的多项性犯罪。

paras.en: The court heard Brailey had initiated contact with one teenager.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉布雷利已开始与一名青少年联系。

paras.en: Reading a victim impact statement prepared by one of the teenagers, the judge said the offending had a deep impact on the students.
paras.zh: 法官阅读了其中一名青少年准备的受害者影响陈述后表示，这一罪行对学生产生了深远的影响。

paras.en: "He wrote that he has been feeling ashamed and had to leave high school before he finished year 12, because of the shame he felt," the judge said.
paras.zh: 法官说：“他写道，他一直感到羞耻，因此在 12 年级读完之前就不得不离开高中，因为他感到羞耻。”

paras.en: "He had suffered lack of sleep and flashbacks … he said none of his friends at high school speak to him anymore.
paras.zh: “他饱受睡眠不足和回忆的困扰……他说他高中时的朋友都不再和他说话了。

paras.en: The judge also acknowledged letters submitted by members of Brailey's family, which said the 32-year-old's crimes had cost her a husband, her job and reputation.
paras.zh: 法官还承认了布莱利家人提交的信件，信中称这位 32 岁的布莱利的罪行让她失去了丈夫、工作和声誉。

paras.en: Reading a psychologist's report tendered to the court, the judge said Brailey had been diagnosed with bipolar disorder and was likely experiencing a manic episode at the time of the offending.
paras.zh: 法官在阅读了提交给法庭的心理学家报告后表示，布雷利被诊断出患有双相情感障碍，并且在犯罪时很可能正在经历躁狂发作。

paras.en: "In July 2023, Ms Brailey made terrible mistakes," the judge said.
paras.zh: “2023 年 7 月，布雷利女士犯了可怕的错误，”法官说。

paras.en: "She used her position as a teacher … to abuse the trust of two young persons."
paras.zh: “她利用自己教师的身份……滥用了两个年轻人的信任。”

paras.en: Brailey will be eligible for parole on April 24, 2027.
paras.zh: 布雷利将于 2027 年 4 月 24 日获得假释资格。

paras.en: The judge made orders for her to be placed on the NSW Police child protection register for 15 years.
paras.zh: 法官下令将她列入新南威尔士州警察儿童保护登记册，为期 15 年。

articles.title: SA MP recounts 'non-stop' messages and being followed to her car
articles.author: Jordanna Schriever

paras.en: Two female South Australian politicians say they have experienced "unwanted" behaviour from a man who has been cautioned by police for stalking.
paras.zh: 两名南澳大利亚女性政客表示，她们经历了一名男子的“不受欢迎”行为，该男子因跟踪而受到警方警告。

paras.en: Lucy Hood and Ella Shaw say they are frustrated by their experiences but have vowed to continue appearing publicly in their local communities.
paras.zh: 露西·胡德（ Lucy Hood ）和艾拉·肖（ Ella Shaw ）表示，他们对自己的经历感到沮丧，但发誓要继续在当地社区公开露面。

paras.en: SA Police will hold a briefing session with all MPs to update them on security issues, arrangements and precautions.
paras.zh: 南澳警方将与所有议员举行简报会，向他们介绍安全问题、安排和​​预防措施的最新情况。

paras.en: Two female South Australian MPs have shared their "frustration" at being targeted by the same stalker — including an incident where one of them was followed back to her car — ahead of a security briefing prompted by the alleged attack on Victorian MP Helen Haines.
paras.zh: 两名南澳大利亚女议员在因维多利亚州议员海伦·海恩斯涉嫌袭击事件而举行的安全简报会之前，分享了她们被同一跟踪者盯上的“挫败感”，其中包括其中一人被跟踪回到她的车上的事件。

paras.en: SA Police said yesterday a 44-year-old northern suburbs man had been issued with stalking cautions for separate incidents involving two MPs which occurred "at different locations".
paras.zh: 南澳警方昨天表示，一名 44 岁的北郊男子因在“不同地点”发生的涉及两名议员的不同事件而收到跟踪警告。

paras.en: Education Minister Lucy Hood and Member for Elizabeth, Ella Shaw, spoke out today "to end speculation" on whom the police report was referring to.
paras.zh: 教育部长露西·胡德和伊丽莎白议员埃拉·肖今天发表讲话，“结束对警方报告所指对象的猜测”。

paras.en: Ms Shaw said the man initially made contact with her online and messaged her "non-stop" over a period of about six months, beginning before she won her seat at this year's state election.
paras.zh: 肖女士说，这名男子最初在网上与她联系，并在大约六个月的时间里“不间断”地给她发信息，从她在今年的州选举中赢得席位之前开始。

paras.en: She said she was at a local community event when she was followed back to her car.
paras.zh: 她说，当她被跟踪回车时，她正在参加当地的一个社区活动。

paras.en: "It was just unwanted behaviour," she said.
paras.zh: “这只是不受欢迎的行为，”她说。

paras.en: "Luckily my family were waiting by my car … and we managed to head off together."
paras.zh: “幸运的是，我的家人在我的车旁等着……我们设法一起出发了。”

paras.en: She said she felt safe in her job, but the escalation to in-person behaviour had been concerning.
paras.zh: 她说她在工作中感到安全，但面对面行为的升级一直令人担忧。

paras.en: "We receive abusive comments online regularly, but when we are receiving inappropriate, unwanted commentary in our messages that's a disconnect with it being on the screen," she said.
paras.zh: “我们经常在网上收到辱骂性评论，但当我们在信息中收到不恰当的、不需要的评论时，这些评论就与屏幕上的内容脱节了，”她说。

paras.en: "When it comes to an in-person thing, that's where the behaviour became completely unwanted. You can ignore a DM [direct message], when it's in person, it's a different story."
paras.zh: “当涉及到面对面的事情时，这种行为就变得完全不受欢迎了。你可以忽略 DM [直接消息]，但当它是面对面的时候，情况就不同了。”

paras.en: Similarly, Ms Hood, who was first elected in 2022, said her experiences with the man began about three years ago.
paras.zh: 同样，胡德女士于2022年首次当选，她说她与这名男子的经历始于大约三年前。

paras.en: "I was quite devastated, when I learned from Ella that she had experienced the same behaviour from the individual, I was hoping it was an isolated case in my instance," Ms Hood said.
paras.zh: 胡德女士说：“当我从艾拉那里得知她也经历过同样的行为时，我感到非常震惊，我希望这只是我的个案。”

paras.en: She said an occasion where police had become involved occurred while she was hosting a community event.
paras.zh: 她说，当她主持社区活动时，警方介入了一次。

paras.en: She said the behaviour was not aggressive, but she was concerned because her children were present.
paras.zh: 她说这种行为并不具有攻击性，但她很担心，因为她的孩子在场。

paras.en: "It can be concerning, you can feel unsafe when you see someone rock up to the place that you have advertised your location, or follow you or persistently rock up at the location that you've advertised yourself at," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“这可能令人担忧，当你看到有人来到你为你做广告的地方，或者跟踪你，或者持续地在你为你做广告的地方做广告时，你会感到不安全。”

paras.en: In the wake of the alleged attack on Victorian MP Helen Haines, Ms Hood said there was heightened unease.
paras.zh: 胡德女士表示，在维多利亚州议员海伦·海恩斯遭到袭击后，人们的不安情绪加剧。

paras.en: "My concern is that that level of discourse that we see online is spilling over the keyboard, into real life and then it's almost giving permission for people to use that abhorrent behaviour and language and the way they speak to people and do it in person, to their face," she said.
paras.zh: “我担心的是，我们在网上看到的这种程度的言论正在溢出键盘，进入现实生活，然后它几乎允许人们使用这种令人憎恶的行为和语言以及他们与人交谈的方式，当面面对面，”她说。

paras.en: "We should be a country that can disagree agreeably, have different points of view, and feel safe being able to have those conversations and arguments and sometimes agree to disagree."
paras.zh: “我们应该是一个可以同意不同意见、有不同观点、能够进行这些对话和争论并有时同意不同意见的国家。”

paras.en: Both MPs said they were "frustrated" about their experiences, but felt supported by SA Police and vowed to continue appearing publicly in their communities to show young people considering a career in politics they should not be deterred.
paras.zh: 两位议员均表示，他们对自己的经历感到“沮丧”，但感到得到了南澳警方的支持，并誓言将继续在社区公开露面，向考虑从政的年轻人表明，他们不应该被吓倒。

paras.en: "We think that anybody, regardless of whether you are a younger person, an older person, a male or a female should feel safe in their workplace and safe going about their work," Ms Hood said.
paras.zh: 胡德女士说：“我们认为，任何人，无论是年轻人、老年人、男性还是女性，都应该在工作场所感到安全，并安全地开展工作。”

paras.en: Police said they issued the cautions on Tuesday, adding that any individual can be formally charged with stalking "if they breach the conditions of the stalking caution".
paras.zh: 警方表示，他们于周二发布了警告，并补充说，任何个人“如果违反跟踪警告的条件”，都可能被正式指控为跟踪行为。

paras.en: In a separate statement, SA Police said the security of parliamentarians was "under constant review and assessment", with more than a dozen incidents investigated this year.
paras.zh: 南澳警方在另一份声明中表示，议员的安全“正在不断审查和评估”，今年已调查了十几起事件。

paras.en: "These security arrangements are continually adjusted as necessary based on the latest intelligence to ensure appropriate measures are in place," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“根据最新情报，这些安全安排会根据需要不断调整，以确保采取适当的措施。”

paras.en: "So far this year police have investigated 18 incidents including threats against SA MPs, harassment and/or threats against electorate office staff and vandalism.
paras.zh: “今年到目前为止，警方已调查了 18 起事件，包括威胁南澳议员、骚扰和/或威胁选举办公室工作人员以及破坏公物。

paras.en: "Last year 11 such investigations were conducted."
paras.zh: “去年进行了 11 起此类调查。”

paras.en: SA Police will conduct a briefing session with all MPs tomorrow "to update them on security issues, arrangements, and precautions" in the wake of the incident involving Ms Haines.
paras.zh: 在涉及海恩斯女士的事件发生后，南澳警方将于明天与所有议员举行简报会，“向他们通报安全问题、安排和​​预防措施的最新情况”。

paras.en: "While the incident involving Dr Haines appears to be isolated, the briefing for MPs will include the latest threat assessments and steps they can initiate to enhance their personal safety," police said.
paras.zh: 警方表示：“虽然涉及海恩斯博士的事件似乎是孤立的，但向国会议员提供的简报将包括最新的威胁评估以及他们可以采取的加强个人安全的措施。”

articles.title: El Salvador deploys hundreds of soldiers to Haiti: security official

paras.en: El Salvador deploys hundreds of soldiers to Haiti: security official
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多向海地部署数百名士兵：安全官员

paras.en: Unclear how long incoming soldiers will remain in the Caribbean country
paras.zh: 尚不清楚即将到来的士兵将在加勒比国家停留多久

paras.en: El Salvador has sent about 1,000 troops to Haiti after four Salvadoran members of a UN-backed force went missing during a gang ambush on the outskirts of the capital of Port-au-Prince, a security official in Haiti told Reuters on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 海地一名安全官员周二告诉路透社，联合国支持的部队的四名萨尔瓦多成员在首都太子港郊区的一次帮派伏击中失踪，萨尔瓦多已向海地派遣了约 1,000 名士兵。

paras.en: The arrival of the flights carrying troops in recent days dramatically expands the Central American nation's role in Haiti's long-standing gang conflict. Yet it remains unclear who will command the new Salvadoran contingent, how long it will stay in Haiti or whether more forces will follow.
paras.zh: 最近几天运载部队的航班的抵达极大地扩大了这个中美洲国家在海地长期帮派冲突中的作用。然而，目前尚不清楚谁将指挥这支新的萨尔瓦多特遣队，他们将在海地停留多久，或者是否会有更多部队跟随。

paras.en: The Haitian and Salvadoran governments did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The security official in Haiti spoke on condition of anonymity due to the sensitive security situation.
paras.zh: 海地和萨尔瓦多政府没有立即回应置评请求。由于安全局势敏感，海地安全官员要求匿名。

paras.en: The surge in deployments comes as the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF) has reached about 2,000 troops — just over a third of the planned size a year into its mandate — with limited impacts on Haitian security.
paras.zh: 部署激增之际，联合国支持的镇压帮派部队 (GSF) 的兵力已达到约 2,000 人——刚上任一年后计划规模的三分之一多一点——对海地安全的影响有限。

paras.en: GSF did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: GSF 没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: - El Salvador's president says military operation launched in Haiti to retrieve missing UN force members
paras.zh: -萨尔瓦多总统表示，在海地发动了军事行动，以找回失踪的联合国部队成员

paras.en: - 4 soldiers from El Salvador missing in Haiti after attack by gangs
paras.zh: - 4名萨尔瓦多士兵在海地遭帮派袭击后失踪

paras.en: Armed gangs in Haiti have meanwhile expanded their influence over the capital and surrounding regions through extortion and brutal attacks that have displaced nearly 1.5 million people.
paras.zh: 与此同时，海地武装团伙通过勒索和残酷袭击扩大了对首都及周边地区的影响力，导致近 150 万人流离失所。

paras.en: Haiti's leadership has since 2022 requested international security support, despite the country's fraught history of foreign intervention. Gang influence grew rapidly after the 2021 assassination of president Jovenel Moïse, deepening a security crisis that has caused authorities to repeatedly delay elections.
paras.zh: 尽管海地有着令人担忧的外国干预历史，但自 2022 年以来，海地领导人一直请求国际安全支持。 2021 年总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹遇刺后，帮派影响力迅速扩大，加剧了安全危机，导致当局一再推迟选举。

paras.en: Pierre Esperance, head of Haiti's National Human Rights Defense Network, welcomed the unusually rapid Salvadoran deployment and said he hoped it would help stop gangs from terrorizing civilians. But he warned that any operation must avoid harming residents trapped in gang-held neighbourhoods.
paras.zh: 海地国家人权捍卫网络负责人皮埃尔·埃斯佩兰斯对萨尔瓦多异常迅速的部署表示欢迎，并表示他希望这将有助于阻止帮派恐吓平民。但他警告说，任何行动都必须避免伤害被困在帮派控制的社区的居民。

paras.en: "Not everybody living in gang-controlled areas are gangsters," he said.
paras.zh: “并不是所有生活在帮派控制地区的人都是帮派，”他说。

paras.en: Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele last week announced a military operation to recover the missing Salvadorans, who have been unaccounted for since leaping from a burning vehicle during an ambush. He has not said how many troops would be sent.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多总统纳伊布·布克莱上周宣布采取军事行动，寻找失踪的萨尔瓦多人，这些人在一次伏击中从燃烧的车辆中跳下后一直下落不明。他没有透露将派遣多少军队。

paras.en: The U.S. provided C-130 military transport jets to help move Salvadoran troops to Haiti, a U.S. military official said.
paras.zh: 一名美国军方官员表示，美国提供了 C-130 军用运输机，帮助萨尔瓦多军队前往海地。

paras.en: Additional commercial and military flights between San Salvador and Port-au-Prince were visible on flight tracking website Flightradar24 and were also reported by the Miami Herald.
paras.zh: 在航班跟踪网站 Flightradar24 上可以看到圣萨尔瓦多和太子港之间的其他商业和军用航班，《迈阿密先驱报》也对此进行了报道。

paras.en: A photo posted on X on Tuesday by a lawmaker from Bukele's ruling party showed a plane carrying uniformed soldiers, some taking selfies.
paras.zh: 周二，布克莱执政党的一名议员在 X 上发布了一张照片，显示一架飞机上载着身穿制服的士兵，其中一些人在自拍。

paras.en: Bukele has won broad support at home through a hardline anti-crime campaign that several right-wing governments in the Americas have sought to emulate. Human rights groups, however, warn that the crackdown has come at the cost of due process and has been linked to hundreds of deaths in custody.
paras.zh: Bukele has won broad support at home through a hardline anti-crime campaign that several right-wing governments in the Americas have sought to emulate.然而，人权组织警告说，镇压行动是以正当程序为代价的，并与数百人在拘留期间死亡有关。

paras.en: Bukele said the missing Salvadorans were air force technicians returning to base from a market and that he believed they were being held hostage by criminal groups.
paras.zh: 布克莱说，失踪的萨尔瓦多人是从市场返回基地的空军技术人员，他相信他们被犯罪团伙扣为人质。

paras.en: No Haitian gang leader has taken responsibility for the attack. Gang leader Wilson Joseph of 400 Mawozo has released videos in which he denies holding the Salvadorans hostage and rejects responsibility for what happened to them.
paras.zh: 没有海地帮派头目承认对此次袭击负责。 400 Mawozo 的帮派头目威尔逊·约瑟夫 (Wilson Joseph) 发布了视频，在视频中，他否认将萨尔瓦多人扣为人质，并拒绝对发生在他们身上的事情负责。

paras.en: Prior to the ambush, El Salvador had deployed at least 124 troops as part of the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force, according to a UN report.
paras.zh: 根据联合国报告，在伏击之前，萨尔瓦多部署了至少 124 名士兵，作为联合国支持的镇压帮派部队的一部分。

paras.en: - Dozens of Haitian civilians killed by police, security company drones in past year, Human Rights Watch says
paras.zh: - 人权观察称，去年有数十名海地平民被警察和安全公司的无人机杀害

paras.en: - Fatal mishap with explosive drone leaves 2 police officers dead in Haiti
paras.zh: - 海地无人机爆炸事故造成 2 名警察死亡

paras.en: Alongside the international mission, Haiti's government has also hired a private military company run by Blackwater founder and ally of U.S. President Donald Trump, Erik Prince, that has carried out controversial anti-gang drone operations since 2025.
paras.zh: 除了国际使命外，海地政府还聘请了黑水公司创始人、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的盟友埃里克·普林斯经营的一家私营军事公司，该公司自 2025 年以来一直开展有争议的反帮派无人机行动。

paras.en: Luis Contreras, a Salvadoran security and organized crime analyst, said he expected that at least some of the new troops would operate outside the UN-backed mission's chain of command and could co-ordinate with Prince's firm.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多安全和有组织犯罪分析师路易斯·孔特雷拉斯（ Luis Contreras ）表示，他预计至少有一些新部队将在联合国支持的特派团的指挥系统之外运作，并可以与普林斯的公司进行协调。

paras.en: "The UN has lacked the political will to resolve the issue of the gangs in Haiti," he said. "Once the whereabouts of the four members have been established, they will have to assess whether to engage in a direct and protracted confrontation."
paras.zh: “联合国缺乏解决海地帮派问题的政治意愿，”他说。 “一旦确定四名成员的下落，他们将不得不评估是否进行直接且持久的对抗。”

articles.title: U.S. and Cuban officials get into shouting match on floor of United Nations

paras.en: U.S. and Cuban officials get into shouting match on floor of United Nations
paras.zh: 美国和古巴官员在联合国大厅内发生争吵

paras.en: U.S. ambassador was urging vote against Cuban resolution prompting island delegation to call him a liar
paras.zh: 美国大使敦促投票反对古巴决议，促使岛屿代表团称他为骗子

paras.en: U.S. and Cuban officials engaged in a stunning shouting match on the floor of the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, the latest in a series of public spats between the longtime adversaries over Washington's escalating economic campaign against Havana.
paras.zh: 周二，美国和古巴官员在联合国大会上进行了一场令人震惊的争吵，这是这两个长期对手之间因华盛顿针对哈瓦那不断升级的经济行动而发生的一系列公开争执中的最新一起。

paras.en: The interaction began shortly after U.S. Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz took the podium to argue against supporting the annual resolution this week condemning the decades-long U.S. economic embargo against the island country.
paras.zh: 在美国驻联合国大使迈克·沃尔兹上台反对支持本周谴责美国对这个岛国长达数十年的经济封锁的年度决议后不久，这种互动就开始了。

paras.en: As Waltz was detailing years of alleged corruption by the socialist government, members of the Cuban delegation, including Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla, began to slam on their designated table and yell for a point of order.
paras.zh: 当沃尔兹详细描述社会主义政府多年来涉嫌的腐败行为时，包括外交部长布鲁诺·罗德里格斯·帕里利亚在内的古巴代表团成员开始猛击指定的桌子并大喊要求遵守程序问题。

paras.en: Then, as UN officials sought to tone down the outbursts, Rodríguez Parrilla walked down the aisle to the head of the General Assembly and yelled at Waltz, "You are a liar!"
paras.zh: 然后，当联合国官员试图平息愤怒时，罗德里格斯·帕里利亚（Rodríguez Parrilla）沿着过道走到大会主席面前，对华尔兹大喊：“你是个骗子！”

paras.en: Waltz responded, "You understand who you're dealing with? This is America. Back up."
paras.zh: 沃尔兹回应道：“你知道你在和谁打交道吗？这是美国。后退。”

paras.en: While the moment represented a shocking break from diplomatic decorum traditional to the UN, it perfectly captured the heightened tensions between Cuba and the U.S. as President Donald Trump's administration seeks to force changes to Cuba's political system by increasing its already punishing economic campaign.
paras.zh: 虽然这一时刻代表着对联合国传统外交礼节的令人震惊的打破，但它完美地体现了古巴和美国之间日益紧张的关系，因为唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府试图通过加大本已严厉的经济行动来迫使古巴政治制度发生变化。

paras.en: The Caribbean country — already facing the dire impact of longtime economic and financial troubles — is now being pushed to a breaking point after Trump announced in late January that he would impose tariffs on any country that sells or provides oil to Cuba. The warning has effectively cut off fuel to the island, leading to widespread power outages that affect basic activities such as cooking, the water supply and internet and telephone services.
paras.zh: 在特朗普一月下旬宣布将对任何向古巴出售或提供石油的国家征收关税后，这个加勒比国家已经面临长期经济和金融问题的可怕影响，现在正被推向崩溃点。该警告实际上切断了岛上的燃料供应，导致大范围停电，影响了烹饪、供水、互联网和电话服务等基本活动。

paras.en: - Mike Waltz moves from security adviser to UN ambassador in wake of Signal controversy
paras.zh: -在信号争议之后， Mike Waltz从安全顾问转为联合国大使

paras.en: - Mike Waltz admits 'mistake' in 'embarrassing' sharing of Yemen strike plans with journalist
paras.zh: -迈克·华尔兹（ Mike Waltz ）承认与记者分享也门罢工计划“令人尴尬”的“错误”

paras.en: Cuban officials have also repeatedly stressed that as U.S. officials demand that Cuba open up to private investment, Washington keeps piling on sanctions that stymie the very economic opening it has sought for decades.
paras.zh: 古巴官员还一再强调，在美国官员要求古巴向私人投资开放的同时，华盛顿不断加大制裁力度，阻碍了古巴几十年来一直寻求的经济开放。

paras.en: A woman walks past a pool of sewage on a Havana street as water and electricity shortages threaten health and hygiene in the island nation. (Ricardo Arduengo/Reuters)
paras.zh: 一名妇女走过哈瓦那街道上的污水池，因为水电短缺威胁着这个岛国的健康和卫生。 (Ricardo Arduengo/Reuters)

paras.en: The outbursts Tuesday came a week after a similar interaction between Waltz and his Cuban counterpart, Ernesto Soberón Guzmán, outside a U.S.-hosted panel with Cuban dissidents and former prisoners that sought to highlight allegations of the oppressive behaviour of the island's government.
paras.zh: 周二的爆发发生一周前，沃尔兹和古巴同行埃内斯托·索伯龙·古兹曼在美国主办的一个由古巴持不同政见者和前囚犯组成的小组外进行了类似的互动，该小组试图强调对该岛政府的压迫行为的指控。

paras.en: Waltz and other U.S. officials have been using these public events and gatherings at the world body to try to persuade UN member states to vote on Wednesday against the annual resolution, which is aimed at calling out the U.S. government's "maximum pressure policy" against Cuba.
paras.zh: 沃尔兹和其他美国官员一直在利用这些公共活动和在联合国的集会，试图说服联合国成员国周三投票反对这项年度决议，该决议旨在呼吁美国政府对古巴实施“极限施压政策”。

paras.en: For the past 34 years, the resolution has received overwhelming support. Last year, the vote was 165-7, with 12 abstentions. Argentina, Ukraine and Hungary opposed the measure for the first time.
paras.zh: 34年来，该决议得到了压倒性的支持。去年，投票结果为 165 票对 7 票，12 票弃权。阿根廷、乌克兰和匈牙利首次反对该措施。

paras.en: Canada has consistently voted in favour of the annual resolution. Earlier this year, Global Affairs Canada announced it was providing $5.5 million in new support to Cubans, following $8 million it provided in February in accelerated funds to help scale up food aid to the nation.
paras.zh: 加拿大一贯投票赞成这项年度决议。今年早些时候，加拿大全球事务部宣布将向古巴提供 550 万美元的新支持，继 2 月份提供了 800 万美元的加速资金，以帮助扩大对该国的粮食援助。

paras.en: While such resolutions are not legally binding, they do reflect world opinion.
paras.zh: 虽然此类决议不具有法律约束力，但它们确实反映了世界舆论。

articles.title: Bobsled, skeleton federation continuing Russian team ban for World Cup season
articles.author: Tim Reynolds

paras.en: Bobsled, skeleton federation continuing Russian team ban for World Cup season
paras.zh: 雪橇、冰橇联合会继续禁止俄罗斯队参加世界杯赛季

paras.en: First World Cup bobsled and skeleton races are Nov. 27 at Altenberg, Germany
paras.zh: 首届世界杯雪橇和钢架雪车比赛将于 11 月 27 日在德国阿尔滕堡举行

paras.en: Russian teams will remain banned from World Cup bobsled races this season, and presumably the sport's world championships as well, after one of sliding's governing bodies voted Tuesday to extend the sanctions stemming from that country's war with Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯雪橇队将继续被禁止参加本赛季的世界杯雪橇比赛，可能也将禁止参加这项运动的世界锦标赛，因为雪橇运动管理机构之一周二投票决定延长该国与乌克兰战争引发的制裁。

paras.en: Some Russian sliders may still compete in skeleton and monobob events this season, the International Bobsled and Skeleton Federation said, but only as individual neutral athletes and "subject to … eligibility and vetting conditions."
paras.zh: 国际雪橇和钢架雪橇联合会表示，一些俄罗斯雪橇运动员本赛季仍可能参加钢架雪橇和单人雪橇项目，但只能作为中立的个人运动员，并且“须符合……资格和审查条件”。

paras.en: The neutrality issue is paramount in the process of determining which Russian athletes will be allowed to compete, just as it was last winter as the fields for the Milan-Cortina Olympics were being set. Certain sports federations have let Russian athletes compete, but only after they are cleared by an independent review process to ensure they have not publicly supported the war and are not affiliated with Russia's military or other forces.
paras.zh: 在决定允许哪些俄罗斯运动员参赛的过程中，中立性问题至关重要，就像去年冬天米兰-科尔蒂纳奥运会场地设置时一样。某些体育联合会允许俄罗斯运动员参加比赛，但前提是他们通过独立审查程序，以确保他们没有公开支持战争并且不隶属于俄罗斯军队或其他部队。

paras.en: The reason skeleton and monobob are considered different from two- or four-man bobsled is simply because of the lack of a team aspect. There is only one person on a skeleton sled – the discipline where sliders go headfirst down the track -- and one woman in a monobob.
paras.zh: 骷髅雪橇和单人雪橇被认为不同于两人或四人雪橇的原因仅仅是因为缺乏团队方面。骨架雪橇上只有一个人，即滑行者头朝下沿着轨道滑行的运动，还有一名坐在单人雪橇上的女人。

paras.en: "After thorough discussion and our presentation of facts about the involvement of the Russian Bobsleigh Federation and Russian athletes in actively supporting the actions of their government, and in some cases even their affiliation with the Russian army, a fair decision was adopted by a convincing majority of votes," Ukrainian skeleton athlete Vladyslav Heraskevych wrote in a statement posted on social media.
paras.zh: 乌克兰钢架雪车运动员弗拉迪斯拉夫·赫拉斯克维奇（Vladyslav Heraskevych）在社交媒体上发布的一份声明中写道：“经过深入讨论并介绍了俄罗斯有舵雪橇联合会和俄罗斯运动员积极支持政府行动的事实，甚至在某些情况下他们与俄罗斯军队的关系，最终以令人信服的多数票通过了一项公平的决定。”

paras.en: Heraskevych, a likely medal contender at the Milan-Cortina Games, was barred from racing in his event last February after refusing a last-minute plea by the International Olympic Committee to not use a helmet honoring more than 20 athletes and coaches killed since Russia invaded his country more than four years ago.
paras.zh: Heraskevych可能是米兰-科尔蒂纳奥运会的奖牌竞争者，他在去年2月拒绝了国际奥林匹克委员会的最后一刻请求，即不要使用头盔来纪念自俄罗斯入侵该国四年多以来被杀害的20多名运动员和教练。

paras.en: The first World Cup bobsled and skeleton races of the season are Nov. 27 at Altenberg, Germany.
paras.zh: 本赛季首届世界杯雪橇和钢架雪车比赛将于 11 月 27 日在德国阿尔滕堡举行。

articles.title: Prague honors Roma resistance fighters against Hitler

paras.en: For more than half a million Roma in Czechia and Slovakia, October 15, 2026, marks an important milestone.
paras.zh: 对于捷克和斯洛伐克超过 50 万的罗姆人来说，2026 年 10 月 15 日是一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: That day, an exhibition on a largely forgotten chapter of Czech history opened at the Museum of the Romani National Revival in Prague. The exhibit explores the role of Czech and Slovak Romani resistance fighters during the Nazi German occupation and the dismantling of Czechoslovakia from 1938 to 1945.
paras.zh: 那天，一场关于捷克历史上被遗忘的章节的展览在布拉格罗姆民族复兴博物馆开幕。该展览探讨了 1938 年至 1945 年纳粹德国占领和捷克斯洛伐克解体期间捷克和斯洛伐克罗姆人抵抗战士的作用。

paras.en: Until now, Czech and Slovak Roma appeared in the history of World War II almost exclusively as victims of the Holocaust against Roma and Sinti. In the so-called Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia, Nazi Germany murdered approximately 90% of the Czech Roma during World War II.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，捷克和斯洛伐克的罗姆人在二战历史上几乎都是作为针对罗姆人和辛提人的大屠杀的受害者出现的。在所谓的波西米亚和摩拉维亚保护国，纳粹德国在第二次世界大战期间杀害了大约 90% 的捷克罗姆人。

paras.en: However, what is less well known is that a large number of Czech and Slovak Roma fought against the German occupiers as partisans in resistance groups and as soldiers in the Czechoslovak Underground Army, or Defense of the Nation, ON.
paras.zh: 然而，鲜为人知的是，大量捷克和斯洛伐克罗姆人作为抵抗组织的游击队员和捷克斯洛伐克地下军（或称“保卫国家”）的士兵与德国占领者作战。

paras.en: The exhibition at the Museum of the Roma National Movement therefore marks a turning point in how the Roma are viewed during World War II. At least that is the hope of museum director Emil Scuka, a lawyer, former prosecutor and one of the best-known Czech Roma activists.
paras.zh: 因此，罗姆人民族运动博物馆的展览标志着二战期间如何看待罗姆人的转折点。至少这是博物馆馆长埃米尔·斯卡卡（Emil Scuka）的希望，他是一名律师、前检察官，也是捷克最著名的罗姆活动家之一。

paras.en: "We were not only victims; we were also heroes," Scuka said in his speech to several hundred attendees at the exhibition opening, most of whom were Roma from Czechia and Slovakia. "Many people, not even among the Roma themselves, are aware that we Roma fought against Nazism," he noted. In his view, "organizing and opening the exhibition was something my generation owed to these Roma heroes and today we are repaying that debt."
paras.zh: “我们不仅是受害者；我们也是英雄，”斯卡在展览开幕式上向数百名与会者发表讲话时说，其中大多数是来自捷克和斯洛伐克的罗姆人。 “许多人，甚至罗姆人自己也不知道，我们罗姆人曾与纳粹主义作斗争，”他指出。在他看来，“组织和举办这次展览是我们这一代人对这些罗马英雄的感谢，今天我们正在偿还这笔债务。”

paras.en: Scuka called on those present: "Bring your children and grandchildren here so they can see for themselves and realize that the Roma have heroes too!"
paras.zh: 斯卡呼吁在场的人：“带你的孩子和孙子来这里，让他们亲眼目睹并认识到罗姆人也有英雄！”

paras.en: He also pointed out that this topic had been completely marginalized in Czech and Slovak historical writing for decades and that the Roma had therefore decided on their own to document the fates of their war heroes.
paras.zh: 他还指出，几十年来，这个话题在捷克和斯洛伐克的历史写作中完全被边缘化，因此罗姆人决定自己决定记录他们的战争英雄的命运。

paras.en: The exhibition presents the detailed life stories of 100 of the most significant Roma partisans and Roma soldiers from the Czech underground army and resistance groups who fought against the Nazis.
paras.zh: 该展览详细介绍了来自捷克地下军和抵抗组织的 100 名最重要的罗姆游击队员和罗姆士兵与纳粹作战的生活故事。

paras.en: "We found over 1,400 Romani fighters in the archives. From among them, we selected the 100 most interesting stories for this exhibition," said exhibition curator Radoslav Scuka at the opening.
paras.zh: 展览策展人拉多斯拉夫·斯卡 (Radoslav Scuka) 在开幕式上表示：“我们在档案中发现了超过 1,400 名罗姆战士。我们从其中挑选了 100 个最有趣的故事来举办这次展览。”

paras.en: Groundbreaking research on Roma resistance fighters
paras.zh: 对罗姆抵抗战士的开创性研究

paras.en: Among these figures is Anton Facuna, a sergeant in the American intelligence agency Office of Strategic Services (OSS), who was flown to Slovakia in October 1944 on a secret mission. Slovakia had been a puppet state of Hitler from 1939 to 1945.
paras.zh: 这些人物中包括美国情报机构战略服务办公室 (OSS) 的中士安东·法库纳 (Anton Facuna)，他于 1944 年 10 月飞往斯洛伐克执行一项秘密任务。 1939年至1945年，斯洛伐克一直是希特勒的傀儡国家。

paras.en: Another is Josef Serinek, known by the nickname "Black Partisan from Vysocina," who managed to escape from the Nazi concentration camp for Roma in Lety and subsequently founded and commanded the large Capajev-Cerny partisan unit in the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands.
paras.zh: 另一位是约瑟夫·塞里内克（Josef Serinek），绰号“来自维索西纳的黑人游击队”，他成功逃离莱蒂的罗姆人纳粹集中营，随后在波西米亚-摩拉维亚高地建立并指挥了大型卡帕耶夫-塞尔尼游击队。

paras.en: In 2022, Czech President Milos Zeman posthumously awarded him the Medal for Heroism. Toward the end of his life, Serinek shared his memories with historian Jan Tesar, who later wrote the three-volume book "Ceska cikanska rapsodie", which translates to Czech Gypsy Rhapsody.
paras.zh: 2022年，捷克总统米洛斯·泽曼追授他英雄主义勋章。在塞里内克生命的最后阶段，塞里内克与历史学家扬·泰萨尔分享了他的记忆，后者后来写了三卷本《Ceska cikanska rapsodie》，翻译过来就是捷克吉普赛狂想曲。

paras.en: Except for Tesar's book, the history of Roma resistance against Nazism has not been researched by Czech and Slovak historians to this day. "I am not aware of any scholarly historical work that deals with Roma resistance against Nazism," Prokop Tomek, a historian at the Military History Institute in Prague, told DW.
paras.zh: 除了特萨尔的书之外，捷克和斯洛伐克的历史学家至今还没有研究过罗姆人抵抗纳粹主义的历史。布拉格军事历史研究所历史学家普罗科普·托梅克 (Prokop Tomek) 告诉德国之声：“我不知道有任何学术历史著作涉及罗姆人反抗纳粹主义的问题。”

paras.en: "The number of 1,400 Roma who took part in the fight against Nazism as members of the resistance or in the foreign army does not strike me as an exaggeration and corresponds to the proportion of the Roma population in Czechoslovakia," Tomek said, adding that the "exhibition on the Roma resistance against Nazism during the war is undoubtedly groundbreaking."
paras.zh: 托梅克说：“在我看来，作为抵抗组织成员或外国军队参加反纳粹斗争的罗姆人有 1,400 人，这一数字并不夸张，这与捷克斯洛伐克罗姆人人口的比例相当。”他补充说，“关于罗姆人在战争期间抵抗纳粹主义的展览无疑是开创性的。”

paras.en: To this day, many Roma in Czechia and Slovakia do not publicly acknowledge their ethnic identity. This is partly due to experiences with the Holocaust during the Nazi era that have been passed down through generations. Czech historians and politicians continue to debate the extent to which the Czech authorities of the Protectorate were complicit in the extermination of the Czech Roma.
paras.zh: 直到今天，捷克和斯洛伐克的许多罗姆人还没有公开承认他们的民族身份。部分原因是纳粹时代代代相传的大屠杀经历。捷克历史学家和政治家继续争论捷克保护国当局在多大程度上参与了灭绝捷克罗姆人的活动。

paras.en: However, one thing is certain: the police registration of all Roma, which had been enshrined in law in Czechoslovakia since 1927, facilitated the extermination of the Roma by the German Nazis.
paras.zh: 然而，有一件事是肯定的：自 1927 年以来，捷克斯洛伐克对所有罗姆人进行警察登记已成为法律，这促进了德国纳粹对罗姆人的灭绝。

paras.en: According to estimates by the Czech government, approximately 250,000 Roma live in the country today. In the 2021 census, however, only 21,000 people identified as Roma.
paras.zh: 据捷克政府估计，目前约有 25 万罗姆人居住在该国。然而，在 2021 年人口普查中，只有 21,000 人被认定为罗姆人。

paras.en: Of all ethnic groups in Czechia, which has a population of 10 million, the Roma are among the three largest ethnic minorities in terms of numbers. However, they are the most socially disadvantaged, have very little political representation, and are therefore scarcely present in Czech politics.
paras.zh: 在拥有1000万人口的捷克各民族中，罗姆人是人口数量最多的三个少数民族之一。然而，他们在社会上处于最不利的地位，几乎没有政治代表性，因此很少出现在捷克政治中。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Gadi Eisenkot campaigns on Moroccan roots in challenge to Netanyahu

paras.en: Campaign posters with various slogans promote the right-wing Likud and the far-right Otzma Yehudit parties. However, one poster is seen more than any others: that of the liberal Yashar party.
paras.zh: 带有各种口号的竞选海报宣传右翼利库德集团和极右翼奥兹马·耶胡迪特政党。然而，有一张海报比其他海报出现得最多：自由派亚沙尔党的海报。

paras.en: Its slogan, "Rosh Memshala Dialna," combines the terms "prime minister" in Hebrew and the words "of our own" in Moroccan Arabic.
paras.zh: 其口号“Rosh Memshala Dialna”结合了希伯来语中的“总理”和摩洛哥阿拉伯语中的“我们自己的”一词。

paras.en: And there is a good reason why Eisenkot's campaign in Sderot and other cities on Israel's sociopolitical periphery focuses on his Moroccan roots.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在斯德洛特和以色列社会政治边缘其他城市的竞选活动重点关注他的摩洛哥根源，这是有充分理由的。

paras.en: Sderot — located in the Negev desert, about 75 kilometers (45 miles) to Tel Aviv's south and just a kilometer away from the Gaza border — is a city with a large Moroccan Jewish community. In recent decades, the city has become symbolic of Moroccan-Jewish culture in Israel, finding its expression in music, cinema and state politics.
paras.zh: 斯德洛特位于内盖夫沙漠，距特拉维夫南部约 75 公里（45 英里），距加沙边境仅一公里，是一座拥有大型摩洛哥犹太人社区的城市。近几十年来，这座城市已成为以色列摩洛哥犹太文化的象征，在音乐、电影和国家政治中都有体现。

paras.en: Historically, Sderot is considered a bastion of the Israeli right, and especially a stronghold of Prime MinisterBenjamin Netanyahu's Likud. In 2022, Likud received more than 40% of the votes in Sderot, compared with 23% nationwide. Other members of Israel's far-right coalition received a lot of support there in the last election.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，斯德洛特被认为是以色列右翼的堡垒，尤其是总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团的据点。 2022年，利库德集团在斯德洛特获得超过40%的选票，而全国这一比例为23%。以色列极右翼联盟的其他成员在上次选举中获得了很多支持。

paras.en: This pattern reflects deeper historical divisions in Israel between Ashkenazim, or Jews of European origin, and Mizrahim, or Jews mostly from Middle Eastern and North African backgrounds. According to estimates, half of Israel's Jewish population is of Mizrahi origin, amounting to about 4 million people.
paras.zh: 这种模式反映了以色列在德系犹太人（欧洲血统的犹太人）和米兹拉希姆（主要来自中东和北非背景的犹太人）之间更深层次的历史分歧。据估计，以色列犹太人口中有一半是米兹拉希裔，约400万人。

paras.en: Mizrahi Jews have faced discrimination and neglect since the early days of the Israeli state. This inequality still shapes the economic and social reality in Israel ― and its political discourse.
paras.zh: 自以色列建国初期以来，米兹拉希犹太人就一直面临歧视和忽视。这种不平等仍然影响着以色列的经济和社会现实及其政治话语。

paras.en: The issue has received special attention in the 2026 campaign. Eisenkot, Netanyahu's major challenger, is of Moroccan origin and grew up in Eilat, a city with a large North African Jewish population. Eisenkot's Yashar party accused Likud of sidelining its Mizrahi politicians. The campaign slogan, "Netanyahu: Let the Mizrahim give interviews,” mocked that omission.
paras.zh: 这个问题在2026年的竞选活动中受到了特别关注。内塔尼亚胡的主要挑战者艾森科特有摩洛哥血统，在埃拉特长大，埃拉特是一个拥有大量北非犹太人口的城市。艾森科特领导的亚沙尔党指责利库德集团排挤其米兹拉希政客。竞选口号“内塔尼亚胡：让米兹拉希姆接受采访”嘲笑了这一遗漏。

paras.en: On live television, the right-wing journalist Yinon Magal — one of Netanyahu's most vocal supporters — claimed that Eisenkot was being controlled by elitist Ashkenazim and called him a "monkey."
paras.zh: 在电视直播中，右翼记者伊农·马加尔（内塔尼亚胡最直言不讳的支持者之一）声称艾森科特受到精英主义德系人士的控制，并称他为“猴子”。

paras.en: Netanyahu, who is of European origin, condemned the remark.
paras.zh: 欧洲裔内塔尼亚胡谴责了这一言论。

paras.en: Morocco-born Daniel Ben-Simon, an award-winning Israeli journalist and a former member of parliament, told DW that Eisenkot's embrace of his roots might have been forced upon him by Magal's comments — but it has historical value nevertheless.
paras.zh: 出生于摩洛哥、屡获殊荣的以色列记者、前议会议员丹尼尔·本-西蒙 (Daniel Ben-Simon) 告诉德国之声，艾森科特可能是因为马加尔的言论而被迫接受自己的根源，但这仍然具有历史价值。

paras.en: "People don't use terms like 'Dialna' with pride," Ben-Simon said, referring to Eisenkot's embrace of the Arabic term "of our own" in campaign posters. He said Israeli society had long tried to erase the Arab identities of North African Jews.
paras.zh: “人们不会自豪地使用‘Dialna’这样的术语，”本-西蒙说，他指的是艾森科特在竞选海报中使用的阿拉伯语术语“我们自己的”。他说，以色列社会长期以来一直试图消除北非犹太人的阿拉伯身份。

paras.en: Eisenkot's embrace of his identity serves as a way of "leaving the frame" set by society. "By using such a term, you're creating a new identity: an Israeli-Moroccan identity," Ben-Simon said. "Eisenkot is the first to allow this double identity to be expressed and still feel at home."
paras.zh: 艾森科特对自己身份的接受是一种“脱离社会设定的框架”的方式。 “通过使用这样的术语，你正在创造一个新的身份：以色列-摩洛哥身份，”本-西蒙说。 “Eisenkot 是第一个允许表达这种双重身份并且仍然有宾至如归的感觉的人。”

paras.en: After Israel's founding, the ruling socialist party, Mapai, whose leadership was largely Ashkenazi, pursued discriminatory policies against Mizrahim. Mizrahim were often expected to "Europeanize” rather than preserve their own culture, heritage, or Arabic language.
paras.zh: 以色列建国后，执政的社会党马派（其领导层主要是阿什肯纳兹人）对米兹拉希姆实行歧视性政策。人们常常期望米兹拉希姆“欧洲化”，而不是保留自己的文化、遗产或阿拉伯语言。

paras.en: These inequalities also took a material form. In the state's early decades, while European immigrants often received better housing and jobs, many Jews from Arab-speaking countries were sent to Ma'abarot, or temporary transit camps, often in remote areas with little infrastructure. Many later became "development towns,” which remained underfunded compared with Israel's central regions. That in turn resulted in poverty. Sderot, in the south, is one of the best-known development towns.
paras.zh: 这些不平等也表现为物质形式。在该州成立的最初几十年，虽然欧洲移民往往能获得更好的住房和工作，但许多来自阿拉伯语国家的犹太人被送往马巴罗特（Ma'abarot）或临时中转营，这些营地通常位于基础设施匮乏的偏远地区。许多后来成为“发展城镇”，与以色列中部地区相比，这些城镇仍然资金不足。这反过来又导致了贫困。南部的斯德洛特是最著名的开发城镇之一。

paras.en: For many Mizrahim, limited access to jobs, education and infrastructure symbolized long-standing exclusion by the Mapai establishment. Likud, founded as a right-wing alliance in 1973, used this frustration effectively under Menachem Begin. Mizrahi support for Begin helped produce the Mahapach, or upheaval, when Likud first defeated the socialist camp and took power. Since then, Mizrahim have often been associated with Likud, even though the party has never had a Mizrahi leader.
paras.zh: 对于许多米兹拉希姆人来说，获得就业、教育和基础设施的机会有限象征着马派机构长期的排斥。 1973 年作为右翼联盟成立的利库德集团在梅纳赫姆·贝京的领导下有效地利用了这种挫败感。当利库德集团首次击败社会主义阵营并掌权时，米兹拉希对贝京的支持促成了马哈帕赫（Mahapach）或剧变。从那时起，米兹拉希姆经常与利库德集团联系在一起，尽管该党从未有过米兹拉希姆领导人。

paras.en: Over the past two decades, Sderot's proximity to Gaza has made the city a frequent target of rocket attacks launched by the militant group Hamas. During the Hamas-led terrorist attacks on October 7, 2023, the city of Sderot was hit especially hard. More than 50 people were killed. In the three years since the attack, the city's population has grown by about 5,000 people, bringing it to 40,000, with many young families making the town their home, both as a result of idealism and government benefits.
paras.zh: 在过去的二十年里，斯德罗特靠近加沙，使得该市经常成为激进组织哈马斯发动火箭袭击的目标。 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的恐怖袭击中，斯德洛特市受到的打击尤其严重。超过50人被杀。袭击发生后的三年里，该市人口增加了约 5,000 人，达到 40,000 人，许多年轻家庭在该镇安家落户，这既是理想主义的结果​​，也是政府福利的结果。

paras.en: Walking around the town, it's hard not to notice that the so-called national-religious community is becoming increasingly dominant. This community tends to vote for Bezalel Smotrich's far-right Religious Zionism party, a main member of Netanyahu's coalition. Though votes for Smotrich and his party are de facto votes for Netanyahu's bloc, the prime minister's Likud party itself could suffer losses in Sderot.
paras.zh: 走在镇上，很难不注意到所谓的民族宗教团体正变得越来越占主导地位。这个社区倾向于投票支持贝扎雷尔·斯莫特里奇领导的极右宗教犹太复国主义党，该党是内塔尼亚胡联盟的主要成员。尽管斯莫特里奇及其政党的选票实际上是内塔尼亚胡集团的选票，但总理所在的利库德集团本身可能会在斯德洛特遭受损失。

paras.en: Regardless of the election's results, the perception of Sderot as a city of Moroccan Jews is not bound to change anytime soon. Ben-Simon said Eisenkot's election could serve as an opportunity for reshaping Moroccan Jews' future identity in Israel.
paras.zh: 无论选举结果如何，斯德洛特作为摩洛哥犹太人城市的看法不会很快改变。本-西蒙表示，艾森科特的当选可能成为重塑摩洛哥犹太人未来在以色列身份的机会。

paras.en: "The connection cities like Sderot have to their Moroccan roots would grow stronger as a result of an Eisenkot win," Ben-Simon said.
paras.zh: “艾森科特获胜后，像斯德洛特这样的城市与其摩洛哥根源的联系将会变得更加紧密，”本-西蒙说。

articles.title: Uganda says it has no active Ebola cases, but infections in Kenya and Nigeria are prompting fresh scrutiny

paras.en: The first confirmed Ebola patients in Kenya and Nigeria may have crossed paths at Uganda's Entebbe International Airport, according to African health officials, as new information from Switzerland contradicts Uganda's account of the Nigerian patient's travel history.
paras.zh: 非洲卫生官员称，肯尼亚和尼日利亚首例确诊的埃博拉患者可能曾在乌干达恩德培国际机场相遇，因为来自瑞士的新信息与乌干达对尼日利亚患者旅行史的描述相矛盾。

paras.en: Uganda, a country reporting no active Ebola infections, has become a focus of investigations into cases thousands of kilometers apart.
paras.zh: 乌干达没有报告活跃的埃博拉感染病例，已成为相距数千公里的病例调查的焦点。

paras.en: Uganda insists that it has no confirmed active cases of the deadly virus. Yet health authorities in Kenya and Nigeria are investigating Ebola infections involving people whose travel histories or contacts are connected to the East African nation.
paras.zh: 乌干达坚称没有确诊的致命病毒活跃病例。然而，肯尼亚和尼日利亚的卫生当局正在调查涉及与东非国家有旅行史或接触史的人的埃博拉感染情况。

paras.en: Both patients passed through Entebbe International Airport on October 3, according to Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency preparedness and response at the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC).
paras.zh: 非洲疾病控制和预防中心 (Africa CDC) 应急准备和响应负责人韦萨姆·曼库拉 (Wessam Mankoula) 表示，两名患者均于 10 月 3 日途经恩德培国际机场。

paras.en: Health officials say the two may have crossed paths, although it has not been established whether they encountered each other or whether any transmission occurred at the airport.
paras.zh: 卫生官员表示，两人可能有过接触，但尚不清楚他们是否相遇，也不清楚是否在机场发生了传播。

paras.en: The differing accounts have raised questions about whether Uganda was simply a transit point for infected travelers. Or could infections be going undetected along some of Africa's busiest cross-border routes?
paras.zh: 不同的说法引发了人们的疑问：乌干达是否只是受感染旅行者的中转站。或者，在非洲一些最繁忙的跨境路线上，感染是否可能未被发现？

paras.en: The latest developments come after Switzerland disputed claims that the Nigerian patient had visited the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where an Ebola outbreak is underway.
paras.zh: 最新事态发展是在瑞士对尼日利亚患者曾访问过正在爆发埃博拉疫情的刚果民主共和国的说法提出质疑之后发布的。

paras.en: Did the two Ebola patients cross paths in Uganda?
paras.zh: 两名埃博拉患者是否在乌干达相遇？

paras.en: Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate confirmed an Ebola case in the capital, Abuja, involving a woman who had recently traveled to East Africa, including Uganda.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚卫生部长穆罕默德·阿里·帕特证实首都阿布贾发生埃博拉病例，涉及一名最近前往东非（包括乌干达）的妇女。

paras.en: "Today we are confirming that there has been one imported case of Ebola virus disease in the Federal Capital Territory," Pate said.
paras.zh: 佩特说：“今天我们确认联邦首都地区出现一例输入性埃博拉病毒病病例。”

paras.en: The woman developed symptoms on October 7 and visited a private health facility on October 11. Further laboratory testing confirmed Ebola, and she was subsequently isolated for treatment.
paras.zh: 该女子于10月7日出现症状，并于10月11日到一家私人医疗机构就诊。进一步的实验室检测证实她感染了埃博拉病毒，随后她被隔离接受治疗。

paras.en: Pate said the patient was stable and health officials had identified 44 contacts, including health care workers, caregivers, patients and people who may have encountered her during her travels.
paras.zh: 佩特表示，该患者情况稳定，卫生官员已确定了 44 名接触者，包括医护人员、护理人员、患者以及可能在她旅行期间遇到过她的人。

paras.en: But the woman's journey has become central to the investigation.
paras.zh: 但这名女子的旅程已成为调查的核心。

paras.en: Speaking on Thursday, Mankoula said the first confirmed patients in Kenya and Nigeria were both known to have traveled through Entebbe International Airport on October 3. Investigators are examining whether the two patients were at the airport at the same time and whether their movements overlapped.
paras.zh: 曼库拉周四表示，已知肯尼亚和尼日利亚的首例确诊患者均于 10 月 3 日途经恩德培国际机场。调查人员正在检查这两名患者是否同时到达机场以及他们的活动是否重叠。

paras.en: Switzerland contradicts Uganda's account
paras.zh: 瑞士反驳乌干达的说法

paras.en: Uganda's Health Ministry says preliminary findings indicate that the Nigerian patient traveled to eastern DRCfor business before passing through Uganda without symptoms and returning to Nigeria.
paras.zh: 乌干达卫生部表示，初步调查结果表明，这名尼日利亚患者前往刚果民主共和国东部出差，然后在没有症状的情况下经过乌干达并返回尼日利亚。

paras.en: "Travel through Uganda does not establish that infection occurred here. The location of exposure remains under investigation," the ministry said in an October 20 statement.
paras.zh: 该部在 10 月 20 日的一份声明中表示：“通过乌干达旅行并不能证明这里发生了感染。暴露地点仍在调查中。”

paras.en: But, on Friday, Switzerland's Federal Department of Foreign Affairs directly disputed the account.
paras.zh: 但周五，瑞士联邦外交部直接对这一说法提出质疑。

paras.en: "She and her husband did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo," the department said in a statement to Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: “她和她的丈夫没有前往刚果民主共和国，”该部门在给路透社的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: The woman, identified by Swiss authorities as a Swiss national of Ugandan origin, is married to a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja.
paras.zh: 瑞士当局确认该女子为乌干达裔瑞士国民，嫁给了驻阿布贾的一名瑞士外交官。

paras.en: On Thursday, the Swiss government told Reuters that she was believed to have contracted Ebola while traveling with her husband in Uganda, although that assessment has not been independently confirmed.
paras.zh: 周四，瑞士政府告诉路透社，据信她与丈夫在乌干达旅行时感染了埃博拉病毒，尽管这一评估尚未得到独立证实。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa CDC also said Thursday that they had not received confirmed information establishing that the woman had traveled to the DRC.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）和非洲疾病预防控制中心周四也表示，他们尚未收到证实该妇女曾前往刚果民主共和国的信息。

paras.en: The conflicting accounts raise fresh questions about where the woman was exposed to the virus and how accurately her movements were initially reconstructed. They do not, however, establish that she contracted Ebola in Uganda.
paras.zh: 这些相互矛盾的说法引发了新的问题：这名妇女在哪里接触了病毒，以及最初重建她的动作的准确性如何。然而，他们并没有证实她在乌干达感染了埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: Uganda maintains that it has no confirmed active Ebola cases and says it is awaiting more detailed information from Nigeria about the woman's movements.
paras.zh: 乌干达坚称没有确诊的埃博拉活跃病例，并表示正在等待尼日利亚提供有关该妇​​女活动的更多详细信息。

paras.en: Kenya's missing contact complicates investigation
paras.zh: 肯尼亚失踪联系人使调查变得复杂

paras.en: In Kenya, Uganda has emerged in a separate investigation involving the country's first confirmed Ebola patient, who died in the Kenyan capital, Nairobi, on October 5. The patient had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda before reaching Kenya.
paras.zh: 在肯尼亚，乌干达出现在另一项调查中，涉及该国首例确诊的埃博拉患者，该患者于 10 月 5 日在肯尼亚首都内罗毕死亡。该患者从刚果民主共和国经乌干达抵达肯尼亚。

paras.en: Health officials have now established that the patient passed through Entebbe International Airport on October 3, the same day as the woman subsequently diagnosed in Nigeria. Kenyan authorities have since reported additional infections linked to the initial case.
paras.zh: 卫生官员现已确定，该患者于 10 月 3 日通过恩德培国际机场，与随后在尼日利亚确诊的该妇女同一天。此后，肯尼亚当局报告了与最初病例有关的更多感染病例。

paras.en: But one aspect of the investigation remains unresolved.
paras.zh: 但调查的一个方面仍未解决。

paras.en: According to Kenya's Daily Nation, health officials are searching for a Ugandan national identified as a contact of the deceased patient.
paras.zh: 据肯尼亚《国家日报》报道，卫生官员正在寻找一名与死者有过接触的乌干达国民。

paras.en: "We know him (the Ugandan) by name and passport number and from his phone but we are not able to reach him," Kenya's director-general for health, Patrick Amoth, told the newspaper.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生总干事帕特里克·阿莫斯告诉该报：“我们通过姓名、护照号码以及电话号码认识了他（乌干达人），但我们无法联系到他。”

paras.en: The Daily Nation reported that the man was using a South Sudanese telephone number, complicating efforts to establish his whereabouts.
paras.zh: 据《国家日报》报道，该男子使用的是南苏丹的电话号码，这使得确定他的下落变得更加困难。

paras.en: Being an untraced contact does not mean that he is infected. However, locating potentially exposed individuals is essential to preventing further transmission.
paras.zh: 未被追踪的接触者并不意味着他被感染了。然而，找到可能暴露的个人对于防止进一步传播至关重要。

paras.en: Uganda shares a lengthy border with the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola outbreaks have repeatedly challenged health authorities.
paras.zh: 乌干达与刚果民主共和国有着漫长的边界，那里的埃博拉疫情多次给卫生当局带来挑战。
