paras.en: But the Israeli electoral system is complicated and no party has ever won a majority of seats in the Knesset, so there has been much debate and deal-making to build potential future governing coalitions ahead of the vote, and they will continue after the results are in.

The Henrietta Szold school in the Rehavia section of Jerusalem, which Benjamin Netanyahu attended as a child, is a polling station. Nearby, the streets are plastered with campaign signs and volunteers are out electioneering in force.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief of staff, have emerged as the top candidates to form the next government in Israel after the general election on Tuesday, the country’s first since the Hamas-led Oct. 7, 2023, attacks set off the war in Gaza.
But other candidates have brought their own drama to the campaign, which has also featured revelations about security failures and a furor over an A.I.-generated political ad.
Here are some key moments from the campaign.

Before Election Day had even been set, the opposition politicians Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid, both former prime ministers, announced a joint run for office. The two men have worked together before: They briefly unseated Mr. Netanyahu in 2021, forming a government that lasted less than two years.

Their announcement in April was seen as mutually beneficial, positioning Mr. Bennett as a candidate for prime minister and ensuring that Mr. Lapid would remain one of the most prominent figures in the anti-Netanyahu bloc.
But their ambition to make their unified party, B’Yachad, the largest in the Knesset quickly fizzled. Surveys consistently suggest the party will finish in third place.

Parties across Israel’s political spectrum have published A.I.-generated content to reinforce their messaging. The content has sometimes stirred up controversy — no more so than in July, when Mr. Netanyahu posted a video depicting Mr. Eisenkot.

In the video, Mr. Eisenkot is shown running through a meadow, arms open, toward a man with a striking resemblance to his late son Gal, who was killed in 2023 at the start of the Israeli military’s war in Gaza. But he runs past the young man, instead embracing Mansour Abbas, a prominent Arab politician. Mr. Netanyahu has sought to paint Mr. Abbas, who could help Mr. Eisenkot form a governing coalition, as a supporter of terrorism.

Mr. Netanyahu’s party, Likud, denied that the young man in the video looked like Mr. Eisenkot’s son or was meant to evoke him. But many Israelis reacted to the ad with anger and disgust. Matan Kahana, a former lawmaker running on Mr. Eisenkot’s slate, said there was “no bottom to the pit the Likud is willing to sink into.”

One of the campaign’s most surprising moments came when Mr. Abbas and Yoav Segalovitz, a veteran Zionist politician and former police commander, announced a joint run. Teaming up on the slate of the United Arab List, or Raam, they offered themselves as an example of Jewish-Arab cooperation, even as they braced for intense criticism from both of their communities.

“There are people who are afraid of partnership,” Mr. Abbas said. “There are parties that are afraid of partnership. They are afraid of what people will say, afraid of what they will lose. Raam is not afraid of partnership. Raam advances it.”

Mr. Netanyahu came under new pressure over reports in the Israeli media and in The New York Times that Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed, the president of the United Arab Emirates, had warned him in advance of Oct. 7, 2023, that Hamas was considering a major attack on Israel.
The warning from Sheikh Mohammed never reached the leaders of Israel’s security establishment, The Times reported, citing five former senior Israeli officials. Mr. Netanyahu has denied the reports.

Israelis seemed to forget the election for a day in late September, when the news emerged that a handful of their fellow citizens had stopped a pilot from crashing a FlyDubai commercial jet bound for Tel Aviv.
Mr. Netanyahu spent hours celebrating the passengers’ resourcefulness, diverting attention away from headlines at the time about his and other officials’ failure to stop the Hamas-led attack in 2023.

Within days, however, his government was on the defensive over revelations of security failures that had allowed the FlyDubai pilot, an Omani man said to have embraced extreme Islamist views, into the cockpit in the first place.

Initial signs are that voter turnout is strong. As of 10 a.m., three hours after polls opened, turnout was 16.7 percent, compared to 15.9 percent at the same point in the last general election, in 2022, according to the Central Elections Committee.

Four years of internal turmoil, war and growing global isolation have left Israelis bitterly divided over their country’s future as they vote in national elections on Tuesday. Opinion polls suggest it will be a close race with the possibility that neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s party nor his opponents will secure a majority.

Many Israelis see the election as a choice over whether to continue the rule of the country’s most hard-line, right-wing government ever, and the dominant fault line is Mr. Netanyahu himself. Critics say he has steered Israel to the lowest point in its history, while his supporters see him as an indispensable leader who has tried to destroy Israel’s enemies in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.
Beyond Mr. Netanyahu’s leadership, however, there are plenty of issues polarizing the country.

The Hamas-led attacks of Oct. 7, 2023, loom over the vote. About 1,200 Israelis were killed in the assault and 250 were seized as hostages, according to the Israeli authorities, making it the deadliest day in Israeli history.

Israel’s military response in Gaza leveled much of the enclave and killed more than 70,000 people, according to local officials, who do not distinguish between civilians and combatants. Most of the enclave’s two million residents were displaced, often multiple times.

Three years later, Israelis still have no official answer about why Mr. Netanyahu’s government and the Israeli military failed to foresee the attacks and then struggled to respond even as Hamas fighters invaded villages and a music festival, killing civilians.

Mr. Netanyahu’s opponents — a bloc of opposition parties and their leaders — have said they would establish an independent inquiry with broad authority, appointed by the president of the Supreme Court. Mr. Netanyahu has called for a “democratic and equitable” commission that would be made of an equal number of representatives of the coalition and the opposition.
Families of those killed and taken hostage broadly back the opposition, arguing that Mr. Netanyahu’s proposal would politicize what should be a comprehensive and dispassionate investigation.

Secular and liberal Israelis have long been uneasy about the status of the ultra-Orthodox, an insular community that adheres to a fundamentalist interpretation of Jewish scripture and makes up roughly 14 percent of the population. Their religious students are eligible for an exemption from mandatory military service and receive state benefits despite not joining the work force.

During the wars in Gaza and Lebanon, that long-simmering frustration boiled over into outrage. Hundreds of Israelis from other backgrounds were killed in combat, and hundreds of thousands more did dangerous rounds of reserve duty.

Mr. Netanyahu’s government has relied heavily on the support of ultra-Orthodox parties. His opponents have called for ending the exemption to the draft for the ultra-Orthodox and cutting off welfare benefits for those who avoid military service.

Before the war, Mr. Netanyahu’s government had sought to advance a highly contentious plan to weaken Israel’s judiciary. Critics, including the president of Israel’s Supreme Court, argued that it would fundamentally undermine Israeli democracy.
Hundreds of thousands of Israelis protested the proposals in mass demonstrations, saying that Mr. Netanyahu was leading the country toward dictatorship.

The Hamas-led attacks largely suspended the overhaul, part of which was also reversed by a Supreme Court ruling. But Mr. Netanyahu’s allies say they will push ahead with the changes if they are re-elected.

While global attention has focused on the West Bank and Gaza, domestically both Mr. Netanyahu and his opponents have preferred to focus elsewhere. Mr. Netanyahu and most of his leading rivals say they oppose giving the Palestinians an independent state.
They still offer different visions for the near future.

Mr. Netanyahu’s coalition is dominated by religious nationalists who have advanced Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank at a breakneck pace. They have called for Israel to urge Palestinians to leave Gaza, with one senior minister saying conditions there should be kept miserable to “take away their hope.”

The fractious bloc of parties opposing Mr. Netanyahu hold wildly diverging views on the Palestinians. They include the left-wing Democrats party, whose members generally support a two-state solution but would have limited influence in a future coalition.

Gadi Eisenkot, who opinion polls suggest will lead the alliance, has vowed to rein in Israeli extremist attacks on Palestinians and engage on the Trump administration’s cease-fire plan for Gaza. But Mr. Eisenkot also supports some Israeli settlements in the West Bank and has even attacked Mr. Netanyahu for having once supported a Palestinian state.

articles.title: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell Says He Requested Jay-Z Take Super Bowl Stage ‘Whenever the Moment Felt Right’
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: GOAT’s out the bag. Jay-Z will headline the Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show for the first time in his historic career on Feb. 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles. But in the NFL‘s announcement on Monday (Oct. 26), commissioner Roger Goodell revealed Jay-Z headlining was going to happen sooner or later.
paras.zh: 山羊从袋子里出来了。Jay-Z将于2027年2月14日在洛杉矶的SoFi体育场首次登上超级碗LXI半场秀的标题。但在周一（ 10月26日）的NFL公告中，专员罗杰·古德尔（ Roger Goodell ）透露， Jay-Z的头条新闻迟早会发生。

paras.en: In the league’s press release, Goodell shared that when the NFL entered a partnership with Roc Nation to serve as the live music entertainment strategist in 2019, his one request was that Jay eventually take the Super Bowl stage.
paras.zh: 在联盟的新闻稿中，古德尔分享了当NFL在2019年与Roc Nation合作担任现场音乐娱乐策略师时，他的一个要求是杰伊最终进入超级碗舞台。

paras.en: “When we first reached an agreement with Roc Nation to produce the show, I had just one request: that Jay-Z take the stage himself one day, whenever the moment felt right to him,” Goodell said in a statement. “I couldn’t be more excited for fans around the world to experience the artistry, creativity and cultural impact he will bring to the Super Bowl stage.”
paras.zh: 古德尔在一份声明中说： “当我们第一次与Roc Nation达成协议制作该节目时，我只有一个要求：有一天，只要他觉得这一刻合适， Jay-Z就自己上台。” “我非常高兴世界各地的粉丝能够体验到他将为超级碗舞台带来的艺术性、创造力和文化影响。”

paras.en: Jay has played an integral role in reshaping the Super Bowl Halftime Show lineup, including sets from Rihanna, The Weeknd, Kendrick Lamar, Usher, Bad Bunny, Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg and more under his reign, which has netted Jay three Primetime Emmy Award wins for codirecting the halftime shows.
paras.zh: Jay在重塑超级碗半场秀阵容方面发挥了不可或缺的作用，包括来自Rihanna、The Weeknd、Kendrick Lamar、Usher、Bad Bunny、Dr. Dre和Snoop Dogg等人的阵容，这让Jay在半场秀中获得了三项黄金时段艾美奖。

paras.en: Hov and Roc Nation signed an extension with the NFL in 2024 to continue the partnership with the league. The NFL’s announcement was made during halftime of Monday Night Football‘s matchup between the Philadelphia Eagles and Dallas Cowboys on Monday, which was soundtracked by Jay’s “Public Service Announcement (Interlude).”
paras.zh: Hov和Roc Nation于2024年与NFL签署了延期协议，以继续与联盟的合作伙伴关系。NFL的宣布是在周一费城老鹰队和达拉斯牛仔队之间的周一夜间足球比赛的中场休息时间做出的，该比赛由杰伊的“公共服务公告（插曲）”配乐。

paras.en: Prior to that, there had been mounting speculation that Jay-Z would be the pick for the Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show, which was first reported by Puck on Oct. 20.
paras.zh: 在此之前，越来越多的人猜测Jay-Z将成为超级碗LXI半场秀的选秀权，该节目于10月20日由Puck首次报道。

paras.en: The Brooklyn rap deity has been back outside this year. He performed a star-studded Yankee Stadium trifecta in July, which was followed by shows in Paris, London and a pair of concerts in Los Angeles on Oct. 23 and Oct. 24.
paras.zh: 布鲁克林说唱神今年又回到了外面。他在7月份演出了一场星光熠熠的洋基体育场三部曲，随后在巴黎、伦敦举行了演出，并于10月23日和10月24日在洛杉矶举行了两场音乐会。

articles.title: Malcolm Spellman & Glasses Malone Talk ‘The Drop: A Snowfall Saga,’ The Importance of Authenticity & What to Expect in the Season Finale
articles.author: Angel Diaz

paras.en: Spin-offs of popular television shows rarely work, but The Drop: A Snowfall Saga is an exception.
paras.zh: 流行电视节目的衍生剧很少能成功，但《The Drop: A Snowfall Saga》是个例外。

paras.en: The eight-episode series picks up about four years after its predecessor left off, but now instead of following the crew as they navigate the ’80s crack epidemic, we follow them as they try to conquer the rap game during the early days of the genre’s commercial viability. The story follows Wanda (played by Gail Bean) after her and Leon (played by Isaiah John) get back from Ghana. She’s cleaned herself up after being addicted to crack and is working on fixing her reputation by legitimizing herself as a record executive during the early ’90s.
paras.zh: 这部八集剧集在其前作停播四年后重新开始，但现在我们不再跟随剧组人员应对 80 年代的毒品流行病，而是跟随他们在该类型商业可行性的早期尝试征服说唱游戏。故事讲述旺达（盖尔·比恩饰）和莱昂（以赛亚·约翰饰）从加纳回来后的故事。在沉迷于可卡因之后，她已经戒掉了自己，并在 20 世纪 90 年代初通过合法化自己作为唱片公司高管的身份，努力修复自己的声誉。

paras.en: But what makes The Drop impressive is that it’s also a family drama, and highlights the nuances of L.A. gang culture. During a specific scene, the audience sees Artillery (played by Simmie “Buddy” Sims III) holing up in a Crip ‘hood after bring chased by the cops — something consultant Glasses Malone commended showrunner Malcolm Spellman for being able to pull off on screen. “Spellman understands that a Blood could be in a house with Crips, like when Artillery’s grandparents live in a Crip neighborhood,” he tells me over Zoom. “You see him in a house full of Crips, and it’s all love. That situation isn’t this astronomical end of the world thing.”
paras.zh: 但《The Drop》令人印象深刻的是，它也是一部家庭剧，凸显了洛杉矶帮派文化的细微差别。在一个特定的场景中，观众看到炮兵（由西米·“巴迪”·西姆斯三世饰演）在被警察追赶后躲在一个瘸子兜里——顾问格拉斯·马龙称赞剧集主管马尔科姆·斯佩尔曼能够在银幕上成功做到这一点。 “斯佩尔曼知道血族可能住在有瘸子的房子里，就像阿蒂勒里的祖父母住在瘸子社区一样，”他通过 Zoom 告诉我。 “你看到他在一个满是瘸子的房子里，这都是爱。那种情况并不是世界末日的天文数字。”

paras.en: Malcolm Spellman hails from the Bay, but has been in the L.A. area for about 30 years, and is old enough to remember ’90s Southern California — which, of course, influenced his perspective. “Motherf—kers were not around to see what it was like to be a big time D-Boy in 1991; even Glasses is too young to have seen what the f—k it was like,” he says about those days. “I’m old enough that I was hanging out with them dudes. They was motherf—king stars. The D-boys was for real bigger stars than the rappers. Most of America was still not really f—king with hip-hop.”
paras.zh: 马尔科姆·斯佩尔曼 (Malcolm Spellman) 来自海湾，但在洛杉矶地区生活了大约 30 年，他的年纪足以记住 90 年代的南加州——这当然影响了他的观点。 “1991 年，Motherf-kers 并没有亲眼目睹成为一名伟大的 D-Boy 是什么样子；就连 Glasses 也太年轻了，没能亲眼目睹那段日子。”他谈到那些日子时说道。 “我已经足够大了，可以和他们一起出去玩了。他们是天王巨星。D-boys 是比说唱歌手更大的巨星。美国大部分人还没有真正成为嘻哈王。”

paras.en: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga will surprise you. It’s more than just a show about L.A.’s rap scene during the early ’90s. It’s also a show with a lot of heart.
paras.zh: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga 会让您大吃一惊。这不仅仅是一场关于 90 年代初洛杉矶说唱场景的节目。这也是一档用心良苦的节目。

paras.en: Check out Billboard‘s conversation with Spellman and Malone below, before tonight’s (Oct. 27) finale airs.
paras.zh: 在今晚（10 月 27 日）大结局播出之前，请查看下面《公告牌》与斯佩尔曼和马龙的对话。

paras.en: I gotta be honest, The Drop has been better than I expected it to be. You never really know if you’re going to like a spin-off or not. I originally thought it was going to be about Leon and Wanda’s experience in Ghana — so how did we instead get to the story of the record industry during early ’90s L.A.?
paras.zh: 老实说，The Drop 比我预期的要好。你永远不知道自己是否会喜欢衍生剧。我原本以为这会是关于 Leon 和 Wanda 在加纳的经历 - 那么我们是如何转而讲述 90 年代初洛杉矶唱片业的故事的呢？

paras.en: Malcolm Spellman: So, before I even came on, the original showrunners and FX wanted to do the record industry. I don’t know how much they knew, but it was a perfect mirror — because crack goes off like a bomb right when West Coast rap was emerging.
paras.zh: 马尔科姆·斯佩尔曼：所以，在我加入之前，最初的剧集制作人和 FX 就想涉足唱片业。我不知道他们知道多少，但这是一面完美的镜子——因为当西海岸说唱兴起时，裂纹就像炸弹一样爆炸。

paras.en: And let me explain something to the people who are misinterpreting what I’m saying about hip-hop coming to the West Coast — the center of hip-hop was New York, but where the conversation was was the West Coast, and then the conversation went to the South, where it’s been the last 20 years or whatever, right? And when it came to the West Coast, it was right at the height of the explosion of military policing, gang-banging, everything that crack inflamed. And so, basically, you can’t have one without the other. Snowfall was the bomb going off, The Drop: A Snowfall Saga is the news report on the bomb.
paras.zh: 让我向那些误解我关于嘻哈来到西海岸的说法的人解释一下——嘻哈的中心是纽约，但谈话的地方是西海岸，然后谈话去了南方，过去 20 年都是在那里，对吧？当事情来到西海岸时，正是军事警务、群殴、一切爆炸事件爆发的高峰期。所以，基本上，两者缺一不可。 《降雪》是炸弹爆炸的故事，《降落：降雪传奇》是有关炸弹的新闻报道。

paras.en: I also like how its not only a story about the early days of the record industry as it pertains to rap music, but it’s also a family drama. Talk about like why that was important to incorporate.
paras.zh: 我还喜欢它不仅是一个关于唱片业早期与说唱音乐有关的故事，而且还是一部家庭剧。谈论为什么合并很重要。

paras.en: M.S.: I felt like we had to show as much soulfulness — and I’m stealing Glasses’ words — but it did personify what we was trying to do. You know how people used to say “soul” music? We wanted to make a “soul” show, and Glasses was the one who kept saying, “Man, this show got too much soul to fail.” So, centering it around the family gave it a chance to give this Blackness an emotion and a humanity that would sort of make these experiences that you’re seeing on screen as opposed to like a highlight reel.
paras.zh: M.S.：我觉得我们必须表现出同样多的深情——我偷用了眼镜的话——但这确实体现了我们想要做的事情。你知道人们过去怎么说“灵魂”音乐吗？我们想要制作一部“灵魂”节目，而眼镜就是那个一直说的人，“伙计，这个节目有太多的灵魂，不可能失败。”因此，以家庭为中心让它有机会赋予这种黑人一种情感和人性，这会让你在屏幕上看到的这些体验而不是像精彩片段一样。

paras.en: So, Glasses, what was your role as a consultant? Making sure everything felt authentic?
paras.zh: 那么，Glasses，您作为顾问的角色是什么？确保一切都感觉真实？

paras.en: G.M.: I would like to believe it’s a little bit different than that. I think they [already] had Skipp Townsend and Jimmy Chris, and really dope brothers who were from that time period. We’re talking about in the prime of their their career during that time period, as far as being in the streets. I remember being 11-12 when this stuff was happening, and I feel like it started off as something simple as that — but it grew into being able to add some story to it, whether that be dialogue or making sure the fashion is correct.
paras.zh: G.M.：我愿意相信情况与此略有不同。我认为他们已经有了斯基普·汤森德和吉米·克里斯，他们是那个时期的真正的兄弟。我们谈论的是他们职业生涯的黄金时期，就在街头而言。我记得这件事发生时我才 11 岁到 12 岁，我觉得一开始就是这么简单的事情 - 但后来逐渐能够添加一些故事，无论是对话还是确保时尚是正确的。

paras.en: But then I realized by the end, it was more about adding heart to everything, and that became the most important thing to me. I think what The Drop did really well — and I would like to believe I helped in in this order — is making sure that nuance existed.
paras.zh: 但后来我意识到，到最后，更多的是为一切付出心血，这对我来说成为最重要的事情。我认为 The Drop 做得非常好的一点——我愿意相信我在这个顺序上提供了帮助——是确保细微差别的存在。

paras.en: That’s funny that you brought that up, because when he broke into the house, I thought it was going to be some beef that caught up to them, because of some stuff that happened previously. Instead, it’s one of the homies having an episode and trippin’ out. That type of stuff happens every day in the hood.
paras.zh: 你提出这个问题很有趣，因为当他闯进房子时，我以为他们会因为之前发生的一些事情而被一些牛肉抓住。相反，这是其中一位朋友发生了一件事并摔倒了。这种事情每天都会在引擎盖里发生。

paras.en: G.M.: This whole story is very much my existence. I mean, even from coming from the game and the streets to making it in the music industry through hip-hop and it saving my life, to having my homeboys be in my house on sherm and having to manage them, to my older sisters being upset that I’m living my life in the streets and me trying to gain back their trust. Some of my homeboys’ moms are Wanda. You know, that person that was on crack when I was in the streets, and then watching them get their life back together and having to reclaim their image and their reputation while having to go through hell to do it.
paras.zh: G.M.：整个故事就是我的存在。我的意思是，甚至从来自游戏界和街头，到通过嘻哈音乐进入音乐界并拯救了我的生命，到让我的同伙们住在我的房子里并不得不管理他们，再到我的姐姐们对我在街头生活而感到不安，而我试图重新获得他们的信任。我的一些同乡的妈妈是旺达。你知道，当我在街上的时候，那个人就处于崩溃状态，然后看着他们重新开始生活，必须重新恢复他们的形象和声誉，同时必须经历地狱般的过程。

paras.en: I was with Isaiah this weekend at his house, and I’m just looking at him, like, “Damn! I wonder how much does he know that he represents me in this story?” Somebody that’s been through so much, saw it all, and still had to find a peace and calm and try to contribute to the community the best way you can. Having friends who felt like they should have been entitled to more and trying to press a line, and me having to show a level of force. So, it’s really personal to me. I think I handled every little thing that I could with care.
paras.zh: 这个周末我和以赛亚一起在他家，我只是看着他，就像，“该死！我想知道他知道多少他在这个故事中代表了我？”一个经历了这么多事情、目睹了这一切的人，仍然必须找到平静和平静，并尽力以最好的方式为社区做出贡献。有一些朋友觉得自己应该有权得到更多，并试图坚持到底，而我必须表现出一定程度的力量。所以，这对我来说真的很私人。我想我已经小心翼翼地处理了每一件我能做的小事。

paras.en: There’s a scene that I noticed people on social media talking about — where Leon is drinking in his crib, looking and old photos of the Snowfall crew while listening to soul music — and this is where we learn that he and Wanda had a miscarriage. Talk about the challenges of tying those strings together, where you connect this show to its predecessor while also giving some much needed background on why Leon and Wanda’s romantic relationship remains broken at the moment.
paras.zh: 我注意到人们在社交媒体上谈论的一个场景——莱昂在婴儿床上喝酒，一边听着灵魂音乐，一边看着《降雪》剧组的旧照片——这就是我们得知他和万达流产的地方。谈谈将这些线索联系在一起的挑战，在这里你将这部剧与其前身联系起来，同时也提供一些急需的背景知识来解释为什么莱昂和旺达的浪漫关系目前仍然破裂。

paras.en: M.S.: First of all, when this comes out, I hope you can express how organically Glasses fits into the story. Just hearing him right there, you can see how he would organically be in a writer’s room. The gift is to be able to not only understand a story, but to take a real life story and then add his sauce to it, and give it to us within the flow of the conversation. Because a lot of motherf—kers come in the room, and they’ll disrupt where the story’s going. So, you just saw right there in this interview how the room works, right? The way he just jumped in and fits those real stories in, plus whatever his opinion is.
paras.zh: M.S.：首先，当这个故事出来时，我希望你能表达一下《眼镜》是如何有机地融入这个故事的。只要听到他的声音，你就可以想象他在作家的房间里会是什么样子。这种天赋不仅能够理解一个故事，还能将一个现实生活中的故事添加到其中，并在对话的过程中将其呈现给我们。因为很多混蛋进来了，他们会扰乱故事的发展。那么，您刚刚在这次采访中看到了房间的运作方式，对吧？他介入并将这些真实故事融入其中的方式，以及他的观点。

paras.en: Now, as far as connecting to Snowfall, that was a real high-wire act because as the vision came together, the show became very, very different, and we knew the hardcore fans were going to be struggling with that for a couple episodes on how different it feels. It’s a warmer show. It’s a little bit softer. It’s music. It’s Black folk going for their dreams, which is inherently different than black folk committing a crime. It’s just a different energy, and what we wanted to do was be very respectful to the original series, which is one of the GOATS, right?
paras.zh: 现在，就《雪落》而言，这真是一场走钢丝的表演，因为随着愿景的汇聚，这部剧变得非常非常不同，我们知道铁杆粉丝们会在几集里为这种不同的感觉而苦苦挣扎。这是一档比较温暖的节目。它稍微软一点。这是音乐。这是黑人在追求自己的梦想，这与黑人犯罪有着本质上的不同。这只是一种不同的能量，我们想做的就是非常尊重原版系列，它是山羊之一，对吗？

paras.en: And to allow ourselves to be free, so it wasn’t an accident that Big Deon comes in very early as a nod to the fans, as if to say, “Hey, y’all, we hear you. We respect you. We’re showing you that we’re considering the original.” We keep it alive, but I’m gonna steal from you again, Glasses. This is a story that’s going on right around the block from where you saw Franklin and them.
paras.zh: 为了让我们自己能够自由，所以 Big Deon 很早就出现并不是偶然的，它是为了向粉丝们致敬，就好像在说，“嘿，大家，我们听到了你们的声音。我们尊重你们。我们正在向你们表明，我们正在考虑原版。”我们让它活着，但我会再次从你那里偷东西，眼镜。这是一个发生在你看到富兰克林和他们的街区附近的故事。

paras.en: For me, it feels like there’s some 2Pac influence in Artillery’s character. Who did you guys use as inspiration when you were coming up with him?
paras.zh: 对我来说，Artillery 的角色似乎受到了 2Pac 的影响。当你们想出他的时候，你们以谁为灵感？

paras.en: M.S.: Buddy wrote that character. I do know this, I did not want a typical, thuggish rapper because I’ve been in L.A. so long and seen how these motherf—kers are behind the scenes, and how they’re real artful and brilliant motherf—kers. You only see one side of the s—t. All we told Buddy and all we described about the character is that he had true artist’s spirit like a DMX and a 2Pac. Guys that kinda know they’re not gonna be here too long and that his mind was free.
paras.zh: M.S.：巴迪写了这个角色。我确实知道这一点，我不想要一个典型的、凶残的说唱歌手，因为我在洛杉矶呆了这么久，看到了这些混蛋是如何在幕后的，以及他们是如何真正狡猾而聪明的混蛋。你只能看到事物的一侧。我们告诉巴迪和我们描述的关于这个角色的一切就是他拥有真正的艺术家精神，就像 DMX 和 2Pac 一样。这些家伙知道他们不会在这里待太久，而且他的思想是自由的。

paras.en: A great example would be in the scene in the pilot, with the N-word, when he says “N—r Man, N—r Man, N—r Man, n—r, n—r, n—a, n—r, and then points at himself and says, “Man,” right? I wrote it one way to make that point, and Buddy took it and made it into what you saw. And the truth is, at some point in the auditions, the character just became Buddy, because of who he is. Buddy’s the real deal. He’s from Compton. He’s from a real neighborhood, and he is what you see. So, that was the spirit of Pac and DMX that we wanted to capture, and Buddy put his personality on top of it.
paras.zh: 一个很好的例子是在试播集的场景中，用 N 字，当他说“N—r Man，N—r Man，N—r Man，n—r，n—r，n—a，n—r，然后指着自己说，“Man，”对吧？我用一种方式来表达这一点，Buddy 接受了它并把它变成了你所看到的。事实是，在试镜的某个时刻，这个角色只是因为他是谁而成为了 Buddy。 Buddy 是真正的人，他来自康普顿，他就是你所看到的，所以，这就是我们想要捕捉的 Pac 和 DMX 精神，而 Buddy 则将他的个性置于其中。

paras.en: For people like that, art and authenticity is the most important thing.
paras.zh: 对于这样的人来说，艺术和真实性才是最重要的。

paras.en: G.M.: When you grow up how we grew up, the environment and the stuff happening around you shapes people. It makes sense that you could get a Tupac and a DMX, and they’re not that far apart. Even an artist like Buddy, who is not that far from any of those guys, because the same circumstances shaped and molded him. So, you have a unique perspective, but it’s very much an archetype.
paras.zh: G.M.：当你像我们一样成长时，环境和你周围发生的事情塑造了人们。您可以同时拥有一台 Tupac 和一台 DMX，这是有道理的，而且它们之间的距离并不远。即使是像巴迪这样的艺术家，他也与这些人相差不远，因为同样的环境塑造和塑造了他。所以，你有一个独特的视角，但这在很大程度上是一个原型。

paras.en: We was talking about the brilliance of Spellman on Tip’s show, Expeditiously, and the fact that he could recognize that version of a person could be in Oakland or Berkeley or Vallejo, and they could be in Compton, in Watts, even in Yonkers or Philadelphia. You don’t need to necessarily emulate a person because — I’m not that different than Dr. Dre, because of how we grew up and the things that shaped us.
paras.zh: 我们正在谈论斯佩尔曼在蒂普的节目《迅速》中的才华，以及他能够识别出一个人的版本可能在奥克兰、伯克利或瓦列霍，也可能在康普顿、瓦茨，甚至在扬克斯或费城的事实。你不一定要模仿一个人，因为——我和德雷博士没有什么不同，因为我们的成长方式和塑造我们的事情。

paras.en: Let’s talk about Lamar, because Buddy kind of grew up like that. He’s from Compton, but wasn’t banging, yet he still had to navigate that environment. When you come up in the hood, there’s a pretty good chance that you have family and friends that are different types of things, which your parents or O.G.’s try to shield you from. I’ve seen a lot of discourse around that character’s actions on social media. To me, he reminds me of the theme to Kendrick’s good kid, m.A.A.d city. He’s growing up in this hectic environment while being naive enough to follow his dreams and not care about what everybody else thinks. Am I making the right assumption?
paras.zh: 我们来谈谈拉马尔，因为巴迪就是这样长大的。他来自康普顿，但并不出名，但他仍然必须适应那种环境。当你出柜时，你很有可能有不同类型的家人和朋友，而你的父母或OG试图保护你免受这些影响。我在社交媒体上看到了很多关于该角色行为的讨论。对我来说，他让我想起了肯德里克的好孩子《m.A.A.d city》的主题。他在这个忙碌的环境中长大，同时天真地追随自己的梦想，不关心别人的想法。我的假设正确吗？

paras.en: M.S.: It’s funny watching the reaction to Lamar. II really am fascinated by it — because No. 1 , let me first state this: We don’t base our characters on nobody. We don’t watch other TV shows and say, “This character’s like that.” We don’t tell Buddy to be like one of these guys, right? You mentioned family earlier. You are meeting a family that you’re gonna be following for this series, and we want them to be their own family.
paras.zh: M.S.：观察人们对拉马尔的反应很有趣。我真的很着迷——因为第一，让我首先声明这一点：我们的角色不以任何人为基础。我们不会在看其他电视节目时说：“这个角色就是那样。”我们不会告诉巴迪要像这些人一样，对吗？你之前提到过家庭。您将遇到一个您将在本系列节目中关注的家庭，我们希望他们成为自己的家庭。

paras.en: And when it comes to Lamar, the reaction to him is really interesting, in that the intensity makes me believe that motherf—kers are actually frustrated, because they’re invested in the character. And I think one of the things they get mad at is, when you watch any white TV show, there’s characters who are “different” at the center of them stories, and they’re embraced and protected, and the fans get it.
paras.zh: 当谈到拉马尔时，人们对他的反应真的很有趣，因为这种强烈的反应让我相信那些混蛋实际上很沮丧，因为他们对这个角色投入了精力。我认为他们生气的一件事是，当你观看任何白色电视节目时，故事的中心都有一些“不同”的角色，他们受到拥抱和保护，粉丝们明白了。

paras.en: This story takes place in 1990, 1991, where if you were maybe a little bit on the spectrum or a little bit odd, there wasn’t no f—king terms for you, bro. You getting socked in your face, you getting dealt with, you getting sheltered. They gonna lock you in a room, give you some music equipment, take your ass to church, and hope you don’t get killed in the most dangerous time in our country’s history. I hope they stay around and get to see what real hip-hop was about — because there wasn’t no streaming, there wasn’t no arguing about who made the most money.
paras.zh: 这个故事发生在 1990 年、1991 年，如果你可能有点自闭症或者有点奇怪，那你就没有什么可怕的术语了，兄弟。你被打在脸上，你被对付，你被庇护。他们会把你锁在一个房间里，给你一些音乐设备，带你去教堂，希望你不要在我们国家历史上最危险的时刻被杀。我希望他们留下来，看看真正的嘻哈音乐是什么——因为没有流媒体，也不存在关于谁赚最多钱的争论。

paras.en: Rappers rapped about that, because the fantasy was having the mansion and the yacht. But these characters care about what they’re doing — and if you look at Lamar, everything he’s done has been about fighting for his art, and the f—king audience be getting mad at him. They be like, “Listen to the label. Why you ain’t listening to the label?” And it’s like, “Yo, y’all don’t know.” This is how you get great s—t, when you don’t listen to the label.
paras.zh: 说唱歌手们对此进行了说唱，因为他们的幻想就是拥有豪宅和游艇。但这些角色关心他们正在做的事情——如果你看看拉马尔，他所做的一切都是为了他的艺术而奋斗，而那些该死的观众会对他生气。他们会说，“听厂牌的。你为什么不听厂牌的？”就像，“哟，你们都不知道。”当你不听厂牌的时候，这就是你获得伟大成就的方式。

paras.en: And then there’s the reason why his grandmother is trying to protect him from the music business because of what ended up happening to his mother. The industry swallowed her whole, and Mama G is trying to protect him from suffering the same fate. Talk about the seduction of the music industry, and how you guys tried to approach that.
paras.zh: 然后，由于他母亲的遭遇，他的祖母试图保护他免受音乐行业的影响。这个行业吞噬了她的全部，而 Mama G 正试图保护他免遭同样的命运。谈谈音乐产业的诱惑，以及你们如何尝试接近这一点。

paras.en: M.S.: One thing no one has caught yet is the way music destroyed this family once, it’s gonna destroy the new family again. That’s gonna be the whole series. Lamar is on the same journey as his mother. I don’t know why people ain’t getting it. But when you keep seeing Gertie say, “You are so much like your mother,” or Big Daddy say the same thing — they’re saying the reason they’re scared is because this dude is special and gifted like his mother, and not built for the industry. I feel like for me, that’s been my f—king journey, right? Same story as everybody else. Been through all the s—t, and I don’t feel I’m built for Hollywood.
paras.zh: M.S.：还没有人明白的一件事是音乐曾经摧毁了这个家庭，它会再次摧毁新的家庭。这将是整个系列。拉马尔和他的母亲正在经历同样的旅程。我不知道为什么人们不明白。但当你不断看到格蒂说，“你太像你妈妈了”，或者大爸爸说同样的话时，他们会说他们害怕的原因是因为这个家伙很特别，而且像他母亲一样有天赋，而不是为这个行业而生。我觉得对我来说，这就是我的旅程，对吧？和其他人一样的故事。经历了所有这些，我不觉得自己适合好莱坞。

paras.en: This industry bothers me — and I’m not in the hot seat like stars like Lamar or Artillery would be, but I identify with the journey and the seduction in the music business, and watching how it turns people against each other. The fans are gonna be seeing that every single season, and it’s gonna get worse as the money gets bigger. It’s gonna get worse. And one last thing, season one is all set up before we’re really in the industry, and we will see the bad side of everybody.
paras.zh: 这个行业让我很困扰——我不像拉马尔或阿炮利这样的明星那样处于困境，但我认同音乐行业的旅程和诱惑，并观察它如何让人们互相对抗。球迷们每个赛季都会看到这种情况，而且随着钱的增加，情况会变得更糟。情况会变得更糟。最后一件事，第一季在我们真正进入这个行业之前就已经准备好了，我们会看到每个人不好的一面。

paras.en: G.M.: What I really appreciate about Spellman is his rejection of conformity. I think that’s why our spirits work really well together. By the time I got to the music industry, I was already forged in so much steel because that’s how it is for me in the streets. I was so certain of who I was, and what I was not gonna be. It was different. You know, a lot of the things we do that are maybe not good for us are ways of us trying to bond with humans. We don’t always have the greatest communication to really get down into who we are and find that bond, so we share through ways of dealing with trauma like smoking weed or smoking sherm with a homie.
paras.zh: G.M.：我真正欣赏斯佩尔曼的是他拒绝墨守成规。我认为这就是为什么我们的精神能够很好地协同工作。当我进入音乐行业时，我已经是钢铁般的人了，因为这就是我在街头的处境。我非常确定我是谁，以及我不会成为什么。这是不同的。你知道，我们所做的很多可能对我们不利的事情都是我们试图与人类建立联系的方式。我们并不总是能通过最好的沟通来真正了解自己并找到那种纽带，因此我们通过处理创伤的方式来分享，比如与朋友吸大麻或吸大麻。

paras.en: Watching somebody like Spellman fight to keep things right… there was an argument — I don’t know if I’m supposed to say this — but FX was arguing about the length of a Harold Melvin & the Blue Notes song. I remember it being a couple days where they wanted to cut the timing down of “I Miss You.” They’re thinking like, “What f—k is the purpose of this long-ass song playing while the actors are talking over the audio?” He fought to keep that soul, and didn’t worry about pleasing the suits, because he understood the assignment of what he was trying to do. If he listens to them, they might bond and gel a little bit more. They’ll feel like he’s taking their advice.
paras.zh: 看着像斯佩尔曼这样的人为保持事情正确而奋斗……发生了一场争论——我不知道我是否应该这么说——但 FX 正在争论 Harold Melvin & the Blue Notes 歌曲的长度。我记得有几天他们想缩短“我想你”的时间。他们在想，“当演员们通过音频说话时，播放这首长歌的目的是什么？”他努力保住那个灵魂，并且不担心取悦西装，因为他明白他想要做的事情的任务。如果他倾听他们的意见，他们之间的联系可能会更加紧密。他们会觉得他正在听取他们的建议。

paras.en: M.S.: Can I ask you a question, Glasses, real quick? Because you have seen what Angel’s talking about too, though. Can you talk about what you’ve seen? One of the things about the seduction and the music business is someone like Glasses will probably never be as rich as he could be if he let it seduce him more. But Glasses, can you talk about when you’ve seen a camp where someone gets hot, and when that music business light beams on them, it rips apart the family.
paras.zh: M.S.：眼镜，我能问你一个问题吗，很快吗？因为你也看到了安吉尔在谈论什么。你能谈谈你所看到的吗？关于诱惑和音乐事业的一件事是，像 Glasses 这样的人如果让它更多地诱惑他，可能永远不会像他应该的那样富有。但是眼镜，你能谈谈当你看到一个营地里有人变得很热的时候，当音乐商业的光芒照在他们身上时，它就会撕裂这个家庭。

paras.en: G.M.: I’ve been that person. I came into the business with Top, Rock, Dot and Nip. All of these are my guys. It sounds like I’m saying something separate, but it’s really together. It’s really that serious. So many things seem like it’s about you. That’s the trickiest part, and I think that’s what makes it the same. You start forgetting that this was not ever just you, right?
paras.zh: 通用汽车：我就是那个人。我与Top、Rock、Dot和Nip合作。所有这些都是我的人。听起来我在说一些不同的东西，但它真的在一起。真的是那么严重。很多事情看起来都与你息息相关。这是最棘手的部分，我认为这是它相同的原因。你开始忘记这不仅仅是你，对吧？

paras.en: There’s this weird expression in hip-hop — and it’s such an oxymoron — self-made. Nothing about that could even be possible. It’s people trying to make you feel better about who you are. That’s the seduction of it. Like, “You’re the man.” That’s what they are telling you. And you’re looking like, “But this person did the music, this person did this, this person did that.”
paras.zh: 嘻哈音乐中有一种奇怪的表达方式——这是一种矛盾修辞——白手起家。这根本就不可能。人们试图让你对自己感觉更好。这就是它的魅力所在。就像，“你就是那个男人。”这就是他们告诉你的。你看起来就像是，“但是这个人做了音乐，这个人做了这个，这个人做了那个。”

paras.en: Also, you think the money’s just gonna keep flowing, you think you’re gonna keep selling scripts, stuff like that. It the same in the streets. You get addicted to the money coming hand over fist. That faucet turns off sometimes and it’ll turn off on you too.
paras.zh: 此外，你认为资金会继续流动，你认为你会继续销售剧本，诸如此类的东西。街道上也是如此。你沉迷于把拳头交出来的钱。那个水龙头有时会关闭，它也会关闭你。

paras.en: M.S.: Yep, it happened to me, bro. It happened to me a few times in my career, and people don’t be knowing that. I be trying to mentor young filmmakers coming up, and I’ve been on that rollercoaster ride of being hot, and people I don’t know calling me and inviting me and throwing jobs at me, and then being ice cold. Don’t nobody prepare you for that part when it all goes cold.
paras.zh: M.S. ：是的，这发生在我身上，兄弟。在我的职业生涯中，这在我身上发生过几次，人们并不知道这一点。我正在努力指导即将到来的年轻电影制作人，我一直在乘坐过山车，热辣辣的，还有那些我不认识的人打电话给我，邀请我，向我投掷工作，然后是冰冷的。当一切都冷却下来时，不要让任何人为您做好准备。

paras.en: M.S.: Remember, season one we’re meeting the family and setting things up. So, season two will be the music biz. We gonna see how the label f—ks with people. We gonna see how different people’s crews start to clash over who’s the hottest rapper and all that s—t. Tiptoe will emerge a little more in tonight’s episode. I said earlier that everyone shows their worst side and their best side, right? I ain’t gonna spoil nothing, but whoever you ain’t seen that from is gonna show it in the finale.
paras.zh: M.S.：记住，第一季我们要和家人见面并安排事情。所以，第二季将是音乐界的。我们要看看这个标签如何与人们相处。我们将看到不同的人的团队如何开始为谁是最热门的说唱歌手以及诸如此类的事情而发生冲突。今晚的节目中，踮脚尖会出现得更多一些。我刚才说过，每个人都会展示自己最坏的一面和最好的一面，对吗？我不会破坏任何东西，但无论你没有从谁那里看到这一点，都会在结局中展示它。

paras.en: Okay, so we should be getting a season two.
paras.zh: 好吧，所以我们应该得到第二季。

paras.en: M.S.: I think it’s likely. I think it’s very likely.
paras.zh: M.S. ：我认为这很有可能。我认为这很有可能。

paras.en: G.M.: When I first met Malc, he knew what season three was going to be.
paras.zh: 通用汽车：当我第一次见到Malc时，他知道第三季会是什么样子。

paras.en: M.S.: Season three is what everybody wants, which is the bulls—t.
paras.zh: M.S. ：第三季是每个人都想要的，这就是公牛队。

paras.en: The bulls—t that comes with being a rap star and all that stuff?
paras.zh: 成为说唱明星所带来的公牛和所有这些东西？

paras.en: M.S.: Our consultants is the people that was there, right? As the streets sprinted to get the f—k out the dope game, they piled in and brought some dysfunction. I ain’t gonna blame them for everything, but some of that dysfunction from the streets spills into the record business. It wasn’t just Death Row; it was Bad Boy. All the labels had to deal with basically a murder epidemic. There’s no other way to describe it. Please put this in the interview. There’s a documentary, Hip-Hop Uncovered, and Dre says during the four years he was at Death Row, 20 something affiliates were murdered.
paras.zh: M.S.：我们的顾问就是当时在场的人，对吗？当街道上的人们争先恐后地想要摆脱毒品游戏时，他们蜂拥而至，带来了一些功能障碍。我不会把所有事情都归咎于他们，但街头的一些失调影响到了唱片业。不仅仅是死囚牢房；还有死囚牢房。这是坏男孩。所有的唱片公司都必须应对谋杀的流行。没有其他方法可以描述它。请把这个放在采访中。有一部纪录片《Hip-Hop Uncovered》，Dre 说在他在死囚牢房的四年里，有 20 多个附属机构被谋杀。

paras.en: Like when Mase left Bad Boy because he was like, “Yo, I’m in the industry to get out the streets, but this s—t still happening around me.”
paras.zh: 就像Mase离开Bad Boy时一样，因为他就像是， “哟，我在这个行业是为了走出街头，但这种情况仍然发生在我周围。”

paras.en: G.M.: Too $hort told me, “Glasses, I didn’t know I could be rich. I just knew that I could be the man around the way.” They saw money, but they was like, “I could be the man.” The streets was the industry. Hip-hop was only the streets. You had to grow up around the way or culturally injected. The same thing that happened with gangbanging happened to hip-hop, when the money change, the violence got crazy. Whenever it’s big money, it’s gonna get real s—tty. People gonna get really hurt. If you look at stories of gangbanging from ’69 to ’79, we ain’t even talking about 100 people died from that old time period.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: There wasn’t big money in the streets like it.
paras.zh: 像这样的街道上没有大笔的钱。

paras.en: G.M.: Boy, when that crack money came in and started to flow through there, the guns even changed. It went from it went from pistols and muskets to Uzis and Tecs and violence. Same thing with hip-hop from ’69 to around ’87. Scott La Rock passing away was a big deal. But it got worse when that money started to funnel in.
paras.zh: 通用汽车：伙计，当那笔钞票进来并开始流经那里时，枪支甚至发生了变化。它从手枪和火枪变成了乌兹和特克和暴力。从69年到87年左右的嘻哈也是如此。斯科特·拉罗克去世是一件大事。但当这笔钱开始流入时，情况变得更糟。

paras.en: Yeah, man. Biggie and Pac dying sent shockwaves — but how many rappers have died since then?
paras.zh: 是的，伙计。Biggie和Pac奄奄一息发出了冲击波—但从那时起有多少说唱歌手死了？

paras.en: M.S.: It’s interesting. When we was doing the doc, Hip-Hop Uncovered, (which is on FX,) there was a stat that said the No. 1 cause of death for rappers was murder, right? But also, the No. 1 cause of death for Black men who are the same age as rappers is murder. So, all they’re doing is bringing the street stat into the music business.
paras.zh: M.S. ：很有趣。当我们做doc时， Hip-Hop Uncovered ， （这是在FX上， ）有一个统计数据说说唱歌手的头号死因是谋杀，对吗？但同样，与说唱歌手同龄的黑人男性的头号死因是谋杀。所以，他们所做的就是将街头数据带入音乐行业。

paras.en: I think one of the things that happened is…You got Ice Cube, who says, “I don’t bang, I rock the good rhymes.” Ice Cube is from the streets, saw the streets, knows the streets, but was allowed to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. The rappers today, not all of them, but there is a certain demographic of young men today who brag about the fact that they’re not rappers. They’re really street dudes who are just rapping money. Them be the dudes who are dying because they’re real street dudes.

articles.title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
articles.author: Colin Stutz

paras.en: As part of our continuing efforts to serve the music industry and its creators, Billboard Pro now features a music industry events calendar for readers.
paras.zh: 作为我们为音乐行业及其创作者提供服务的持续努力的一部分，Billboard Pro 现在为读者提供了音乐行业活动日历。

paras.en: The calendar will act as music’s most complete summary major national and international industry events, from conferences to festivals to networking mixers and more. Just as Billboard is music’s must-read source for news, charts and analysis, now it also is the go-to for business happenings.
paras.zh: 该日历将作为音乐最完整的主要国内和国际行业活动的总结，从会议到节日到社交混音器等等。正如 Billboard 是音乐界必读的新闻、图表和分析来源一样，现在它也是商业活动的首选。

articles.title: Lego Has Hired a Hollywood-Whisperer
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: The Lego Group is bringing on an in-house Hollywood-whisperer.
paras.zh: 乐高集团正在聘请一位好莱坞内部人士。

paras.en: The Danish toy giant has hired WME veteran Kelsey Gray Sherman as head of celebrity talent and brand first partnerships, where she will work with Hollywood talent (and their agents and managers) and develop opportunities for Lego in entertainment projects and brand campaigns. She will also be tasked with developing relationships with brands that stretch beyond licensing and product collaborations.
paras.zh: 这家丹麦玩具巨头聘请了 WME 资深人士 Kelsey Gray Sherman 担任名人人才和品牌优先合作伙伴关系负责人，她将与好莱坞人才（及其经纪人和经理）合作，并为乐高在娱乐项目和品牌活动中开发机会。她还将负责与品牌建立超越授权和产品合作的关系。

paras.en: Sherman joins Lego from WME, where she had been VP in the agency’s entertainment marketing & advisory group, where she led talent partnerships and strategies for major global brands including McDonald’s, Visa, Amazon and Lego.
paras.zh: Sherman 在加入乐高之前曾在 WME 担任该机构娱乐营销和咨询小组的副总裁，领导麦当劳、Visa、亚马逊和乐高等全球主要品牌的人才合作和战略。

paras.en: She will report to Jill Wilfert, senior VP of entertainment, partnerships & content at Lego.
paras.zh: 她将向乐高娱乐、合作伙伴关系和内容高级副总裁 Jill Wilfert 汇报工作。

paras.en: “Kelsey brings deep relationships across the talent and entertainment communities, along with a strong understanding of the Lego brand,” said Wilfert. “She knows how to bring together the right talent, partners and ideas in ways that feel fresh and authentic, and her experience and instincts will be invaluable as we continue to grow our work in entertainment and culture.”
paras.zh: “凯尔西在人才和娱乐界建立了深厚的关系，并对乐高品牌有深入的了解，”威尔弗特说。 “她知道如何以新鲜和真实的方式汇集合适的人才、合作伙伴和想法，随着我们继续发展娱乐和文化领域的工作，她的经验和直觉将非常宝贵。”

paras.en: “Having worked closely with the Lego Group for many years, I’ve seen first-hand its unique ability to bring together entertainment, experiences and culture,” added Sherman. “I’m excited to build on that strength through ambitious, distinctive partnerships with exceptional talent and brands. Together, we can create new ways to inspire creativity and play and connect with audiences around the world.”
paras.zh: “与乐高集团密切合作多年，我亲眼目睹了其将娱乐、体验和文化融为一体的独特能力，”谢尔曼补充道。 “我很高兴能够通过与杰出人才和品牌建立雄心勃勃、独特的合作伙伴关系来巩固这一优势。我们可以共同创造新的方式来激发创造力、玩耍并与世界各地的观众建立联系。”

articles.title: Studios Get Millions From California’s Tax Credit. But They Balk at the State’s Diversity Initiative
articles.author: Erik Hayden

paras.en: Opposition is mounting among some major Hollywood studios against the California Film Commission’s diversity initiative designed to encourage more inclusive hiring on movies and TV series.
paras.zh: 一些主要好莱坞电影公司对加州电影委员会旨在鼓励电影和电视剧更具包容性的招聘的多元化举措的反对声音越来越大。

paras.en: At the heart of their frustration: concerns that compliance could violate federal law as the government cracks down on diversity programs hailed not too long ago as representing a much-needed step forward in getting films and TV shows to more accurately reflect audiences in California and the rest of the world. In recent years, Disney, Amazon Studios and Skydance, among others, have quietly retreated from diversity efforts, like tying staffing goals to race, ethnicity and gender.
paras.zh: 他们感到沮丧的核心是：担心合规可能违反联邦法律，因为政府严厉打击不久前称赞的多元化计划，这些计划代表着在让电影和电视节目更准确地反映加州和世界其他地区的观众方面向前迈出了急需的一步。近年来，迪士尼、亚马逊影业和 Skydance 等公司都悄悄放弃了多元化努力，比如将员工目标与种族、民族和性别挂钩。

paras.en: Participation in the state’s diversity initiative, which gives movies and TV shows a small bump in their overall tax credit, isn’t mandatory. Productions, however, risk leaving money on the table by choosing not to opt in. Over the course of multiple films, it can net studios a hefty sum. For California, criticism of the program has emerged as yet another roadblock to restoring production in the state amid a global tit-for-tat battle to host Hollywood.
paras.zh: 参与该州的多元化倡议并不是强制性的，该倡议使电影和电视节目的整体税收抵免略有增加。然而，制作方可能会选择不参与，从而面临损失资金的风险。在多部电影的制作过程中，它可以为制片厂带来巨额收入。对于加州来说，在全球为争夺好莱坞而展开的针锋相对之战中，对该计划的批评已成为该州恢复生产的又一个障碍。

paras.en: The pushback to the initiative climaxed in June at a commission meeting, reviewed by The Hollywood Reporter, in which board members employed by the studios and unions expressed significant reservations about whether it should move forward as currently constructed because of legal and administrative issues. Arturo Barquet, a board member and CFO of Global Production Operations for Universal Filmed Entertainment, said that Universal has “many times considered whether we should opt out.”
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》报道，在 6 月份的一次委员会会议上，对该倡议的抵制达到了高潮，会上，由于法律和行政问题，制片厂和工会雇用的董事会成员对是否应按照目前的构建方式推进该倡议表示了重大保留。环球电影娱乐公司董事会成员兼全球制作运营部首席财务官阿图罗·巴奎特 (Arturo Barquet) 表示，环球影业“多次考虑过我们是否应该选择退出”。

paras.en: “There are regulations — there are things in here that are in conflict with federal law,” he added.
paras.zh: “有一些规定——有些东西与联邦法律相冲突，”他补充道。

paras.en: Universal exec Barquet pointed to Skydance, which he said isn’t participating in the initiative as studios look to avoid clashing with the government. “My understanding is that Paramount is not going for the diversity program,” the exec noted at the June 5 meeting.
paras.zh: 环球影业执行官巴奎特提到了 Skydance，他表示该公司没有参与该计划，因为电影公司希望避免与政府发生冲突。 “我的理解是，派拉蒙不会推行多元化计划，”该高管在 6 月 5 日的会议上指出。

paras.en: Skydance does not have a blanket policy against participating in the diversity initiative and a number of shows under review by the commission are being considered, a person familiar with the situation tells THR.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士告诉《好莱坞报道》，Skydance 并没有针对参与多样性倡议的全面政策，委员会正在考虑一些正在审查的节目。

paras.en: Under the construction of the California film incentive program, movies and TV shows must opt into the initiative to maximize filming subsidies. Gov. Gavin Newsom has championed the incentives and signed a bill to double them from $330 million to $750 million last year. The program doesn’t carry diversity quotas and rewards good-faith efforts by studios to boost minority representation on productions. It was constructed, in part, to sidestep federal law believed to prohibit hiring targets by rewarding productions that comply rather than punishing those that do not.
paras.zh: 在加州电影激励计划的建设下，电影和电视节目必须选择加入最大限度提高拍摄补贴的举措。州长加文·纽瑟姆 (Gavin Newsom) 大力支持这些激励措施，并签署了一项法案，将激励措施从去年的 3.3 亿美元翻倍至 7.5 亿美元。该计划没有多样性配额，并奖励工作室为提高少数族裔在作品中的代表性所做的善意努力。它的建立在一定程度上是为了通过奖励遵守规定的作品而不是惩罚那些不遵守规定的作品来回避被认为禁止招聘目标的联邦法律。

paras.en: During the June meeting, Fanshen Cox, manager of the DEIA program, stressed that minority representation in Hollywood has taken a step back in recent years.
paras.zh: 在 6 月的会议上，DEIA 项目经理 Fanshen Cox 强调，近年来好莱坞的少数族裔代表性有所下降。

paras.en: “Instead of raising the bar, we are now seeing productions fall below it,” she said. “This is not progress. This is a reversal.”
paras.zh: “我们现在看到的产量不但没有提高标准，反而低于标准，”她说。 “这不是进步。这是逆转。”

paras.en: UCLA documented that backslide in a report earlier this year when it noted, for the first time in three years, that the proportion of minority lead actors on streaming fell below their proportion of the U.S. population, from a high of 51 percent in 2024 to 36 percent in 2025. Streaming films featuring casts with a majority of minorities also slipped from 41 percent to roughly 26 percent.
paras.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校在今年早些时候的一份报告中记录了这种倒退，当时它指出，流媒体中少数族裔主演的比例三年来首次低于其在美国人口中的比例，从 2024 年的 51% 下降到 2025 年的 36%。以少数族裔演员为主的流媒体电影也从 41% 下降到大约 26%。

paras.en: Another study from ¡Pa’lante!, a Latino representation initiative from the USC Norman Lear Center, found that Latinos only accounted for six percent of all roles across the top broadcast series, despite making up nearly 20 percent of the country’s total population and 41 percent of California’s population.
paras.zh: 南加州大学诺曼·李尔中心 (USC Norman Lear Center) 发起的拉丁裔代表倡议 ¡Pa’lante! 的另一项研究发现，尽管拉丁裔占全国总人口的近 20%、加州总人口的 41%，但在顶级广播剧中仅占所有角色的 6%。

paras.en: “We’re seeing what happens when our finger gets taken off the pulse,” said Colleen Bell, executive director of the California Film Commission, about the figures.
paras.zh: “我们正在观察当我们的手指离开脉搏时会发生什么，”加州电影委员会执行主任科琳·贝尔谈到这些数字时说。

paras.en: The productions that drop out of the diversity initiative also do so because of the administrative process, which requires attending orientation sessions and filling out voluminous paperwork, among other things. It’s believed to be overly burdensome by several of the studios.
paras.zh: 退出多样性倡议的作品也是因为行政流程的原因，其中需要参加说明会并填写大量文件等。一些工作室认为这过于繁琐。

paras.en: Still, 105 of 115 productions opted into the diversity provisions across the last eight application windows, according to the commission.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，据该委员会称，在过去 8 个申请窗口中，115 部作品中的 105 部选择了多样性条款。

paras.en: California began collecting information in 2020 about diversity for films and TV shows tapped to receive filming subsidies, requiring productions to report the racial, ethnic and gender makeup of their workforces. The state last year expanded the requirements, making productions eligible for the full value of their tax credits only if they also comply with a more extensive process setting and assessing diversity goals.
paras.zh: 加州于 2020 年开始收集有关获得拍摄补贴的电影和电视节目多样性的信息，要求制作报告其劳动力的种族、民族和性别构成。该州去年扩大了要求，只有在遵守更广泛的流程设置和评估多样性目标的情况下，作品才有资格获得全额税收抵免。

paras.en: Under the expanded rules, productions must submit a checklist covering hiring, workplace education, workforce development and supplier diversity. They must also hand over a plan outlining specific efforts to broaden access to jobs, an interim assessment before filming begins and a final assessment after completing production. The initiative does not include racial quotas or hiring targets; instead, it evaluates whether a production has made a good-faith effort to pursue the goals in its blueprint. Productions that opt out of the additional requirements, or fail to meet the standard, still qualify for 96 percent of their allocated credit rather than the full amount.
paras.zh: 根据扩大后的规则，制作公司必须提交一份涵盖招聘、工作场所教育、劳动力发展和供应商多样性的清单。他们还必须提交一份计划，概述扩大就业机会的具体努力、拍摄开始前的临时评估以及制作完成后的最终评估。该倡议不包括种族配额或招聘目标；相反，它评估作品是否为实现其蓝图中的目标做出了真诚的努力。选择不满足额外要求或未达到标准的作品仍有资格获得其分配学分的 96%，而不是全额。

paras.en: Diversity programs requiring applicants to come from certain racial or ethnic groups have long been on legally tenuous ground, but the nail in the coffin came in 2023 when the Supreme Court struck down race-conscious admissions in colleges. Since then, there’s been heightened scrutiny around such initiatives. A year after the decision, a script coordinator for SEAL Team who was denied a staff writer job sued CBS Studios and Paramount for allegedly carrying diversity quotas that discriminate against white men. General counsels at studios have pushed to keep race out of hiring decisions. Policies meant to encourage more inclusive hiring now often employ read-between-the-lines placeholders like “underrepresented” or “underserved” or “unique experiences.”
paras.zh: 长期以来，要求申请者来自某些种族或族裔群体的多元化计划在法律上一直站不住脚，但棺材上的钉子在 2023 年敲响了警钟，当时最高法院否决了大学在招生时注重种族的做法。从那时起，对此类举措的审查就更加严格。该决定一年后，一名被拒绝担任编剧工作的海豹突击队剧本协调员起诉哥伦比亚广播公司工作室和派拉蒙影业，称其实施了歧视白人的多元化配额。工作室的总法律顾问一直在努力将种族因素排除在招聘决策之外。旨在鼓励更具包容性的招聘的政策现在经常采用字里行间的占位符，例如“代表性不足”或“服务不足”或“独特的体验”。

paras.en: Part of the Barquet’s grievance also stemmed from its belief that an untitled movie from Daniel Kawn and Daniel Scheinert had complied with the program’s requirements but was rejected three times. Universal Pictures’ Snoop Dogg biopic, he added, was rejected twice before a recent greenlight. The exec indicated that he didn’t know why these titles were initially rejected from qualifying for the state’s diversity initiative. Snoop is expected to receive $17 million in tax credits from the California Film Commission, though the figure will come in lower if the production fails to complete the program (the commission hasn’t approved Snoop yet but is expected to do so, according to a person familiar with the matter).
paras.zh: Barquet 的部分不满还源于它认为 Daniel Kawn 和 Daniel Scheinert 的一部未命名电影符合该计划的要求，但被拒绝了 3 次。他补充说，环球影业的《史努比狗狗》传记片在最近获得批准之前曾两次被拒绝。这位高管表示，他不知道为什么这些头衔最初被拒绝获得该州多元化倡议的资格。 《史努比》预计将从加州电影委员会获得 1700 万美元的税收抵免，但如果制作未能完成该计划，这一数字将会更低（据一位知情人士透露，该委员会尚未批准《史努比》，但预计会批准）。

paras.en: Some studios believe they should get credited for complying with California’s overall goal to boost diversity in the Hollywood workforce because they still maintain diversity program even though particular productions may not have sufficiently diverse cast and crew or made good-faith efforts to achieve diversity goals.
paras.zh: 一些电影公司认为，他们应该因遵守加州促进好莱坞劳动力多元化的总体目标而受到赞誉，因为他们仍然维持多元化计划，即使某些制作可能没有足够多元化的演员和工作人员，或者没有为实现多元化目标做出真诚的努力。

paras.en: Andrew Davis, Sony Pictures’ president of production administration, echoed Universal’s criticism of the diversity initiatives’ construction, saying that studios want to participate in the program but that compliance is a “tremendous burden on both television and features.” Thom Davis, the head of IATSE Local 80, argued that diversity initiatives clash with the longtime process of placing members into productions.
paras.zh: 索尼影业的制作管理总裁安德鲁·戴维斯(Andrew Davis)回应了环球影业对多元化计划建设的批评，称电影公司希望参与该计划，但合规性“对电视和故事片来说都是巨大的负担”。 IATSE Local 80 的负责人 Thom Davis 认为，多元化举措与将成员投入制作的长期流程相冲突。

paras.en: “All this work and all these resources put into [studio diversity] programs are getting no credit and are actually being discouraged,” Davis said. “We’ve got people that come in through the union side who tell us they aren’t getting on” because productions need to prioritize compliance at times.
paras.zh: 戴维斯说：“所有这些工作和投入[工作室多样性]项目的所有资源都没有得到认可，而且实际上受到了阻碍。” “工会方面的人告诉我们他们进展不顺利”，因为制作有时需要优先考虑合规性。

paras.en: By Cox’s thinking, however, increasing minority representation in Hollywood means giving a share of work to Californians looking for a foothold in the industry who also reflect the diversity of the state.
paras.zh: 然而，根据考克斯的想法，增加少数族裔在好莱坞的代表性意味着向那些寻求在该行业立足的加州人提供一份工作，这些人也反映了该州的多样性。

paras.en: “All these jobs are coming back, and they’re still going to the same people,” Cox, who no longer works with the commission, says. She adds, “This is a system-wide problem. Ultimately, it’s the studios that need to do the work.”
paras.zh: “所有这些工作岗位都会回来，而且仍然属于同一个人，”不再在该委员会工作的考克斯说。她补充道，“这是一个系统范围的问题。最终，需要做这项工作的是工作室。”

paras.en: In a statement, Bell stressed that the commission is in regular talks with the studios on the issue. “Our goal hasn’t changed: keep California the best place to make film and television, with opportunity open to everyone who wants to build a career here,” she said.
paras.zh: 贝尔在一份声明中强调，委员会正在与电影公司就这个问题进行定期会谈。 “我们的目标没有改变：让加州成为制作电影和电视的最佳之地，为每个想在这里开创事业的人提供机会，”她说。

articles.title: ‘Fear Factor’ Goes Vertical With Scripted Microdrama
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: Fox‘s Fear Factor: House of Fear is going in a couple of new directions: The reality series will be the basis for a scripted microdrama.
paras.zh: 福克斯的《恐惧因素：恐惧屋》正朝着几个新方向发展：真人秀系列将成为有剧本的微剧的基础。

paras.en: Fox Entertainment Studios and Endemol Shine North America are teaming up for a vertical video show inspired by the current iteration of Fear Factor, which is going into its second season on the network (Endemol Shine North America, a Banijay company, produces the unscripted series). The microseries will stream on the My Drama platform owned by Holywater Tech, in which Fox has an equity stake.
paras.zh: 福克斯娱乐工作室 (Fox Entertainment Studios) 和 Endemol Shine North America 正在联手制作一部垂直视频节目，其灵感来自当前版本的《恐惧因素》(Fear Factor)，该节目即将在网络上播出第二季（Banijay 公司的 Endemol Shine North America 制作了该无脚本剧集）。这部微剧将在由福克斯持有股权的 Holywater Tech 旗下的 My Drama 平台上播出。

paras.en: According to Fox, the currently untitled microdrama will mark the first unscripted-to-scripted franchise extension in television. It’s also the first horror series for My Drama (though there are a number of vampire and werewolf romances on the platform).
paras.zh: 据福克斯报道，这部目前尚未命名的微剧将标志着电视领域第一部从无剧本到有剧本的系列延伸。这也是 My Drama 的第一部恐怖系列（尽管该平台上有许多吸血鬼和狼人的爱情故事）。

paras.en: “Fear Factor has always tapped into something primal: what scares us, how far we’ll go and what happens when we’re forced to confront our fears,” said Hannah Pillemer, head of scripted at Fox Entertainment Studios. “The tremendous response [to Fear Factor: House of Fear] has opened the door to take Fear Factor somewhere it has never gone before: becoming the first unscripted television franchise to make the leap into original scripted storytelling. Our friends at Endemol Shine came to us with an inspired way to do exactly that, turning everything audiences love about Fear Factor into the foundation for a completely original horror story.”
paras.zh: “《恐惧因素》总是利用一些原始的东西：我们害怕什么，我们会走多远，以及当我们被迫面对恐惧时会发生什么，”福克斯娱乐工作室的剧本主管汉娜·皮勒默(Hannah Pillemer)说。 “《恐惧因素：恐惧之屋》的巨大反响打开了大门，让《恐惧因素》达到了前所未有的高度：成为第一部无剧本电视系列，实现了原创剧本叙事的飞跃。Endemol Shine 的朋友们向我们提出了一种充满灵感的方式来实现这一目标，将观众喜爱的《恐惧因素》的一切都转变为完全原创的恐怖故事的基础。”

paras.en: Added Michael Heyerman, executive vp unscripted series at Endemol Shine North America, “Vertical storytelling is creating a new language for entertainment, one built on immediacy, intimacy, and serialized discovery, and Fear Factor already speaks it fluently. Our partners at Fox gave the franchise a powerful new life with House of Fear, and we’re proud to build on that momentum. Alongside Holywater, together we’re creating a new generation of horror that doesn’t just fit the mobile screen but uses it as part of the experience.”
paras.zh: Endemol Shine 北美无剧本剧集执行副总裁迈克尔·海尔曼 (Michael Heyerman) 补充道：“垂直叙事正在创造一种新的娱乐语言，一种建立在即时性、亲密性和系列化发现基础上的新语言，而《恐惧因素》已经能流利地表达这种语言。福克斯的合作伙伴通过《恐惧屋》为该系列赋予了强大的新生命，我们很自豪能够在此基础上再接再厉。与 Holywater 一起，我们正在共同打造新一代恐怖游戏，不仅适合移动屏幕但将其作为体验的一部分。”

paras.en: The Fear Factor microseries will have 30 three-minute episodes. It “takes place during prep week on a remote horror television set,” the logline reads, “where a practical-effects artist and her crew unleash a haunted fortune-telling machine that forces them into personalized death trials, leaving the survivors to uncover its tragic origins before it claims everyone they love.”
paras.zh: 《恐惧因素》微型连续剧将有 30 集，每集三分钟。故事梗概是这样写的：“故事发生在远程恐怖电视台的准备周期间，一位特效艺术家和她的团队释放了一台闹鬼的算命机器，迫使他们进行个性化的死亡审判，让幸存者在它夺走他们所爱的每个人之前揭开它的悲惨起源。”

paras.en: Holywater bills itself as an “AI-first company,” but the Fear Factor series is a physical production. Ian Nsenga and Yuliia Vyshnevska are producing, with Gabriel Caste directing and Thom Woodley and Andrew Beck writing.
paras.zh: Holywater 自称为“人工智能优先公司”，但《恐惧因素》系列是实体作品。伊恩·恩森加和尤利娅·维什涅夫斯卡担任制片人，加布里埃尔·卡斯特执导，汤姆·伍德利和安德鲁·贝克编剧。

paras.en: “We’re grateful to see our vision of turning My Drama into a trusted platform for studios, creators and IP like Fear Factor come to life,” said Anatolii Kasianov and Bogdan Nesvit, co-founders and co-CEOs of Holywater Tech. “This is another step toward expanding the audience and helping vertical TV evolve into mainstream entertainment.”
paras.zh: Holywater Tech 联合创始人兼联席首席执行官阿纳托利·卡西亚诺夫 (Anatolii Kasianov) 和博格丹·内斯维特 (Bogdan Nesvit) 表示：“我们很高兴看到我们的愿景得以实现，即将 My Drama 打造成工作室、创作者和《恐惧因素》等 IP 值得信赖的平台。” “这是扩大受众群体、帮助垂直电视发展成为主流娱乐的又一步。”

articles.title: Speaker Mike Johnson calls election-transfer concerns ‘absurd’

paras.en: U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., committed to a peaceful post-election transfer of power, calling concerns that President Donald Trump and congressional Republicans could contest the results if Democrats win control of Congress "absurd."
paras.zh: 美国众议院议长、路易斯安那州共和党人迈克·约翰逊致力于在选举后和平移交权力，他称，如果民主党赢得国会控制权，唐纳德·特朗普总统和国会共和党人可能会对选举结果提出质疑，这种担忧是“荒谬的”。

paras.en: "We're going to follow the Constitution. The Constitution says when a state certifies the election of members of Congress, then they're administered the oath. That's what I'll be doing on Jan. 3 to everybody who's there," Johnson said Tuesday during a campaign stop with New York Republican Rep. Mike Lawler, one week before the Nov. 3 midterm election, in response to a question from MS NOW. "I may not like some of those outcomes, but that's our system. And for anybody to suggest otherwise is absurd."
paras.zh: “我们将遵守宪法。宪法规定，当一个州批准国会议员的选举时，他们就要宣誓。这就是我将在 1 月 3 日对在场的所有人所做的事情，”约翰逊周二在与纽约共和党众议员迈克·劳勒 (Mike Lawler) 的竞选活动中说道，距离 11 月 3 日中期选举还有一周。 “我可能不喜欢其中一些结果，但这就是我们的系统。任何人提出其他建议都是荒谬的。”

paras.en: Democrats and voting rights advocates are bracing for potential challenges if control of the House flips, as is widely projected to happen, or control changes in the Senate, which is more closely contested. Republicans have a majority in both chambers of Congress.
paras.zh: 如果众议院的控制权发生翻转（正如人们普遍预计的那样），或者参议院的控制权发生变化（竞争更加激烈），民主党人和投票权倡导者正准备迎接潜在的挑战。共和党在参众两院均占多数。

paras.en: Trump, who has continued to falsely claim that widespread fraud cost him the 2020 election, has fueled those fears by calling to "nationalize" elections earlier this year and repeatedly questioning the security of mail voting, while also suggesting noncitizens could vote in large enough numbers to skew results. His administration sued California earlier this month in a fight over noncitizens voting.
paras.zh: 特朗普继续错误地声称，普遍存在的舞弊行为让他在 2020 年大选中失败。今年早些时候，他呼吁将选举“国有化”，并多次质疑邮寄投票的安全性，同时还暗示非公民可以进行足够多的投票，从而影响结果，从而加剧了这些担忧。他的政府本月早些时候就非公民投票问题起诉了加州。

paras.en: The Department of Justice also sued Alaska last week to block the certification of its results in the event of voter confusion. GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan will appear on the ballot beside Daniel J. Sullivan, a retired teacher whom Republicans have said is on the ballot only as a spoiler candidate.
paras.zh: 司法部上周还起诉阿拉斯加，要求在选民混淆的情况下阻止对其结果进行认证。共和党参议员丹·沙利文 (Dan Sullivan) 将与退休教师丹尼尔·J·沙利文 (Daniel J. Sullivan) 一起出现在选票上，共和党人称他只是作为搅局者候选人出现在选票上。

paras.en: Johnson, who in the wake of the 2020 election was a key congressional ally of Trump's in his quest to overturn results, on Tuesday said questions about a peaceful transfer were "a little silly."
paras.zh: 约翰逊在 2020 年大选后是特朗普寻求推翻选举结果的重要国会盟友，他周二表示，有关和平移交的问题“有点愚蠢”。

paras.en: "Of course we'll have a peaceful transfer of power. But it will not be transferring, because we are going to keep the majority and I'm going to be the speaker of the House and I will keep steady hands at the wheel," Johnson told reporters.
paras.zh: “当然，我们会和平地进行权力移交。但它不会移交，因为我们将保留多数席位，我将成为众议院议长，我将保持稳定的权力，”约翰逊告诉记者。

articles.title: CNBC Workforce Executive Summit live updates: AI and the future of work

paras.en: Today's workplace faces a litany of challenges. Whether it's shifting power dynamics between employers and employees, the accelerating impact of artificial intelligence on how we work and the skills we need, or the financial stresses that employees of all ranks are feeling, these issues and more are challenging the cohesion of workplace communities.
paras.zh: 当今的工作场所面临着一系列挑战。无论是雇主和雇员之间权力动态的转变、人工智能对我们工作方式和所需技能的加速影响，还是各级员工所感受到的财务压力，这些问题以及更多问题都在挑战工作场所社区的凝聚力。

paras.en: To address these issues, CNBC is convening its premiere council of human resource executives in New York City on Tuesday for the annual CNBC Workforce Executive Summit. The event is exclusive to members of CNBC's Workforce Executive Council.
paras.zh: 为了解决这些问题，CNBC 将于周二在纽约召开首届人力资源高管委员会，参加年度 CNBC 劳动力高管峰会。该活动仅限 CNBC 劳动力执行委员会成员参加。

paras.en: For more about the WEC and to apply for membership, visit www.cnbccouncils.com/wec.
paras.zh: 有关 WEC 的更多信息以及申请会员资格，请访问 www.cnbccouncils.com/wec。

articles.title: Early third-quarter earnings show a 'resilient' U.S. consumer, with signs of strain

paras.en: One word keeps appearing in third-quarter earnings reports: "resilient."
paras.zh: 第三季度财报中不断出现一个词：“韧性”。

paras.en: That's the early read on U.S. consumers from various companies that released their results this week. Many businesses say Americans are still spending despite inflationary pressures, though not every company has enjoyed the same success.
paras.zh: 这是本周发布业绩的多家公司对美国消费者的初步解读。许多企业表示，尽管面临通胀压力，美国人仍在消费，但并非每家公司都取得了同样的成功。

paras.en: The commentary comes amid fears that diesel fuel prices, which hit an all-time high of $6.52 per gallon in September, would drive up prices on consumer products. Economists also worried that more expensive regular gas, combined with high borrowing costs and continued tension between the U.S. and Iran, would spur a pullback in consumer spending.
paras.zh: 发表此评论的背景是，人们担心柴油价格在 9 月份创下每加仑 6.52 美元的历史新高，这将推高消费品价格。经济学家还担心，常规天然气价格上涨，加上借贷成本高昂以及美国和伊朗之间持续紧张的局势，将刺激消费者支出缩减。

paras.en: Retail sales rose 0.8% in September, following a jump of 1.3% in August. Sales in September were boosted by rising gas station spending. Despite all those challenges, some corporate executives say the headwinds aren't yet affecting sales.
paras.zh: 继 8 月增长 1.3% 后，9 月零售额增长 0.8%。加油站支出增加推动了 9 月份的销售。尽管面临所有这些挑战，一些企业高管表示，逆风尚未影响销售。

paras.en: While retail sales rose 0.8% in September, following a jump of 1.3% in August, the September came as gas station spending jumped. Despite all those challenges, some corporate executives say the headwinds aren't yet affecting sales.
paras.zh: 继 8 月份增长 1.3% 之后，9 月份零售额增长 0.8%，但 9 月份加油站支出大幅增长。尽管面临所有这些挑战，一些企业高管表示，逆风尚未影响销售。

paras.en: "There's been a lot of noise in the market this year. There's a lot of geopolitical stuff," Royal Caribbean Chairman and CEO Jason Liberty said on the company's earnings call on Tuesday. "But I look at our business [and our results], and I think that really talks to the resilience of the business, the resilience of the consumer."
paras.zh: “今年市场上有很多噪音。有很多地缘政治因素，”皇家加勒比董事长兼首席执行官杰森·利伯蒂在周二的公司财报电话会议上表示。 “但我看看我们的业务[和我们的结果]，我认为这确实与业务的弹性、消费者的弹性有关。”

paras.en: Royal Caribbean reported an increase in bookings during its third quarter, while Sherwin-Williams's CEO said the quarter was evidence of the company's strength.
paras.zh: 皇家加勒比公司报告称，第三季度的预订量有所增加，而宣伟首席执行官表示，该季度证明了该公司的实力。

paras.en: Here's how companies are reading the consumer in the most recent three-month period:
paras.zh: 以下是公司在最近三个月内如何解读消费者的情况：

paras.en: The food and beverage company beat analysts' expectations for third-quarter earnings and revenue despite what CEO Henrique Braun called an "uneven environment."
paras.zh: 尽管首席执行官恩里克·布劳恩(Henrique Braun)称之为“不平衡的环境”，但这家食品和饮料公司第三季度的盈利和收入超出了分析师的预期。

paras.en: Coca-Cola reported that North America unit case volume was flat, indicating demand was steady in the face of higher prices. The company's overall unit case volume was helped by higher demand outside of North America.
paras.zh: 可口可乐报告称，北美单位箱销量持平，表明尽管价格上涨，需求仍保持稳定。该公司的整体单位箱量得益于北美以外地区更高的需求。

paras.en: "The underlying momentum remains quite strong," CFO John Murphy told CNBC. "Consumer sentiment is largely unchanged in the sense that, wherever you are on the income scale, you're looking for value, and I think our system here has done a good job interpreting that."
paras.zh: 首席财务官约翰·墨菲 (John Murphy) 告诉 CNBC：“潜在的势头仍然相当强劲。” “消费者情绪基本上没有变化，因为无论你的收入水平如何，你都在寻找价值，我认为我们的系统很好地解释了这一点。”

paras.en: The company increased its full-year forecast and now expects its comparable earnings per share to grow at least 11%, up from a prior forecast of growth between 9% and 10%.
paras.zh: 该公司上调了全年预测，目前预计其可比每股收益将增长至少 11%，高于之前预测的 9% 至 10% 之间的增长。

paras.en: The cruise company beat Wall Street's expectations for earnings per share and narrowly missed on revenue.
paras.zh: 该游轮公司的每股收益超出了华尔街的预期，但营收却略低于华尔街的预期。

paras.en: "Our third quarter results reflect continued strong consumer demand for our vacation experiences and the accelerated momentum across our industry leading brands," CEO Liberty said in the release.
paras.zh: 首席执行官 Liberty 在新闻稿中表示：“我们第三季度的业绩反映了消费者对我们度假体验的持续强劲需求以及我们行业领先品牌的加速发展势头。”

paras.en: The company reported that the number of guests served in the third quarter increased 9% year over year to 2.7 million vacationers and said booking volumes for 2027 were already "up in the high teens," pacing ahead of historical levels and indicating high travel demand.
paras.zh: 该公司报告称，第三季度接待的游客数量同比增长 9%，达到 270 万名度假者，并表示 2027 年的预订量已经“达到十几岁”，领先于历史水平，表明旅行需求很高。

paras.en: "It's not that we don't see points of challenges, but really what we've seen is that even in those points of challenges, the consumer comes roaring back as relates to the vacation experiences," Liberty told CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" following the report.
paras.zh: Liberty 在报告发布后告诉 CNBC 的“Squawk on the Street”节目：“这并不是说我们没有看到挑战，但我们真正看到的是，即使在这些挑战中，消费者也会在度假体验方面卷土重来。”

paras.en: Royal Caribbean shares rose over 8% in Tuesday trading.
paras.zh: 周二交易中，皇家加勒比股价上涨超过 8%。

paras.en: Sherwin-Williams beat analysts' expectations for revenue but fell short of expected earnings per share.
paras.zh: 宣伟公司的营收超出了分析师的预期，但每股收益未达到预期。

paras.en: Sherwin-Williams CEO Heidi Petz said in the company's earnings release that the paint retailer's performance demonstrated "the resilience of our Company and the strength of our strategy in a challenging demand environment."
paras.zh: 宣伟首席执行官海蒂·佩茨（Heidi Petz）在公司财报中表示，这家涂料零售商的业绩证明了“我们公司在充满挑战的需求环境中的韧性和战略优势”。

paras.en: "Despite muted underlying market volumes, we continued to win new customers, increase share-of-wallet and deliver sales growth across all three reportable segments," she said.
paras.zh: 她表示：“尽管基础市场销量低迷，但我们继续赢得新客户，增加钱包份额，并在所有三个可报告细分市场实现销售增长。”

paras.en: Net sales increased 7.9% from the same period last year. The company attributed the gain to higher selling prices, but the benefits to profits were partially offset by increased costs of raw materials and supply-chain related expenses.
paras.zh: 净销售额较去年同期增长7.9%。该公司将收益归因于较高的销售价格，但利润带来的收益被原材料成本和供应链相关费用的增加部分抵消。

paras.en: And the company maintained full-year guidance, saying "customer sentiment and the leading indicators we track point to muted demand over the remainder of the year and into 2027."
paras.zh: 该公司维持全年指引，称“客户情绪和我们跟踪的领先指标表明，今年剩余时间和 2027 年需求疲软。”

paras.en: UPS beat Wall Street expectations for both earnings per share and revenue in the third quarter.
paras.zh: UPS 第三季度每股收益和营收均超出华尔街预期。

paras.en: Revenue in the U.S. rose 4.5% during the period to $14.86 billion.
paras.zh: 同期美国收入增长 4.5% 至 148.6 亿美元。

paras.en: CEO Carol Tomé told investors on the company's earnings call that consumers remain "resilient" ahead of the holiday season, the company's busiest period. She said the company expects that average daily shipping volume will grow next quarter at a rate consistent with last year. However, fourth-quarter domestic average daily volume will likely fall due to reducing deliveries with Amazon, she said.
paras.zh: 首席执行官卡罗尔·托梅（Carol Tomé）在公司财报电话会议上告诉投资者，消费者在公司最繁忙的假日季节之前保持“弹性”。她表示，该公司预计下季度日均发货量将以与去年一致的速度增长。然而，她表示，由于亚马逊的送货量减少，第四季度国内日均交易量可能会下降。

paras.en: UPS has been in the midst of unwinding its partnership with Amazon at the same time it's executing a broad turnaround effort to operate more leanly.
paras.zh: UPS 一直在解除与亚马逊的合作伙伴关系，同时正在进行广泛的转型努力，以更加精益运营。

paras.en: The company raised its full-year forecast for the second quarter in a row, projecting consolidated revenue of approximately $92.6 billion, up from its previous expectations of $91.2 billion.
paras.zh: 该公司连续上调第二季度全年预期，预计合并营收约为 926 亿美元，高于此前预期的 912 亿美元。

paras.en: Shares rose more than 4% in Tuesday trading.
paras.zh: 周二交易中该股上涨超过 4%。

paras.en: Not every company is seeing the same spending trends, however.
paras.zh: 然而，并非每家公司都看到相同的支出趋势。

paras.en: Appliance maker Whirlpool missed on both the top and bottom lines for its third quarter and cut its full-year revenue guidance.
paras.zh: 家电制造商惠而浦第三季度的营收和利润均未达标，并下调了全年营收预期。

paras.en: Net sales in North America fell more than 8% year over year during the period ending on Sept. 30.
paras.zh: 截至 9 月 30 日的期间，北美地区的净销售额同比下降超过 8%。

paras.en: Even still, the company cited its own read on "resilience."
paras.zh: 尽管如此，该公司还是引用了自己对“弹性”的解读。

paras.en: "Through disciplined working capital management, we are protecting our year end free cash flow and
paras.zh: “通过严格的营运资金管理，我们正在保护我们的年终自由现金流和

paras.en: our balance sheet resilience to navigate challenging market conditions," CFO Roxanne Warner said in the earnings release.
paras.zh: 我们的资产负债表具有应对充满挑战的市场条件的弹性，”首席财务官罗克珊·华纳(Roxanne Warner)在财报中表示。

paras.en: Shares were down nearly 1% in Tuesday trading.
paras.zh: 周二交易中该股下跌近 1%。

paras.en: — CNBC's Amelia Lucas and Laya Neelakandan contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Amelia Lucas 和 Laya Neelakandan 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Underwater data centers may be coming to the U.S.—smack in the middle of endangered whale habitat

paras.en: The battle over where to put data centers is heading below the waves: the Trump administration is considering proposals to build two massive underwater data centers off the country’s coast. The sites selected for the projects—one in Cook Inlet, Alaska, and one in the Gulf of Maine—are smack in the middle of two endangered whale populations’ habitats.
paras.zh: 关于数据中心选址的争论正在水下进行：特朗普政府正在考虑在该国海岸建造两个大型水下数据中心的提议。项目选定的地点（一处位于阿拉斯加库克湾，一处位于缅因湾）正好位于两个濒临灭绝的鲸鱼种群栖息地的中间。

paras.en: Whales are “skittish animals,” says Arial Brewer, a beluga researcher at the University of Washington and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. “A massive-scale project like this could really stress them out in a lot of different ways.”
paras.zh: 华盛顿大学和国家海洋与大气管理局的白鲸研究员阿里尔·布鲁尔 (Arial Brewer) 表示，鲸鱼是“易受惊吓的动物”。 “像这样的大规模项目确实会给他们带来很多不同的压力。”

paras.en: Data centers, with their thousands of servers, generate considerable heat that can damage equipment if not offset in some way. Land-based facilities use massive amounts of fresh water to cool down. By putting a data center underwater, the ocean can easily dispel that heat. “Cooling is a large part of what a data center costs to run, and seawater is a free sink,” says Vishal Misra, a computer scientist and professor at Columbia University.
paras.zh: 拥有数千台服务器的数据中心会产生大量热量，如果不以某种方式抵消，可能会损坏设备。陆上设施使用大量淡水来冷却。通过将数据中心置于水下，海洋可以轻松驱散热量。哥伦比亚大学计算机科学家兼教授维沙尔·米斯拉 (Vishal Misra) 表示：“冷却是数据中心运行成本的很大一部分，而海水是免费的水槽。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Microsoft showed that the concept could work with a pilot project off California in 2015 and another off Scotland a few years later. Currently, there are only two operational underwater data centers in the world, one off the Chinese island of Hainan and another off the coast of Shanghai, and they’re a fraction of the size of the proposed centers at the two U.S. sites.
paras.zh: 微软表明，这一概念可以在 2015 年加利福尼亚州附近的一个试点项目中发挥作用，并在几年后在苏格兰附近的另一个试点项目中发挥作用。目前，世界上只有两个正在运行的水下数据中心，一个位于中国海南岛，另一个位于上海沿海，它们的规模只是拟议的美国两个地点的一小部分。

paras.en: In the Maine project, a cluster of what official documents call “subsea-compute hives” or “data center pods” would rest on the seabed, powered by up to 50 tidal turbines across 27 acres. In Cook Inlet, the data center would be made up of 66 pods and more than 300 tidal turbines. Its footprint would span 1,650 acres—more than 1,000 football fields.
paras.zh: 在缅因州项目中，官方文件中所称的“海底计算蜂巢”或“数据中心吊舱”集群将位于海底，由占地 27 英亩的多达 50 个潮汐涡轮机提供动力。在库克湾，数据中心将由 66 个吊舱和 300 多个潮汐涡轮机组成。其占地面积达 1,650 英亩，相当于 1,000 多个足球场。

paras.en: The locations were chosen by DeepGreen Holdings LLC—a U.S.-based developer—because of their potential for tidal power, which works by harnessing the movement of water.
paras.zh: 美国开发商 DeepGreen Holdings LLC 选择这些地点是因为它们具有利用水的运动产生潮汐能的潜力。

paras.en: But each spot is also home to beleaguered groups of whales. A distinct population of around 300 critically endangered beluga whales lives in Cook Inlet. And the Gulf of Maine hosts feeding grounds for the North Atlantic right whale, a species whose numbers have dropped below 400 individuals.
paras.zh: 但每个地点也是陷入困境的鲸鱼群的家园。库克湾生活着约 300 头极度濒危白鲸的独特种群。缅因湾是北大西洋露脊鲸的觅食地，该物种的数量已降至 400 头以下。

paras.en: The primary concern over data centers underwater is the same as for those on land: they are exceedingly noisy. “Pumps, fans and especially turbine arrays make continuous low-frequency sound, and pile-driving during construction is louder still,” Misra says.
paras.zh: 水下数据中心的主要问题与陆地数据中心相同：它们的噪音非常大。 “泵、风扇，尤其是涡轮机阵列会发出连续的低频声音，施工期间打桩的声音更大，”米斯拉说。

paras.en: Shipping noise has doubled every decade since the 1960s, and there’s evidence to suggest that when the volume goes down, marine mammals are less stressed. One study found that when ship noise decreased immediately after 9/11, right whales in the Gulf of Maine had lower levels of stress hormones. As for the belugas in Cook Inlet, they are particularly sensitive to noise, Brewer says. Because of glacial runoff, the bay is very turbid. “It literally looks like chocolate milk,” she says, so the belugas there rely almost entirely on echolocation to feed, mate and move around.
paras.zh: 自 20 世纪 60 年代以来，航运噪音每十年就会增加一倍，有证据表明，当噪音降低时，海洋哺乳动物的压力就会减轻。一项研究发现，当 9/11 事件后船舶噪音立即减少时，缅因湾的露脊鲸的应激激素水平较低。布鲁尔说，至于库克湾的白鲸，它们对噪音特别敏感。由于冰川径流，海湾非常浑浊。 “它看起来就像巧克力牛奶，”她说，因此那里的白鲸几乎完全依靠回声定位来进食、交配和移动。

paras.en: The purpose for putting the data centers underwater—heat shedding—also threatens the whales. When a pattern of warming waters hit the Gulf of Maine in the early 2010s, right whales started to abandon their feeding grounds. “Ocean warming is a big, big deal to them,” says Philip Hamilton, a senior scientist at the New England Aquarium.
paras.zh: 将数据中心置于水下的目的——散热——也威胁到鲸鱼。 2010 年代初，当缅因湾出现一系列变暖的海水时，露脊鲸开始放弃它们的觅食地。 “海洋变暖对他们来说是一件非常非常大的事情，”新英格兰水族馆的高级科学家菲利普·汉密尔顿说。

paras.en: In Alaska, salmon are one of the main prey sources for belugas—and the fish need cold water to develop their eggs, keep their metabolism stable and prevent energy depletion during long migratory journeys. “All that hot energy, what’s that going to do to very delicate salmon populations that rely on cold water?” Brewer says.
paras.zh: 在阿拉斯加，鲑鱼是白鲸的主要猎物来源之一，这些鱼需要冷水来产卵、保持新陈代谢稳定并防止在长途迁徙过程中能量耗尽。 “所有这些热能，会对依赖冷水的非常脆弱的鲑鱼种群产生什么影响？”布鲁尔说。

paras.en: Community backlash has been fervent: The city of Eastport, Maine, issued a moratorium halting all permits and applications for all industrial data centers. The local Passamaquoddy tribe has also publicly expressed that it has no interest in any sort of collaboration with DeepGreen. Several groups have filed motions to intervene with the proposal for Cook Inlet.
