Testosterone deficiency synergistically exacerbates fructose-induced hepatic steatosis through gut microbiota and pyruvate in mice. American Journal of Physiology-Endocrinology and Metabolism, 2026; 330 (2): E233 DOI: 10.1152/ajpendo.00518.2025
paras.zh: - Hiroki Takahashi、Naoki Harada、Yohei Hayamizu、Erdenetsogt Dungubat、Masami Nakazawa、Tomoya Kitakaze、Keiichiro Sugimoto、Hiroshi Inui、Eiji Yoshihara、Yoshihisa Takahashi、Ryoichi Yamaji。睾酮缺乏通过小鼠肠道微生物群和丙酮酸协同加剧果糖诱导的肝脏脂肪变性。美国生理学-内分泌与代谢杂志，2026； 330 (2)：E233 DOI：10.1152/ajpendo.00518.2025

articles.title: The secret to slower aging may be hiding in your gut

paras.en: The secret to slower aging may be hiding in your gut
paras.zh: 延缓衰老的秘密可能就藏在你的肠道里

paras.en: - The secret to aging more slowly may be hiding in your gut. Scientists discovered that certain gut bacteria are strongly linked to how quickly the body ages, with microbial differences accounting for about 15% of the variation in biological aging rates. Some bacterial species were associated with slower aging, while others were linked to accelerated aging.
paras.zh: - 减缓衰老的秘密可能就藏在你的肠道里。科学家发现，某些肠道细菌与身体衰老速度密切相关，微生物差异约占生物衰老速度变化的 15%。一些细菌种类与较慢的衰老有关，而另一些则与加速衰老有关。

paras.en: Scientists have uncovered a surprising connection between the bacteria living in the human gut and the speed at which the body ages. Researchers at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa found that certain gut microbes are associated with slower biological aging, while others are linked to faster aging.
paras.zh: 科学家发现人类肠道中的细菌与身体衰老速度之间存在令人惊讶的联系。夏威夷大学马诺阿分校的研究人员发现，某些肠道微生物与较慢的生物衰老有关，而另一些则与较快的衰老有关。

paras.en: The study, published in Scientific Reports, found that differences in gut bacterial communities accounted for approximately 15% of the variation in participants' biological aging rates. The results suggest that the gut microbiome, the vast community of microorganisms living in the digestive system, may provide valuable clues about aging at the molecular level.
paras.zh: 这项发表在《科学报告》上的研究发现，肠道细菌群落的差异约占参与者生物衰老率变化的 15%。结果表明，肠道微生物组（生活在消化系统中的庞大微生物群落）可能在分子水平上提供有关衰老的宝贵线索。

paras.en: "This study advances our understanding of the relationship between the gut microbiome and biological aging," said senior author Alika K. Maunakea of the UH Mānoa John A. Burns School of Medicine. "We found that microbial patterns in the gut were significantly associated with molecular measures of aging, even independent of chronological age. These findings open important new directions for understanding how modifiable biological systems influence long-term health trajectories and longevity."
paras.zh: “这项研究增进了我们对肠道微生物组与生物衰老之间关系的理解，”夏威夷大学马诺阿约翰·A·伯恩斯医学院的资深作者 Alika K. Maunakea 说。 “我们发现肠道中的微生物模式与衰老的分子测量显着相关，甚至与实际年龄无关。这些发现为理解可修改的生物系统如何影响长期健康轨迹和寿命开辟了重要的新方向。”

paras.en: Scientists Identify Gut Bacteria Linked to Faster and Slower Aging
paras.zh: 科学家发现肠道细菌与衰老速度加快和减缓有关

paras.en: To investigate the relationship between gut bacteria and aging, researchers examined stool and blood samples collected from 123 adults across a wide range of ages. They identified the bacteria present in each participant's gut and compared those findings with blood-based molecular markers used to estimate the body's rate of aging.
paras.zh: 为了研究肠道细菌与衰老之间的关系，研究人员检查了从 123 名不同年龄段的成年人身上采集的粪便和血液样本。他们鉴定了每个参与者肠道中存在的细菌，并将这些发现与用于估计身体衰老速度的基于血液的分子标记进行比较。

paras.en: These biological measurements differ from chronological age, which simply reflects how many years someone has been alive. Instead, they are designed to assess how quickly aging-related changes are occurring within the body.
paras.zh: 这些生物学测量值与实际年龄不同，后者仅反映一个人已经活了多少年。相反，它们旨在评估体内与衰老相关的变化发生的速度。

paras.en: The researchers found a notable association between the composition of the gut microbiome and DunedinPACE, an advanced biomarker that measures the pace of biological aging.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现肠道微生物组的组成与 DunedinPACE 之间存在显着关联，DunedinPACE 是一种衡量生物衰老速度的先进生物标志物。

paras.en: Some bacterial species stood out for their particularly strong relationships with aging. Bifidobacterium adolescentis was among the microbes most strongly associated with slower biological aging. In contrast, Succinivibrio dextrinosolvens showed one of the strongest associations with faster aging.
paras.zh: 一些细菌种类因其与衰老的密切关系而引人注目。青春双歧杆菌是与减缓生物衰老最密切相关的微生物之一。相比之下，琥珀弧菌右旋糖酐显示出与更快衰老的最强关联之一。

paras.en: These differences suggest that particular patterns of gut bacteria may offer important information about how rapidly the body is aging.
paras.zh: 这些差异表明，肠道细菌的特定模式可能提供有关身体衰老速度的重要信息。

paras.en: How Diet, Lifestyle, and Environment May Influence Gut Health
paras.zh: 饮食、生活方式和环境如何影响肠道健康

paras.en: Lead author Braden P. Kunihiro said the discovery adds to growing evidence that the gut microbiome could play an important role in precision health research, which aims to better understand individual differences in health and disease.
paras.zh: 主要作者 Braden P. Kunihiro 表示，这一发现进一步证明肠道微生物组可以在精准健康研究中发挥重要作用，该研究旨在更好地了解健康和疾病方面的个体差异。

paras.en: Unlike chronological age, the composition of the gut microbiome can change in response to everyday influences, including diet, lifestyle, and environmental conditions. This makes it a particularly interesting area of investigation for scientists studying healthy aging.
paras.zh: 与实际年龄不同，肠道微生物组的组成可以根据日常影响而发生变化，包括饮食、生活方式和环境条件。这使得它成为研究健康衰老的科学家特别有趣的研究领域。

paras.en: "The gut microbiome is highly responsive to lifestyle, diet, environment and other everyday exposures," Kunihiro said. "Our findings suggest that the microbiome may reflect important aspects of biological resilience and aging in ways that could eventually help inform future wellness and healthy aging strategies."
paras.zh: “肠道微生物组对生活方式、饮食、环境和其他日常暴露高度敏感，”邦宏说。 “我们的研究结果表明，微生物组可能反映生物弹性和衰老的重要方面，最终有助于为未来的健康和健康衰老策略提供信息。”

paras.en: The research also included Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander participants, groups that have historically received limited representation in studies of aging and gut microorganisms.
paras.zh: 该研究还包括夏威夷原住民和太平洋岛民的参与者，这些群体历来在衰老和肠道微生物的研究中代表性有限。

paras.en: Co-author Ruben Juarez explained that including these populations could help scientists investigate how social circumstances and environmental conditions leave lasting biological effects over the course of a person's life.
paras.zh: 合著者鲁本·华雷斯（Ruben Juarez）解释说，将这些人群纳入其中可以帮助科学家研究社会环境和环境条件如何在人的一生中留下持久的生物影响。

paras.en: "The microbiome exists at the intersection of behavior, environment and human biology," Juarez said. "Studies like this help illuminate potential pathways through which lived experiences and social factors influence long-term health outcomes."
paras.zh: “微生物组存在于行为、环境和人类生物学的交叉点，”华雷斯说。 “这样的研究有助于阐明生活经历和社会因素影响长期健康结果的潜在途径。”

paras.en: Could Changing Gut Bacteria Influence How We Age?
paras.zh: 改变肠道细菌会影响我们的衰老吗？

paras.en: Although the findings reveal a meaningful relationship between gut bacteria and biological aging, researchers stress that the study does not establish cause and effect. In other words, finding certain microbes in people who age more slowly does not necessarily mean those bacteria are responsible for slowing the aging process.
paras.zh: 尽管研究结果揭示了肠道细菌与生物衰老之间存在有意义的关系，但研究人员强调，该研究并未确定因果关系。换句话说，在衰老较慢的人体内发现某些微生物并不一定意味着这些细菌能够减缓衰老过程。

paras.en: Further studies will be needed to determine whether deliberately changing the gut microbiome can influence biological aging or improve long-term health.
paras.zh: 需要进一步的研究来确定故意改变肠道微生物组是否可以影响生物衰老或改善长期健康。

paras.en: Still, the findings offer a promising starting point for exploring how the microorganisms living inside us relate to the aging process and whether they could eventually help guide more personalized approaches to healthy aging.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这些发现为探索我们体内的微生物如何与衰老过程相关以及它们是否最终有助于指导更个性化的健康衰老方法提供了一个有希望的起点。

paras.en: "This is an important early step toward understanding the gut microbiome's relationship with healthy aging," Maunakea said. "Future research will help clarify the mechanisms involved and whether these microbial signatures may eventually contribute to precision approaches for promoting long-term health and wellness."
paras.zh: “这是了解肠道微生物组与健康衰老关系的重要早期步骤，”莫纳凯亚说。 “未来的研究将有助于阐明所涉及的机制，以及这些微生物特征是否最终有助于促进长期健康的精确方法。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Hawaii at Manoa. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由夏威夷大学马诺阿分校提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Braden P. Kunihiro, Brennan Y. Yamamoto, Ruben Juarez, Alika K. Maunakea. Gut microbiome signatures associate with DNA methylation-based biological aging. Scientific Reports, 2026; 16 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41598-026-52974-x
paras.zh: - Braden P. Kunihiro、Brennan Y. Yamamoto、Ruben Juarez、Alika K. Maunakea。肠道微生物组特征与基于 DNA 甲基化的生物衰老相关。科学报告，2026； 16 (1) DOI：10.1038/s41598-026-52974-x

articles.title: 'Dungeon Crawler Carl' is getting a killer new comic book series
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: Matt Dinniman's "Dungeon Crawler Carl" is the hottest science fantasy novel series in the galaxy, and now it's getting a comic book adaptation.
paras.zh: 马特·丁尼曼的《地下城爬行者卡尔》是银河系最热门的科学奇幻小说系列，现在正在改编成漫画。

paras.en: "Dungeon Crawler Carl" follows the exploits of pantless Coast Guard vet Carl and his ex-girlfriend’s kitty, Princess Donut, as they compete in an intergalactic reality TV show to decide the fate of planet Earth. Carl and Princess Donut must endure a series of traps and challenges set forth by the neurotic, foot-fetishizing System AI.
paras.zh: 《地下城爬行者卡尔》讲述了没穿裤子的海岸警卫队兽医卡尔和他前女友的小猫甜甜圈公主的故事，他们在星际真人秀节目中竞争决定地球的命运。卡尔和甜甜圈公主必须忍受神经质、恋足癖系统人工智能设置的一系列陷阱和挑战。

paras.en: Dinniman exploded in popularity from a viral self-publishing novelty to a New York Times bestselling phenomenon whose eight books in the "Dungeon Crawler Carl" universe have sold 14 million copies worldwide. There is even an upcoming TV adaptation produced by "Family Guy's" Seth MacFarlane and "Thor: Ragnarok" screenwriter Christopher Yost coming to streaming service Peacock.
paras.zh: 丁尼曼从一种病毒式的自助出版新奇作品迅速流行起来，成为《纽约时报》的畅销书现象，其“地下城爬行者卡尔”宇宙中的八本书已在全球售出 1400 万册。甚至还有一部由《恶搞之家》的塞思·麦克法兰和《雷神 3：诸神黄昏》编剧克里斯托弗·约斯特制作的即将推出的电视改编作品即将在流媒体服务 Peacock 上播出。

paras.en: Now in a move that seems almost obligatory, "Dungeon Crawler Carl" is leaping into the world of comic books with a newly announced series courtesy of Montana-based Vault Comics. A special double-sized, 48-page debut issue will arrive in January of 2027, with subsequent monthly issues landing in stores and digitally.
paras.zh: 现在，“地下城爬行者卡尔”似乎几乎是必须采取的行动，通过蒙大拿州 Vault Comics 提供的新宣布的系列，进入漫画世界。特别双倍尺寸、48 页的首期特刊将于 2027 年 1 月上市，随后的月刊将登陆商店和数字版。

paras.en: "New Achievement! You like 'em floppy! You wanted Carl and Donut every month, you get Carl and Donut every month," states the synopsis. "Reward: An ongoing series with scaled up art! You know what's worse than breaking up with your girlfriend? Getting stuck on a sadistic alien game show with her cat!"
paras.zh: “新成就！你喜欢松软的东西！你每个月都想要卡尔和甜甜圈，你每个月都会得到卡尔和甜甜圈，”剧情简介说。 “奖励：一个正在进行的系列，其中有放大的艺术！你知道什么比和你的女朋友分手更糟糕吗？和她的猫一起参加虐待狂的外星游戏节目！”

paras.en: Vault's "Dungeon Crawler Carl" project will be an adaptation of the popular DCC webtoon series penned by Tevagah and Dinniman and illustrated by Laurel Pursuit Studios.
paras.zh: Vault 的“地下城爬行者卡尔”项目将改编自流行的 DCC 网络漫画系列，由 Tevagah 和 Dinniman 创作，Laurel Pursuit Studios 负责插画。

paras.en: Artist Kuzomari will aid in the transition from webtoon to comic book format. Main covers will be crafted by Nathan Gooden ("Barbaric') with variants provided by a roster of artists including Ryan Ottley ("Invincible"), Brett Bean, Frank Cho, Clayton Crain, Yoshi Yoshitani, Katie Cook, Riley Rossmo, Tyler Walpole, Doug Mahnke, Trish Forstner and Luciano Fleitas, who creates the novel covers.
paras.zh: 艺术家 Kuzomari 将帮助网络漫画向漫画书格式的转变。主要封面将由内森·古登（《野蛮人》）制作，而变体则由瑞安·奥特利（《无敌》）、布雷特·比恩、弗兰克·曹、克莱顿·克雷恩、吉谷耀西、凯蒂·库克、莱利·罗斯莫、泰勒·沃波尔、道格·马恩克、特里什·福斯特纳和创作小说封面的卢西亚诺·弗莱塔斯等艺术家提供。

paras.en: "Entering the comic space is nothing short of amazing," Dinniman stated in an official press release. "The fact that I get to work with some of the greatest creators and artists working today feels like a dream."
paras.zh: 丁尼曼在官方新闻稿中表示：“进入漫画领域真是令人惊叹。” “我能与当今一些最伟大的创作者和艺术家一起工作，这感觉就像一个梦想。”

paras.en: Serializing the first two episodes of the webtoon series, "Dungeon Crawler Carl #1" will be released by Vault Comics on Jan. 20, 2027.
paras.zh: 连载网络漫画前两集的《地下城爬行者卡尔 #1》将于 Vault Comics 于 2027 年 1 月 20 日发行。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: Cowboy Space unveils 'Big Iron' rocket to launch 20,000 AI data centers
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: PALO ALTO, Calif. — Cowboy Space just showed us how it plans to become a big player in the final frontier.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州帕洛阿尔托——Cowboy Space 刚刚向我们展示了它计划如何成为最后前沿的重要参与者。

paras.en: The California-based company, which is run by Robinhood co-founder Baiju Bhatt, intends to operate a constellation of 20,000 AI data centers in low Earth orbit (LEO). It will build those satellites in house and launch them on a homegrown rocket — a vehicle Cowboy Space unveiled here on Monday night (Oct. 26), at an event it called "Big Sky Rising."
paras.zh: 这家总部位于加利福尼亚州的公司由 Robinhood 联合创始人 Baiju Bhatt 运营，计划在近地轨道 (LEO) 运营由 20,000 个人工智能数据中心组成的星座。它将在内部建造这些卫星，并用国产火箭发射——周一晚上（10 月 26 日），在一场名为“Big Sky Rising”的活动中，牛仔太空公司推出了这辆火箭。

paras.en: "It's a fundamentally novel approach to rocketry in the modern era, in our opinion," Bhatt said during the event. "The idea is that you have a two-stage rocket where the upper stage of the rocket itself transforms into the satellite."
paras.zh: 巴特在活动期间表示：“我们认为，这是现代火箭技术的一种全新方法。” “这个想法是你有一个两级火箭，其中火箭的上级本身转变为卫星。”

paras.en: That rocket is called Big Iron, Bhatt told us on Monday night. And so is the data-center satellite, as both are considered to be part of the same system.
paras.zh: 巴特周一晚上告诉我们，那枚火箭叫做“大铁”。数据中心卫星也是如此，因为两者被认为是同一系统的一部分。

paras.en: The stainless-steel rocket will be 282 feet (86 meters) tall and 15.4 feet (4.7 m) wide. It will be powered by Cowboy Space's Clydesdale engines — nine in the first stage and one in the upper stage, the same configuration employed by SpaceX's workhorse Falcon 9 rocket. And, like the Raptor engines that power another SpaceX launcher, the giant Starship, Clydesdale will burn liquid oxygen and liquid methane, a combo known as methalox.
paras.zh: 不锈钢火箭高 282 英尺（86 米），宽 15.4 英尺（4.7 m）。它将由 Cowboy Space 的 Clydesdale 发动机提供动力——第一级有 9 个，上级有一个，与 SpaceX 的主力猎鹰 9 号火箭采用的配置相同。而且，就像为 SpaceX 的另一艘发射器（巨型星舰）提供动力的猛禽发动机一样，克莱兹代尔号将燃烧液氧和液态甲烷，这种组合被称为甲氧灵。

paras.en: Big Iron's first stage will be reusable; an animation Bhatt showed during "Big Sky Rising" showed the booster coming down for a landing on a ship at sea, as Falcon 9 first stages often do these days.
paras.zh: Big Iron 的第一级将可重复使用；巴特在《Big Sky Rising》中展示的动画显示助推器降落在海上的一艘船上，就像猎鹰 9 号第一级现在经常做的那样。

paras.en: The upper stage, meanwhile, will stay in orbit as a Big Iron satellite. The spacecraft will tip the scales here on Earth at about 33,000 pounds (15,000 kilograms), and, after unfurling its solar panels, it will be about 433 feet (132 m) long.
paras.zh: 与此同时，上级将作为一颗大铁卫星留在轨道上。该航天器将在地球上倾斜约 33,000 磅（15,000 公斤）的重量，展开太阳能电池板后，其长度约为 433 英尺（132 m）。

paras.en: The payload fairing that protected the satellite during launch will morph into a radiator, which will dump into space the prodigious heat generated by Big Iron's GPUs (general processing units). And there will be a lot of GPUs: Each satellite will carry five racks of them, Bhatt said, which will provide about 1 megawatt of compute payload.
paras.zh: 在发射过程中保护卫星的有效载荷整流罩将变成散热器，将 Big Iron 的 GPU（通用处理单元）产生的大量热量释放到太空中。而且将会有很多 GPU：Bhatt 说，每颗卫星将携带 5 个 GPU 机架，这将提供大约 1 兆瓦的计算有效负载。

paras.en: Big Iron will therefore be much larger than an "imperial-class satellite" — Bhatt's term for SpaceX's planned Starmind AI data center spacecraft, each of which will have a solar wingspan of 246 feet (75 m) and boast about 250 kW of compute payload.
paras.zh: 因此，Big Iron 将比“帝国级卫星”大得多——Bhatt 对 SpaceX 计划中的 Starmind AI 数据中心航天器的术语，每颗卫星的翼展将达到 246 英尺（75 m），并拥有约 250 kW 的计算有效载荷。

paras.en: Cowboy Space plans to operate about 20,000 Big Iron satellites in LEO, a constellation it calls Stampede. Each rocket will carry just one of these satellites to orbit, so it will take 20,000 launches to build Stampede — and, likely, several thousand more every year to maintain it at that number.
paras.zh: Cowboy Space 计划在 LEO（一个被称为 Stampede 的星座）运行约 20,000 颗 Big Iron 卫星。每枚火箭只会将其中一颗卫星送入轨道，因此建造 Stampede 需要进行 20,000 次发射，而且每年可能还要发射数千次才能将其维持在这个数字。

paras.en: Cowboy Space therefore intends to launch very often — multiple times per day, from launch complexes it calls Trailheads. The company has not yet announced where these complexes will be, but each one will likely feature four active launch mounts, Bhatt said on Monday night.
paras.zh: 因此，牛仔太空公司打算经常从其称为“Trailheads”的发射场进行发射——每天多次。巴特周一晚上表示，该公司尚未宣布这些综合体的位置，但每个综合体可能都会配备四个主动发射架。

paras.en: And not all of these launches will serve Stampede. Toward the end of "Big Sky Rising," Bhatt announced that Big Iron will also launch payloads for customers, a service that Cowboy Space calls Big Iron Express.
paras.zh: 并非所有这些发布都会为 Stampede 服务。在《Big Sky Rising》接近尾声时，巴特宣布 Big Iron 还将为客户发射有效载荷，这项服务被 Cowboy Space 称为 Big Iron Express。

paras.en: The first flights of this new rocket are a few years away. Cowboy Space — which was founded in 2024 as the power-beaming company Aetherflux — is still building and testing its Clydesdale engine and says it aims to launch Big Iron for the first time in December 2028.
paras.zh: 这枚新型火箭的首次飞行还有几年时间。 Cowboy Space 成立于 2024 年，当时名为动力发射公司 Aetherflux，目前仍在建造和测试其 Clydesdale 发动机，并表示其目标是在 2028 年 12 月首次发射 Big Iron。

paras.en: "Now, a lot of things have to go right for that to happen; it's not a guarantee," Bhatt said. "I think it's ambitious. But if it wasn't ambitious, I wouldn't be an entrepreneur."
paras.zh: “现在，很多事情都必须顺利进行才能实现；这并不是保证，”巴特说。 “我认为这是雄心勃勃的。但如果没有雄心勃勃，我就不会成为一名企业家。”

paras.en: Cowboy Space is operating one piece of space hardware at the moment, by the way — a satellite called Reason-1, which launched on SpaceX's Transporter-18 rideshare mission on Oct. 1.
paras.zh: 顺便说一下，Cowboy Space 目前正在运营一个太空硬件——一颗名为 Reason-1 的卫星，该卫星于 10 月 1 日在 SpaceX 的 Transporter-18 拼车任务中发射升空。

paras.en: "Its job is to prove out power beaming: using a high-power laser to transfer energy from low Earth orbit to a receiver on the ground," Cowboy Space said via X on Sept. 28. "If you want to build data centers in space, you have to master the optical systems between orbit and Earth. This is where that journey begins."
paras.zh: 9 月 28 日，Cowboy Space 通过 X 表示：“它的工作是验证功率发射：使用高功率激光器将能量从近地轨道传输到地面接收器。如果你想在太空建立数据中心，你必须掌握轨道和地球之间的光学系统。这就是旅程开始的地方。”

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: November full moon 2026: When, where and how to see the Beaver Moon
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: The November full moon reaches maximum illumination at 9:53 a.m. EST (1453 GMT) on Nov. 24, as the lunar disk sits opposite the sun in Earth's sky, appearing fully lit by its rays.
paras.zh: 11 月的满月在 11 月 24 日美国东部时间上午 9:53（格林尼治标准时间 1453）达到最大亮度，此时月盘位于地球天空中太阳的对面，看起来完全被太阳光线照亮。

paras.en: November's full moon is traditionally known as the "Beaver Moon", because it rises around the time when the small mammals take refuge in their dens, having stored enough food to survive the long winter months, according to the Old Farmer's Almanac.
paras.zh: 根据《老农年鉴》，十一月的满月传统上被称为“海狸月”，因为它的升起时间恰逢小型哺乳动物在它们的巢穴中避难，它们储存了足够的食物来度过漫长的冬季。

paras.en: The Nov. 24 full moon also happens to be the first of three consecutive "supermoons". The non-scientific term is often bestowed on full moons that occur when the natural satellite is within 90% of perigee, when the moon is closest to Earth in its elliptical orbit. The proximity can make a supermoon appear 14% larger and 30% brighter than the smallest full moon of the year, according to NASA.
paras.zh: 11 月 24 日的满月也恰好是连续三个“超级月亮”中的第一个。这个非科学术语通常指的是当天然卫星位于近地点 90% 以内时发生的满月，此时月球在其椭圆轨道上距离地球最近。据美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 称，与一年中最小的满月相比，超级月亮看起来比一年中最小的满月大 14%、亮 30%。

paras.en: The November full moon will be below the horizon for stargazers in the U.S. when it turns full at 9:53 a.m. EST on Nov. 24. Instead, viewers in America will get their best view of the near-full Beaver Moon as it arcs towards the western horizon in the predawn hours of Nov. 23.
paras.zh: 美国东部时间 11 月 24 日上午 9 点 53 分，11 月满月将位于美国观星者的地平线以下。相反，美国观众将在 11 月 23 日黎明前以弧线朝向西方地平线时，以最佳视角观赏近乎满月的海狸月。

paras.en: You may notice the lunar disk take on a gorgeous yellow-orange hue in the hour before moonset, as the bluer wavelengths of its light are scattered by Earth's dense atmosphere through a process known as Rayleigh scattering — the same phenomenon that turns the sky red at sunset.
paras.zh: 您可能会注意到，月盘在月落前一小时呈现出绚丽的黄橙色色调，因为其光的蓝色波长通过地球稠密的大气层通过称为瑞利散射的过程而散射，这种现象与日落时天空变红的现象相同。

paras.en: November's supermoon may appear even larger as it travels close to the horizon thanks to a phenomenon known as the "Moon Illusion", which tricks us into thinking that the lunar disk is larger than it actually is while closer to foreground objects, compared to when it shines overhead. The moon will also appear fully lit to the casual observer on the evenings of Nov. 23 and Nov. 24, so there's no need to miss out if you struggle with early mornings!
paras.zh: 由于一种被称为“月亮错觉”的现象，十一月的超级月亮在接近地平线时可能会显得更大，这种现象让我们误以为月盘在靠近前景物体时比实际的要大，而与它在头顶闪耀时相比。 11 月 23 日和 11 月 24 日晚上，对于不经意的观察者来说，月亮也会显得完全明亮，所以如果你在清晨挣扎，没有必要错过！

paras.en: The table below details local full moon timings for when the moon is 100% illuminated for a selection of cities spread across the globe (local moonset and moonrise times will vary based on your location):
paras.zh: 下表详细介绍了全球部分城市月亮 100% 照亮时的当地满月时间（当地月落和月出时间将根据您所在的位置而有所不同）：

paras.en: Local full moon timings for November 2026
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月当地满月时间

paras.en: The November full moon is often called the Beaver Moon because it rises around the time that beavers retreat to their lodges after collecting enough food to see them through the winter.
paras.zh: 十一月的满月通常被称为“海狸月”，因为它在海狸收集足够的食物过冬后撤回小屋的时间升起。

paras.en: This is a fantastic go-to telescope with a 4-inch aperture that can help you quickly find a steady view of the moon. For a closer look at craters and the terminator, make sure to grab a 9mm or 12mm eyepiece and get stronger magnification.
paras.zh: 这是一款出色的首选望远镜，孔径为 4 英寸，可帮助您快速稳定地观测月球。要仔细观察陨石坑和明暗界线，请务必使用 9 毫米或 12 毫米目镜并获得更强的放大倍率。

paras.en: It is also known as the Frost Moon by the indigenous Cree people of Canada and the northwestern U.S., and as the Digging Moon by the Tlingit, in reference to the animals that scratch around for fallen nuts in the hardening autumn earth, per the Old Farmer's Almanac.
paras.zh: 根据《老农年鉴》，加拿大和美国西北部的土著克里人也将它称为“霜月”，特林吉特人也将其称为“挖掘月”，指的是在硬化的秋季大地中寻找落下坚果的动物。

paras.en: The rising of the November full moon also marks the Hindu festival of Dev Diwali when worshippers light earthen lamps called "diyas" and offer prayers to celebrate Lord Shiva's defeat of the demon Tripurasura, after which the Hindu gods descended to Earth to celebrate, according to the Edinburgh Hindu Mandir & Cultural Centre.
paras.zh: 据爱丁堡印度教寺庙和文化中心介绍，十一月满月的升起也标志着印度教的排灯节，信徒们会点燃被称为“diyas”的土灯并祈祷，庆祝湿婆神击败恶魔特里普拉苏拉，之后印度教诸神降临地球进行庆祝。

paras.en: Nov. 24 and the rising of the full moon also coincides with the Sikh celebration of Guru Nanak Gurpurab, when millions celebrate the birthday of Guru Nanak, the founder of Sikhism, according to the BBC.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司报道，11 月 24 日满月的升起也恰逢锡克教徒庆祝古鲁纳纳克古尔普拉布 (Guru Nanak Gurpurab) 的日子，数百万人庆祝锡克教创始人古鲁纳纳克 (Guru Nanak) 的生日。

paras.en: What else to see in the sky around the full moon
paras.zh: 满月周围的天空中还能看到什么

paras.en: Stargazers in the U.S. will be treated to a magnificent natural light show in the predawn hours of Nov. 24, when the near-full moon shines low on the western horizon less than 5 degrees from the bright stars of the Pleiades open star cluster.
paras.zh: 11 月 24 日黎明前，美国的观星者将欣赏到一场壮丽的自然光秀，届时，接近满月的月亮将在西方地平线低处闪耀，距离昴宿星团的明亮恒星不到 5 度。

paras.en: The Pleiades and moon will be close enough to share the field of view of a pair of 10X50 binoculars, which will help reveal gorgeous detail on the lunar surface, while helping to resolve dozens more of the clusters blue-white stars as they cut through the deluge of moonlight.
paras.zh: 昴宿星团和月球将足够接近，可以共享一副 10X50 双筒望远镜的视野，这将有助于揭示月球表面华丽的细节，同时有助于分辨出数十个穿过月光的蓝白色星团。

paras.en: Tear your gaze away from the moon and find a trio of spectacular multi-colored lights forming a tight triangle high in the southern sky. The red light of Mars will shine steadily above the twinkling star Regulus at the heart of the constellation Leo, with the yellow-white light of Jupiter to their right.
paras.zh: 将目光从月亮上移开，你会发现三道壮观的彩色光芒在南边的天空中形成了一个紧密的三角形。火星的红光将稳定地闪耀在位于狮子座中心的闪烁恒星轩辕十四之上，木星的黄白色光在其右侧。

paras.en: Venus will also be visible as a dazzling "Morning Star" hanging low on the eastern horizon, with Mercury below, tracing out the path of the approaching sun.
paras.zh: 金星也将作为一颗耀眼的“晨星”低悬在东方地平线上，水星在下方，描绘着即将到来的太阳的路径。

paras.en: Saturn, meanwhile, will make for a satisfyingly easy and visually spectacular target in the post sunset hours of Nov. 24, as it shines in the southeastern sky in the constellation Pisces, whose stars will be a challenge to spot in the light of the newly waning moon.
paras.zh: 与此同时，土星将在 11 月 24 日日落后的时间里成为一个令人满意的、视觉上壮观的目标，因为它在双鱼座的东南天空中闪耀，在新亏月的光线下发现双鱼座的星星将是一个挑战。

paras.en: The November full moon presents a stunning opportunity to photograph the entirety of the Earth-facing lunar disk as its disk appears temporarily free from shadow. Be sure to make use of our expert guide to photographing the moon, along with our picks of the best cameras and lenses for astrophotography, if you want to upgrade your equipment.
paras.zh: 十一月的满月提供了拍摄整个面向地球的月盘的绝佳机会，因为它的圆盘暂时没有阴影。如果您想升级您的设备，请务必使用我们的月球拍摄专家指南，以及我们精选的最佳天文摄影相机和镜头。

paras.en: - Use a tripod to keep your camera as steady as possible.
paras.zh: - 使用三脚架尽可能保持相机稳定。

paras.en: - Use a remote shutter/timer to prevent camera wobble.
paras.zh: - 使用远程快门/定时器来防止相机晃动。

paras.en: - A smartphone stargazing app can help you find the exact point of moonrise on your local horizon.
paras.zh: - 智能手机观星应用程序可以帮助您找到当地地平线上月出的准确点。

paras.en: - A lens with a focal length of 12-50 mm is useful for landscape photography, while a focal length of at least 400 mm is advised for capturing more detailed views of the lunar surface.
paras.zh: - 焦距为 12-50 毫米的镜头适用于风景摄影，而建议焦距至少为 400 毫米以捕捉月球表面的更详细视图。

paras.en: - The moon can be made to appear particularly large while close to the horizon next to foreground objects, where it may take on an orange-yellow appearance thanks to Rayleigh scattering. A cleaner, more "classic" view can be captured as it soars high overhead.
paras.zh: - 可以使月亮在靠近前景物体旁边的地平线时显得特别大，由于瑞利散射，月亮可能呈现橙黄色外观。当它在头顶高空翱翔时，可以捕捉到更干净、更“经典”的景色。

paras.en: These times mark the exact instant of full illumination. Your own moonrise or moonset may be hours earlier or later, depending on your location. For the best viewing plan, use an app such as Stellarium or SkySafari 7 Pro to find your local moonrise time and be sure to read our full moon calendar for comprehensive timings for each full moon in 2026.
paras.zh: 这些时间标志着完全照明的确切时刻。您自己的月出或月落可能会提前或晚几个小时，具体取决于您所在的位置。为了获得最佳观看计划，请使用 Stellarium 或 SkySafari 7 Pro 等应用程序查找您当地的月出时间，并务必阅读我们的满月日历，了解 2026 年每个满月的全面时间。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you would like to share your full moon photos with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s) along with your name, the location and any comments on what it was like to capture the picture to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享您的满月照片，请将您的照片连同您的姓名、地点以及对拍摄照片的感受的任何评论发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: Global Satcom Services Revenues to Reach $145 Billion by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | October 2026 – Global satellite services revenues are forecast to grow 44% to reach $145 billion by 2035, according to the 33rd edition of Novaspace’s Satellite Connectivity and Video Market report. The next decade will mark a fundamental shift in the industry as data services become the dominant growth engine, driving revenues to nearly $100 billion by 2035.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 10 月——根据 Novaspace 第 33 版卫星连接和视频市场报告，全球卫星服务收入预计将增长 44%，到 2035 年达到 1,450 亿美元。随着数据服务成为主要的增长引擎，到 2035 年收入将接近 1000 亿美元，未来十年将标志着该行业的根本性转变。

paras.en: Data services are expected to increase their share of total satellite services revenues from 26% to 68% over the decade, as demand for connectivity accelerates across consumer, defense, government, and enterprise markets.
paras.zh: 随着消费者、国防、政府和企业市场对连接的需求加速增长，数据服务在卫星服务总收入中的份额预计将在十年内从 26% 增加到 68%。

paras.en: While video remains the industry’s largest revenue segment today, future growth will be driven by connectivity. Consumer Broadband, Milsatcom, and Enterprise Networks are forecast to lead market expansion, adding $22.6 billion, $19.2 billion, and $17.2 billion in revenues, respectively, over the next decade.
paras.zh: 虽然视频仍然是当今行业最大的收入领域，但未来的增长将由连接性推动。消费者宽带、军事卫星通信和企业网络预计将引领市场扩张，在未来十年内分别增加 226 亿美元、192 亿美元和 172 亿美元的收入。

paras.en: Milsatcom is emerging as a particularly important growth engine, fueled by rising defense spending and broader adoption of satcom-enabled operational concepts across military forces. At the same time, NGSO constellations are becoming an increasingly important source of resilient capacity for government and defense users.
paras.zh: 在国防支出不断增加以及军队更广泛采用卫星通信作战概念的推动下，军事卫星通信正在成为一个特别重要的增长引擎。与此同时，NGSO 星座正成为政府和国防用户日益重要的弹性能力来源。

paras.en: “Satellite connectivity is moving firmly into the mainstream,” said Dimitri Buchs, Project Manager and Editor of the report. “The rapid expansion of NGSO capacity, declining bandwidth costs, and growing demand for resilient, always-available connectivity are fundamentally changing where and how satellite communications compete.”
paras.zh: “卫星连接正在坚定地成为主流，”项目经理兼报告编辑 Dimitri Buchs 说。 “NGSO 容量的快速扩张、带宽成本的下降以及对弹性、始终可用连接的需求不断增长，正在从根本上改变卫星通信的竞争地点和方式。”

paras.en: The satellite capacity market is forecast to exceed $46 billion by 2035, more than tripling from 2025 levels. Video Distribution, the largest capacity segment in 2025, is expected to account for just 3% of capacity revenues by 2035. Consumer Broadband and Milsatcom, meanwhile, are projected to represent more than half of total capacity revenues.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，卫星容量市场将超过 460 亿美元，比 2025 年的水平增加两倍多。视频分发是 2025 年最大的容量部分，预计到 2035 年将仅占容量收入的 3%。与此同时，消费者宽带和军事卫星通信预计将占总容量收入的一半以上。

paras.en: Declining bandwidth costs, driven by HTS systems and a growing number of NGSO projects, are accelerating satellite connectivity’s expansion into mass-market applications. Providers such as Starlink are increasingly competing with terrestrial broadband on price, strengthening satellite broadband’s position as a viable alternative to fiber and wireless connectivity in a growing range of markets.
paras.zh: 在 HTS 系统和越来越多的 NGSO 项目的推动下，带宽成本不断下降，正在加速卫星连接向大众市场应用的扩展。 Starlink 等提供商在价格上与地面宽带的竞争日益激烈，从而巩固了卫星宽带在越来越多的市场中作为光纤和无线连接的可行替代方案的地位。

paras.en: The transformation is also reshaping the role of GEO operators. Following a low of six commercial GEO orders in 2024, the market rebounded to 10 orders in 2025, with another 14 recorded by mid-September 2026. The renewed activity reflects evolving multi-orbit strategies and continued demand for GEO capabilities alongside rapidly expanding NGSO systems.
paras.zh: 这一转变也正在重塑 GEO 运营商的角色。继 2024 年 6 个商业 GEO 订单的低点之后，市场在 2025 年反弹至 10 个订单，到 2026 年 9 月中旬又记录了 14 个订单。新的活动反映了不断发展的多轨道战略以及对 GEO 能力的持续需求以及快速扩展的 NGSO 系统。

paras.en: “This is not a return to the traditional GEO model,” Buchs added. “Software-defined satellites, more flexible commercial models, sovereign requirements, and growing multi-orbit strategies are redefining GEO’s role. The future of satellite communications will not be GEO or NGSO—it will increasingly be an ecosystem in which each architecture serves distinct and complementary requirements.”
paras.zh: “这并不是对传统 GEO 模式的回归，”布克斯补充道。 “软件定义的卫星、更灵活的商业模式、主权要求和不断增长的多轨道战略正在重新定义 GEO 的角色。卫星通信的未来将不再是 GEO 或 NGSO，而是越来越成为一个生态系统，其中每种架构都满足不同且互补的需求。”

paras.en: The 33rd edition of Satellite Connectivity and Video Market provides a comprehensive assessment of global satellite service revenues, capacity demand, pricing trends, competitive dynamics, and operator strategies across video, broadband, enterprise, mobility, government, and defense markets through 2035.
paras.zh: 第 33 版《卫星连接和视频市场》对 2035 年之前的视频、宽带、企业、移动、政府和国防市场的全球卫星服务收入、容量需求、定价趋势、竞争动态以及运营商战略进行了全面评估。

paras.en: This edition introduces a granular bottom-up model for Enterprise Networks Back-up terminals, providing greater visibility into market demand and deployment trends. It also features a revised commercial Milsatcom model with deeper analysis by region, frequency band, and infrastructure type.
paras.zh: 该版本引入了企业网络备份终端的细粒度自下而上模型，提供了对市场需求和部署趋势的更深入的了解。它还具有修订后的商业军事卫星通信模型，可按地区、频段和基础设施类型进行更深入的分析。

paras.en: The report also provides an updated assessment of major developments shaping the satellite communications market, including the evolution of NGSO constellations, emerging Q/V frequency bands and other regulatory developments, government and defense spending trends, and the changing competitive dynamics between satellite and terrestrial connectivity.
paras.zh: 该报告还对塑造卫星通信市场的主要发展进行了最新评估，包括NGSO星座的演变、新兴的Q/V频段和其他监管发展、政府和国防支出趋势，以及卫星和地面连接之间不断变化的竞争动态。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

paras.zh: 媒体查询：奥利维亚·卡尼尔 (Olivia Garnier) |通讯主管 | olivia.garnier@nova.space

articles.title: TechnoMile Recognized as a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Award Winner
articles.author: TechnoMile

paras.en: TechnoMile, the leading AI solution that unifies growth, contracts, compliance, and security workflows, has been named a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards winner, recognizing the company among the leading B2B partners supporting entrepreneurs and businesses across the country.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 是统一增长、合同、合规性和安全工作流程的领先 AI 解决方案，被评为 2026 年 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖得主，认可该公司是支持全国企业家和企业的领先 B2B 合作伙伴之一。

paras.en: The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards honor B2B companies that have demonstrated a track record of helping entrepreneurs and businesses navigate the challenges of building and growing a company. From hiring and compliance to technology, infrastructure, fundraising, marketing, and more, these partners provide expertise and services that enable businesses to operate, scale, and pursue their ambitions.
paras.zh: 一年一度的 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖旨在表彰那些在帮助企业家和企业应对创建和发展公司的挑战方面取得良好记录的 B2B 公司。从招聘和合规到技术、基础设施、筹款、营销等，这些合作伙伴提供专业知识和服务，使企业能够运营、扩大规模并实现其抱负。

paras.en: “Business owners have no shortage of tools at their disposal, and B2B companies need to make clear why their products and services are worth the investment,” says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. “The companies on this year’s Power Partners list have done just that. They don’t just have customers – they have superfans and evangelists. Across industries like marketing, financial services, and technology, they’ve proved their dedication to helping fellow business owners grow and succeed.”
paras.zh: Inc 编辑总监邦尼·戈什 (Bonny Ghosh) 表示：“企业主并不缺乏可用的工具，B2B 公司需要明确为什么他们的产品和服务值得投资。今年 Power Partners 名单上的公司已经做到了这一点。他们不仅拥有客户，还拥有超级粉丝和传播者。在营销、金融服务和技术等行业，他们已经证明了自己致力于帮助其他企业主成长和成功。”

paras.en: TechnoMile was recognized for its investment in their clients’ long-term success, solving the persistent challenges that growing government contractors face – identifying the right opportunities among thousands of federal solicitations, managing pipelines through manual processes, lacking visibility to forecast and make confident pursuit decisions, and meeting stringent compliance and security requirements once contracts are won.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 因其对客户长期成功的投资而获得认可，解决了不断增长的政府承包商面临的持续挑战——在数千个联邦招标中识别合适的机会，通过手动流程管理管道，缺乏预测和做出自信的追求决策的可见性，以及赢得合同后满足严格的合规性和安全要求。

paras.en: TechnoMile’s unified platform connects growth, contracts, and security workflows, delivering GovCon, Defense, and Public Sector organizations greater visibility, stronger compliance, lower risk, and more efficient operations. By combining purpose-built technology, trusted AI, and deep government contracting experience, TechnoMile helps organizations compete for, win, and successfully execute mission-critical government work.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 的统一平台连接增长、合同和安全工作流程，为 GovCon、国防和公共部门组织提供更高的可视性、更强的合规性、更低的风险和更高效的运营。通过将专用技术、可信人工智能和深厚的政府签约经验相结合，TechnoMile 帮助组织竞争、获胜并成功执行关键任务的政府工作。

paras.en: “TechnoMile solves a real problem for the contracting market – providing a unified way to manage the full lifecycle of federal business,” said Ashish Khot, CEO of TechnoMile. “This award is a special honor because it is largely based on the feedback and experience of our customers and shows that we are living up to our promise to be a partner for business growth, helping companies better manage the work behind winning and delivering federal business.”
paras.zh: “TechnoMile 解决了承包市场的一个真正问题——提供统一的方式来管理联邦业务的整个生命周期，”TechnoMile 首席执行官 Ashish Khot 表示。 “这个奖项是一项特殊的荣誉，因为它主要基于我们客户的反馈和经验，表明我们正在履行我们的承诺，成为业务增长的合作伙伴，帮助公司更好地管理赢得和交付联邦业务背后的工作。”

paras.en: For more information on Inc.’s Power Partner Awards or to view the complete list of honorees, visit https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards.
paras.zh: 有关 Inc. 电力合作伙伴奖的更多信息或查看获奖者的完整列表，请访问 https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards。

paras.en: Inc. is the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future. Through its journalism, Inc. aims to inform, educate, and elevate the profile of its community: the risk-takers, the innovators, and the ultra-driven go-getters who are creating the future of business. Inc. is published by Mansueto Ventures, along with fellow leading business publication Fast Company. For more information, visit www.inc.com.
