paras.en: The wider public backlash to the ad was so intense that Apple soon apologised and withdrew it from television.
paras.zh: 公众对这则广告的强烈反对非常强烈，以至于苹果公司很快就道歉并从电视上撤下了这则广告。

paras.en: But the PR damage was done. The metaphor was too obvious. And there's been no sign, in the two years since, that Silicon Valley's chief executives really understood why people hated that ad so much.
paras.zh: 但公关损失已经造成。这个比喻太明显了。此后的两年里，没有任何迹象表明硅谷的首席执行官们真正理解为什么人们如此讨厌这则广告。

paras.en: And now AI technology is coursing so quickly through society that nothing feels immune from its impact, whether good or bad.
paras.zh: 现在，人工智能技术在社会中的传播速度如此之快，以至于没有什么能免受其影响，无论是好还是坏。

paras.en: For example, this may seem unimportant in the scheme of things, but it's indicative of a larger societal issue. The Reserve Bank recently published a transcript on its website of governor Michele Bullock's "fireside chat" from September 22.
paras.zh: 例如，这在事情的计划中似乎并不重要，但它表明了一个更大的社会问题。储备银行最近在其网站上公布了行长米歇尔·布洛克 (Michele Bullock) 9 月 22 日的“炉边谈话”记录。

paras.en: The transcript used the American spelling for labour on seven occasions (i.e. it used "labor" instead of "labour"), so it had Ms Bullock saying this:
paras.zh: 这份笔录七次使用了美式劳工拼写（即使用“劳工”而不是“劳工”），因此布洛克女士是这样说的：

paras.en: "What happens is that we combine labor and capital in a way that allows more output for the same amount of labor and capital, and that's what allows profits to rise, it allows real wages to rise, and improves living standards, and that's what we've observed over the long sweep of time."
paras.zh: “所发生的情况是，我们将劳动力和资本结合起来，使相同数量的劳动力和资本能够获得更多产出，这就是利润上升的原因，它使实际工资上升，并提高生活水平，这就是我们长期以来观察到的情况。”

paras.en: And it used the Australian spelling for "labour" on seven other occasions, in the same transcript, with Ms Bullock saying this:
paras.zh: 在同一份文字记录中，它在其他七个场合使用了澳大利亚的“劳工”拼写，布洛克女士是这样说的：

paras.en: "Productivity, it's a really important concept, which means we use our resources, labour and capital resources, in more efficient ways that allow more output for the same amount of inputs."
paras.zh: “生产力，这是一个非常重要的概念，这意味着我们以更有效的方式使用我们的资源、劳动力和资本资源，从而以相同的投入获得更多的产出。”

paras.en: The RBA has long taken pride in its correct use of grammar and spelling in its written communications. It's always talking about the importance of its "credibility" as an institution. To see it publish such a sloppy transcript on its website was jarring.
paras.zh: 长期以来，澳大利亚央行一直以其在书面沟通中正确使用语法和拼写而感到自豪。它总是在谈论其作为一个机构的“信誉”的重要性。看到它在其网站上发布如此草率的文字记录令人震惊。

paras.en: If these types of "AI issues" are even affecting the RBA, what's it doing to other institutions?
paras.zh: 如果这些类型的“人工智能问题”甚至影响到了澳大利亚央行，那么它会对其他机构产生什么影响呢？

paras.en: Now, consider some bigger and more important examples.
paras.zh: 现在，考虑一些更大、更重要的例子。

paras.en: We're currently reading stories every week about AI agents "going rogue" and hacking into government systems, bank accounts, and whatever else.
paras.zh: 目前，我们每周都会阅读有关人工智能代理“失控”并侵入政府系统、银行账户和其他任何内容的故事。

paras.en: If private citizens were caught doing that, they would end up in prison. But since it's AI agents, it's often framed as though they're "escaping from a lab" and misbehaving like naughty children, with the assumption being that it's just a quirk of the technology that will be fixed over time.
paras.zh: 如果普通公民这样做被发现，他们最终会入狱。但由于它是人工智能代理，因此经常被认为是“逃离实验室”并且像顽皮的孩子一样行为不端，并假设这只是技术的一个怪癖，随着时间的推移会得到修复。

paras.en: Meanwhile, we're all hoping that we won't wake up one morning to find our personal data stolen and bank accounts drained.
paras.zh: 与此同时，我们都希望自己不会有一天早上醒来发现我们的个人数据被盗，银行账户被耗尽。

paras.en: This strange atmosphere of unaccountability for AI agents, mixed with apathy from our leaders, where there's little information being shared by authorities about what's actually going on and what can be done about it, is creating a huge amount of anxiety for people.
paras.zh: 这种对人工智能代理不负责任的奇怪气氛，加上我们领导人的冷漠，当局几乎没有分享关于实际发生的事情以及可以采取的措施，这给人们带来了巨大的焦虑。

paras.en: Why are policymakers hardly acknowledging the anxiety?
paras.zh: 为什么政策制定者几乎不承认这种焦虑？

paras.en: Perhaps it's because governments see the AI investment and data centre boom as an economic lifeline out of our historic productivity slump.
paras.zh: 也许是因为政府将人工智能投资和数据中心的繁荣视为摆脱历史性生产力下滑的经济生命线。

paras.en: In a speech last week, Treasurer Jim Chalmers said massive investments in the AI boom were ramping up competition for capital globally.
paras.zh: 财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 在上周的一次演讲中表示，人工智能热潮中的大规模投资正在加剧全球资本的竞争。

paras.en: "Capital expenditure by the five largest hyperscalers in 2023 was $230 billion. It's now forecast to quadruple to over $1.1 trillion," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“到 2023 年，五家最大的超大规模企业的资本支出为 2300 亿美元。现在预计将翻两番，达到超过 1.1 万亿美元。”

paras.en: "To finance this, corporate bond issuances by hyperscalers have exploded. Annual issuance averaged around US$40 billion five years ago, but is now projected to average around US$400 billion ($570 billion) in the next few years."
paras.zh: “为了筹集资金，超大规模企业的公司债券发行量呈爆炸式增长。五年前，年发行量平均约为 400 亿美元，但现在预计未来几年平均发行量约为 4000 亿美元（5700 亿美元）。”

paras.en: He said Australia was a "digital hub" in the Indo-Pacific with the land, energy, skills and capital to make the most of the AI investment boom.
paras.zh: 他表示，澳大利亚是印太地区的“数字中心”，拥有土地、能源、技能和资本，可以充分利用人工智能投资热潮。

paras.en: "As one of the world's top 10 markets for data centre capacity, we have over $150 billion of AI infrastructure scheduled for the next five years, around 5 per cent of current GDP," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“作为全球十大数据中心容量市场之一，我们计划在未来五年建设超过 1500 亿美元的人工智能基础设施，约占当前 GDP 的 5%。”

paras.en: Ms Bullock has acknowledged that people see AI as the "great white hope" to improve productivity.
paras.zh: 布洛克女士承认，人们将人工智能视为提高生产力的“伟大的白人希望”。

paras.en: When the ABC spoke to the American journalist Gil Durán recently, he said data centre protests in the US had become a focal point for regular people to come together as a community to fight billionaire power.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司最近采访美国记者吉尔·杜兰时，他表示，美国的数据中心抗议活动已成为普通民众团结起来对抗亿万富翁权力的焦点。

paras.en: "The data centres are viewed, I think, as a physical manifestation of billionaire power on the land that's become this bogeyman, this monster, this alien invasion that arrives in your community to suck up your water and pollute your air and eat up your land, all for the promise that it will fuel a technology that will kill your job and possibly wipe humanity off the face of the planet.
paras.zh: “我认为，数据中心被视为亿万富翁权力在这片土地上的物理表现，它已经成为这个妖怪、这个怪物、这个外星人入侵，它到达你的社区，吸走你的水，污染你的空气，吃掉你的土地，所有这一切都是为了承诺它将推动一项技术的发展，这种技术会杀死你的工作，并可能将人类从地球上抹去。

paras.en: But there's another element to the global AI pushback that's getting less attention.
paras.zh: 但全球人工智能的抵制还有另一个因素受到的关注较少。

paras.en: Lots of people also despise how AI is radically cheapening our artistic and cultural output, and burning through fossil fuels to do so.
paras.zh: 许多人还鄙视人工智能如何从根本上降低我们的艺术和文化产出的价格，并为此燃烧化石燃料。

paras.en: Will our children be able to make a living in the future as artists, musicians, and writers, or are those opportunities disappearing with every new data centre that's being built?
paras.zh: 我们的孩子将来能否以艺术家、音乐家和作家的身份谋生，或者这些机会是否会随着每一个新数据中心的建设而消失？

paras.en: Where will we find joy in a future where AI has comprehensively debased the arts?
paras.zh: 当人工智能全面贬低艺术的未来，我们到哪里去寻找快乐呢？

paras.en: The concerns are genuine. Perhaps our leaders will give them more attention one day.
paras.zh: 这些担忧是真实的。也许有一天我们的领导人会给予他们更多的关注。

articles.title: IN PHOTOS | Rise and fall of Hunter's Moon

paras.en: IN PHOTOS | Rise and fall of Hunter's Moon
paras.zh: 照片 |猎人之月的兴衰

paras.en: Next full moon, called a Beaver Moon, occurs on Nov. 24
paras.zh: 下一次满月称为海狸月，发生在 11 月 24 日

paras.en: October's full moon has been a delight for stargazers. Traditionally known as the Hunter’s Moon, its name recalls a time when people hunted, preserved food and prepped for the coming winter.
paras.zh: 十月的满月对于观星者来说是一大乐趣。它传统上被称为猎人之月，它的名字让人想起人们狩猎、保存食物并为即将到来的冬天做准备的时代。

paras.en: Check out some of the best images of this celestial event around the world.
paras.zh: 查看世界各地这一天体事件的一些最佳图像。

paras.en: The moon rises near the 17th of Ramadan Mosque in Baghdad's Firdos Square on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日，月亮在巴格达菲尔多斯广场斋月十七日清真寺附近升起。

paras.en: The full moon rises over the San Gabriel Mountains, as seen from the Baldwin Hills Scenic Overlook State Park in Culver City, Calif., on Monday.
paras.zh: 周一，从加利福尼亚州卡尔弗城鲍德温山风景区州立公园看到的满月从圣盖博山脉升起。

paras.en: The moon rises behind a statue on the top of a column at the Piazza Venezia landmark in Rome.
paras.zh: 月亮从罗马威尼斯广场地标柱顶的雕像后面升起。

paras.en: The full moon rises behind a cross on the Church of St. John the Baptist in Skopje, Macedonia.
paras.zh: 满月从马其顿斯科普里施洗者圣约翰教堂的十字架后面升起。

paras.en: The moon sets over the fountain at the R.C. Harris water treatment plant in Toronto on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 月亮落在 R.C. 的喷泉上。周二，多伦多哈里斯水处理厂。

paras.en: The moon sets behind the Kremlin in Moscow.
paras.zh: 月亮落在莫斯科克里姆林宫后面。

paras.en: The moon sets in Dana Point, Calif., about 100 kilometres south of Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 月亮落在距洛杉矶以南约 100 公里的加利福尼亚州达纳角。

paras.en: The next full moon, called the Beaver Moon, will occur on Nov. 24.
paras.zh: 下一次满月称为“海狸月”，将于 11 月 24 日发生。

articles.title: These midterm races will decide who controls U.S. Congress for the rest of Trump's presidency
articles.author: Mike Crawley

paras.en: These midterm races will decide who controls U.S. Congress for the rest of Trump's presidency
paras.zh: 这些中期选举将决定谁在特朗普剩余的总统任期内控制美国国会

paras.en: Democrats need net gains of 4 seats in Senate, 3 seats in House to flip power from Republicans
paras.zh: 民主党需要在参议院净获得 4 个席位、在众议院净获得 3 个席位才能从共和党手中夺回权力

paras.en: The most important elections in next Tuesday's U.S. midterms are in the handful of states and districts where polling suggests the Republicans and Democrats are locked in tight races.
paras.zh: 下周二美国中期选举中最重要的选举将在少数几个州和地区进行，民意调查显示共和党和民主党的竞争十分激烈。

paras.en: The Democratic Party needs a net gain of just three seats to take control of the 435-member House of Representatives, a target that polling analysis suggests is well within reach.
paras.zh: 民主党只需净增加三个席位即可控制拥有 435 名议员的众议院，民意调查分析表明这一目标完全可以实现。

paras.en: The far more difficult task for Democrats will be wresting control of the Senate from U.S. President Donald Trump's Republican Party.
paras.zh: 对于民主党来说，更为艰巨的任务将是从美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的共和党手中夺取参议院的控制权。

paras.en: To achieve a 51-49 Senate majority, Democrats need a net gain of four seats. That requires flipping at least two states Trump won by double digits in 2024, such as Ohio, Iowa, Alaska, Texas or Kansas.
paras.zh: 为了获得参议院 51 比 49 的多数席位，民主党需要净增加 4 个席位。这需要特朗普在 2024 年以两位数的优势赢得至少两个州，例如俄亥俄州、爱荷华州、阿拉斯加州、德克萨斯州或堪萨斯州。

paras.en: Here's a look at the pivotal races to watch in Tuesday's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 以下是周二中期选举中值得关注的关键竞选。

paras.en: U.S. Sen. Susan Collins, a Republican representing Maine, speaks with gun shop owner Rick LaChapelle at a campaign stop in Lewiston, Me. on Oct. 21. (Robert F. Bukaty/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 代表缅因州的共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯 (Susan Collins) 在缅因州刘易斯顿的竞选活动中与枪支店老板里克·拉切贝尔 (Rick LaChapelle) 进行了交谈。 10 月 21 日。（Robert F. Bukaty/美联社）

paras.en: - Candidates: (R) Sen. Susan Collins vs. (D) Troy Jackson
paras.zh: - 候选人：(R) 参议员苏珊·柯林斯 (Susan Collins) VS (D) 特洛伊·杰克逊 (Troy Jackson)

paras.en: Collins has held this seat for 30 years, even though Maine has not voted for a Republican presidential candidate since 1988.
paras.zh: 尽管缅因州自 1988 年以来就没有投票给共和党总统候选人，但柯林斯已担任该席位 30 年。

paras.en: Collins has kept winning elections by persuading enough Democrats that she gets results for Maine in Washington. Most recently, she took credit for Trump's moves to exempt certain Canadian products used by Maine businesses from the crushing 50 per cent tariffs he'd imposed in late August.
paras.zh: 柯林斯通过说服足够多的民主党人相信她在华盛顿获得了缅因州的选举结果，从而不断赢得选举。最近，她对特朗普8月下旬对缅因州企业使用的某些加拿大产品免除50%关税的举措表示赞赏。

paras.en: The question is whether Maine voters will punish Collins for being a Republican this time or reward her for the occasions when she stood up to Trump.
paras.zh: 问题是，缅因州选民是否会因为柯林斯这次是共和党人而惩罚她，还是会因为她勇敢地面对特朗普而奖励她。

paras.en: Her Democratic Party opponent is a former logger turned politician from a small town in northern Maine. Jackson entered the race only in July after the original nominee, Graham Platner, stepped down amid allegations he had sexually assaulted a former partner.
paras.zh: 她的民主党对手是一位来自缅因州北部小镇的前伐木工，后来成为政治家。杰克逊在七月才参加竞选，此前原提名人格雷厄姆·普拉特纳因被指控性侵犯前伴侣而辞职。

paras.en: - Key issues: Trump's posture toward Canada has led to a sharp drop in Canadians crossing the border to visit Maine. His war in Iran triggered a 74 per cent jump in the price of furnace oil, which roughly half of all households in the state use to heat their homes.
paras.zh: - 关键问题：特朗普对加拿大的态度导致跨越边境访问缅因州的加拿大人急剧下降。他在伊朗发动的战争导致炉油价格上涨 74%，该州大约一半的家庭使用炉油来取暖。

paras.en: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed is hoping to put U.S. President Donald Trump's trade war with Canada on the ballot in Michigan this November. (Sylvia Thomson/CBC News)
paras.zh: 民主党人阿卜杜勒·赛义德希望今年 11 月在密歇根州将美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与加拿大的贸易战纳入投票。 （西尔维娅·汤姆森/CBC新闻）

paras.en: - Candidates: (D) Abdul El-Sayed vs (R) Mike Rogers
paras.zh: - 候选人：（D）阿卜杜勒·赛义德 vs（R）迈克·罗杰斯

paras.en: This seat was thrown open by incumbent Democrat Gary Peters' decision not to seek re-election. If Democrats can't hold Michigan, their path to a Senate majority becomes significantly tougher.
paras.zh: 该席位因现任民主党人加里·彼得斯决定不寻求连任而空出。如果民主党无法保住密歇根州，他们获得参议院多数席位的道路就会变得更加艰难。

paras.en: El-Sayed is a medical doctor and staunch progressive who was born in the U.S. to Egyptian immigrant parents. Since winning the Democratic nomination in August, he has become a frequent target of Trump's attacks.
paras.zh: 埃尔-赛义德是一位医生和坚定的进步人士，出生在美国，父母是埃及移民。自8月获得民主党提名以来，他频频成为特朗普攻击的对象。

paras.en: Trump launched an Islamophobic rant against El-Sayed during a rally Sunday in the border town of Port Huron, Mich. The president called him a "jihadist" and warned that a Democratic win would bring "hordes of jihadis to our shores, creating a nightmare of violence and terror."
paras.zh: 周日，特朗普在密歇根州边境小镇休伦港举行的集会上对埃尔·赛义德发起了仇视伊斯兰教的咆哮。总统称他为“圣战分子”，并警告说，民主党的胜利将把“成群结队的圣战分子带到我们的海岸，造成暴力和恐怖的噩梦”。

paras.en: - 'Canada is not our enemy': Michigan Republican Senate candidate breaks with Trump on trade war
paras.zh: - “加拿大不是我们的敌人”：密歇根州共和党参议员候选人在贸易战问题上与特朗普决裂

paras.en: - A Michigan Democrat wants to put Canada on the ballot during the midterms. Are voters listening?
paras.zh: - 密歇根州民主党人希望在中期选举期间让加拿大参与投票。选民在听吗？

paras.en: Rogers, a former FBI agent who served in the House for 14 years, has attempted to put some distance between himself and Trump on Canada-U.S. relations. He launched a new ad this month in which he said, "We need to end this tariff war now," while sitting in a sports bar with a Labatt beer.
paras.zh: 曾在众议院任职14年的前联邦调查局特工罗杰斯试图在加美关系上与特朗普保持一定距离。他本月推出了一则新广告，其中他坐在一家体育酒吧里喝着拉巴特啤酒，说道：“我们现在需要结束这场关税战”。

paras.en: - Key issues: Trump's tariffs on Canadian products and the breakdown in trade talks are causing upheaval in the auto industry, Michigan's economic engine. Michigan residents have faced higher tariff costs per household than any other state, according to a recent study by the National Taxpayers Union Foundation.
paras.zh: - 关键问题：特朗普对加拿大产品征收关税和贸易谈判破裂正在导致密歇根州经济引擎汽车行业发生剧变。根据国家纳税人联盟基金会最近的一项研究，密歇根州居民每户面临的关税成本比任何其他州都高。

paras.en: Trump listens as Republican Sen. Jon Husted of Ohio speaks at a campaign rally in Youngstown, Ohio on Oct. 12. (Gene J. Puskar/THe Associated Press)
paras.zh: 10 月 12 日，特朗普在俄亥俄州扬斯敦举行的竞选集会上聆听俄亥俄州共和党参议员 Jon Husted 的讲话。（Gene J. Puskar/美联社）

paras.en: - Candidates: (R) Sen. Jon Husted vs (D) Sherrod Brown
paras.zh: - 候选人：(R) 参议员 Jon Husted VS (D) Sherrod Brown

paras.en: Husted was appointed to the seat in 2025 to replace JD Vance when Vance became Trump's vice-president. Before that, Husted had a lengthy career in state politics, holding elected office since 2001.
paras.zh: 当万斯成为特朗普的副总统时，赫斯特德于 2025 年被任命接替万斯担任该席位。在此之前，赫斯特德在州政坛有着漫长的职业生涯，自 2001 年起担任民选公职。

paras.en: Trump has recently commented frequently on the 59-year-old Husted's athletic physique, including at events outside of Ohio.
paras.zh: 特朗普最近频繁评论 59 岁的赫斯特德的运动体格，包括在俄亥俄州以外的活动中。

paras.en: "I examined his ass," the president said at a rally in Kentucky on Oct. 17. "I then patted him on the shoulder, and it was like a piece of steel. I'm still recovering."
paras.zh: 10 月 17 日，总统在肯塔基州的一次集会上说：“我检查了他的屁股。然后我拍了拍他的肩膀，他的肩膀就像一块钢铁。我还在恢复中。”

paras.en: Brown has been in politics for more than 50 years, first elected to the state legislature just before his 22nd birthday. He held Ohio's other U.S. Senate seat from 2007 until losing his re-election bid in 2024.
paras.zh: 布朗从政已有 50 多年，他在 22 岁生日前首次当选为州议员。自 2007 年起，他一直担任俄亥俄州的另一个美国参议院席位，直至 2024 年竞选连任失败。

paras.en: - In Ohio, Canada-U.S. trade war sparks anger and uncertainty
paras.zh: - 在俄亥俄州，加拿大与美国的贸易战引发愤怒和不确定性

paras.en: - Video Data centre backlash is a problem for Trump’s Republicans
paras.zh: - 视频数据中心的强烈反对是特朗普的共和党人面临的一个问题

paras.en: Brown has long advocated targeted tariffs to protect U.S. manufacturing jobs but has consistently criticized Trump's sweeping tariffs, including those on Canadian goods, as ineffective and inflationary.
paras.zh: 布朗长期以来一直主张征收有针对性的关税以保护美国制造业就业，但他一直批评特朗普的全面关税，包括对加拿大商品的关税，认为关税无效且会引发通货膨胀。

paras.en: - Key issues: Ohio is a often considered a bellwether state, so the issues top of mind for voters there mirror those resonating across the country: the rising cost of living and whether Trump's war against Iran and his tariffs are to blame. Concern over the spread of data centres is also emerging as a local issue that could affect the statewide race.
paras.zh: - 关键问题：俄亥俄州通常被认为是一个领头羊州，因此那里的选民最关心的问题反映了全国范围内引起共鸣的问题：生活成本上升以及特朗普对伊朗的战争和关税是否应归咎于这一问题。对数据中心扩张的担忧也正在成为一个可能影响全州竞选的地方问题。

paras.en: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, right, greets a supporter at a campaign rally in Allen, Tex. on Oct. 19. Paxton is the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Texas, running against Democrat James Talarico. (Mike Crawley/CBC)
paras.zh: 10 月 19 日，德克萨斯州总检察长肯·帕克斯顿（右）在德克萨斯州艾伦举行的竞选集会上向一名支持者致意。帕克斯顿是德克萨斯州美国参议院的共和党候选人，与民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科竞选。 （迈克·克劳利/CBC）

paras.en: - Candidates: (R) Ken Paxton vs (D) James Talarico
paras.zh: - 候选人：(R) 肯·帕克斯顿 (Ken Paxton) VS (D) 詹姆斯·塔拉里科 (James Talarico)

paras.en: Democrats haven't won a U.S. Senate election in Texas since 1988, the year before Talarico was born.
paras.zh: 自 1988 年（塔拉里科出生前一年）以来，民主党就没有在德克萨斯州的美国参议院选举中获胜。

paras.en: Yet polls suggest Trump himself has put the seat at risk by rejecting incumbent Sen. John Cornyn and endorsing Paxton — the state's scandal-ridden attorney general — as the Republican candidate.
paras.zh: 然而民意调查显示，特朗普本人拒绝了现任参议员约翰·科宁并支持丑闻缠身的州总检察长帕克斯顿作为共和党候选人，从而将席位置于危险之中。

paras.en: A Republican loss in Texas would be the most significant midterm repudiation of Trump in the country. Paxton seems to realize the burden.
paras.zh: 共和党在德克萨斯州的失利将是特朗普在该国中期选举中最严重的失败。帕克斯顿似乎意识到了这个负担。

paras.en: "I'm not exaggerating when I say if we lose Texas, we lose America," he told an Oct. 19 rally in Fort Worth.
paras.zh: “当我说如果我们失去德克萨斯州，我们就失去美国时，我并不夸张，”他在 10 月 19 日在沃斯堡举行的集会上说。

paras.en: - Trump's scandal-plagued pick wins Texas Senate primary run-off — and Democrats see an opening
paras.zh: - 特朗普丑闻缠身的人选赢得德克萨斯州参议院初选决选——民主党看到了一个机会

paras.en: - Analysis Why Republicans are questioning the masculinity of Texas Democratic Senate contender James Talarico
paras.zh: - 分析为什么共和党人质疑德克萨斯州民主党参议员候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科的男子气概

paras.en: In their campaign stump speeches, the rivals describe each another in extreme terms. Talarico calls Paxton "the most corrupt politician in Texas," while Paxton says a vote for Talarico is "a vote for every dangerous idea that Democrats across the country are putting forward right now."
paras.zh: 在竞选演说中，竞争对手用极端的措辞互相描述。塔拉里科称帕克斯顿是“德克萨斯州最腐败的政客”，而帕克斯顿则表示，对塔拉里科的投票是“对全国民主党人目前提出的每一个危险想法的投票”。

paras.en: - Key issues: The Latino community accounts for roughly one in every five eligible voters in Texas. It supported Trump in record numbers in the 2024 presidential election, but Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) targeting thousands of non-criminals who've been in the U.S. for years could swing many of those voters toward Talarico.
paras.zh: - 关键问题：拉丁裔社区约占德克萨斯州合格选民的五分之一。它在 2024 年总统选举中支持特朗普的人数创历史新高，但移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 针对数千名在美国生活多年的非犯罪分子可能会让其中许多选民转向塔拉里科。

paras.en: Iowa Republican nominee for U.S. Senate Ashley Hinson, right, speaks during a televised debate with Democratic nominee Josh Turek on Oct. 13 in Des Moines, Iowa. (Charlie Neibergall/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日，爱荷华州共和党美国参议院候选人阿什利·辛森 (Ashley Hinson)（右）在爱荷华州得梅因与民主党候选人乔什·图雷克 (Josh Turek) 进行电视辩论时发表讲话。 （查理·尼伯格/美联社）

paras.en: - Candidates: (R) Ashley Hinson vs (D) Josh Turek
paras.zh: - 候选人：(R) Ashley Hinson VS (D) Josh Turek

paras.en: Both parties believe they've nominated appealing candidates in the race to replace retiring Republican Sen. Joni Ernst.
paras.zh: 两党都认为他们已经在竞选中提名了有吸引力的候选人来接替即将退休的共和党参议员乔尼·恩斯特。

paras.en: Hinson was a TV reporter and anchor before winning a House seat in 2020. Turek is a three-time Paralympian in wheelchair basketball who was born with spina bifida after his father was exposed to Agent Orange in Vietnam.
paras.zh: 辛森 (Hinson) 在 2020 年赢得众议院席位之前曾是一名电视记者和主播。图雷克 (Turek) 是一名三届残奥会轮椅篮球运动员，他的父亲在越南接触橙剂后，出生时患有脊柱裂。

paras.en: Both candidates have tried to persuade Iowa voters they aren't beholden to their party or its leadership. Hinson has said she will stand with Trump on issues such as border security but stand up to him when she believes his policies are wrong for Iowa.
paras.zh: 两位候选人都试图说服爱荷华州选民，他们不会受制于他们的政党或其领导层。辛森表示，她将在边境安全等问题上与特朗普站在一起，但当她认为特朗普的政策对爱荷华州来说是错误的时候，她会站出来反对他。

paras.en: Turek, campaigning in a state that hasn't sent a Democrat to the U.S. Senate in 16 years, has described himself as "proudly a moderate" and said he and Trump could agree on many issues.
paras.zh: 图雷克在一个16年来没有派出民主党人进入美国参议院的州竞选，他形容自己是“自豪的温和派”，并表示他和特朗普可以在许多问题上达成共识。

paras.en: - Key issues: Farmers are a major voting bloc in Iowa and rely on diesel to fuel their equipment. For months, Trump brushed aside concerns about soaring fuel prices, driven largely by the war with Iran. Less than two weeks before election day, he announced $8 billion US in one-time payments to farmers to offset diesel costs.
paras.zh: - 关键问题：农民是爱荷华州的主要投票群体，依靠柴油为其设备提供燃料。几个月来，特朗普一直对主要由伊朗战争推动的燃油价格飙升的担忧置之不理。距离选举日不到两周，他宣布向农民一次性支付 80 亿美元，以抵消柴油成本。

paras.en: - North Carolina appears poised to be the mostly likely state for Democrats to flip.
paras.zh: - 北卡罗来纳州似乎将成为民主党最有可能推翻的州。

paras.en: Incumbent Republican Sen. Thom Tillis is retiring, Trump only carried the state by three percentage points in 2024, and Democratic candidate Roy Cooper served 16 years as North Carolina's attorney general and two terms as governor.
paras.zh: 现任共和党参议员汤姆·蒂利斯 (Thom Tillis) 即将退休，特朗普在 2024 年的支持率仅领先该州 3 个百分点，而民主党候选人罗伊·库珀 (Roy Cooper) 曾担任北卡罗来纳州总检察长 16 年，并担任过两届州长。

paras.en: His opponent Michael Whatley, the former chair of the Republican National Committee, is a political backroomer who has never held elected office.
paras.zh: 他的对手、共和党全国委员会前主席迈克尔·沃特利是一位从未担任过民选公职的政治幕后操纵者。

paras.en: - Alaska has sent only one Democrat to the U.S. Senate in the past 50 years. But there are clear signs the Republicans are worried this time.
paras.zh: - 过去 50 年来，阿拉斯加州仅向美国参议院派出一名民主党议员。但有明显迹象表明共和党人这次感到担忧。

paras.en: At Trump's behest, the Department of Justice launched a lawsuit seeking to bar the state from certifying the election if Republican incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan loses. The ostensible reason: there is also an independent candidate on the ballot named Daniel J. Sullivan.
paras.zh: 在特朗普的要求下，司法部发起了一项诉讼，试图在共和党现任参议员丹·沙利文失败的情况下禁止该州对选举进行认证。表面原因是：选票上还有一位独立候选人，名叫丹尼尔·J·沙利文。

paras.en: The Democratic candidate is Mary Peltola. She and Minnesota Democratic candidate Peggy Flanagan could become the first Indigenous women elected to the U.S. Senate.
paras.zh: 民主党候选人是玛丽·佩尔托拉。她和明尼苏达州民主党候选人佩吉·弗拉纳根可能成为第一位当选美国参议院的土著女性。

paras.en: - In Kansas, no Democrat has won a U.S. Senate election since 1932.
paras.zh: - 在堪萨斯州，自 1932 年以来，还没有民主党人赢得美国参议院选举。

paras.en: Yet polls suggest that could change in 2026. Similar dynamics are at play in Kansas as in Iowa: farmers are upset by soaring diesel prices triggered by the Iran war and rising input costs resulting from tariffs.
paras.zh: 然而民意调查显示，这种情况可能会在 2026 年发生变化。堪萨斯州和爱荷华州也出现了类似的情况：农民对伊朗战争引发的柴油价格飙升以及关税导致的投入成本上升感到不安。

paras.en: Republican incumbent Sen. Roger Marshall is up against Democrat Adam Hamilton, founding pastor of a megachurch.
paras.zh: 共和党现任参议员罗杰·马歇尔的对手是民主党人亚当·汉密尔顿，他是一座大型教堂的创始牧师。

paras.en: All 435 seats in the House of Representatives are up for election.
paras.zh: 众议院全部 435 个席位都将进行选举。

paras.en: However, various websites that analyze U.S. politics — including the Cook Political Report, the University of Virginia's Center for Politics, Decision Desk HQ and 270toWin — currently rate no more than 50 of them as truly competitive.
paras.zh: 然而，分析美国政治的各种网站——包括库克政治报告、弗吉尼亚大学政治中心、Decision Desk HQ 和 270toWin——目前将其中不超过 50 个评为真正具有竞争力的网站。

paras.en: Here are a few of the key Republican-held districts Democrats are targeting in their effort to take control of the House.
paras.zh: 以下是民主党为控制众议院而瞄准的几个共和党控制的关键选区。

paras.en: - Virginia 1st district: (R) Rob Wittman (incumbent) vs (D) Shannon Taylor
paras.zh: - 弗吉尼亚第一选区：(R) Rob Wittman (现任) vs (D) Shannon Taylor

paras.en: Polls close in Virginia at 7 p.m. ET, so this race could provide one of the earliest indications of what kind of a night it will be for Republicans and Democrats. The district, which stretches from the suburbs of the state capital, Richmond, to the historic city of Williamsburg, was flagged by the Washington Post as one of the "bellwether races to watch" in the midterms.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚州投票于晚上 7 点结束ET，所以这场比赛可以提供最早的迹象之一，表明共和党和民主党将度过一个什么样的夜晚。该地区从州首府里士满郊区一直延伸到历史名城威廉斯堡，被《华盛顿邮报》标记为中期选举中“值得关注的领头羊竞选”之一。

paras.en: - Pennsylvania 7th district: (R) Ryan Mackenzie (incumbent) vs (D) Bob Brooks
paras.zh: - 宾夕法尼亚州第七选区：(R) Ryan Mackenzie (现任) vs (D) Bob Brooks

paras.en: This district, centred on the working-class city of Allentown, has swung between Democrats and Republicans four times since 2006. Latinos make up nearly one-quarter of eligible voters. Mackenzie won the seat in 2024 by a one-point margin. Brooks is a former firefighter who has never held elected office.
paras.zh: 这个选区以工薪阶层城市阿伦敦为中心，自 2006 年以来已四次在民主党和共和党之间摇摆不定。拉丁裔占合格选民的近四分之一。麦肯齐以一分优势赢得 2024 年席位。布鲁克斯是一名前消防员，从未担任过民选公职。

paras.en: - New York 17th district: (R) Mike Lawler (incumbent) vs (D) Cait Conley
paras.zh: - 纽约第 17 选区：(R) Mike Lawler（现任）vs (D) Cait Conley

paras.en: Lawler's pitch to voters in this Hudson Valley district includes what he has called his "strong working relationship" with Trump as a way to get things done in Washington. Conley is a West Point graduate who served in Iraq and Afghanistan and is making her first run for office. She has put her military background front and centre in her campaign advertising.
paras.zh: 劳勒向哈德逊河谷选区的选民推销的内容包括他所说的与特朗普的“牢固的工作关系”，以此作为在华盛顿完成任务的一种方式。康利毕业于西点军校，曾在伊拉克和阿富汗服役，目前正在首次竞选公职。她在竞选广告中将自己的军事背景放在了首位和中心位置。

paras.en: Democrat Bobby Pulido, a famous singer among the Latino community, is trying to unseat Republican Monica De La Cruz in the race for the 15th Congressional district of Texas. (Mike Crawley/CBC)
paras.zh: 民主党人鲍比·普利多 (Bobby Pulido) 是拉丁裔社区中的著名歌手，他正试图在德克萨斯州第 15 国会选区的竞选中击败共和党人莫妮卡·德拉克鲁兹 (Monica De La Cruz)。 （迈克·克劳利/CBC）

paras.en: - Texas 15th district: (R) Monica De La Cruz (incumbent) vs (D) Bobby Pulido
paras.zh: - 德克萨斯州第 15 选区：(R) Monica De La Cruz（现任）vs (D) Bobby Pulido

paras.en: Democrats recruited a star candidate for this South Texas race: Pulido is a two-time Latin Grammy Award winner. De La Cruz tried to dismiss him as unserious by saying the election "isn't about who you want performing at your niece's quinceañera." Pulido seized on the remark by taking his campaign to quinceañeras, the traditional celebration of a girl's 15th birthday.
paras.zh: 民主党为这场南德克萨斯州的竞选招募了一位明星候选人：普利多是两届拉丁格莱美奖获得者。德拉克鲁兹试图斥责他不认真，他说选举“并不是关于你想让谁在你侄女的成人礼上表演”。普利多抓住了这句话，将他的竞选活动带到了成人礼上，这是女孩 15 岁生日的传统庆祝活动。

paras.en: - Ohio 7th district: (R) Max Miller (incumbent) vs (D) Brian Poindexter
paras.zh: - 俄亥俄州第七选区：（R）Max Miller（现任）vs（D）Brian Poindexter

paras.en: This district in Cleveland's western suburbs wasn't originally a prime target for Democrats. That changed after Miller's ex-wife — the daughter of Republican Sen. Bernie Moreno — accused him of physical abuse, including throwing boiling water at her and holding a gun to her head. Miller has denied the allegations.
paras.zh: 克利夫兰西郊的这个地区最初并不是民主党的主要目标。米勒的前妻——共和党参议员伯尼·莫雷诺的女儿——指控他对她进行身体虐待，包括向她泼沸水，并用枪指着她的头，之后情况发生了变化。米勒否认了这些指控。

paras.en: Poindexter is an ironworker and city councillor in the working-class community of Brook Park.
paras.zh: 波因德克斯特是布鲁克公园工人阶级社区的一名钢铁工人和市议员。

paras.en: - Michigan 10th district: (R) Michael Bouchard vs (D) Christina Hines
paras.zh: - 密歇根州第 10 区：(R) 迈克尔·布沙尔 (Michael Bouchard) VS (D) 克里斯蒂娜·海因斯 (Christina Hines)

paras.en: This race in Detroit's northern suburbs is open because incumbent Republican John James is running for governor. Bouchard is an Army veteran whose ads have focused on being tough on crime and securing the southern border.
paras.zh: 底特律北郊的这场竞选是开放的，因为现任共和党人约翰·詹姆斯正在竞选州长。布沙尔是一名退伍军人，他的广告重点是严厉打击犯罪和保护南部边境。

paras.en: Hines is a former prosecutor who boasts of having put "hundreds of predators, murderers, and pedophiles in jail."
paras.zh: 海因斯是一名前检察官，他吹嘘自己曾将“数百名掠夺者、杀人犯和恋童癖者关进监狱”。

articles.title: Ebola cases top 10,000 in Democratic Republic of Congo, as countries race to stop spread
articles.author: Chinedu Asadu, Constance Same Bagalwa

paras.en: Ebola cases top 10,000 in Democratic Republic of Congo, as countries race to stop spread
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国埃博拉病例突破 10,000 例，各国竞相阻止传播

paras.en: Outbreak caused by rare Bundibugyo strain, no approved vaccine or treatment
paras.zh: 由罕见的 Bundibugyo 菌株引起的疫情，尚无批准的疫苗或治疗方法

paras.en: The fast-moving Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (D.R.C.) has reached 10,000 confirmed cases, government data showed on Tuesday, as health authorities race to slow the spread of the disease in multiple African countries.
paras.zh: 周二政府数据显示，刚果民主共和国（D.R.C.）埃博拉疫情快速蔓延，确诊病例已达 10,000 例，卫生当局正在竞相减缓该疾病在多个非洲国家的传播。

paras.en: It is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history and nearly half of the 10,060 people confirmed to have the virus have died, according to data from D.R.C.'s Ministry of Health.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国卫生部的数据显示，这是历史上增长最快的埃博拉疫情，确诊感染该病毒的 10,060 人中有近一半死亡。

paras.en: That also makes it the deadliest outbreak of the disease in the country's history.
paras.zh: 这也使其成为该国历史上最致命的疾病爆发。

paras.en: The outbreak declared in May is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment.
paras.zh: 五月份宣布的疫情是由罕见的本迪布焦病毒引起的，目前尚无批准的疫苗或治疗方法。

paras.en: Response teams are battling armed conflict, poor roads and violence from residents fuelled by mistrust and misinformation. Those obstacles compound the challenge of persuading people to report symptoms and accept care in communities that have endured years of violence and repeated epidemics.
paras.zh: 响应小组正在与武装冲突、道路状况不佳以及因不信任和错误信息而引发的居民暴力作斗争。这些障碍使得在经历了多年暴力和疫情反复的社区中说服人们报告症状并接受护理变得更加困难。

paras.en: Compared to the West Africa Ebola outbreak of 2014-2016 — history's largest and deadliest, with more than 28,000 cases, including more than 11,000 deaths — this has had at least three times the number of cases and deaths in the time since it was declared.
paras.zh: 与2014-2016年西非埃博拉疫情相比——历史上规模最大、死亡人数最多的埃博拉疫情，有超过28,000例病例，其中11,000多人死亡——相比之下，自宣布以来的病例数和死亡人数至少是其三倍。

paras.en: It has spread farther across Africa than any previous Ebola outbreak, reaching three regions, with cases recorded in Kenya and Nigeria as well.
paras.zh: 它在非洲的传播范围比以往任何一次埃博拉疫情都要严重，已蔓延到三个地区，肯尼亚和尼日利亚也有病例。

paras.en: It's so far been recorded in five countries, including Uganda, which saw 21 cases and three deaths but no new reported cases since late June, and France, a case involving a doctor who returned from D.R.C. and later recovered in hospital.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，有五个国家出现了这种情况，其中包括乌干达（该国出现了 21 例病例和 3 例死亡，但自 6 月下旬以来没有新报告病例）和法国（该国出现了一名从刚果民主共和国返回的医生的病例）。后来在医院康复。

paras.en: A health worker attends to an Ebola patient at the Rwampara treatment centre in Ituri, D.R.C., on June 18. (Moses Sawasawa/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 6 月 18 日，刚果民主共和国伊图里鲁万帕拉治疗中心，一名卫生工作者正在照顾一名埃博拉患者。（Moses Sawasawa/美联社）

paras.en: A recurring problem in the spread in Africa is what appears to be lax surveillance efforts, as most of the first cases were confirmed long after people started showing symptoms or after travelling.
paras.zh: 非洲疫情传播中反复出现的一个问题是监测工作似乎松懈，因为大多数首批病例是在人们开始出现症状或旅行后很久才确诊的。

paras.en: African health ministers are to hold a virtual summit on Wednesday to strengthen the continent's collective response.
paras.zh: 非洲卫生部长将于周三举行虚拟峰会，以加强非洲大陆的集体应对措施。

paras.en: "Ebola is crossing borders. Our response must move faster, with stronger co-ordination, greater solidarity and decisive political leadership," said Dr. Jean Kaseya, head of Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention.
paras.zh: 非洲疾病控制与预防中心主任让·卡塞亚博士表示：“埃博拉病毒正在跨越国界。我们的应对行动必须更快、更强有力的协调、更大的团结和果断的政治领导。”

paras.en: Ongoing community spread, many not seeking care
paras.zh: 持续的社区传播，许多人没有寻求治疗

paras.en: In D.R.C., the disease has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, from three zones when it was first declared in May.
paras.zh: 在刚果民主共和国，该疾病已从 5 月份首次宣布的三个卫生区蔓延至 8 个省份的 66 个卫生区。

paras.en: Responders have told The Associated Press that they're seeing treatment centres in some of those health zones being overwhelmed, and people still skeptical and violent toward them, and health workers are regularly going on strike to protest delayed or unpaid wages.
paras.zh: 响应者告诉美联社，他们看到其中一些卫生区的治疗中心不堪重负，人们仍然对他们持怀疑态度和暴力行为，卫生工作者经常举行罢工，抗议拖欠或拖欠工资。

paras.en: "Some people still don't seem to understand the seriousness of the situation, even though they are directly exposed to the risk," said Sephora Bgosi with the Ebola burial team in Ituri province, the epicentre.
paras.zh: 震中伊图里省埃博拉埋葬团队的丝芙拉·博戈西 (Sephora Bgosi) 表示：“有些人似乎仍然不了解情况的严重性，尽管他们直接暴露在风险之中。”

paras.en: "Ebola disease is extremely dangerous and can be deadly," said Bgosi.
paras.zh: 布戈西说：“埃博拉疾病极其危险，可能致命。”

paras.en: - Nigeria Ebola patient flown to Switzerland, Congo health worker killed as 4 countries deal with outbreak
paras.zh: - 尼日利亚埃博拉患者飞往瑞士，刚果卫生工作者在四个国家应对疫情时丧生

paras.en: - 1 in 4 Ebola deaths are children in Democratic Republic of Congo's worst outbreak
paras.zh: - 在刚果民主共和国疫情最严重的地区，四分之一的埃博拉死亡病例是儿童

paras.en: About 80 per cent of recorded cases are still coming from outside of monitored contacts, showing there are ongoing chains of transmission that health authorities are not aware of.
paras.zh: 约 80% 的记录病例仍来自受监控的接触者之外，这表明卫生当局尚未意识到存在持续的传播链。

paras.en: At least 95 per cent of recorded cases are supposed to be coming from known contacts for officials to say the outbreak has largely been brought under control, the African CDC has said.
paras.zh: 非洲疾病预防控制中心表示，至少 95% 的记录病例应该来自已知的接触者，官员们表示疫情已基本得到控制。

paras.en: At least half of deaths recorded are among people who have not been admitted to treatment centres, a sign that people are still not reporting symptoms at all in many areas.
paras.zh: 记录的死亡中至少有一半是没有被送往治疗中心的人，这表明许多地区的人们仍然没有报告任何症状。

paras.en: At least 2,600 patients have recovered from the disease in D.R.C., bringing rare moments of joy to affected communities. A viral video this week showed health workers in full protective gear dancing as the last two patients were discharged from a treatment centre in Mongbwalu, Ituri province.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国至少有 2,600 名患者已康复，为受影响的社区带来了难得的欢乐时刻。本周一段广为流传的视频显示，当最后两名患者从伊图里省蒙布瓦卢的治疗中心出院时，身穿全套防护装备的医护人员跳舞。

paras.en: "The outbreak is far from over, but every life saved is worth celebrating," World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said of the video.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞在谈到这段视频时表示：“疫情还远没有结束，但每一个被拯救的生命都值得庆祝。”

paras.en: Medical workers attacked, health services strained
paras.zh: 医务人员遭到袭击，卫生服务紧张

paras.en: In many zones, health workers are battling challenges ranging from basic needs such as adequate vehicles to complex ones like persuading families to release their relatives who are sick with the disease or who have died from it and need to be buried safely.
paras.zh: 在许多地区，卫生工作者正在应对各种挑战，从足够的车辆等基本需求到说服家庭释放患有这种疾病或死于这种疾病并需要安全埋葬的亲属等复杂的挑战。

paras.en: Last week at the Nia Nia health zone in Ituri province, some Ebola responders, including surveillance and community engagement officers, went on strike over unpaid bonuses owed since late August, a common trend across many affected localities.
paras.zh: 上周，在伊图里省的尼亚尼亚卫生区，一些埃博拉应对人员，包括监测和社区参与官员，因自 8 月底以来拖欠的奖金而举行罢工，这是许多受影响地区的普遍趋势。

paras.en: More than five months since the outbreak was declared, health workers are still being attacked by angry villagers, including on Saturday when a nurse was killed and another health worker severely injured while responding to an Ebola alert in Bafwasende, Tshopo province.
paras.zh: 自宣布疫情爆发以来五个多月以来，卫生工作者仍然受到愤怒村民的袭击，包括周六，在乔波省巴夫瓦森德应对埃博拉警报时，一名护士被杀，另一名卫生工作者受重伤。

paras.en: The outbreak has disrupted essential health services that are already underfunded and overstretched and has shifted attention away from other disease outbreaks the country is battling, such as cholera— with more than 51,000 suspected cases reported in western D.R.C. since the beginning of 2026.
paras.zh: 这场疫情扰乱了本已资金不足、捉襟见肘​​的基本卫生服务，并转移了人们对该国正在抗击的其他疾病爆发的注意力，例如霍乱——刚果民主共和国西部报告了超过 51,000 例疑似病例。自2026年初以来。

paras.en: More pregnant women are dying as they avoid hospitals over fear of infection and isolation, causing maternal mortality to double in some provinces soon after the outbreak was declared.
paras.zh: 越来越多的孕妇因担心感染和隔离而避开医院，导致死亡，导致一些省份的孕产妇死亡率在疫情爆发后不久就翻了一番。

paras.en: It has also disrupted routine health-care services such as childhood vaccinations, interrupted schooling for children where millions are already out of school, caused trauma and stigma for affected families and further stretched the livelihoods of many already struggling with hardship.
paras.zh: 它还扰乱了儿童疫苗接种等常规医疗保健服务，中断了数百万人已经失学的儿童的学业，给受影响的家庭造成了创伤和耻辱，并进一步加剧了许多本已陷入困境的人的生计。

articles.title: Protein shakes for teenagers: Good or bad idea?

paras.en: You can take it as a powdered drink, or in a snack bar. Puddings and certain breads are also promoted as "sources of protein," and protein-enriched products like Kindershake and Teen Balance are specifically designed to appeal to a young people — and it appears to be working.
paras.zh: 您可以将其作为粉末饮料饮用，或在小吃店中饮用。布丁和某些面包也被宣传为“蛋白质来源”，Kindershake 和 Teen Balance 等富含蛋白质的产品是专门为吸引年轻人而设计的——而且它似乎很有效。

paras.en: In a representative survey of almost 1,000 parents by the University of Michigan in 2024, just under half said their children, who were aged 13 to 17, had consumed protein products over the previous year. The survey found that boys were more likely to do so than girls, especially in connection with sport, or to build muscle. Girls took them to balance their diet, and to lose weight.
paras.zh: 密歇根大学 2024 年对近 1,000 名家长进行的一项代表性调查显示，不到一半的家长表示，他们 13 至 17 岁的孩子在过去一年中食用了蛋白质产品。调查发现，男孩比女孩更有可能这样做，特别是在运动或锻炼肌肉方面。女孩们用它们来平衡饮食和减肥。

paras.en: According to the statistics portal Statista, between March 2024 and March 2025 the fitness protein product market in Germany recorded a huge jump of around 25% in retail revenue.
paras.zh: 根据统计门户网站 Statista 的数据，2024 年 3 月至 2025 年 3 月期间，德国健身蛋白产品市场的零售收入大幅增长约 25%。

paras.en: Proteins are key building blocks for our metabolism. They play an important role in building up and repairing tissue in our muscles, skin and organs. Proteins are the basis for the formation of enzymes that regulate chemical reactions in the body, and of antibodies that are vital for our immune system.
paras.zh: 蛋白质是我们新陈代谢的关键组成部分。它们在构建和修复我们的肌肉、皮肤和器官组织方面发挥着重要作用。蛋白质是形成调节体内化学反应的酶和对我们的免疫系统至关重要的抗体的基础。

paras.en: According to the German Nutrition Society (DGE), healthy adults should consume 0.8 grams of protein daily per kilogram of body weight. A woman weighing 65 kilos should eat 52 grams of protein per day, for example.
paras.zh: 根据德国营养学会（DGE）的建议，健康成年人每天每公斤体重应摄入0.8克蛋白质。例如，体重 65 公斤的女性每天应摄入 52 克蛋白质。

paras.en: But they can do this without special protein products. A portion of oat flakes with an almond drink for breakfast, a baked potato with curd cheese for lunch, and two slices of wholemeal bread with peanut butter in the evening — objective achieved.
paras.zh: 但他们不需要特殊的蛋白质产品就能做到这一点。早餐吃一份燕麦片加杏仁饮料，午餐吃一份烤土豆加凝乳干酪，晚上吃两片加花生酱的全麦面包——目标达到了。

paras.en: Young people should consume a little more, as they are still growing. For them, the formula is 0.9 grams of protein per kilo of body weight. A teenager weighing 45 kilos should therefore eat 40.5 grams of protein per day. People over 65 and children aged one to four should have a little more: one gram of protein per kilo of body weight.
paras.zh: 年轻人应该多吃一点，因为他们还在成长。对于他们来说，配方是每公斤体重 0.9 克蛋白质。因此，体重 45 公斤的青少年每天应摄入 40.5 克蛋白质。 65岁以上的人和1至4岁的儿童应该多吃一点：每公斤体重一克蛋白质。

paras.en: Older people tend to eat too little protein, often because their appetite decreases. But a study done in Germany between 2015 and 2017 showed that children and young people there often consume too much. Around half of six- to 17-year-olds ate more than double the recommended daily amount of protein.
paras.zh: 老年人往往吃得太少的蛋白质，通常是因为他们的食欲下降。但 2015 年至 2017 年在德国进行的一项研究表明，那里的儿童和年轻人往往消费过多。大约一半的 6 至 17 岁儿童摄入的蛋白质是每日建议摄入量的两倍以上。

paras.en: Too much protein can be harmful in the long term, according to the DGE. Various studies show that children who eat too much protein, particularly animal protein, often become overweight. Some enter puberty early.
paras.zh: DGE 表示，从长远来看，过多的蛋白质可能有害。各种研究表明，摄入过多蛋白质（尤其是动物蛋白）的儿童往往会变得超重。有些人提前进入青春期。

paras.en: Above all, too much protein can put excessive strain on the kidneys, causing damage. The kidneys have to convert the amino acids that constitute the building blocks of proteins into urea before they are excreted in urine. Damage is particularly likely if a person doesn't drink enough fluids, or has pre-existing kidney damage — but adolescents are also at greater risk.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，过多的蛋白质会给肾脏带来过度的压力，造成损害。肾脏必须将构成蛋白质的氨基酸转化为尿素，然后再通过尿液排出体外。如果一个人没有喝足够的液体，或者已有肾脏损伤，那么损伤的可能性特别大，但青少年也面临更大的风险。

paras.en: Protein helps build muscle and shed weight
paras.zh: 蛋白质有助于增强肌肉和减轻体重

paras.en: A person's protein requirement is greater if they are very physically active. Among other things, according to a DGE position paper, proteins can help maintain or build up muscular mass and strength, and support recovery after strain.
paras.zh: 如果一个人的体力活动非常活跃，那么他对蛋白质的需求量就会更大。除其他外，根据 DGE 立场文件，蛋白质可以帮助维持或增强肌肉质量和力量，并支持拉伤后的恢复。

paras.en: The paper states that, depending on physical condition and what they are training for, sportspeople should consume between 1.2 and 2 grams of protein per kilo of body weight, divided into several portions throughout the day. These recommendations only apply to people who train for more than five hours a day.
paras.zh: 该论文指出，根据身体状况和训练目的，运动员每公斤体重应摄入 1.2 至 2 克蛋白质，一天中分几次摄入。这些建议仅适用于每天训练超过五个小时的人。

paras.en: Proteins are of interest to people who want to lose weight because they are good at satisfying hunger. People usually lose more weight by following a protein-rich diet rather than another. Long-term, though, the most important thing to look at is: How many calories am I consuming, and how many am I burning?
paras.zh: 蛋白质之所以引起想要减肥的人的兴趣，是因为它们善于充饥。人们通常通过富含蛋白质的饮食而不是其他饮食来减轻体重。但从长远来看，最重要的是：我消耗了多少卡路里，燃烧了多少卡路里？

paras.en: Is animal protein better than plant protein?
paras.zh: 动物蛋白比植物蛋白好吗？

paras.en: Overall, plant proteins usually contain somewhat fewer essential amino acids than animal protein. "Essential" because the body cannot make them by itself – it has to take them in as food.
paras.zh: 总体而言，植物蛋白含有的必需氨基酸通常比动物蛋白少一些。 “必需”是因为身体无法自行制造它们，必须将它们作为食物摄入。

paras.en: However, wholegrain products, pulses, or nuts are also higher in fiber, vitamins, and unsaturated fats – all of which are healthy. The DGE therefore advises that protein intake should be increased primarily with sources of plant protein.
paras.zh: 然而，全麦产品、豆类或坚果的纤维、维生素和不饱和脂肪含量也较高——所有这些都是健康的。因此，DGE 建议增加蛋白质摄入量应主要通过植物蛋白来源。

paras.en: What is the criticism leveled against protein products?
paras.zh: 针对蛋白质产品的批评是什么？

paras.en: Protein powders and bars are often enriched not only with vitamins and minerals but also with unhelpful ingredients like sweeteners, sugar, additives and flavorings. The German Sport University in Cologne even found doping substances in protein products that were praised for building muscle.
paras.zh: 蛋白粉和蛋白棒通常不仅富含维生素和矿物质，还富含甜味剂、糖、添加剂和调味剂等无用成分。科隆的德国体育大学甚至在被誉为增强肌肉的蛋白质产品中发现了兴奋剂。

paras.en: Adolescents in particular might experience an unpleasant side-effect of consuming protein powders. These usually consist of milk proteins. There are various ways in which milk proteins can increase the skin's production of sebum, and this can trigger or exacerbate acne, although a direct link between milk protein products and acne has not been definitively proven.
paras.zh: 尤其是青少年可能会因食用蛋白粉而出现令人不快的副作用。这些通常由牛奶蛋白组成。牛奶蛋白可以通过多种方式增加皮肤皮脂的产生，这可能引发或加剧痤疮，尽管牛奶蛋白产品与痤疮之间的直接联系尚未得到明确证明。

paras.en: Specialists are also skeptical about protein shakes, fearing that they could lead to young people eating fewer normal meals, and thus consuming less fiber, micronutrients, and healthy fats.
paras.zh: 专家们也对蛋白质奶昔持怀疑态度，担心它们可能会导致年轻人减少正常膳食，从而摄入更少的纤维、微量营养素和健康脂肪。

paras.en: Protein-enriched foods are usually expensive. In a 2022 study, consumer organizations also found that foods that are naturally high in protein, such as cheese, curds, or soya drinks, often cost more if the protein content has been highlighted by the manufacturer.
paras.zh: 富含蛋白质的食物通常很昂贵。在 2022 年的一项研究中，消费者组织还发现，如果制造商强调了蛋白质含量，那么天然富含蛋白质的食品（例如奶酪、凝乳或大豆饮料）通常会花费更高。

paras.en: Not even sportspeople with a high protein requirement need to supplement their diet with special protein products. The DGE advises that they should aim to satisfy their requirements by optimizing their diet, and says there is no scientific evidence that our bodies require protein-enriched food supplements when put under strain.
paras.zh: 即使是蛋白质需求量高的运动员也不需要用特殊的蛋白质产品来补充饮食。 DGE 建议他们应该通过优化饮食来满足自己的需求，并表示没有科学证据表明我们的身体在承受压力时需要富含蛋白质的食品补充剂。

paras.en: However, the experts do say that it may make sense for people to use protein preparations if they have allergies, problems with digestion, chewing, or swallowing, or if their appetite is very low.
paras.zh: 然而，专家确实表示，如果人们有过敏、消化、咀嚼或吞咽问题，或者食欲很低，那么使用蛋白质制剂可能是有意义的。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: Will elections in Israel change its Iran approach?

paras.en: Israel's vote this Tuesday is the first general election for the country since the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023 — an assault which led to one of the deepest security crises in Israel's history.
paras.zh: 以色列本周二的投票是自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以来该国举行的首次大选，这次袭击导致了以色列历史上最严重的安全危机之一。

paras.en: As incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu fights to retain power, the question is not merely who will lead Israel's next government, but also how that government will navigate the region-wide security crisis that was triggered by the attack and the Israeli reaction, which included launching a war against Iran.
paras.zh: 在现任总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡努力保住权力之际，问题不仅在于谁将领导以色列下一届政府，还在于该政府将如何应对由袭击和以色列反应（包括对伊朗发动战争）引发的地区性安全危机。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump recently issued a full-throated endorsement of the incumbent Israeli leader as a "warrior prime minister" and warned that any other choice would affect Israel's alliance with Washington.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普最近大力支持以色列现任领导人作为“战士总理”，并警告说任何其他选择都将影响以色列与华盛顿的联盟。

paras.en: "If Israel has the wrong leader, which would be anyone other than Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu), America will have to do this work ourselves, and I am not inclined to do so," Trump said in an online post, referring to the Iran conflict.
paras.zh: “如果以色列有错误的领导人，而不是比比（本杰明·内塔尼亚胡），美国将不得不自己做这项工作，而我不倾向于这样做，”特朗普在一篇在线帖子中谈到伊朗冲突时表示。

paras.en: Behind the scenes, however, media reports indicated a rift between the Israeli government and the Trump administration. According to The Financial Times, the Israeli military intended to launch a new round of attacks on Iran's nuclear facilities, government centers, and energy infrastructure around October 10. However, Trump opposed the new escalation before the US midterm elections on November 3.
paras.zh: 然而，在幕后，媒体报道表明以色列政府和特朗普政府之间存在裂痕。据英国《金融时报》报道，以色列军方打算在10月10日左右对伊朗核设施、政府中心和能源基础设施发动新一轮袭击。不过，特朗普在11月3日美国中期选举前反对新一轮升级。

paras.en: The Jerusalem Post later questioned the narrative, reporting that the army had no specific directive for such an operation.
paras.zh: 《耶路撒冷邮报》后来对这种说法提出质疑，报道称军队没有针对此类行动的具体指示。

paras.en: Israel's moves hinge on Trump's decision
paras.zh: 以色列的行动取决于特朗普的决定

paras.en: The Israeli race has turned into a tight duel between Netanyahu and his main rival, Gadi Eisenkot — former IDF (Israel Defense Forces) chief of staff and leader of the front-running centrist party "Yashar."
paras.zh: 以色列的竞选已经演变成内塔尼亚胡和他的主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特之间的激烈对决。加迪·艾森科特是以色列国防军前参谋长、领先的中间派政党“亚沙尔”的领导人。

paras.en: But Raz Zimmt, the head of the Iran program at the Tel Aviv-based Institute for National Security Studies (INSS), warns political divisions between the two options are not deep enough to speak of a "fundamental change in Tel Aviv's approach toward Tehran" after the election.
paras.zh: 但特拉维夫国家安全研究所（INSS）伊朗项目负责人拉兹·齐姆特警告说，两种选择之间的政治分歧还不够深，不足以在选举后“特拉维夫对德黑兰的态度发生根本性改变”。

paras.en: "In the perception of Israel's left, right, and center factions regarding the Iranian threat, especially its nuclear threat, there are minor differences," Zimmt told DW.
paras.zh: 齐姆特告诉德国之声：“以色列的左翼、右翼和中间派对伊朗威胁，尤其是核威胁的看法存在细微差别。”

paras.en: Moreover, according to Zimmt, any military escalation against Iran depends "on the decision of the US president" far more than on the identity of Israel's prime minister.
paras.zh: 此外，齐姆特表示，任何针对伊朗的军事升级都取决于“美国总统的决定”，而不是以色列总理的身份。

paras.en: "Overall, I do not expect Israel's policy toward Iran and its proxies to undergo dramatic changes, regardless of the future government's composition," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“总体而言，无论未来政府的组成如何，我预计以色列对伊朗及其代理人的政策不会发生巨大变化。”

paras.en: INSS senior fellow Danny Citrinovitch agreed that one should not expect "fundamental changes" in Israel's Iran policy depending on the election outcome.
paras.zh: INSS 高级研究员丹尼·西特里诺维奇 (Danny Citrinovitch) 同意，不应指望以色列的伊朗政策会根据选举结果发生“根本性变化”。

paras.en: "Even if Netanyahu personally steps down from power, his influence and the policies shaped over recent years will not simply vanish," Citrinovitch told DW.
paras.zh: 西特里诺维奇告诉德国之声：“即使内塔尼亚胡亲自下台，他的影响力和近年来制定的政策也不会消失。”

paras.en: Hamas attack as a turning point for Israel and Iran
paras.zh: 哈马斯袭击是以色列和伊朗的转折点

paras.en: The current consensus on Iran can be traced to the Hamas terror attack three years ago. Before the assault, according to Navid Toobian from the US-based Middle East Media Research Institute, many believed Israel should deal with the Islamic Republic "in a limited and managed way" and confront only the arms of the so-called "Axis of Resistance." But October 7 completely changed the rules of the game.
paras.zh: 目前关于伊朗问题的共识可以追溯到三年前的哈马斯恐怖袭击事件。总部位于美国的中东媒体研究所的纳维德·托比安表示，在袭击发生之前，许多人认为以色列应该“以有限和有管理的方式”与伊斯兰共和国打交道，并且只对抗所谓“抵抗轴心”的武装。但10月7日彻底改变了游戏规则。

paras.en: While Israel had been aware of Iran's slogans calling for its destruction, it was believed that such calls had an "internal aspect" to rally the base of hardcore Islamists in Iran, Toobian said.
paras.zh: 图比安说，虽然以色列已经意识到伊朗呼吁摧毁其国家的口号，但人们相信这种呼吁具有“内部意义”，可以团结伊朗的铁杆伊斯兰主义者。

paras.en: The terror strike by the Iran-allied Hamas, however, showed that Tehran "spares no effort to strike Israel."
paras.zh: 然而，伊朗盟友哈马斯的恐怖袭击表明，德黑兰“不遗余力地打击以色列”。

paras.en: What are US and Israel hoping to achieve in the Iran war?
paras.zh: 美国和以色列希望在伊朗战争中达到什么目的？

paras.en: Damon Golriz, a researcher at the Hague Institute for Geopolitics, also points to October 7 as the trigger of the "largest historical trauma of the Jewish nation."
paras.zh: 海牙地缘政治研究所研究员达蒙·戈尔里兹也指出，10 月 7 日是“犹太民族最大的历史创伤”的触发点。

paras.en: "Preserving Iran's nuclear ambitions and continuous threats against Israel has intensified this fear that for a large portion of Israeli society, today's rulers in Iran have become a symbol of a historical threat," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“保留伊朗的核野心和对以色列的持续威胁加剧了以色列社会大部分人的担忧，即今天的伊朗统治者已成为历史威胁的象征。”

paras.en: With that in mind, the current US and Israeli policy towards Iran follows three vectors, according to Golriz.
paras.zh: 戈尔里兹表示，考虑到这一点，美国和以色列目前对伊朗的政策遵循三个方向。

paras.en: "First, the removal of the regime's leaders; second, industrial and infrastructural collapse," and third, orchestrating a civil war and what he called "geographic scissors" to dismember Iran with the help of armed Kurdish and Baluch separatists, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，“首先，推翻政权领导人；其次，工业和基础设施崩溃”；第三，在库尔德和俾路支武装分裂分子的帮助下，策划一场内战和他所谓的“地理剪刀”来肢解伊朗。

paras.en: The US and Israel, however, are not the only players in the conflict. In a recent report, the Reuters news agency cited senior Iranian security officials as saying that Tehran has prepared detailed operational plans for retaliatory strikes. Tehran warned that their retaliatory tools include destroying undersea fiber-optic communication cables in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, alongside targeting US-dependent data centers and AI infrastructure in the region.
paras.zh: 然而，美国和以色列并不是这场冲突的唯一参与者。路透社在最近的一篇报道中援引伊朗高级安全官员的话说，德黑兰已经制定了详细的报复性打击行动计划。德黑兰警告称，他们的报复工具包括摧毁波斯湾和霍尔木兹海峡的海底光纤通信电缆，同时瞄准该地区依赖美国的数据中心和人工智能基础设施。

paras.en: Commenting on possible alternatives to military escalation, Golriz highlights a diplomatic opportunity that opened six months ago in Islamabad, when Tehran agreed to never initiate war or military operations against Israel.
paras.zh: 在评论军事升级的可能替代方案时，戈尔里兹强调了六个月前在伊斯兰堡开启的外交机会，当时德黑兰同意永远不对以色列发动战争或军事行动。

paras.en: "For the first time in the history of the Islamic Republic, the fundamental national security interests of Israel were signed by the presidents of Iran and the United States," according to Gorliz.
paras.zh: 戈尔利兹表示：“伊朗和美国总统签署了以色列基本国家安全利益协议，这在伊斯兰共和国历史上尚属首次。”

paras.en: The first article of the Islamabad framework could have been "the beginning of the end for 'Death to America' slogans and anti-Jewish threats, including 'Death to Israel," Golriz said.
paras.zh: 戈尔里兹说，伊斯兰堡框架的第一篇文章可能是“‘美国去死’口号和反犹太威胁（包括‘以色列去死’）终结的开始。”

paras.en: This diplomatic window was quickly closed, but "with political will, the provisions and spirit of the Islamabad Memorandum will be the first strategic step toward lasting peace," he said.
paras.zh: 这个外交窗口很快就关闭了，但“只要有政治意愿，《伊斯兰堡备忘录》的条款和精神将成为实现持久和平的第一步战略步骤，”他说。

paras.en: But INSS senior fellow Citrinovitch was less optimistic when assessing the willingness of Israeli elites to return to diplomacy.
paras.zh: 但 INSS 高级研究员 Citrinovitch 在评估以色列精英重返外交的意愿时并不乐观。

paras.en: "Currently, returning to the nuclear deal has no place in Israel's political arena," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“目前，以色列政治舞台上没有重返核协议的空间。”

articles.title: Myanmar: Is the US undermining the EU's diplomatic blockade?

paras.en: The US government has begun a quiet reproachment with Myanmar's military-backed government, holding two rounds of talks since September with State Department representative Michael Vance. American diplomats reportedly meet Myanmar officials in Naypyitaw and then in Tokyo earlier this month.
paras.zh: 美国政府已开始悄悄指责缅甸军方支持的政府，自9月份以来与国务院代表迈克尔·万斯举行了两轮会谈。据报道，美国外交官本月早些时候在内比都和东京会见了缅甸官员。

paras.en: Washington wants to tackle online scam centers, secure the release of imprisoned American businessman Adam Castillo, and potentially gain access to Myanmar's rare-earth resources. The market for the valuable minerals is currently controlled by the US rival China.
paras.zh: 华盛顿希望打击网络诈骗中心，确保被监禁的美国商人亚当·卡斯蒂略获释，并有可能获得缅甸的稀土资源。这些贵重矿物的市场目前由美国的竞争对手中国控制。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Southeast Asian governments are also increasingly questioning their policy of isolating Myanmar's military leadership. Multiple countries have already renewed direct diplomatic contacts.
paras.zh: 与此同时，东南亚各国政府也越来越多地质疑其孤立缅甸军事领导层的政策。多个国家已经恢复了直接外交接触。

paras.en: The EU, however, continues to reject the legitimacy of the military junta in the war-torn country. The European bloc has also remained unmoved by the 2025/2026 election, which ended with military chief Min Aung Hlaing becoming the president. The military retains control over the political system.
paras.zh: 然而，欧盟继续否认这个饱受战争蹂躏的国家军政府的合法性。欧洲集团对 2025/2026 年选举也无动于衷，最终军事领导人敏昂莱 (Min Aung Hlaing) 就任总统。军方保留对政治体系的控制权。

paras.en: The EU responded to Myanmar's February 2021 military coup by suspending direct financial assistance to the government, imposing targeted sanctions and sharply reducing diplomatic engagement with the military authorities.
paras.zh: 欧盟对缅甸 2021 年 2 月军事政变的回应是暂停对政府的直接财政援助、实施有针对性的制裁并大幅减少与军事当局的外交接触。

paras.en: Its sanctions currently cover 105 individuals and 22 entities connected to the military. In April, the EU extended these measures for another 12 months.
paras.zh: 目前，其制裁对象包括 105 名个人和 22 家与军方有关的实体。 4 月，欧盟将这些措施再延长 12 个月。

paras.en: At the same time, Brussels is providing humanitarian assistance to displaced communities and Rohingya refugees and is supporting civil society organizations.
paras.zh: 与此同时，布鲁塞尔正在向流离失所社区和罗兴亚难民提供人道主义援助，并支持民间社会组织。

paras.en: The EU also stopped short of withdrawing Myanmar's preferential trade access because of concerns about the consequences for workers, particularly the mostly young women employed in the country's garment industry. Last year, bilateral goods trade was worth about €4 billion ($4.46 billion), up from €3.4 billion in 2019.
paras.zh: 欧盟也没有取消缅甸的优惠贸易准入，因为担心对工人，特别是该国服装业就业的年轻女性造成的后果。去年，双边货物贸易额约为 40 亿欧元（44.6 亿美元），高于 2019 年的 34 亿欧元。

paras.en: The civil war triggered by the 2021 coup has killed an estimated 100,000 people. Rebel groups still control or contest large swathes of Myanmar, and over 4 million people have been internally displaced, according to UN data.
paras.zh: 2021 年政变引发的内战已造成估计 10 万人死亡。根据联合国的数据，叛乱组织仍然控制或争夺缅甸大片地区，超过 400 万人在国内流离失所。

paras.en: The EU "continues to uphold its policy of non-recognition of the current military regime," in view of "the ongoing violence and the attack against its own population," an EU spokesman told DW.
paras.zh: 一位欧盟发言人告诉德国之声，鉴于“针对其本国人民的暴力和袭击仍在持续”，欧盟“继续坚持不承认现军政权的政策”。

paras.en: At the same time, the bloc "is closely monitoring developments in the discussions and positions of the United States, Japan, ASEAN countries and other major actors with representatives of Myanmar's military regime."
paras.zh: 与此同时，该集团“正在密切关注美国、日本、东盟国家和其他主要参与者与缅甸军政权代表的讨论和立场的进展”。

paras.en: "It also supports ASEAN efforts, in particular the Five-Point Consensus, which has yet to be fully implemented," the spokesperson added, referring to the peace deal proposed by the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) in 2021.
paras.zh: 发言人补充说：“它还支持东盟的努力，特别是尚未全面落实的五点共识。”他指的是东南亚国家联盟（东盟）在2021年提出的和平协议。

paras.en: Myanmar diplomats reach out to European partners
paras.zh: 缅甸外交官与欧洲伙伴接触

paras.en: In the aftermath of the coup, ASEAN took the unprecedented decision to exclude Myanmar's military leaders from its highest-level meetings after the junta failed to implement the regional peace plan.
paras.zh: 政变后，由于军政府未能执行地区和平计划，东盟做出了史无前例的决定，将缅甸军事领导人排除在最高级别会议之外。

paras.en: However, ASEAN's position is showing signs of change. Some member states, most notably Myanmar's neighbor Thailand, signal growing frustration with the lack of progress towards ending Myanmar's civil war.
paras.zh: 然而，东盟的立场正在出现变化的迹象。一些成员国，特别是缅甸的邻国泰国，对结束缅甸内战缺乏进展表示越来越失望。

paras.en: Last week, Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow welcomed Washington's renewed engagement and suggested that ASEAN members would hold substantive discussions about Myanmar's future at their summit in Manila next month.
paras.zh: 上周，泰国外交部长西哈萨克·庞克乔对华盛顿的重新参与表示欢迎，并建议东盟成员国将在下个月的马尼拉峰会上就缅甸的未来进行实质性讨论。

paras.en: Myanmar's authorities are also seeking to break their diplomatic isolation. In September, Myanmar's leader Hlaing gave an interview to Time magazine, his first with a major Western publication since the coup, as part of an apparent effort to rebuild relations with Western governments.
paras.zh: 缅甸当局也在寻求打破外交孤立。 9月，缅甸领导人莱接受了《时代》杂志的采访，这是自政变以来他首次接受西方主要出版物的采访，这显然是重建与西方政府关系的努力的一部分。

paras.en: On October 22, Burma Campaign UK, a London-based human rights organization, accused the British government of making a "significant shift in approach" after the British Foreign Office hosted Win Zeyar Tun, the charge d'affaires of Myanmar's military-controlled embassy in London, at an ASEAN diplomatic gathering days earlier.
paras.zh: 10 月 22 日，总部位于伦敦的人权组织“缅甸运动英国”指责英国外交部在几天前的东盟外交聚会上接待了缅甸军方控制的驻伦敦大使馆临时代办温泽亚敦后，英国政府在做法上做出了“重大转变”。

paras.en: According to an article published by Intelligence Online this month, the regime's charge d'affaires in Brussels, Khin Thidar Ay, has also sought contacts with European politicians, including Czech MEP Ondrej Dostal, a member of the European Parliament's delegation for Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 据《情报在线》本月发表的一篇文章称，该政权驻布鲁塞尔临时代办钦蒂达尔·艾(Khin Thidar Ay)还寻求与欧洲政界人士接触，其中包括欧洲议会东南亚代表团成员、捷克议员翁德雷·多斯塔尔(Ondrej Dostal)。

paras.en: EU's isolation 'has achieved relatively little'
paras.zh: 欧盟的孤立“收效相对较小”

paras.en: Kristina Kironska, of Palacky University Olomouc in the Czech Republic and an expert on the EU's policy on Myanmar, told DW that the EU has little reason to follow Washington's apparent shift towards engagement with the Myanmar junta.
paras.zh: 捷克奥洛穆茨帕拉茨基大学的欧盟缅甸政策专家克里斯蒂娜·基龙斯卡(Kristina Kironska)告诉德国之声，欧盟没有理由追随华盛顿与缅甸军政府接触的明显转变。

paras.en: The US strategy "appears to be pursuing specific interests" such as rare earth mining and cybercrime, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，美国的战略“似乎是在追求特定利益”，例如稀土开采和网络犯罪。

paras.en: However, the most important rare earth mining operations are no longer controlled by the military, but by rebels such as the Kachin Independence Organization in Kachin State. "It remains to be seen what the US can achieve through negotiations with the junta," she said.
paras.zh: 然而，最重要的稀土开采作业不再由军方控制，而是由克钦邦克钦独立组织等叛乱分子控制。 “美国通过与军政府的谈判能取得什么成果还有待观察，”她说。

paras.en: The EU has long positioned itself as a defender of democracy and human rights in Myanmar, "so abandoning this now because the US is exploring a new, perhaps more transactional approach would undermine the EU's credibility," Kironska added.
paras.zh: 欧盟长期以来一直将自己定位为缅甸民主和人权的捍卫者，“因此现在放弃这一点，因为美国正在探索一种新的、也许更具交易性的方法，这将损害欧盟的信誉，”基龙斯卡补充道。

paras.en: "At the same time, isolation has achieved relatively little. The question is therefore not whether the EU should engage, but rather with whom and under what conditions."
paras.zh: “与此同时，孤立收效甚微。因此，问题不在于欧盟是否应该接触，而在于与谁接触以及在什么条件下接触。”

paras.en: Balancing act between Myanmar's rebels and junta
paras.zh: 缅甸叛军与军政府之间的平衡

paras.en: The EU is forced to consider risks to its own influence. If Washington, ASEAN governments and other regional powers increase their engagement with Myanmar's authorities, the EU risks becoming increasingly marginal in discussions about the country's political future.
paras.zh: 欧盟被迫考虑自身影响力面临的风险。如果华盛顿、东盟各国政府和其他地区大国加强与缅甸当局的接触，欧盟就有可能在有关该国政治未来的讨论中变得越来越边缘化。

paras.en: Yet greater engagement with the military could undermine Brussels' relations with Myanmar's democratic opposition and ethnic resistance organizations, many of which control substantial territory.
paras.zh: 然而，与军方的更多接触可能会破坏布鲁塞尔与缅甸民主反对派和民族抵抗组织的关系，其中许多组织控制着大片领土。

paras.en: "The key question for Brussels is whether it can remain a credible defender of democratic change while ensuring that it still has a meaningful voice in the negotiations that will determine Myanmar's future," Sabe Soe, director of the NGO Burma Centre Prague, told DW.
paras.zh: 非政府组织布拉格缅甸中心主任萨贝·索（Sabe Soe）告诉德国之声：“布鲁塞尔面临的关键问题是，它能否继续成为民主变革的可靠捍卫者，同时确保在决定缅甸未来的谈判中仍然拥有有意义的发言权。”

paras.en: One possibility is for Brussels to maintain its sanctions against military leaders and their businesses while expanding diplomacy through ASEAN, the UN and other regional partners. The EU could also tie any easing of restrictions to humanitarian access, improvements in political freedoms and progress towards peace.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是布鲁塞尔维持对军事领导人及其企业的制裁，同时通过东盟、联合国和其他区域伙伴扩大外交。欧盟还可以将限制的放松与人道主义准入、政治自由的改善以及和平的进展联系起来。

paras.en: Soe also suggested that the EU could pursue economic engagement in areas administered by revolutionary and ethnic resistance forces, offering an alternative to engagement centred on the military authorities in Naypyidaw.
paras.zh: 索伊还建议，欧盟可以在革命和民族抵抗力量管理的地区寻求经济参与，为以内比都军事当局为中心的参与提供替代方案。

paras.en: This approach would allow the EU to remain involved in Myanmar's future without necessarily recognizing its military-backed government, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，这种做法将使欧盟能够继续参与缅甸的未来，而不必承认其军方支持的政府。

paras.en: For now, Brussels seems to have little appetite for a fundamental policy rethink. But this could change as more governments reopen their doors to Myanmar's generals.
paras.zh: 目前，布鲁塞尔似乎对重新思考基本政策没有兴趣。但随着更多政府向缅甸将军重新敞开大门，这种情况可能会改变。

articles.title: Lula’s victory echoes across BRICS after fears of a Bolsonaro win

paras.en: When Brazil’s President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva scored his surprise election victory on Sunday, winning an unprecedented fourth term in office, his supporters were euphoric.
paras.zh: 当巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦周日意外取得选举胜利，史无前例地赢得第四个任期时，他的支持者欣喜若狂。

paras.en: The joy they felt over Lula’s victory has echoed across large parts of the Global South – and could restore some hope to the grouping that has sought to give emerging countries a greater stake on the world stage, the BRICS alliance.
paras.zh: 他们对卢拉胜利的喜悦感回响在全球南方大部分地区 — — 并可能给金砖国家联盟重新燃起一些希望，金砖国家联盟一直致力于让新兴国家在世界舞台上拥有更大的利益。

paras.en: At a time when United States President Donald Trump is seeking to reassert US power and has cast BRICS as a threat to US interests, Lula’s victory in Brazil offers the alliance a measure of political reassurance, experts say.
paras.zh: 专家表示，在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普寻求重申美国实力并将金砖国家视为对美国利益的威胁之际，卢拉在巴西的胜利为该联盟提供了一定程度的政治保证。

paras.en: A win by his rival, Flavio Bolsonaro, could have threatened Brazil’s commitment to the bloc, given his links to Trump and calls to reconsider the country’s role in BRICS.
paras.zh: 鉴于他的竞争对手弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗与特朗普的联系以及重新考虑巴西在金砖国家中角色的呼吁，他的胜利可能会威胁到巴西对欧盟的承诺。

paras.en: Instead, Lula’s return gives the grouping one fewer reason to fear a retreat from within – as it continues to help forge a more multipolar future for a world dominated by the US.
paras.zh: 相反，卢拉的回归让该组织不再有理由担心内部撤退 — — 因为它继续帮助美国主导的世界打造一个更加多极化的未来。

paras.en: As Esmat Zaidan, professor of public policy at Qatar’s Hamad Bin Khalifa University, told Al Jazeera, “The victory of Lula is important to BRICS’ political continuation in the current climate as it seeks to increase the bloc’s role and make it stronger in global governance.”
paras.zh: 正如卡塔尔哈马德·本·哈利法大学公共政策教授埃斯马特·扎伊丹（Esmat Zaidan）告诉半岛电视台的那样，“卢拉的胜利对于金砖国家在当前气候下的政治延续非常重要，因为金砖国家寻求增强金砖集团的作用并使其在全球治理中更加强大。”

paras.en: It was clear to analysts that Lula’s win would safeguard the continuation of the BRICS alliance, while under Bolsonaro, its future may have floundered.
paras.zh: 分析人士很清楚，卢拉的胜利将保障金砖国家联盟的延续，而在博尔索纳罗的领导下，金砖国家联盟的未来可能陷入困境。

paras.en: Lula himself was one of the architects of the bloc when it was founded nearly two decades ago, and has sought to advance its role on the global stage.
paras.zh: 卢拉本人是近二十年前欧盟成立时的缔造者之一，并一直寻求提升其在全球舞台上的作用。

paras.en: According to Zaidan, Bolsonaro’s desire to reconsider Brazil’s participation in BRICS and instead pursue closer alignment with Washington would have weakened the bloc’s political cohesion and potentially slowed cooperation on trade and financial reform.
paras.zh: 扎伊丹表示，博尔索纳罗希望重新考虑巴西加入金砖国家，转而寻求与华盛顿更紧密的联盟，这将削弱该集团的政治凝聚力，并可能减缓贸易和金融改革方面的合作。

paras.en: Bolsonaro had reportedly also promised the US Trade Representative that Brazil’s Pix instant payment system would stay out of non-Western payment schemes, as the US seeks to safeguard global dominance of the dollar, said Imran Khalid, a geostrategic analyst and senior fellow at Foreign Policy in Focus.
paras.zh: 据报道，博尔索纳罗还向美国贸易代表承诺，巴西的 Pix 即时支付系统将不会参与非西方支付计划，因为美国寻求维护美元的全球主导地位，焦点外交政策高级研究员伊姆兰·哈立德表示。

paras.en: “BRICS makes decisions by consensus, so one unwilling founding member can slow everything down from the inside. That was the real risk, more than Brazil walking out,” Khalid told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “金砖国家通过协商一致做出决定，因此一个不情愿的创始成员可以从内部放慢一切。这才是真正的风险，比巴西退出更危险，”哈立德告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Still, Zaidan cautioned that continuity of the alliance does not amount to total unity within.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，扎伊丹警告说，联盟的连续性并不意味着内部完全团结。

paras.en: “The member countries of BRICS have distinctly different economic interests and geopolitical goals,” he said. “Therefore, while Lula’s victory makes it easier for the BRICS bloc to continue working towards a common agenda, his election did not eliminate these distinct differences.”
paras.zh: “金砖国家成员国有着明显不同的经济利益和地缘政治目标，”他说。 “因此，虽然卢拉的胜利使金砖国家集团更容易继续努力实现共同议程，但他的当选并没有消除这些明显的分歧。”

paras.en: Guy Burton, a geopolitical and policy analyst, agreed that the bloc’s differences will remain unchanged with Brazil’s election result.
paras.zh: 地缘政治和政策分析师盖伊·伯顿（Guy Burton）同意，随着巴西大选结果的变化，欧盟的分歧将保持不变。

paras.en: “BRICS matters because it represents a large share of the world’s population, economy and trade. But it has never really acted as a political unit. Its members are too different,” he said.
paras.zh: “金砖国家很重要，因为它代表了世界人口、经济和贸易的很大一部分。但它从未真正作为一个政治单位发挥作用。其成员差异太大，”他说。

paras.en: “The bloc now includes Iran and the UAE, which sit on opposite sides of the current war. That tells you how limited its cohesion is,” Burton added.
paras.zh: “该集团现在包括伊朗和阿联酋，它们在当前战争中处于对立面。这表明它的凝聚力有多么有限，”伯顿补充道。

paras.en: More multipolarity, but not a counterweight to Washington
paras.zh: 更多多极化，但无法制衡华盛顿

paras.en: The apparent relief in the Global South to Lula’s win reflects a broader concern among many emerging economies about their exposure to decisions made in Washington, “particularly regarding trade, tariffs and international economic relations,” said Zaidan.
paras.zh: 扎伊丹表示，卢拉获胜让南半球国家明显松了口气，反映出许多新兴经济体对华盛顿决策的影响更加广泛的担忧，“特别是在贸易、关税和国际经济关系方面”。

paras.en: “For these countries, the issue is not necessarily opposition to the US. It is about having greater room to make independent decisions and avoiding excessive dependence on any single global power,” he said.
paras.zh: “对这些国家来说，问题不一定是反对美国。问题在于拥有更大的独立决策空间，避免过度依赖任何单一全球大国，”他说。

paras.en: Khalid pointed to China and Russia’s support for Lula, with Xi Jinping backing him against outside interference, and the Kremlin praising his work for the BRICS alliance.
paras.zh: 哈立德指出了中国和俄罗斯对卢拉的支持，习近平支持他反对外部干涉，克里姆林宫赞扬了他为金砖国家联盟所做的工作。

paras.en: “Most of these countries do not want a fight with the United States; they want the freedom to say no to Washington without being punished for it,” he explained.
paras.zh: “这些国家中的大多数不想与美国发生冲突；他们希望有向华盛顿说不的自由，而不会因此受到惩罚，”他解释道。

paras.en: “A strong Brazil inside BRICS helps protect that freedom.”
paras.zh: “金砖国家内部强大的巴西有助于保护这种自由。”

paras.en: Lula has long advocated for a more multipolar international system, in which emerging economies have a stronger voice when it comes to shaping international rules and institutions, added Zaidan.
paras.zh: 扎伊丹补充道，卢拉长期以来一直主张建立更加多极的国际体系，让新兴经济体在制定国际规则和机构方面拥有更强的发言权。

paras.en: Burton said even countries and regions beyond the Global South are looking to lessen their reliance on Washington, including Europe, which is building its own security against Russia and in support of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 伯顿表示，即使是南半球以外的国家和地区也在寻求减少对华盛顿的依赖，包括欧洲，欧洲正在建立自己的安全体系以对抗俄罗斯并支持乌克兰。

paras.en: “So states, whether in the Western camp or not, have accepted that they must pursue their own interests. That means working with whoever they can. We are moving into a genuinely multipolar world,” he said.
paras.zh: “因此，无论是否属于西方阵营，各国都承认它们必须追求自己的利益。这意味着与任何可以合作的人合作。我们正在进入一个真正的多极世界，”他说。

paras.en: Still, BRICS’ diversity and its member states’ varied interests have meant it has never been a coherent counterweight to the West, experts said.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，专家表示，金砖国家的多样性及其成员国的不同利益意味着它从来都无法对西方形成一致的制衡作用。

paras.en: Many in the alliance maintain strong economic and security relationships with the US, said Zaidan.
paras.zh: 扎伊丹表示，联盟中许多国家与美国保持着牢固的经济和安全关系。

paras.en: “I would see Lula’s victory as strengthening the case for strategic autonomy rather than confrontation with Washington,” said the professor.
paras.zh: 这位教授表示：“我认为卢拉的胜利加强了战略自主权，而不是与华盛顿的对抗。”

paras.en: “BRICS is potentially more effective when it expands the choices available to its members, rather than defining itself simply through opposition to the United States.”
paras.zh: “当金砖国家扩大其成员国的选择范围时，它可能会更有效，而不是仅仅通过反对美国来定义自己。”

paras.en: Burton agreed, pointing to Brazil’s changing ties with Trump over the years.
paras.zh: 伯顿对此表示同意，并指出多年来巴西与特朗普关系的变化。

paras.en: “Russia and China are the obvious US rivals. But India under Modi long had a close relationship with Washington, and with Trump in particular, even if that has weakened recently,” he said.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯和中国是美国明显的竞争对手。但莫迪领导下的印度长期以来与华盛顿，特别是与特朗普的关系密切，尽管这种关系最近有所减弱，”他说。

paras.en: “Brazil, too, was close to Trump under Jair Bolsonaro, Flavio Bolsonaro’s father, when he was in office.”
paras.zh: “在弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗的父亲贾尔·博尔索纳罗执政期间，巴西也与特朗普关系密切。”

paras.en: Among the BRICS’ many ambitions is to promote trade in local currencies rather than the US dollar – and Lula’s victory could provide the political foundation to build on these efforts, said Zaidan, given that Brazil is one of the largest trading economies in the bloc.
paras.zh: 扎伊丹表示，金砖国家的众多目标之一是促进以本币而非美元进行的贸易，而卢拉的胜利可以为这些努力奠定政治基础，因为巴西是金砖国家最大的贸易经济体之一。

paras.en: Khalid said that after the alliance scrapped the idea of a common BRICS currency at its most recent summit in New Delhi in September, its ambition for trade in local currencies has become far more viable.
paras.zh: 哈立德表示，金砖五国联盟在 9 月份在新德里举行的最近一次峰会上放弃了金砖国家共同货币的想法后，其以当地货币进行贸易的雄心变得更加可行。

paras.en: “If the [BRICS’ New Development Bank] moves towards its goal of 30 percent of lending in member currencies, and Brazil and China settle more trade in reais and yuan as they agreed in 2023, reliance on the dollar falls step by step, without an open confrontation,” he explained.
paras.zh: 他解释说：“如果（金砖国家新开发银行）实现以成员国货币发放贷款 30% 的目标，并且巴西和中国按照 2023 年商定的那样以雷亚尔和人民币结算更多贸易，那么对美元的依赖将逐步下降，而不会出现公开对抗。”

paras.en: But Zaidan said that political will alone is not enough.
paras.zh: 但扎伊丹表示，仅靠政治意愿是不够的。

paras.en: “Countries also need reliable payment infrastructure, sufficient currency liquidity, appropriate financial regulations, and businesses willing to use these arrangements,” he said.
paras.zh: “各国还需要可靠的支付基础设施、充足的货币流动性、适当的金融监管以及愿意使用这些安排的企业，”他说。

paras.en: For now the dollar reigns supreme in foreign exchange transactions, and there may be no tipping point for another decade or so, Burton said.
paras.zh: 伯顿表示，目前美元在外汇交易中占据主导地位，未来十年左右可能不会出现转折点。

paras.en: Ultimately, though, Lula’s victory could help BRICS move from political discussions towards more practical financial cooperation, while reducing dollar dependence will be “gradual, uneven and driven as much by economic feasibility as by geopolitical ambition”, said Zaidan.
paras.zh: 不过，扎伊丹表示，最终，卢拉的胜利可能有助于金砖国家从政治讨论转向更实际的金融合作，同时减少美元依赖将是“渐进的、不均衡的，并受到经济可行性和地缘政治野心的推动”。

paras.en: How Washington reacts to this is another variable; Trump’s government sits at the contradiction of wanting to remain the world’s superpower, while also retreating to a more protectionist America-first role, said Burton.
paras.zh: 华盛顿对此有何反应是另一个变量。伯顿表示，特朗普政府面临着一个矛盾，一方面想保持世界超级大国的地位，另一方面又退回到更加保护主义的“美国优先”角色。

paras.en: “Developments such as Lula’s re-election will only sharpen the pressures already building in the Global North,” said the expert.
paras.zh: 这位专家表示：“卢拉连任等事态发展只会加剧北半球已经存在的压力。”

articles.title: Spain deports migrants from Ceuta in move criticised by rights group

paras.en: Spain has deported more than a dozen migrants from its North African enclave of Ceuta, prompting criticism from Amnesty International, which said Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez’s left-wing government was endangering their human rights.
paras.zh: 西班牙从其北非飞地休达驱逐了十几名移民，引发国际特赦组织的批评，称总理佩德罗·桑切斯的左翼政府正在危害他们的人权。

paras.en: It was the first deportation of its kind since a mass border crossing into the territory from Morocco in July.
paras.zh: 这是自七月份从摩洛哥大规模越境进入该领土以来的首次此类驱逐。

paras.en: The Spanish Interior Ministry said on Tuesday that it had deported the migrants from Ceuta after their asylum applications were rejected, and that Morocco had agreed to receive them.
paras.zh: 西班牙内政部周二表示，在庇护申请被拒绝后，已将这些移民从休达驱逐出境，摩洛哥已同意接收他们。

paras.en: Nongovernmental organisations (NGOs) told the Reuters news agency that 16 people from African, Middle Eastern and Asian countries had been deported.
paras.zh: 非政府组织（NGO）告诉路透社，来自非洲、中东和亚洲国家的 16 人已被驱逐出境。

paras.en: About 80,000 people entered from Morocco over a 48-hour period in late July. At least 100 people died during the mass crossing into the autonomous city, which covers just 18.5 square kilometres (7.2sq miles) and has a population of about 80,000.
paras.zh: 7月下旬，48小时内约有8万人从摩洛哥入境。大规模越境进入这座占地仅 18.5 平方公里（7.2 平方英里）、人口约 8 万的自治城市期间，至少有 100 人死亡。

paras.en: The crisis has evolved into a major political challenge for Sanchez, who is seeking re-election in snap polls scheduled for November 29.
paras.zh: 这场危机已演变成桑切斯面临的重大政治挑战，他正在定于 11 月 29 日举行的提前民意调查中寻求连任。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of protesters have gathered across Spain in recent months to denounce the government’s handling of the situation. Meanwhile, right-wing parties have used the crisis to attack Sanchez.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，数万名抗议者聚集在西班牙各地，谴责政府对局势的处理方式。与此同时，右翼政党利用这场危机攻击桑切斯。

paras.en: The leader of the far-right Vox Party, Santiago Abascal, has branded the prime minister a “traitor”.
paras.zh: 极右翼 Vox 党领导人圣地亚哥·阿巴斯卡尔 (Santiago Abascal) 将总理称为“叛徒”。

paras.en: Amnesty International has warned that the human rights of those deported from Ceuta on Tuesday could be at risk.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织警告称，周二被从休达驱逐出境的人的人权可能面临风险。

paras.en: “Spain, despite its [progressive] speeches in Europe, is not ensuring that human rights guarantees are met for people who cross its borders in Ceuta and Melilla,” said Virginia Alvarez, an Amnesty International researcher.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织研究员弗吉尼亚·阿尔瓦雷斯表示：“尽管西班牙在欧洲发表了[进步]言论，但它并没有确保在休达和梅利利亚跨越其边境的人们的人权得到保障。”

paras.en: “Morocco does not respect many human rights.”
paras.zh: “摩洛哥不尊重很多人权。”

paras.en: However, Madrid disputes the rights group’s accusations. In a statement, the interior ministry told Reuters that the European Union considers Morocco to be a safe country, adding that deportations are carried out “with all the necessary safeguards”.
paras.zh: 然而，马德里对人权组织的指控提出异议。内政部在一份声明中告诉路透社，欧盟认为摩洛哥是一个安全的国家，并补充说驱逐是在“一切必要的保障措施下”进行的。

paras.en: Most of those who entered Ceuta in late July left within days. However, about 8,000 migrants still remain. Some are sleeping on the streets, while others are being housed by Spain, charities and civil society groups.
paras.zh: 大多数七月底进入休达的人在几天内就离开了。然而，仍有约 8,000 名移民留存。一些人露宿街头，另一些人则被西班牙、慈善机构和民间社会团体安置。

articles.title: Protesters storm Serbian pro-Vucic TV station after his loss at polls

paras.en: Protesters stormed a Serbian television station supportive of former President Aleksandar Vucic, interrupting broadcasting to call for the arrest of its editor, as tens of thousands took to the streets for a second night of post-election celebrations late Monday after his defeat at the polls.
paras.zh: 抗议者袭击了支持前总统亚历山大·武契奇的塞尔维亚电视台，中断了广播，呼吁逮捕其编辑。周一晚间，数万人在前总统在民意调查中落败后走上街头，参加选举后的第二个晚上的庆祝活动。

paras.en: Live footage broadcast by Informer TV showed about 30 people entering its newsroom on Monday evening and surrounding editor-in-chief and owner Dragan Vucicevic. Some protesters shouted, “This is how it is in free Serbia!” and “Where is Vucic now?” Others called for Vucicevic’s arrest.
paras.zh: Informer TV 播放的现场录像显示，周一晚间约有 30 人进入其新闻编辑室，周围环绕着主编兼所有者 Dragan Vucicevic。一些抗议者高喊：“自由的塞尔维亚就是这样！”以及“武契奇现在在哪里？”其他人则呼吁逮捕武西切维奇。

paras.en: On his personal Instagram account, Vucic, dressed in a jumper displaying the crossed-out word “sorry”, called the incident an attack on free speech and the freedom of journalism.
paras.zh: 武契奇在他的个人Instagram账户上身穿一件套头衫，上面写着“抱歉”，他称这一事件是对言论自由和新闻自由的攻击。

paras.en: Serbia’s Student List, born out of a student-led anticorruption protest movement, defeated Vucic’s alliance in a historic election on Sunday, bringing to an end his party’s 14-year grip on power.
